articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.

A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.

To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Niterra President and CEO Mike Schwab on ‘Delivering Trusted Solutions’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Mike Schwab, president and CEO, Niterra North America, Inc.

Schwab said Niterra has evolved well beyond its roots as an ignition specialist while maintaining the quality and reliability associated with its NGK brand. Today, Niterra’s automotive portfolio extends beyond spark plugs to include ignition coils, wire sets, NTK oxygen and technical sensors and rotating electrical products such as starters and alternators. Schwab emphasized that this expansion is about more than adding product categories. By leveraging its engineering expertise, OEM relationships and aftermarket partnerships, Niterra is building on its reputation to deliver solutions trusted by professional technicians and customers.

Schwab emphasized that execution means consistently delivering on commitments involving product availability, customer service and new product introductions. articles.title: OEC Launches Largest Parts Marketplace for U.S. Repair Shops
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: OEConnection LLC (OEC), a leading global technology provider for the automotive aftersales industry, has announced the launch of the first marketplace to bring all major part types together, giving U.S. repair shops one place to source OE, aftermarket and tires. PartsTech already connects shops to 240-plus aftermarket suppliers, 60-plus tire suppliers, and distributor-sponsored promotional programs. Now, through the integration of RepairLink, PartsTech adds nearly 9,000 OE dealers across all 50 states and OE-sponsored promotional programs from 14-plus OE brands. Every major part type is now available in a single search, an industry first at this scale. The result is a faster, simpler ordering process for shops, along with greater reach for the suppliers and dealers who serve them.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Until now, shops typically sourced parts across multiple disconnected channels, with OE and aftermarket parts available only on separate platforms. With OE now in PartsTech through the RepairLink integration, parts from the shop’s preferred dealers appear in the same search results as aftermarket parts and tires, so shops can compare options and place orders in one workflow.

Shops simply connect their RepairLink account to PartsTech, which automatically adds the shop’s preferred OE dealers, including dealer pricing, to their parts search. The upgraded PartsTech marketplace features both the newly added OE-sponsored promotional programs, from RepairLink, and the existing aftermarket distributor-sponsored promotional programs.
Manufacturer-sourced OE diagrams are also now available in PartsTech, helping shops confirm the right part before they order.

“For too long, mechanical shops have had to work through a fragmented, error-prone parts procurement process that slows repair order times and, ultimately, hurts shop performance,” said Greg Kirber, senior vice president of Mechanical eCommerce at OEC. “The PartsTech and RepairLink integration changes that. Shops can now find and order every part they need, whether it’s aftermarket, OE or tires, in a single search and cart. This is something shops have requested for a long time, and we’re excited to deliver it.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: For dealers, the new marketplace puts their parts inventory in front of PartsTech’s network of 34,000-plus shops at the start of the ordering process, without changing how they manage orders. OE parts orders placed in PartsTech flow directly into the RepairLink Dealer Portal for review and approval. With sourcing consolidated in one platform, counter teams also handle fewer phone calls and manual lookups, freeing up time for sales and customer support.

“Shops want to spend less time sourcing parts and more time repairing vehicles and serving their customers,” said Greg Rivera, president at OEC. “Through the RepairLink integration, PartsTech now connects their preferred OE dealers with their aftermarket and tire suppliers, while providing both OE- and distributor-sponsored promotions, all in one place. That’s time and margin back in the shop’s hands, and that’s what keeps a repair business growing.”

The all-part-types marketplace is available now to all U.S. repair shops through PartsTech and RepairLink dealers. Shops can connect their RepairLink account to PartsTech for free, and dealers on RepairLink are connected automatically.

articles.title: New Pro Spot Products Bring More Flexibility, Precision and Productivity to Collision Repair
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Pro Spot continues to expand its lineup of collision repair equipment with new technology designed to help body shops work more efficiently, improve repair quality and give technicians greater flexibility throughout the repair process. The latest additions include the PR-28U Ultrasonic Plastic Welder, PRO-101 Ion Hammer and PRO-99 Pro Pull + Cordless Dent Pullers, PLZ-1 Handheld Laser Welder and PSA-i5s Robotic Spot Welder. Each product addresses a different area of collision repair, bringing new capabilities to the shop while helping technicians handle repairs with greater control and consistency.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The new Ion Hammer (PRO-101) and Pro Pull + (PRO-99) cordless dent pullers give technicians the freedom to bring the tool directly to the repair, without being tethered to a power cord or stationary workstation. Whether working on a vehicle in the body shop or moving between repair areas, technicians can take the tool wherever it’s needed. Both systems deliver controlled pulling power designed to create a strong pull without burning through the backside of the panel.

The PR-28U Ultrasonic Plastic Welder adds another option for repairing modern vehicle plastics, including bumper covers, brackets, clips, sensor mounts and headlamp tabs. Using high-frequency vibrations to fuse compatible thermoplastics, it creates strong bonds without filler materials or preheating. OEMs are also able to use this technology for many of their thermoplastic subassemblies.

The PLZ-1 Handheld Laser Welder brings laser welding technology to the collision repair environment, offering a fast, easy-to-learn solution for welding steel, stainless steel and aluminum. Its low heat input helps minimize the heat-affected area, while optional pre-weld and post-weld cleaning capabilities help improve weld quality and finish.

For shops looking to take the next step with automation, the first-of-its-kind PSA-i5s Robotic Spot Welder combines Pro Spot’s resistance spot welding technology with collaborative robot automation. Features such as automatic weld adjustment, easy on-gun programming, repeatable weld positioning and welding data capture help shops improve consistency, traceability and production efficiency with what can be called the world’s smartest tool balancer.
Together, these products give collision repair facilities more ways to tackle today’s repair challenges while preparing for the demands of tomorrow’s vehicles.
For more information, visit prospot.com.

articles.title: MSO CEOs on the right people for the right jobs, and some industry misconceptions
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: This year’s MSO Symposium brought together “the Four Aces” — the CEOs of Boyd Group, Caliber, Classic Collision, and Crash Champions —in Las Vegas on Monday, who ultimately landed on a simple conclusion: the collision repair industry depends on the right people fitting into the right roles.

When moderator Dan Risley asked what they’re hearing from investors and other stakeholders about the industry today, Boyd Group CEO Brian Kaner responded that the industry isn’t “recession-proof, but it is recession-resilient.”

“There are plenty of opportunities for us to continue to grow our businesses,” he said. “It all comes down to making sure you have the right people in the right roles with the right capabilities. And if you have that and you know how to keep score and you can win with the insurance carriers and you can take care of their customers and really be the extension of what they’re looking for, this is a great business to be in, and it’s something that we can continue to all thrive in.”

However, in response to a different question Risley posed about the “temperature” of each MSO’s team leaders, Crash Champions CEO Matt Ebert and Kaner agreed it’s a tense, stressful time for them, and made some important points about estimators.
Ebert said being an estimator, or as Crash Champions calls them, a service advisor, “has to be one of the most miserable spots.”

“You’ve got technicians bitching at you, you’ve got management or ownership bitching at you, you’ve got insurance companies bitching at you,” he said. “Everything you do gets criticized. Everything you do gets reviewed and sent back, and you have to do it again. I wouldn’t last a week. I would quit that job and tell you to shove it up your a**. If you want to know the temperature of our people, that is the truth.”

Ebert added that general managers also face pressure to keep customers, employees, and insurance companies happy while trying to make money and handle the safety, legal, and logistical pieces of their jobs.
Kaner said the industry has a “compelling opportunity” to invest in people.

“You’ve got to make investments in estimators,” he said. “We all make investments in technicians. I think one of the bigger gaps we have as an industry right now is in estimators. There’s not enough of them. There’s not enough of them that understand the metrics. There’s not enough of them that are salespeople that can go help actually go sell a consumer-paid job. …it’s a tense time and anytime when you’re in an environment where volume is tight, it just ups the pressure of the organization.”
Brad Anderson, who joined the collision repair industry in June to take over as CEO of Classic Collision, said he believes all jobs in the industry are hard.

“We put a lot on them, and I think all of us as an industry and ecosystem have to consider that it all crashes down to the people at the shop,” he said. “The small changes we make up here get really big when there’s 20 changes happening to the individual, whether it’s a tech, a GM, a service advisor, so we’ve got to simplify the work.”
During the discussion, Ebert also noted that 40-50% of MSO employees don’t touch a car, which he said “presents huge administrative opportunity,” another point he and Kaner agreed on.

“We have 15,000 people in our organization, and half of them are technicians and the other half are the people that are just trying to get the car to the back and do all the administrative things that they need to do to get it there,” Kaner said.
The conversation also touched on declining repairable claims volume, with Risley asking what’s missing from that narrative.

Caliber CEO David Simmons said the overall picture on repairable claims is probably a little more positive than the data that’s often quoted, “even though it is bad.” The primary misleading point, he said, is repairable claims data being viewed as representative of the market.

“If you allow yourself to be defined by repairable claims volumes, you have 30 years of history of insurance premium inflation in one year followed by claims frequency 12 to 18 months later,” he said. “And the pattern recognition in that 30-year data set would show that when you get into mid- to low-single-digit insurance premium inflation, which we’ve been in for several quarters now, you have a lag to low- to mid-single-digit claims frequency increase. There’s reasons for optimism that the old pattern holds, kind of offset by a structural shift with consumers because of the shock factor of insurance premium inflation.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: However, outside of insurance claims, one point remains: people are still getting their cars repaired, but they’re paying out of pocket, he said.

“We don’t track the juxtaposition of [the] increase in the dollar value of direct customer pay against the decrease in repairable claims and the dollar value of that,” Simmons said. “If you look at that, the total market has come down, but it’s a lot different dynamic. Now we’re built to service the insurance carrier, so it requires some adaptation to get at this customer pay. But if you want, we have to adapt, but if one’s willing to adapt, that market segment is there, and it’s growing, it’s growing robustly.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Simmons said he would love to see Mitchell and CCC “come together with a combined audited data set that is as close to accurate as possible on what’s really going on with claims, total losses, repairable claims, and segments of claims.”
Kaner said he thinks one thing people miss is that what’s happening in the industry isn’t all that different from what’s been happening.
“It’s like any ecosystem; something that happens can have a negative effect downstream, and this industry has the same thing,” he said.

In this case, “a very precipitous increase in premiums that then put consumers on heightened alert,” Kaner said, causing them to raise their deductibles, drop coverage, or not file a claim for fear of a large premium increase.

“But if you look at what’s happening in the environment, the underlying claims themselves, i.e., we call for a claims environment to be down 2%,” he said. “I think the claims environment driven by the ADAS systems, collision avoidance systems, is probably just that. What’s happened is the propensity to file a claim over that two-year period of time is really what’s driven much of the negative in the industry. And as that starts to work itself out of the system, you’re starting to see the claims environment come back again.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Kaner added that too much is ascribed to collision avoidance systems.

“We as an industry have to do a really good job of making sure people don’t hear things like, ‘Oh, well, front-end collisions are down 40%.’ Well, front-end collisions are down 40% in the cars that actually have that technology in them,” he said. “The reality is, for that technology to bleed through the system takes quite a while… Anything that happens new in a car takes 20 years to get all the way through the system.”
Risley also asked the group what the biggest threat to the collision repair industry is. Three out of the four responded, “ourselves.” Anderson’s take was technology.

articles.title: Annual Red Carpet Awards recognize excellence in leadership, education, and advocacy
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards, held Tuesday during SEMA Week in Las Vegas, honored several individuals in the collision repair industry for their dedication to safe and proper repairs; education and training; consumer advocacy; and doing the right thing.

The Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) honored Petra Schroeder, known to the industry as “Collisionista,” with the 2026 Humanitarian Award for a relentlessness never to stop giving to the industry.

“There are people who talk about giving back, and there are people who just quietly get to work, people who answer the phone when someone needs help, who encourage someone who’s trying to find their place in the industry, and who remind us that sometimes the most meaningful thing we can do for another person is simply show up,” said SCRS Board Member Kena Dacus, when co-presenting the award. “Our recipient has spent a lifetime doing exactly that.”
Past SCRS Chair and co-presenter Amber Alley added that Schroeder’s mentoring, advocacy, and generosity have never stopped, and her impact has kept growing with a genuine love for the industry.

“I truly love this industry,” Schroeder said when accepting the award. “I truly love the people even more. And everything, every person that I ever met means a lot to me. …I just want to cry and just say thank you so much for your love, for your passion that you returned to this industry as much as I have returned to this industry.”

SCRS also awarded the March Taylor Kina’Ole Award to Jason Bartanen in celebration of March Taylor, who passed away in 2007. SCRS says Taylor’s commitment to technical excellence, mentorship, and service to others left a lasting impression on the collision repair community and around the SCRS table.

Taylor was a master technician, owner of Auto Body Hawaii, and an industry leader who spearheaded the idea of a centralized service that repairers could use to submit inquiries challenging estimating systems’ data based on real-world repairs. That idea became the Data Enhancement Gateway (DEG).

“March was a technician first,” said Aaron Schulenburg, SCRS executive director. “He was somebody who believed in the work that was being done behind the front office in the bays of our shops. He lived and breathed and taught the culture of doing the right thing, the right way, for the right reasons, and that’s what kina’ole means.

“I think March understood something that can get lost in conversations about this industry: that the greatest responsibility lies with the men and women who perform repairs; the people who go home at the end of the day with busted knuckles and calloused hands; the people who straighten the structures, and repair the damage, and put vehicles back together. They’re the ones whose work determines how vehicles will protect our families.”
Barry Dorn added that Taylor “stood for the people whose voices weren’t always heard — the technicians, the people doing the work.”

Dorn said Bartanen never loses sight of his “why,” and has spent his career advocating for technicians, investing in their success, and making sure they have someone in their corner. Bartanen has spent years working with SkillsUSA students and now helps build technicians’ careers through his business, Collision ProAssist.

“I’ve always wanted to do the right thing,” Bartanen said. “Our technicians are the reason we’re here today; the men and women who are fixing cars each and every day. I want all of us to lift them up, recognize their accomplishments, and support them.”

In honor of another collision repair industry leader, the Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF) presented the first annual Clark Plucinski Legacy Award to Chris Evans of State Farm. Evans is a former collision technician and collision center manager who previously served as CREF’s chair and on I-CAR’s Board of Directors.
The award recognizes an individual who embodies the spirit, dedication, and commitment that defined Plucinski’s life and career.
Plucinski dedicated more than 50 years to the collision repair industry, receiving numerous honors and recognitions throughout his career, including induction into the Hall of Eagles in 1993.
From 2012 until his retirement in 2020, Plucinski served as CREF’s executive director.

“Those of you who knew Clark will remember hearing him say time and time again, ‘It’s all about the kids,'” shared Stacy Bartnik, CREF Board of Trustees member. “Those words were more than just a phrase. They reflected his passion, his purpose, his unwavering belief that the future of our industry depends on investing in the next generation. Clark dedicated his career to creating opportunities for students, supporting collision repair education and ensuring that young people had a path to successful careers in our industry.”

articles.title: Don’t Forget Lubrication During an Oil Change
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Back in my day at the service station, when a customer came in for an oil change, they pulled it into a grease pit and we would grease up everything on the vehicle—ball joints, universal joints, and then we would do the oil changes. Today, it’s different. Vehicles are a lot more low maintenance.

However, the aftermarket has not abandoned the message that lubrication is required for certain repair components to make that repair just that much better. In other words, we have ball joints that have grease nipples that need to be lubricated every so often, like during an oil change. It’s also written in the vehicle service information that doors and lift hatches need to be lubricated every so often.
Your shop probably has an oil change and you probably call it an LOF. So let’s put that L back in LOF: lubrication, oil, filter.

articles.title: Six Tips for Building and Selling a Better Timing Belt Job
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Although timing chains offer maintenance advantages, timing belts can provide benefits for engine efficiency and noise, vibration and harshness (NVH). With many engines having timing belt replacement intervals of more than 100,000 miles, it is very important to recommend a complete service designed to last until the next replacement interval. When preparing the estimate and presenting it to the customer, keep the following six tips in mind.

The labor times for replacing a timing belt found in your shop management system are typically based on ideal conditions. Account for additional labor when corrosion, damaged fasteners or other complications are likely. Labor for servicing the cooling system, front cover or water pump may not be included in the published time.

Also, include the necessary labor to remove and reinstall wheel-well liners, splash shields and other components. If these parts are missing or damaged, replacements may be available and should be included in the estimate.

If the water pump is driven by the timing belt, be aware that a new pump may exhibit a small amount of seepage through the weep hole during its initial break-in period. Changes in water-pump designs can also mean that limited seepage during initial operation may be considered normal. Always consult the pump manufacturer’s service information before determining whether leakage indicates a problem.
On timing-belt-driven water pumps, the weep-hole passage may discharge behind the front cover, making the source of the coolant difficult to identify.
3. Don’t Forget the Other Belts and Tensioners

Whether the engine is mounted longitudinally or transversely, the serpentine belt will usually be removed during the timing belt service. If the customer has not previously replaced the belt, this is the ideal time to recommend replacement.

On many applications, replacing the automatic belt tensioner is also recommended. Some engines may have an additional belt that drives a balance shaft or another component. Inspect these belts and replace them as needed.

Because the camshaft and crankshaft sprockets may already be exposed, consider recommending replacement of the related seals. With some timing belt replacement intervals reaching 120,000 miles, these seals may be prime candidates for replacement because of the age and deterioration of their soft materials and sealing lips.

Some camshaft seals may be subjected to increased pressure from variable valve timing actuators. These seals can be exposed to full engine oil pressure as oil is routed through the camshaft to the actuator. Some timing belt kits include new camshaft and crankshaft seals. When included, these seals should not be treated as optional parts.

If the valve cover gasket is allowing even a small amount of oil to enter the timing belt area, recommend replacing the gasket. This can prevent oil from contaminating the belt and causing premature failure.
6. Don’t Forget the Oil Change and Other Mileage-Based Maintenance

Timing belt replacement is typically part of a larger scheduled maintenance service that may include an oil change, filters, fluids and other service items. Consult the manufacturer’s maintenance schedule and recommend any services due at the vehicle’s current mileage.

articles.title: AISIN Announces New Product Program
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: AISIN Corp. announced that it will introduce a new product line at the Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo (AAPEX) in Las Vegas.

To support the rollout, AISIN vetted and established a pilot program with a China-based global supply chain partner. The pilot enabled AISIN to maintain its OE-quality standards while expanding into new, high-volume maintenance-related categories, the company said.
Parts available through this program include products in cooling systems, drivetrain, steering, suspension, chemicals and fluids.

The new AISIN product range has begun rolling out through online sellers first, including Amazon, and will expand into offline channels by the end of the year. Following the pilot, the company has a pending joint venture in the works, with additional details to be announced at completion.
The new line of products will be on display at booth V3261 in The Venetian Expo at AAPEX, Nov. 3-5, 2026.

articles.title: PRT to Showcase New Light Commercial Vehicle Line at AAPEX
articles.author: Brake and Front End Staff

paras.en: PRT announced that it will be showcasing its new light commercial vehicle (LCV) line, among other products, at AAPEX 2026. The company will exhibit at the Venetian Expo in booth F14600.

The company also will present its air shocks, top mounts and motor mounts product lines. Its heavy-duty portfolio includes applications for trucks, trailers, buses, commercial vehicles, cement mixers and motorhomes.

“We’re more than happy to introduce our new LCV line and showcase our multiple product lines at AAPEX 2026,” said Bruno Bello of PRT. “Our ongoing investments in manufacturing technology and OE-quality engineering support the continued development of solutions for the North American aftermarket.”

articles.title: DENSO Sponsors EcoCAR Innovation Challenge
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: DENSO is sponsoring the EcoCAR Innovation Challenge, a four-year collegiate engineering competition that prepares students to become future leaders in mobility, technology and innovation. Through its sponsorship, DENSO is providing advanced radar sensors, engineering volunteer support and financial contributions to help students gain hands-on experience solving real-world automotive challenges.

Managed by Argonne National Laboratory as part of the U.S. Department of Energy’s Advanced Vehicle Technology Competitions program, the EcoCAR Innovation Challenge brings together 20 university teams from across North America. Students apply advanced engineering, super intelligence and entrepreneurial thinking to develop mobility solutions while building the technical and professional skills needed for future careers.

“DENSO is committed to creating safer, smarter and more sustainable mobility while helping develop the next generation of engineers and technology leaders,” said Mike Murzyn, leader of DENSO’s North America Peace of Mind business group. “EcoCAR gives students the opportunity to work on real-world technologies, collaborate with industry experts and solve meaningful engineering challenges. We’re proud to support a program that helps build the technical talent, creativity and leadership needed to shape the future of mobility.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Technology Donation and Industry Relevance

As part of its commitment, DENSO is donating advanced radar sensing technology to support vehicle development activities within the competition. DENSO has decades of experience developing sensing technologies that help enable advanced driver-assistance systems and safer mobility solutions. By providing students with access to industry-relevant technologies, the company said it is helping bridge the gap between classroom learning and real-world engineering applications.
Competition Focus Areas and Skill Development

The competition challenges students to develop advanced vehicle technologies across areas such as connected and automated vehicles, battery systems, powertrain development, innovation and entrepreneurship. Through collaboration with industry sponsors and technical experts, participants gain experience that extends beyond engineering fundamentals to include project management, communication and commercialization skills.

articles.title: BendPak Introduces MaxJax MAX7 Portable Two-Post Lift
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: BendPak Inc. introduced the MaxJax MAX7 portable two-post lift at the SEMA show. The MAX7 rises 3 inches higher than earlier models, providing more under-vehicle clearance and additional room to work. The company said it’s also the first MaxJax model to integrate BendPak’s Automatic Swing Arm Restraint System (ASARS). The system helps prevent unintended swing arm movement during vehicle lifting, lowering and service.

Attendees can see the lift at BendPak’s outdoor interactive display in the Silver Lot, Booth 80043. BendPak also is hosting hands-on equipment demonstrations inside the Las Vegas Convention Center’s Upper South Hall, Booth 36129.
The SEMA Show runs Nov. 3-6 at the Las Vegas Convention Center. The show, previously open only to trade attendees, opens to the public Friday, Nov. 6.

“Garage space is premium real estate, whether you’re running a busy shop or wrenching at home,” said Sean Price, BendPak director of quality control and product development. “The MAX7 stands out for its versatility. It delivers commercial-grade lifting power for enthusiasts without permanently sacrificing parking space, while enabling professional shops to quickly increase service capacity during peak hours. The MaxJax MAX7 unlocks maximum utility without requiring a permanent footprint.”
The MaxJax MAX7 offers a maximum lifting height of 50.25 inches, providing additional under-vehicle clearance while maintaining a compact profile. Its design accommodates spaces with low ceilings.

Its open design provides direct access to brakes, suspension, exhaust and other undercar components for repair and maintenance tasks. A 7,000-pound rated load capacity enables the MAX7 to lift a wide range of cars, trucks and SUVs.

The MAX7 is the first MaxJax lift to incorporate BendPak’s patent-pending ASARS. The system features a 360-degree locking interface with 10 times the holding force of traditional swing arm restraint mechanisms. It secures the lift arms in position under the vehicle.
The MAX7 also features seven safety locking positions and an upgraded lock release.

BendPak said that MaxJax is the original, patented portable two-post lift. It combines the undercar access and lifting capability of a two-post lift with removable columns and a power unit. During use, operators securely bolt each column to floor anchors permanently recessed in the concrete floor. The anchors provide a stable foundation.
After completing the job, operators can unbolt the columns and roll them away, leaving the floor clear.
BendPak offers four MAX7 packages to accommodate different equipment and accessory needs:
- Standard Package: Includes the MAX7 lift assembly, power unit with tow cart, standard anchor bolt kit, round lift pads and medium adapters.
- Deluxe Package: Adds a rolling work seat and portable oil drain.
- Supreme Package: Includes everything in the Deluxe Package, plus frame cradle pads and tall adapters.
- Ultimate Package: Replaces the Supreme Package’s standard rolling work seat with the MaxJax Ergonomic Height-Adjustable Creeper Seat.
An optional MaxJax Motorcycle and ATV Adapter Kit adds powersports service capability to the MAX7 car lift.

articles.title: Hybrids Forecast to Reach 32% of U.S. Sales by 2035
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Hybrids are playing a larger role in how Americans move toward electrified vehicles. A new report from the Auto Care Association and MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers forecasts substantial hybrid sales growth over the next decade. Meanwhile, U.S. battery electric vehicle (BEV) adoption continues at a slower pace than in China and Europe.
paras.zh: 混合动力车在美国人转向电动汽车的过程中发挥着更大的作用。汽车护理协会和MEMA售后市场供应商的一份新报告预测，未来十年混合动力车的销售将大幅增长。与此同时，美国电池电动汽车（ BEV ）的采用速度继续低于中国和欧洲。

paras.en: Developed with Strategy&, PwC’s strategy division, the 2026 Joint Powertrain Trends & Outlook Forecast projects significant growth for hybrids. Their share of U.S. new-vehicle sales will increase from 17% in 2026 to 32% in 2035. The report also forecasts BEV market share will rise from 8% in 2025 to 25% in 2035.
paras.zh: 《2026年联合动力总成趋势与展望预测》与普华永道战略部共同开发，预计混合动力车将大幅增长。他们在美国新车销售中的份额将从2026年的17%增加到2035年的32%。该报告还预测，纯电动汽车的市场份额将从2025年的8%上升到2035年的25%。

paras.en: The findings point to a transition that includes an important hybrid phase before BEVs become more prominent.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，在BEV变得更加突出之前，过渡包括一个重要的混合阶段。

paras.en: Hybrids Lead Key Powertrain Forecast Findings
paras.zh: 混合动力车领先关键动力总成预测结果

paras.en: – Hybrids are gaining share. The report forecasts hybrids will account for 32% of U.S. new-vehicle sales in 2035, compared with 17% in 2026.
paras.zh: –混合动力车正在获得份额。该报告预测，到2035年，混合动力汽车将占美国新车销量的32% ，而2026年这一比例为17%。

paras.en: – U.S. BEV adoption trails other markets. BEVs accounted for approximately 6% of U.S. new-vehicle sales in the first half of 2026. That compares with 38% in China and an estimated 23% in European markets.
paras.zh: –美国BEV的采用率落后于其他市场。2026年上半年， BEV约占美国新车销量的6%。相比之下，中国为38% ，欧洲市场估计为23%。

paras.en: – Price remains a hurdle. Automakers are placing greater emphasis on models priced below $45,000, a segment that accounts for more new-vehicle sales.
paras.zh: –价格仍然是一个障碍。汽车制造商正在更加重视售价低于$ 45,000的车型，这一细分市场占据了更多的新车销售。

paras.en: – Hybrids can cost less to own. Despite higher purchase prices, hybrids have lower three-year ownership costs than comparable internal combustion engine vehicles. Lower fuel costs and higher residual values contribute to the difference.
paras.zh: –拥有混合动力车的成本更低。尽管购买价格较高，但与同类内燃机汽车相比，混合动力汽车的三年拥有成本较低。较低的燃料成本和较高的残值会导致差异。

paras.en: – Buyers will have more choices. The report expects the number of hybrid models to triple between 2025 and 2035. These include full hybrids, plug-in hybrids and range-extended vehicles.
paras.zh: –买家将有更多选择。该报告预计，混合动力车型的数量将在2025年至2035年之间增加两倍。其中包括全混合动力车、插电式混合动力车和增程车。

paras.en: What the Forecast Means for the Aftermarket
paras.zh: 预测对售后市场意味着什么

paras.en: The report also puts the powertrain shift in the context of a growing aftermarket. The U.S. light-vehicle aftermarket, including warranty and post-warranty activity, will grow from $543 billion in 2026 to $733 billion in 2035. That represents an increase of approximately $190 billion, or 3.4% annually.
paras.zh: 该报告还将动力总成转换置于不断增长的售后市场背景下。美国轻型汽车售后市场，包括保修和保修后活动，将从2026年的5430亿美元增长到2035年的7330亿美元。这意味着每年增加约1900亿美元，即3.4%。

paras.en: Consumers’ “repair, don’t replace” response to the cost of new and gently used vehicles drives growth. Price and product mix also contribute to growth as vehicle population growth remains modest.
paras.zh: 消费者对新车和轻度二手车成本的“维修，不要替代”反应推动了增长。由于汽车人口增长仍然温和，价格和产品组合也有助于增长。

paras.en: Within the post-warranty market, the report forecasts parts revenue associated with electrification will grow approximately 24% annually through 2035. It also projects ADAS hardware revenue will grow approximately 23% annually.
paras.zh: 在保修后市场，该报告预测，到2035年，与电气化相关的零部件收入将每年增长约24%。它还预测ADAS硬件收入每年将增长约23%。

paras.en: “The shift toward electrification is not happening in one straight line,” said Philip Atkins, director of strategic research and planning at MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers. “Hybrids are becoming a bigger part of the picture, and suppliers need to plan for that reality. The mix of vehicles on the road will keep changing, and understanding where that demand is headed will help companies make better decisions about products and investment. This report will help companies do that.”
paras.zh: MEMA售后市场供应商战略研究和规划总监菲利普·阿特金斯（ Philip Atkins ）表示： “向电气化的转变并非一蹴而就。” “混合动力车正在成为更大的一部分，供应商需要针对这一现实进行规划。道路上的车辆组合将不断变化，了解需求的走向将有助于公司对产品和投资做出更好的决策。这份报告将帮助公司做到这一点。”

paras.en: “Price and choice matter to consumers, and the forecast makes that clear,” said Michael Chung, executive director of market intelligence at Auto Care Association. “As more hybrid models become available and automakers focus on affordability, the market is responding. This research helps aftermarket businesses understand the vehicles they will be serving in the years ahead.”
Auto Care Association and MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers members can access the 2026 Joint Powertrain Trends & Outlook Forecast as a membership benefit.
Nonmembers can purchase the report at digital.autocare.org or mema.org.

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Newnan, Ga.
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Newnan, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 216 Bullsboro Dr. with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from West Georgia Technical College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts在纽南开设了最新的门店，为当地司机和汽车专业人士提供了更多的零部件、工具和专业知识。该公司在216 Bullsboro Dr.开设了商店，与当地官员和西乔治亚技术学院的代表一起举行了剪彩仪式，他们在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐赠。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training and career opportunities through the College’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 这笔捐款将帮助学生通过学院的汽车技术课程获得实践经验、培训和就业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，到2034年，对熟练的汽车技术人员的需求仍然很高，预计每年约有70,000个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to open our newest store in Newnan and continue serving customers across the area,” said Mike Fogarty, Rregional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “This location helps us better support local drivers and professional customers with convenient access to the parts, and products they rely on. We’re also proud to support students at West Georgia Technical College and strengthen our connection to the Newnan community.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts区域副总裁Mike Fogarty表示： “我们很高兴在纽南开设我们的最新商店，并继续为整个地区的客户提供服务。” “这个位置有助于我们更好地为当地合作车主和专业客户提供支持，让他们能够方便地获取他们所依赖的零件和产品。我们也很自豪能够为西乔治亚技术学院的学生提供支持，并加强我们与纽南社区的联系。”

paras.en: “Community support plays an important role in career and technical education,” said Brittney Wells, executive director of institutional advancement at West Georgia Technical College. “We are grateful to Advance Auto Parts for this contribution, which helps support our students as they gain practical experience and explore opportunities in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: West Georgia Technical College机构发展执行董事Brittney Wells表示： “社区支持在职业和技术教育方面发挥着重要作用。“我们感谢Advance Auto Parts的这一贡献，这有助于支持我们的学生获得实践经验并探索汽车行业的机会。”

paras.en: The new store also serves as a market hub – a centralized facility designed to improve parts availability and same-day fulfillment across a network of stores, enhancing hard parts coverage for professional customers.
paras.zh: 新商店还充当市场中心，这是一个集中的设施，旨在提高商店网络中的零件可用性和当日配送率，提高专业客户的硬件覆盖率。

articles.title: Worldpac to Open First Automated Distribution Center in Georgia
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Worldpac announced plans to open its first automated distribution center, a new 413,000-square-foot facility in Forest Park, Georgia. Scheduled to begin operations in the first half of 2027, the facility will feature AutoStore robotic storage and retrieval technology, expanding Worldpac’s distribution capacity and supporting future growth, the company said.
paras.zh: Worldpac宣布计划在佐治亚州森林公园开设其第一个自动化配送中心，一个占地413,000平方英尺的新设施。该公司表示，该设施计划于2027年上半年开始运营，将采用AutoStore机器人存储和检索技术，扩大Worldpac的分销能力，并支持未来的增长。

paras.en: The facility will support Worldpac branches and customers across the Southeast and surrounding markets, while providing more than 250,000 additional square feet compared with the current Norcross distribution center.
paras.zh: 该工厂将为东南部和周边市场的Worldpac分支机构和客户提供支持，同时与目前的Norcross配送中心相比，将提供超过25万平方英尺的额外面积。

paras.en: The facility will utilize AutoStore, an advanced automated storage and retrieval system that uses robotics to store, retrieve, and process inventory within a highly efficient storage grid. Rather than team members traveling through warehouse aisles to locate parts, inventory is automatically delivered to workstations for picking, replenishment and processing. The technology will enable more efficient inventory management and order processing while supporting consistent, reliable service as Worldpac continues to grow, the company said.

articles.title: Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education Given to Corey Bartlett
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, presented the 2026 Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education, to Corey Bartlett, CEO of Auto Parts Headquarters (APH) based in St. Cloud, Minnesota. The award was presented on November 1st by AWDA Vice Chair Young Suhr at AWDA’s 2026 Annual Conference in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会的社区售后市场仓库分销商协会（ AWDA ）向位于明尼苏达州圣克劳德的汽车零部件总部（ APH ）首席执行官Corey Bartlett颁发了2026年Art Fisher卓越教育奖。该奖项由AWDA副主席Young Suhr于11月1日在拉斯维加斯举行的AWDA 2026年年会上颁发。

paras.en: AWDA’s Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education is presented annually to an aftermarket company or individual that demonstrates outstanding commitment to education and training, either within their organization or throughout the industry. Given in memory of former AWDA Chairman Art Fisher, the award grants scholarships in the name of the award winner to two students enrolled in the automotive aftermarket management program at Northwood University. AWDA Vice Chair Young Suhr presented the award.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Bartlett has prioritized education throughout his career at APH. Within his first 10 years, he reorganized staff and expanded employee training. He completed the University of the Aftermarket’s Leadership 2010 program and earned Automotive Aftermarket Professional and Master Automotive Aftermarket Professional designations in 2002 and 2009.
paras.zh: Bartlett在APH的职业生涯中始终将教育放在首位。在最初的10年里，他重组了员工并扩大了员工培训。他完成了售后市场大学的2010年领导力计划，并于2002年和2009年获得了汽车售后市场专业人士和汽车售后市场专业人士大师称号。

paras.en: “Corey has shown incredible initiative in supporting training and continuing education,” said John R. Washbish, president and CEO, Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc. “Through his leadership roles and example, he has consistently improved the education and standards of his staff, the Alliance, and the industry as a whole.”
paras.zh: Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc.总裁兼首席执行官John R. Washbish表示： “Corey在支持培训和继续教育方面表现出了令人难以置信的主动性。通过他的领导角色和榜样，他一直在提高员工、联盟和整个行业的教育水平和标准。”

paras.en: As CEO, Bartlett and his managers developed a 101-level course to help employees understand APH’s expansion into medium-duty, heavy-duty and agricultural segments. A partnership with a local technical college added hands-on experience, with nearly 100% participation among the company’s 1,200 employees. Corey also helped oversee the Alliance scholarship program and create its Technician of the Year program.
paras.zh: 作为首席执行官， Bartlett及其经理开发了一门101级的课程，帮助员工了解APH向中型、重型和农业领域的扩张。与当地技术学院的合作增加了实践经验，公司的1,200名员工几乎100%参与其中。Corey还帮助监督了联盟奖学金计划，并创建了年度技术人员计划。

paras.en: His industry service includes chairing the AWDA Board of Governors, mentoring through the Young Auto Care Networking Group and supporting the Auto Care Political Action Committee. He was the 2017 AWDA Pursuit of Excellence honoree and supports WACOSA and other local nonprofits.

articles.title: Physicists sank a telescope 1.5 miles under the sea to put Einstein's relativity to the test
articles.author: Larissa G. Capella

paras.en: A particle-detecting telescope sunk more than a mile beneath the sea off the coast of France has tested a core principle of Einstein's relativity and found no cracks.
paras.zh: 一台粒子探测望远镜沉入法国海岸海底超过一英里处，测试了爱因斯坦相对论的核心原理，没有发现裂缝。

paras.en: The detector, called Oscillation Research with Cosmics in the Abyss (ORCA), detects elusive particles called neutrinos. As a doctoral student, Alba Domi rode onto the Mediterranean aboard one of two boats that helped build the telescope, lowering some of its first detection units to the seafloor about 1.5 miles (2.4 kilometers) below the waves off Toulon, France.
paras.zh: 这种名为“深渊宇宙振荡研究” （ ORCA ）的探测器可以探测到被称为中微子的难以捉摸的粒子。作为一名博士生，阿尔巴·多米（ Alba Domi ）乘坐两艘帮助建造望远镜的船只之一登上地中海，将其首批探测装置降低到法国土伦海浪以下约1.5英里（ 2.4公里）的海底。

paras.en: Now, data from those first detection units have been used to test one of the founding rules of Einstein’s relativity: the idea that the laws of nature look the same no matter which way you face or how fast you move.
paras.zh: 现在，来自第一个探测单元的数据已被用来测试爱因斯坦相对论的基本规则之一：无论你面对哪个方向或移动速度如何，自然法则看起来都是一样的。

paras.en: The team found no sign that this rule, called Lorentz invariance, is broken. But even with a detector only a fraction of its planned size, they set limits that compete with those of far larger and longer-running experiments.
paras.zh: 研究小组没有发现这个被称为洛伦兹不变性的规则被打破的迹象。但即使探测器只有其计划尺寸的一小部分，他们也设定了与大得多、运行时间更长的实验相竞争的极限。

paras.en: The results were published Wednesday (Nov. 4) in the Journal of Cosmology and Astroparticle Physics.
paras.zh: 研究结果于周三（ 11月4日）发表在《宇宙学和天体粒子物理学杂志》上。

paras.en: Physics rests on two successful theories: general relativity, conceived by Albert Einstein more than 100 years ago, and the Standard Model of subatomic physics.
paras.zh: 物理学基于两种成功的理论： 100多年前由阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦设想的广义相对论，以及亚原子物理学的标准模型。

paras.en: "General relativity describes the universe well on a cosmic scale, and the Standard Model of particle physics describes the microscopic scale; really, the single particles, how they behave," said study co-author Lukas Hennig, a doctoral student in advanced physics at Erlangen-Nürnberg.
paras.zh: “广义相对论在宇宙尺度上很好地描述了宇宙，粒子物理学的标准模型描述了微观尺度；实际上，单个粒子，它们的行为方式，”该研究的合著者、埃尔兰根-纽伦堡大学高级物理学博士生卢卡斯·亨尼希（ Lukas Hennig ）说。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Both theories assume Lorentz invariance to be true. But in extreme settings, such as the first moments after the Big Bang, the two theories don't mesh. That has fueled a decades-long hunt for a theory of quantum gravity that unites them. Some candidates, including versions of string theory and loop quantum gravity, suggest that space-time might have a hidden "grain" at the tiniest scales — and that Lorentz invariance, "one of the most basic assumptions we make about our universe, might be violated," Hennig said.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Any such violation would be extremely small. To spot it, physicists would need a probe that could travel long distances and barely interact with anything along the way. Enter the neutrino.
paras.zh: 任何此类违规行为都将是极其微小的。为了发现它，物理学家需要一个可以长途跋涉的探测器，沿途几乎不会与任何东西相互作用。进入中微子。

paras.en: Neutrinos are nearly massless particles that pass through Earth every second and carry zero charge. They barely interact with anything and come in three types: electron, muon and tau neutrinos. As neutrinos travel, they morph from one type into another in a predictable pattern that physicists call neutrino oscillation.
paras.zh: 中微子几乎是无质量的粒子，每秒钟穿过地球，携带零电荷。它们几乎不与任何东西相互作用，有三种类型：电子、μ子和tau中微子。随着中微子移动，它们以可预测的模式从一种类型转变为另一种类型，物理学家称之为中微子振荡。

paras.en: If Lorentz invariance were broken, that oscillation would change, with the effect growing more pronounced the farther the neutrinos traveled. So the team focused on neutrinos created when cosmic rays slam into the atmosphere elsewhere on the globe before traveling up through the planet to the detector. Some of the tested neutrinos crossed the entire 7,900-mile (12,700 km) width of Earth.
paras.zh: 如果洛仑兹不变性被打破，这种振荡就会发生变化，中微子行进得越远，这种影响就越明显。因此，该团队专注于宇宙射线在穿越行星到达探测器之前撞击地球其他地方的大气层时产生的中微子。一些被测试的中微子穿越了地球的整个7,900英里（ 12,700公里）宽。

paras.en: ORCA is part of the KM3NeT neutrino telescope. Each of its detection units is anchored to the seabed and holds 18 glass spheres packed with 31 light sensors apiece. When a neutrino collides with a particle in the water, it produces a faint flash of blue light that the sensors catch. The many sensors in each sphere help the team pin down which direction the light came from, Domi said.
paras.zh: ORCA是KM3NeT中微子望远镜的一部分。它的每个探测单元都锚定在海底，并容纳18个玻璃球，每个玻璃球装有31个光传感器。当中微子与水中的粒子碰撞时，它会产生传感器捕捉到的微弱的蓝光闪光。Domi说，每个球体中的许多传感器可以帮助团队确定光线来自哪个方向。

paras.en: Earth itself serves as a filter. The researchers selected only particles traveling upward through the planet, and they were able to weed out the flood of other particles from the atmosphere that would otherwise swamp the signal. "Only the neutrinos can get through," Hennig said.
paras.zh: 地球本身就是一个过滤器。研究人员只选择了向上穿过行星的粒子，他们能够从大气中清除大量其他粒子，否则这些粒子会淹没信号。“只有中微子才能通过，”亨尼希说。

paras.en: That setup differs from that of IceCube, the Nobel Prize-winning detector buried in Antarctic ice. "Ice scatters the light more than water, but on the other hand, water absorbs the light more than ice," Domi said, which changes how each team reconstructs a neutrino's energy and path.
paras.zh: 这与埋在南极冰中的诺贝尔奖获奖探测器IceCube的设置不同。“冰比水更能散射光线，但另一方面，水比冰更能吸收光线，” Domi说，这改变了每个团队重建中微子能量和路径的方式。

paras.en: The researchers used 5,828 neutrinos collected over about 17 months between 2020 and 2021. They found that the oscillations matched standard physics. That means if Lorentz violation exists, it must be weaker than the limits the team set.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用了2020年至2021年间约17个月收集的5,828个中微子。他们发现振荡与标准物理学相匹配。这意味着如果存在Lorentz违规行为，它必须弱于团队设定的限制。

paras.en: Those limits matter for theorists. If a model "predicts a Lorentz invariance violation [stronger than the new limits], the data rule it out. In that case, you can be pretty sure that this model is not correct," Hennig said.
paras.zh: 这些限制对理论家来说很重要。如果模型“预测洛仑兹不变性违规[强于新极限] ，则数据将其排除在外。在这种情况下，你可以很确定这个模型是不正确的，” Hennig说。

paras.en: The team also set the first direct limits on a kind of violation that would treat muon neutrinos and tau neutrinos differently.
paras.zh: 该团队还对一种不同对待μ子中微子和tau中微子的违规行为设定了第一个直接限制。

paras.en: The detector's limits on several key measures are competitive with those from Japan's Super-Kamiokande, which used 12 years of data, and from IceCube, which used two years of data from its full array.
paras.zh: 该探测器对几项关键措施的限制与日本的Super-Kamiokande （使用了12年的数据）和IceCube （使用了来自其全阵列的两年数据）相比具有竞争力。

paras.en: "I'm surprised that we have competitive results with only six detection units," Hennig said. Today, 44 units are in the water, and the collaboration plans to activate 108 by 2030.
paras.zh: “我很惊讶我们只有六个检测单元的竞争结果，” Hennig说。如今，有44个单元在水中，合作计划到2030年激活108个。

paras.en: The best tests may still lie ahead. Because Lorentz-violating effects grow with distance and energy, neutrinos from distant cosmic sources are "actually the best candidates to do this kind of research," Domi said. The team plans to repeat the search using ORCA's sister detector, ARCA (Astroparticle Research with Cosmics in the Abyss), which sits off the coast of Sicily and is designed to catch those high-energy cosmic travelers.
paras.zh: 最好的测试可能还在前面。Domi说，由于洛伦兹破坏效应随着距离和能量的增加而增加，来自遥远宇宙源的中微子“实际上是进行这种研究的最佳候选者”。该团队计划使用逆戟鲸的姐妹探测器ARCA （深渊中的天体粒子研究）重复搜索，该探测器位于西西里岛海岸外，旨在捕捉那些高能量的宇宙旅行者。

paras.en: If space-time does have a grain, those particles may be among the first to feel it.
paras.zh: 如果时空确实有颗粒，那么这些粒子可能是第一个感受到它的粒子。

paras.en: Adriani et al. (2026). Atmospheric neutrino constraints on Lorentz invariance violation with the first six detection units of KM3NET/ORCA. Journal of Cosmology and Astroparticle Physics. https://doi.org/10.1088/1475-7516/2026/11/012
paras.zh: Adriani et al. (2026). KM3NET/ORCA前六个检测单元对洛伦兹不变性违规的大气中微子约束。宇宙学和天体粒子物理学杂志。https://doi.org/10.1088/1475-7516/2026/11/012

paras.en: Larissa G. Capella is a science writer based in Washington state. She obtained a B.S. in physics and a B.A. in English creative writing in 2024, which enabled her to pursue a career that integrates both disciplines. She reports mainly on environmental, Earth and physical sciences, but is always willing to write about any science that sparks her curiosity. Her work has appeared in Eos, Science News, Space.com, among others.

articles.title: Gigantic chasm on Mars is still tectonically active
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: Mars' supersize Valles Marineris — the largest known canyon in the solar system — is still tectonically active even though the Red Planet is geologically "dead," new research on a previously record-breaking marsquake reveals.
paras.zh: 对先前破纪录的火星地震的最新研究显示，尽管这颗红色星球在地质上已经“死亡”，但火星上的超大水手峡谷（太阳系中已知最大的峡谷）仍然处于构造活跃状态。

paras.en: On Aug. 25, 2021, NASA's InSight lander, which touched down on the Red Planet in 2018, detected a powerful marsquake, designated S0976a. The Martian equivalent of an earthquake reached magnitude 4.2, which, at the time, was the most powerful quake that InSight or any other Mars lander had ever seen. (Since then, a 4.7 magnitude marsquake in May 2022 knocked it off the top spot, but S0976a remains second on this list.)
paras.zh: 2021 年 8 月 25 日，美国宇航局的洞察号着陆器于 2018 年降落在这颗红色星球上，检测到一场强烈的火星地震，编号为 S0976a。火星地震相当于 4.2 级，这在当时是洞察号或任何其他火星着陆器所见过的最强烈的地震。 （此后，2022 年 5 月发生的 4.7 级火星地震将其从榜首位置上挤了下来，但 S0976a 仍然位居第二。）

paras.en: Unlike most marsquakes, which have been minor tremors triggered by meteorite impacts near InSight, S0976a was a deep rumble that originated from the opposite side of Mars as the robotic seismologist, in the western half of Valles Marineris.
paras.zh: 与大多数火星地震不同的是，S0976a 是由洞察号附近的陨石撞击引发的轻微震动，而 S0976a 是一种深沉的隆隆声，起源于火星的另一侧，即水手谷的西半部，即机器人地震学家。

paras.en: In the new study, published Oct. 15 in the journal Nature Communications, researchers reanalyzed the seismic wave data of S0976a and found that the quake originated from within a fault line running below the enormous canyon. The most likely explanation, they argue, is that there was tectonic movement in this hidden crustal crack.
paras.zh: 在10月15日发表在《自然通讯》杂志上的新研究中，研究人员重新分析了S0976a的地震波数据，发现地震起源于巨大峡谷下方的断层线内。他们认为，最可能的解释是，在这个隐藏的地壳裂缝中发生了构造运动。

paras.en: "Valles Marineris is one of the most spectacular geological structures anywhere in the solar system, but until now we didn't know for certain that its faults are still active," study first author Jung-Hun Song, a researcher in the Department of Earth Science and Engineering at Imperial College London, said in a statement. "What we see is that this is not just a 'dead' fossil landscape, as faults deep beneath the canyon can still slip and generate marsquakes, long after the geological processes that originally formed them have ceased."
paras.zh: “水手谷是太阳系中最壮观的地质结构之一，但直到现在我们还不确定它的断层是否仍然活跃，”该研究的第一作者、伦敦帝国理工学院地球科学与工程系的研究员 Jung-Hun Song 在一份声明中说。 “我们看到的是，这不仅仅是一个‘死亡’的化石景观，因为在最初形成断层的地质过程停止很久之后，峡谷深处的断层仍然可以滑动并产生火星地震。”

paras.en: Valles Marineris is an enormous set of interconnected gullies and ravines stretching up to 2,500 miles (4,000 kilometers) in length, or roughly 10 times longer than the Grand Canyon. It is also up to 20 times wider and five times deeper, meaning that if you found yourself stranded at the bottom, it could take you a couple of months to climb out again.
paras.zh: 水手谷是一组巨大的相互连接的沟壑和峡谷，长度长达 2,500 英里（4,000 公里），大约是大峡谷的 10 倍。它的宽度也增加了 20 倍，深度增加了 5 倍，这意味着如果您发现自己被困在底部，可能需要几个月的时间才能再次爬出来。

paras.en: The enormous chasm — named after the Mariner 9 spacecraft, which helped discover it in 1971 — is clearly visible from space, like a giant scar carved into the Red Planet's face. From orbit, you would also see the nearby Tharsis region, which is home to Mars' giant volcanoes, including Olympus Mons, which is at least three times taller than Mount Everest.
paras.zh: 这条巨大的裂缝——以 1971 年帮助发现它的水手 9 号宇宙飞船命名——从太空中清晰可见，就像刻在这颗红色星球表面上的巨大疤痕。从轨道上看，您还会看到附近的塔尔西斯地区，那里是火星巨型火山的所在地，其中包括奥林匹斯山，它至少比珠穆朗玛峰高三倍。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: These imposing structures are proof that Mars was once geologically active, perhaps even more so than Earth. However, scientists think the Red Planet's surface has remained relatively unchanged for nearly 3 billion years, according to the European Space Agency.
paras.zh: 这些雄伟的建筑证明火星曾经具有地质活跃性，甚至可能比地球还要活跃。然而，据欧洲航天局称，科学家认为这颗红色星球的表面近 30 亿年来一直保持相对不变。

paras.en: The reason for this is twofold. First, Mars is smaller than Earth, so its core and mantle have cooled much faster than our planet's and are, therefore, less dynamic. Second, Mars has no tectonic plates. Instead of giant patches of crust butting against each other, the Red Planet's outermost layer is almost completely intact and acts like a giant lid over its cooling molten innards. (Research published earlier this week throws the "dead" theory into question, hinting that magma may still lurk below dormant Martian volcanoes).
paras.zh: 其原因是双重的。首先，火星比地球小，因此它的核心和地幔的冷却速度比我们的星球快得多，因此动态性较差。其次，火星没有构造板块。这颗红色星球的最外层几乎完好无损，而不是巨大的地壳相互碰撞，就像一个巨大的盖子盖在其冷却的熔融内部上。 （本周早些时候发表的研究对“死亡”理论提出了质疑，暗示岩浆可能仍然潜伏在休眠的火星火山下方）。

paras.en: Despite this, Mars still has fault lines. But rather than being a boundary between tectonic plates, these lines are more like giant cracks in its crust, some of which are visible at the surface.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，火星仍然存在断层线。但这些线并不是构造板块之间的边界，而更像是地壳中的巨大裂缝，其中一些在地表可见。

paras.en: In the new study, researchers discovered proof of what they call a slip-strike marsquake, where "blocks of crust move horizontally past one another along a steep, deeply rooted fault," the team said. They believe this occurred somewhere between 12 and 25 miles (20 to 40 km) below Valles Marineris.
paras.zh: 研究小组表示，在这项新研究中，研究人员发现了所谓的滑击火星地震的证据，即“地壳块沿着陡峭、根深蒂固的断层水平移动”。他们认为这发生在水手谷下方 12 至 25 英里（20 至 40 公里）处。

paras.en: The researchers also simulated several other potential causes of the marsquake, including a major asteroid strike or a landslide within the canyon, but nothing else could explain the patterns they saw.
paras.zh: 研究人员还模拟了火星地震的其他几个潜在原因，包括重大的小行星撞击或峡谷内的山体滑坡，但没有其他方法可以解释他们所看到的模式。

paras.en: "What makes the result compelling is that several completely different types of evidence point in the same direction," Song said.
paras.zh: 宋说：“结果令人信服的是，几种完全不同类型的证据都指向同一个方向。”

paras.en: The finding also raises hopes that similar tectonic activity could one day be detected on other worlds across the solar system.
paras.zh: 这一发现还引发了人们的希望，即有一天可以在太阳系的其他世界上检测到类似的构造活动。

paras.en: "Our study opens up exciting possibilities for discovering ongoing seismic activity on other planetary bodies that we might otherwise consider geologically inactive," Song said.
paras.zh: 宋说：“我们的研究为发现其他行星上正在进行的地震活动开辟了令人兴奋的可能性，否则我们可能会认为这些行星在地质上不活跃。”

paras.en: The discovery highlights the importance of detecting and studying marsquakes, which were only officially discovered in 2019, thanks to InSight. (Scientists have since uncovered older marsquakes, using data collected by the Viking landers in the late 1970s.)
paras.zh: 这一发现凸显了探测和研究火星地​​震的重要性，而火星地震是在 InSight 的帮助下于 2019 年才被正式发现的。 （此后，科学家们利用 20 世纪 70 年代末维京登陆器收集的数据发现了更古老的火星地震。）

paras.en: "S0976a has turned out to be an extraordinary event," study co-author Doyeon Kim, head of Imperial College London's Terrestrial and Planetary Seismology Lab, said in the statement. "Its waves traveled through the core and helped us investigate the deepest part of Mars, and now they are telling us what happened at the source itself. From a single marsquake, we can learn both about the center of the planet and about an active fault beneath one of its most remarkable landscapes."
paras.zh: “S0976a已被证明是一个非同寻常的事件，”伦敦帝国理工学院陆地和行星地震学实验室负责人Doyeon Kim在声明中说。“它的波浪穿过核心，帮助我们调查火星的最深处，现在他们正在告诉我们源头发生了什么。从一次火星地震中，我们可以了解到地球的中心，以及它最引人注目的景观之一下的活跃断层。”

paras.en: - 'I would never have guessed it': Unexpected effect is squeezing Mars' atmosphere like toothpaste, experts say
paras.zh: - “我永远不会猜到” ：专家说，意想不到的效果正在像牙膏一样挤压火星的大气层

paras.en: Scientists have similarly used marsquake vibrations from InSight to map out Mars' interior, leading to several intriguing subsurface discoveries, including dozens of blobs left over from ancient protoplanets, the hidden cause of the planet's uneven hemispheres, a potentially active "mantle plume" and a gigantic underground water reservoir containing enough liquid to cover Mars with a mile-deep (1.6 km) ocean.
paras.zh: 科学家同样利用洞察号的火星地震振动来绘制火星的内部，导致了几项有趣的地下发现，包括来自古代原行星的数十个斑点，地球半球不均匀的隐藏原因，潜在的活跃“地幔柱”和一个巨大的地下水库，其中含有足够的液体，可以用一英里深（ 1.6公里）的海洋覆盖火星。

paras.en: Unfortunately, in December 2022, InSight quite literally bit the dust: A thick covering of Martian powder blocked its solar panels, preventing the lander from returning signals to Earth and thus ending its mission.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，在 2022 年 12 月，洞察号彻底落入尘埃：一层厚厚的火星粉末覆盖了它的太阳能电池板，阻止了着陆器向地球返回信号，从而结束了它的任务。

paras.en: This means we currently have no way of detecting new marsquakes. However, the new study proves that the lander's archived data can still lead to exciting discoveries.
paras.zh: 这意味着我们目前无法探测到新的地震。然而，这项新研究证明，着陆器的存档数据仍然可以带来令人兴奋的发现。

paras.en: Song, J., Kim, D., Kolawole, F., Davis, J. M., Parry, R., & Maguire, R. (2026). Active crustal straining and fault reactivation at Valles Marineris. Nature Communications, 17(1). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-78193-6
paras.zh: Song, J., Kim, D., Kolawole, F., Davis, J. M., Parry, R., & Maguire, R. (2026). Valles Marineris的主动地壳应变和断层再激活。自然通讯， 17 （ 1 ）。https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-78193-6

paras.en: Mars quiz: Is your knowledge of the Red Planet out of this world?
paras.zh: 火星测验：你对这颗红色星球的了解是否超出了这个世界？

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.

articles.title: 'Life is too brief to leave this planet': Live Science readers share whether they'd go to Mars, despite health risks
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: For centuries, Mars has been seen as a potential place for future human settlements. But long-duration space travel comes with serious risks to astronauts' health, including those resulting from cosmic radiation and the effects of microgravity.
paras.zh: 几个世纪以来，火星一直被视为未来人类定居的潜在地点。但长时间的太空旅行会给宇航员的健康带来严重风险，包括宇宙辐射和微重力影响造成的风险。

paras.en: A new study found that rats that were exposed to radiation similar to what astronauts might encounter during a Mars mission developed more scar tissue around their hearts' small blood vessels compared with a control group. Although the findings haven't been validated in humans, the results contribute to growing concerns about the potential effects of long-haul space missions on astronauts' health.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究发现，与对照组相比，暴露于类似于宇航员在火星任务中可能遇到的辐射的老鼠，其心脏小血管周围会形成更多的疤痕组织。尽管这些发现尚未在人体中得到验证，但这些结果引发了人们对长途太空任务对宇航员健康潜在影响的日益担忧。

paras.en: Given these new findings, Live Science asked its readers whether they'd travel to the Red Planet, despite these potential health risks. Over 240 readers weighed in, with 65% picking "No, I don't think the risks are worth it."
paras.zh: 鉴于这些新发现，《生活科学》询问读者是否愿意前往这颗红色星球，尽管存在这些潜在的健康风险。超过 240 名读者发表了意见，其中 65% 的人选择“不，我认为冒险不值得”。

paras.en: Interestingly enough, the comments reflect a slightly different trend. One reader wrote, "Any pioneers who travel to Mars will be facing the prospect of death and never coming back. Even if they make it back, there are any number of health issues that could come up. These risks have not stopped people from exploring throughout human history. The bigger question is who to send?"
paras.zh: 有趣的是，评论反映了略有不同的趋势。一位读者写道：“任何前往火星的先驱者都将面临死亡并且永远不会回来的前景。即使他们回来了，也可能会出现许多健康问题。这些风险并没有阻止人们在整个人类历史上进行探索。更大的问题是派谁去？”

paras.en: - Chinese lander reveals giant 'cavity' of radiation between Earth and the moon — and it could change how lunar exploration is done
paras.zh: - 中国着陆器揭示了地球和月球之间巨大的辐射“空腔” - 它可能会改变月球探索的方式

paras.en: - 'Everything we know about space travel is going to change within a decade': The fusion breakthrough that could unlock a path to the stars
paras.zh: -“我们所知道的关于太空旅行的一切都将在十年内发生变化”：聚变突破可以开启通往恒星的道路

paras.en: - Scientists finally know why astronauts struggle to poop in space — and reveal a hidden risk of long-haul spaceflight
paras.zh: - 科学家们终于知道为什么宇航员在太空中难以排便——并揭示了长途太空飞行的隐藏风险

paras.en: Other commenters echoed this sentiment, with another reader posting, "Explorers in the past have always been exposed to unusual risks; without the risk takers we would still believe the world is flat."
paras.zh: 其他评论者也赞同这种观点，另一位读者发帖称，“过去的探险家总是面临不寻常的风险；如果没有冒险者，我们仍然会相信世界是平的。”

paras.en: Beyond the feelings that Mars will be explored anyway, despite the health risks, other commenters highlighted the cost of these missions, with one reader stating, "Sending flesh water balloons to Mars is ridiculous. For the cost of one human on Mars, we could literally probe the entire solar system and map/sample/rove every planet and every major Moon."
paras.zh: 尽管存在健康风险，但除了认为火星无论如何都会被探索之外，其他评论者还强调了这些任务的成本，一位读者表示，“向火星发送肉水气球是荒谬的。对于一个人在火星上的成本，我们实际上可以探测整个太阳系，并对每颗行星和每颗主要卫星进行地图/采样/漫游。”

paras.en: Others highlighted the mental and emotional cost of a trip to Mars. "As a devoted sci-fi fan for decades, I always wished I could go into space," another reader noted. "Now that I am 77 years old, I realize I would miss the outdoors. The wind and trees, the birdsong and sweet grass under my feet would be a devastating loss. Let the brave explorers go instead. Life is too brief to leave this planet for the uncertainty and dangers of space travel."
paras.zh: 其他人则强调了火星之旅的精神和情感成本。另一位读者指出：“作为几十年来忠实的科幻迷，我一直希望能够进入太空。” “现在我已经 77 岁了，我意识到我会想念户外活动。风和树木、脚下的鸟鸣和甜草将是毁灭性的损失。让勇敢的探险家去吧。生命太短暂，不能因为太空旅行的不确定性和危险而离开这个星球。”

paras.en: Do you agree with these readers? Let us know your thoughts in the comments!
paras.zh: 您同意这些读者的观点吗？请在评论中告诉我们您的想法！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: The Arctic Polar Vortex Is Collapsing Earlier in the Season Than Ever Documented—but We Don't Know How It'll Affect Global Weather

paras.en: Something strange is happening in the skies above the Arctic: the polar vortex is collapsing unusually early.
paras.zh: 北极上空正在发生一些奇怪的事情：极地涡旋异常提早崩溃。

paras.en: The polar vortex is a ring of westerly winds that forms about 10 to 30 miles above the Earth’s surface, which generally keeps the coldest air sequestered around the North Pole. It usually reaches its peak intensity in December and January and weakens later in the season.
paras.zh: 极地涡旋是在地球表面上方约 10 至 30 英里处形成的西风环，通常将最冷的空气隔离在北极周围。它通常在十二月和一月达到峰值强度，并在季节后期减弱。

paras.en: This year, however, it’s already showing signs of disruption. Forecasts suggest that the polar vortex could collapse within the next week, report Joe Wertz and Mary Hui at Bloomberg. This extraordinary occurrence, combined with the “super” El Niño, could influence global weather patterns in ways that scientists are still trying to understand.
paras.zh: 然而今年，它已经显示出颠覆的迹象。彭博社的 Joe Wertz 和 Mary Hui 报道称，预测表明极涡可能在下周内崩溃。这一非同寻常的现象与“超级”厄尔尼诺现象相结合，可能会以科学家仍在试图了解的方式影响全球天气模式。

paras.en: “As a weather fan, this is a big event because it’s so unprecedented,” says Judah Cohen, a climatologist at MIT, to Jackie Flynn Mogensen at Scientific American. “It’s a lot of excitement. Everybody’s hair is on fire in the climate or meteorologist community.”
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院的气候学家犹大·科恩 (Judah Cohen) 对《科学美国人》的杰基·弗林·摩根森 (Jackie Flynn Mogensen) 说：“作为一名气象迷，这是一件大事，因为它是如此前所未有。” “这非常令人兴奋。在气候或气象学家界，每个人都兴奋不已。”

paras.en: When the polar vortex weakens, it can lead to something called sudden stratospheric warming (SSW). This phenomenon occurs when temperatures in the stratosphere, a layer of the Earth’s atmosphere, dramatically spike within just a few days. The temperature increase can weaken or even reverse the west-to-east winds of the polar vortex, sometimes causing the vortex to split apart. As a result, the cold air that is usually trapped within the stratosphere can be pushed south.
paras.zh: 当极涡减弱时，可能会导致平流层突然变暖（SSW）。当平流层（地球大气层）的温度在短短几天内急剧上升时，就会发生这种现象。温度升高会减弱甚至逆转极地涡旋的西向东风，有时会导致涡旋分裂。结果，通常困在平流层内的冷空气可以被推向南方。

paras.en: We reside in an atmospheric layer called the troposphere. The stratosphere sits above it, stretching from about 6.2 miles to 31 miles above Earth’s surface, and it contains the ozone layer.
paras.zh: 我们居住在一个称为对流层的大气层中。平流层位于其上方，距离地球表面约 6.2 英里至 31 英里，其中包含臭氧层。

paras.en: Researchers have been keeping reliable records of these events since 1958, and only two other SSWs have been documented in November, says Laura Ciasto, a meteorologist at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, to Doyle Rice and Dinah Voyles Pulver at USA Today. Previously, the earliest polar vortex disruption happened on November 28 in 1968, reports Scientific American.
paras.zh: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局的气象学家劳拉·恰斯托 (Laura Ciasto) 向《今日美国》的多伊尔·赖斯 (Doyle Rice) 和黛娜·沃伊尔斯·普尔弗 (Dinah Voyles Pulver) 表示，自 1958 年以来，研究人员一直在保存这些事件的可靠记录，而 11 月份只记录了另外两次超级风暴。据《科学美国人》报道，此前，最早的极涡扰动发生在 1968 年 11 月 28 日。

paras.en: These events can have wide-ranging impacts. In 2021, a disruption pushed cold air into Texas, leading to the Great Texas Freeze. The devastating chill caused more than 200 deaths and left more than 4.5 million homes and businesses without power because of the enormous strain on the state’s power grid.
paras.zh: 这些事件可能会产生广泛的影响。 2021 年，一场破坏将冷空气推入德克萨斯州，导致德克萨斯州大冰冻。由于该州电网承受巨大压力，这场毁灭性的严寒导致 200 多人死亡，超过 450 万户家庭和企业断电。

paras.en: That doesn’t mean the same thing will happen this winter. For now, researchers are unsure how the collapsing polar vortex’s influence will interact with that of the ongoing El Niño. It’s a naturally occurring climate pattern characterized by warmer-than-average surface water temperatures in the Pacific Ocean and weakened east-to-west trade winds, which affects global weather patterns.
paras.zh: 这并不意味着今年冬天会发生同样的事情。目前，研究人员还不确定崩溃的极地涡旋的影响将如何与正在进行的厄尔尼诺现象相互作用。这是一种自然发生的气候模式，其特征是太平洋表面水温高于平均水平和东西向信风减弱，影响全球天气模式。

paras.en: An El Niño year usually equates with milder winters in North America, but the polar vortex split could bring in cooler temperatures, per Scientific American. Northern Europe could also face chillier weather in a few weeks, report Matt Andrews and Morgan Thomas for the Guardian. But this year’s record-breaking El Niño could bring surprises.
paras.zh: 据《科学美国人》报道，厄尔尼诺年通常意味着北美的冬季较为温和，但极地涡旋分裂可能会带来较低的气温。马特·安德鲁斯和摩根·托马斯为《卫报》报道，北欧也可能在几周内面临更寒冷的天气。但今年破纪录的厄尔尼诺现象可能会带来惊喜。

paras.en: “When multiple exceptional events happen at the same time, even without climate change, it’s hard to know what to think,” says Simon Lee, a polar vortex researcher at the University of St. Andrews in Scotland, to Bloomberg. “When you have a rapidly warming climate underneath that, it’s even harder.”
paras.zh: “当多个异常事件同时发生时，即使没有气候变化，也很难知道该怎么想，”苏格兰圣安德鲁斯大学极涡研究员西蒙·李向彭博社表示。 “当气候迅速变暖时，事情就更加困难了。”

paras.en: Overall, “El Niño will still be the primary driver behind this winter because it’s so strong,” Alex DaSilva, a meteorologist at AccuWeather, tells Anna Skinner at Newsweek.
paras.zh: 总体而言，“厄尔尼诺现象仍将是今年冬天的主要推动因素，因为它非常强烈，”AccuWeather 的气象学家亚历克斯·达席尔瓦 (Alex DaSilva) 告诉《新闻周刊》的安娜·斯金纳 (Anna Skinner)。

paras.en: As of now, AccuWeather is still forecasting a “very warm” Northeast and northern Midwest this winter, he adds. Researchers will continue monitoring temperature and wind patterns for clues about what’s to come, including whether another polar vortex disruption could happen later this winter.
paras.zh: 他补充说，截至目前，AccuWeather 仍预测今年冬天东北部和中西部北部将“非常温暖”。研究人员将继续监测温度和风型，以寻找有关即将发生的事情的线索，包括今年冬天晚些时候是否会发生另一次极地涡旋破坏。

articles.title: This Wooden Wardrobe in Pompeii Remained Sealed for Nearly 2,000 Years. Archaeologists Just Opened It for the First Time

paras.en: Nearly 2,000 years ago, residents of the ancient Roman city of Pompeii stashed an eclectic mix of objects in a wooden wardrobe. The trove boasted both utilitarian items, such as a bronze lamp, and personal treasures, including a necklace featuring at least two dozen miniature charms and a cache of 38 coins. Now, archaeologists have unearthed these artifacts in a house on one of Pompeii’s busiest streets.
paras.zh: 大约 2000 年前，古罗马城市庞贝城的居民在木制衣柜里藏了各种各样的物品。该宝库中既有青铜灯等实用物品，也有私人珍宝，其中包括一条项链，上面至少有两打微型饰物，还有一箱 38 枚硬币。现在，考古学家在庞贝最繁忙的街道之一的一所房子里挖掘出了这些文物。

paras.en: Based on the number of valuables found in the wardrobe, archaeologists suspect that the house’s owners left in a hurry, perhaps during the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 C.E. (Most of the bronze coins date to the time of the Roman emperor Nero, who reigned between 54 and 68, and the frescoes adorning the building’s rooms correspond with the fourth style of Roman wall painting, which was popular between 20 and 79.) Whatever the reason for these Pompeians’ departure, they never returned home to retrieve their belongings.
paras.zh: 根据衣柜中发现的贵重物品的数量，考古学家怀疑这座房子的主人可能在公元 79 年维苏威火山爆发期间匆忙离开（大多数铜币可以追溯到罗马皇帝尼禄的时代，他在位 54 至 68 年间，装饰建筑物房间的壁画符合 20 至 79 年间流行的第四种罗马壁画风格。）这些庞贝人离开后，就再也没有回家取回自己的财物。

paras.en: “We cannot reconstruct with certainty the identity of whoever lived in the house, but these fragments bring us closer to their daily life,” says Gabriel Zuchtriegel, director of the Archaeological Park of Pompeii, in a statement, per a translation by Reuters’ Crispian Balmer. “The value of this discovery lies in the possibility of reading together the different traces of a life: personal habits, work and memories.”
paras.zh: 庞贝考古公园主任加布里埃尔·祖赫特里格尔 (Gabriel Zuchtriegel) 在一份声明中表示：“我们无法确定地重建房子里居住者的身份，但这些碎片让我们更接近他们的日常生活。” “这一发现的价值在于可以一起解读生活的不同痕迹：个人习惯、工作和记忆。”

paras.en: Archaeologists uncovered the wardrobe while surveying the House of Cornelius Maximus, a building in central Pompeii that was first excavated in 1912. As Zuchtriegel and his colleagues write in the archaeological park’s online journal, the cabinet’s contents paint a portrait of domestic life in the doomed city, revealing the range of activities that took place in ancient Roman homes.
paras.zh: 考古学家在勘察庞贝城中心的科尼利厄斯·马克西姆斯故居时发现了这个衣柜，这座建筑位于庞贝城中心，于 1912 年首次出土。正如 Zuchtriegel 和他的同事在考古公园的在线日志中所写，柜子里的东西描绘了这座注定要失败的城市的家庭生活，揭示了古罗马家庭中发生的一系列活动。

paras.en: Several artifacts recovered from the site are characteristic of mundus muliebris, a Latin term that refers to “objects intended for the personal care and adornment of women in the Roman world,” in the words of historian Pilar Pavón. These items include a pair of tweezers, a mortar used to prepare makeup pigments, and a glass balsamarium that once held perfume or scented oils.
paras.zh: 从该遗址中发现的几件文物具有“mundus muliebris”的特征，用历史学家皮拉尔·帕文（Pilar Pavón）的话说，这是一个拉丁术语，指的是“罗马世界女性用于个人护理和装饰的物品”。这些物品包括一把镊子、一个用来准备化妆颜料的研钵，以及一个曾经盛放香水或香油的玻璃香脂。

paras.en: - The ancient Romans used tweezers to remove unwanted body hair. Those who wanted assistance with this task could hire attendants at public baths.
paras.zh: - 古罗马人用镊子去除多余的体毛。那些需要帮助完成这项任务的人可以在公共浴室雇用服务员。

paras.en: - Seneca, a Roman politician and philosopher, lived near a bathhouse in the first century. As he wrote in a letter, he frequently heard “the skinny armpit hair-plucker, whose cries are shrill so as to draw people’s attention and who never stops, except when he’s doing his job and making someone else shriek for him.”
paras.zh: - 塞内卡，罗马政治家和哲学家，一世纪时住在澡堂附近。正如他在一封信中所写，他经常听到“那个瘦小的腋毛拔毛者，他的叫声很刺耳，以引起人们的注意，而且他从不停止，除非他在做他的工作，让别人为他尖叫。”

paras.en: In addition to these beauty accessories, archaeologists found bronze, glass and ceramic vessels that were likely used for cooking and dining. The tableware ranged from a two-handled cup to six lids of varying diameters to an assortment of pots.
