articles.title: Breaking Free a Seized Wheel Bearing Hub
articles.author: BCA Bearings by NTN

paras.en: A wheel bearing hub unit that is seized into a suspension knuckle can turn a routine repair into a struggle. The hub may be retained by bolts, but corrosion between the hub and knuckle can hold it in place after every fastener is removed. Understanding what formed that bond helps you choose an effective removal method and avoid damaging the knuckle, axle, or nearby components.
paras.zh: 车轮轴承轮毂单元卡在悬架转向节中可能会使例行维修变得很困难。轮毂可以通过螺栓固定，但在卸下每个紧固件后，轮毂和转向节之间的腐蚀可以将其固定到位。了解形成这种粘合的原因有助于您选择有效的去除方法，并避免损坏转向节、车轴或附近的部件。

paras.en: When a steel hub seizes in a knuckle bore, oxygen and moisture have reacted with metal at the interface. For iron in the steel, a simplified rust-forming reaction is:
paras.zh: 当钢轮毂卡在转向节孔中时，氧气和湿气会在界面处与金属发生反应。对于钢中的铁，简化的生锈反应为：

paras.en: The iron hydroxide then changes into hydrated iron oxides—the reddish-brown corrosion commonly called rust. These corrosion products take up more space than the original metal. As they build up in the narrow clearance between the hub and knuckle, they can wedge the two parts together. But, the oxides are very reactive and brittle.
paras.zh: 然后氢氧化铁转变为水合铁氧化物——红棕色腐蚀，通常称为铁锈。这些腐蚀产物比原始金属占据更多的空间。当它们积聚在轮毂和转向节之间的狭窄间隙中时，它们可以将两个零件楔在一起。但是，氧化物非常活泼且易碎。

paras.en: The joint may also involve dissimilar metals. Many hubs are made of steel, while some knuckles are aluminum. In the presence of moisture, these metals can form a galvanic cell that accelerates corrosion. De-icers and road salt can make the problem worse in areas that receive snow. When a steel hub is mounted in an aluminum knuckle, galvanic corrosion can occur alongside rust on the steel hub, so it may not be accurate to describe the entire bond as iron oxide. BCA Bearings identifies galvanic corrosion at steel hub and aluminum knuckle interfaces as a common cause of hubs becoming difficult to separate.
paras.zh: 接头还可能涉及不同种金属。许多轮毂是钢制的，而一些转向节是铝制的。在潮湿的情况下，这些金属会形成原电池，加速腐蚀。除冰剂和道路盐会使降雪地区的问题变得更严重。当钢轮毂安装在铝制转向节中时，钢轮毂上会同时生锈，同时发生电偶腐蚀，因此将整个结合描述为氧化铁可能并不准确。 BCA Bearings 认为钢轮毂和铝制转向节接口处的电偶腐蚀是导致轮毂难以分离的常见原因。

paras.en: The goal of removal is to break the mechanical bond created by corrosion products. Vibration, impact or movement can crack them. Heat can create stress at the interface, while penetrants may reduce friction and help the parts move once a gap opens. Dedicated rust removers can react chemically with corrosion, but they may also attack the base metal or nearby finishes.
paras.zh: 去除的目的是打破腐蚀产物产生的机械结合。振动、冲击或移动可能会使它们破裂。热量会在界面处产生应力，而渗透剂可以减少摩擦，并在间隙打开时帮助零件移动。专用除锈剂会与腐蚀发生化学反应，但它们也可能会腐蚀基底金属或附近的饰面。

paras.en: During the vehicle inspection, look for other corrosion damage. Dust shields and parking brake components inside the rotor hat can be perforated by rust and corrosion. Spotting this damage during the inspection can help you avoid delays while waiting for replacement parts.
paras.zh: 在检查车辆期间，寻找其他腐蚀损坏。转子帽内的防尘罩和驻车制动部件可能会因生锈和腐蚀而穿孔。在检查过程中发现这种损坏可以帮助您避免在等待更换零件时发生延误。

paras.en: What heat and chemicals can—and can’t—do
paras.zh: 热量和化学物质可以做什么，不能做什么

paras.en: Heat does not reverse the rust reaction. It does not turn iron oxide back into iron. Instead, heating and cooling create differential expansion and contraction between the hub, knuckle, and corrosion layer. That movement can stress and crack brittle deposits. If the outer part of the joint expands more than the inner part, the temporary increase in clearance can help the components move.
paras.zh: 加热不会逆转生锈反应。它不会将氧化铁还原成铁。相反，加热和冷却会在轮毂、转向节和腐蚀层之间产生不同的膨胀和收缩。这种运动会对脆性沉积物施加压力并使其破裂。如果接头的外部膨胀超过内部，间隙的临时增加可以帮助部件移动。

paras.en: Where you apply heat matters. The knuckle surrounds the hub, so heating the knuckle near the bore can expand the bore; however, uncontrolled torch heat can damage or distort the knuckle and nearby ball joints, seals, sensors, brake parts, or suspension components. BCA recommends against torch heating the knuckle and suggests an induction heater for localized heat at the wheel end.
paras.zh: 在哪里加热很重要。转向节围绕轮毂，因此加热孔附近的转向节可以使孔扩大；然而，不受控制的割炬热量可能会损坏或扭曲转向节和附近的球窝接头、密封件、传感器、制动部件或悬架部件。 BCA 建议不要用焊枪加热转向节，并建议使用感应加热器在轮端进行局部加热。

paras.en: If you plan to use heat, follow the vehicle and tool manufacturers’ instructions, and apply it only where you can control its effects. Be aware of wiring for the wheel speed sensor and brake pad wear sensor, as well as suspension bushings that could be damaged by heat. You are not trying to melt the hub unit. The goal is to use controlled heating and expansion to help break the corrosion bond.
paras.zh: 如果您打算使用热量，请遵循车辆和工具制造商的说明，并且仅在可以控制其影响的地方使用热量。请注意轮速传感器和刹车片磨损传感器的接线，以及可能因热而损坏的悬架衬套。您并不是试图熔化轮毂单元。目标是使用受控的加热和膨胀来帮助打破腐蚀键。

paras.en: Penetrants work differently. Most penetrating oils do not chemically dissolve iron oxide. They can seep into small clearances, lubricate contact surfaces and reduce friction as the hub begins to move. A light tap or controlled vibration may help the fluid reach the interface. Give it time to soak, and reapply as needed.
paras.zh: 渗透剂的作用不同。大多数渗透油不会以化学方式溶解氧化铁。它们可以渗入小间隙，润滑接触表面并减少轮毂开始移动时的摩擦。轻敲或受控振动可能有助于流体到达界面。给它一些时间浸泡，并根据需要重新涂抹。

paras.en: Rust removers, often acid-based, are designed to react with or dissolve corrosion. They may be useful on accessible parts after removal, but they are not automatically safe to use on an assembled hub and knuckle. Check product compatibility with aluminum, coatings, seals and nearby components. Keep penetrants and other flammable products away from open flames and hot surfaces, and follow label directions before applying heat.
paras.zh: 除锈剂通常是酸基的，旨在与腐蚀发生反应或溶解腐蚀。它们在拆卸后可能对可触及的零件很有用，但在组装好的轮毂和转向节上使用它们并不自动安全。检查产品与铝、涂层、密封件和附近组件的兼容性。使渗透剂和其他易燃产品远离明火和热表面，并在加热前遵循标签说明。

paras.en: When selecting a penetrant, make sure it is a penetrant and not a lubricant. Penetrants are formulated to wick into areas between the hub unit and knuckle. Also, penetrants do not catch fire or damage rubber and plastic materials like ball joint boots. If any penetrant contaminates the brake pads or rotor, clean it off immediately with a solvent.
paras.zh: 选择渗透剂时，请确保它是渗透剂而不是润滑剂。渗透剂的配方可渗透到轮毂单元和转向节之间的区域。此外，渗透剂不会着火或损坏橡胶和塑料材料，例如球形接头防护罩。如果任何渗透剂污染了刹车片或转子，请立即用溶剂将其清除。

paras.en: Most of all, take your time and read the directions with these products. Also, use in a well-ventilated area because some of the ingredients can cause health problems.
paras.zh: 最重要的是，花点时间阅读这些产品的说明。此外，请在通风良好的地方使用，因为某些成分可能会导致健康问题。

paras.en: Always begin with the vehicle safely supported and the service procedure for that application in hand. In recent years there have been a lot of tools introduced to remove hub units faster. They can range from a simple bar the attaches to the flange that you can strike with a sledge hammer, to application specific tools that use hydraulics to force the hub unit out of the bore. But, all of these tool do the same thing, they help to breakdown oxides between the hub and knuckle.
paras.zh: 始终从安全支持车辆并掌握该应用程序的维修程序开始。近年来，出现了许多工具来更快地拆卸轮毂单元。它们的范围从连接到法兰的简单杆（您可以用大锤敲击）到使用液压将轮毂单元推出孔的特定应用工具。但是，所有这些工具都做同样的事情，它们有助于分解轮毂和转向节之间的氧化物。

paras.en: An air hammer can help, but technique matters more than simply increasing force or buying a larger air hammer. The key is to use a suitable blunt attachment on the hub’s mounting flange or ears to make the hub rotate slightly in the knuckle. Avoid driving the tool between the hub and knuckle as a wedge; that can gouge the bore or break the casting. BCA recommends using the air hammer to rotate the hub flange relative to the knuckle, while keeping the tool off the knuckle. Once the hub moves, continue around the flange and pull it out squarely.
paras.zh: 气锤可以提供帮助，但技术比简单地增加力量或购买更大的气锤更重要。关键是在轮毂的安装法兰或耳上使用合适的钝头附件，使轮毂在转向节中轻微旋转。避免将工具作为楔子驱动在轮毂和转向节之间；这可能会凿孔或损坏铸件。 BCA 建议使用气锤相对于转向节旋转轮毂法兰，同时使工具远离转向节。一旦轮毂移动，继续围绕法兰并将其直接拉出。

paras.en: A hub puller, hub shocker, or forcing-screw tool applies controlled extraction force. Use the correct adapters for the vehicle and make sure the tool is centered and aligned for a straight pull. Increase force gradually, checking for movement and repositioning only as the tool instructions allow..
paras.zh: 轮毂拉拔器、轮毂减震器或拧紧螺丝工具可施加受控的拔出力。使用适合车辆的正确适配器，并确保工具居中并对齐以进行直拉。逐渐增加力，仅在工具说明允许的情况下检查移动和重新定位。

paras.en: Another tip is to look at the service information for the procedures and recommended tools. Some OEMs might include an flat part of the knuckle that can be used by a puller or forcing screw to remove the hub unit.
paras.zh: 另一个技巧是查看程序和推荐工具的服务信息。一些原始设备制造商可能包括转向节的平坦部分，可供拉拔器或加压螺钉用来拆卸轮毂单元。

paras.en: After removal, clean corrosion from the bore and mounting face without removing base metal. Inspect for cracks, gouging, or deformation, then install the replacement hub according to the vehicle procedure and specified torque.
paras.zh: 拆卸后，清除孔和安装面上的腐蚀物，无需去除母材。检查是否有裂纹、凿痕或变形，然后根据车辆程序和规定扭矩安装更换轮毂。

paras.en: You can add a light coating of moly anti-seize to the bore of the knuckle to decrease the chances of future corrosion. Avoid getting any anti-seize on the bolt holes of the knuckle. Any lubricant can change the torque value of a fastener.
paras.zh: 您可以在转向节的孔中添加一层薄薄的钼防卡剂涂层，以减少未来腐蚀的机会。避免在转向节的螺栓孔上沾上任何防卡剂。任何润滑剂都可以改变紧固件的扭矩值。

paras.en: The most important step to removing a stuck hub unit is to review the service information and TSB. Often, the service procedure will be amended to include information on procedures and special tools.
paras.zh: 拆除卡住的集线器单元最重要的步骤是查看服务信息和 TSB。通常，服务程序将被修改以包括有关程序和特殊工具的信息。

paras.en: If you’re unable to free the hub unit from the knuckle, don’t take it personally. One of the most important skills gained through experience is knowing when to stop trying to remove a hub unit with heat, brute force or chemicals. In some cases, recommending replacement of the knuckle along with the hub unit is more productive and makes for a better repair.
paras.zh: 如果您无法将轮毂单元从转向节上松开，请不要认为这是针对您个人的。通过经验获得的最重要的技能之一是知道何时停止尝试用热、蛮力或化学物质拆卸轮毂单元。在某些情况下，建议更换转向节和轮毂单元，这样可以提高工作效率，并且可以更好地进行维修。

paras.en: Aftermarket replacement knuckles are available, and some lines cover applications where hub units can be especially difficult to remove. Experience also helps you recognize which applications are most likely to cause frustration.
paras.zh: 售后市场提供替换转向节，某些系列涵盖了轮毂单元特别难以拆卸的应用。经验还可以帮助您识别哪些应用程序最有可能造成挫败感。

paras.en: Wheel End Service: Do You Have These Tools?
paras.zh: 轮端服务：您有这些工具吗？

paras.en: Over the past decade, tool companies have introduced new wheel end service tool and have improved existing tools. These next generation tools can be used on their own or together to make your next hub unit job easier.
paras.zh: 在过去的十年中，工具公司推出了新的轮端维修工具并改进了现有工具。这些下一代工具可以单独使用或一起使用，以使您的下一个轮毂单元工作更加轻松。

paras.en: Hub Strikers: A hub striker is a solid metal bar that bolts to the hub flange and provides a striking point outside the wheel well. This helps reduce the risk of hitting the fender while using a sledgehammer. Hub strikers can work well on some Gen 2 and Gen 3 hub units that use orbital forming to retain the flange and set bearing preload. Depending on the application, they can make removal much faster.
paras.zh: 轮毂撞针：轮毂撞针是一根实心金属棒，用螺栓固定在轮毂法兰上，并在轮舱外提供一个撞击点。这有助于降低使用大锤时击中挡泥板的风险。轮毂撞针可以在某些使用轨道成型来固定法兰并设置轴承预载的第 2 代和第 3 代轮毂单元上很好地工作。根据应用的不同，它们可以使移除速度更快。

paras.en: Lug Nuts and Washers: Another tool you can use to hammer on the hub unit is an old brake rotor with the same lug pattern. Secure the rotor to the flange with lug nuts and washers. The rotor provides a solid surface to strike with your hammer.
paras.zh: 凸耳螺母和垫圈：另一种可以用来锤击轮毂单元的工具是具有相同凸耳图案的旧制动盘。用凸耳螺母和垫圈将转子固定到法兰上。转子提供了坚固的表面，可以用锤子敲击。

paras.en: Forcing Screws: A forcing screw uses a threaded rod or fastener to apply force between the hub flange and the knuckle, pushing the hub outward. Some applications allow a suitable bolt to be used as a forcing screw, but it must have adequate thread engagement and bear against a solid part of the knuckle. Purpose-built tool sets use a plate that attaches to the hub, often at the wheel studs, and a forcing screw to push the hub out. Use the correct setup for the vehicle and keep the force aligned with the hub.
paras.zh: 强制螺钉：强制螺钉使用螺纹杆或紧固件在轮毂法兰和转向节之间施加力，将轮毂向外推。某些应用允许使用合适的螺栓作为强制螺钉，但它必须具有足够的螺纹啮合并靠在转向节的坚固部分上。专用工具套件使用固定在轮毂上的板（通常位于车轮螺柱处）和将轮毂推出的施力螺钉。对车辆使用正确的设置并保持力与轮毂对齐。

paras.en: Slide Hammer: A slide hammer can attach to the hub flange and apply repeated outward force as the hammer is moved along its shaft. It can be effective when the knuckle does not provide a suitable surface for a forcing screw. Use an appropriate hub adapter and keep the hammer’s path clear of the body and nearby components.
paras.zh: 滑动锤：滑动锤可以连接到轮毂法兰上，并在锤沿其轴移动时施加重复的向外力。当转向节没有为施力螺钉提供合适的表面时，它可能会很有效。使用合适的轮毂适配器，并使锤子的路径远离主体和附近的组件。

paras.en: Air Hammer: An air hammer can help break the corrosion bond by vibrating or rotating the hub flange relative to the knuckle. Use a suitable attachment and work around the flange without striking or gouging the knuckle. Tool size alone does not determine effectiveness; consider the hammer’s stroke, operating rate, air supply, and how well you can control it. More force is not always better. BCA recommends using the air hammer to rotate the hub flange rather than wedging the tool between the hub and knuckle.
paras.zh: 空气锤：空气锤可以通过相对于转向节振动或旋转轮毂法兰来帮助打破腐蚀结合。使用合适的附件并在法兰周围工作，不要敲击或凿伤转向节。工具大小本身并不能决定有效性；考虑锤子的冲程、运转率、空气供应以及控制能力。力量越大并不总是越好。 BCA 建议使用气锤旋转轮毂法兰，而不是将工具楔入轮毂和转向节之间。

paras.en: Hydraulic Press: On some vehicles, you may need to remove the knuckle to free the hub. Success depends on using the correct fixtures and adapters to support the knuckle securely and keep the press load aligned. Special press plates are available for some applications. Protect the knuckle, dust shield, and machined surfaces from damage, and follow the tool manufacturer’s instructions.
paras.zh: 液压机：在某些车辆上，您可能需要拆下转向节以释放轮毂。成功取决于使用正确的夹具和适配器来牢固地支撑转向节并保持压力机负载对齐。特殊压板可用于某些应用。保护转向节、防尘罩和加工表面免受损坏，并遵循工具制造商的说明。

paras.en: Heat: Heat can help loosen the joint through differential expansion and contraction; it does not reverse the corrosion reaction. Options include a propane or MAP-Pro torch and an induction heater. A torch can supply sufficient heat, but it is difficult to control and can damage CV-joint, tie-rod, and ball-joint boots, along with other nearby parts. An induction heater uses an electromagnetic field to heat metal, and many units include a flexible coil that can be positioned around the hub or knuckle. Use only a heating method and location appropriate for the application. BCA cautions against torch-heating the knuckle and recommends localized induction heating for wheel-end work.
paras.zh: 热：热可以通过不同的膨胀和收缩来帮助松开接头；它不会逆转腐蚀反应。选项包括丙烷或 MAP-Pro 割炬和感应加热器。割炬可以提供足够的热量，但难以控制，并且可能损坏等速万向节、横拉杆和球窝接头防尘套以及其他附近的部件。感应加热器使用电磁场来加热金属，许多装置都包含可放置在轮毂或转向节周围的柔性线圈。仅使用适合应用的加热方法和位置。 BCA 警告不要使用火炬加热转向节，并建议对轮端工作进行局部感应加热。

paras.en: Chemicals: Penetrants are formulated to flow into tight clearances and reduce friction at the hub-to-knuckle interface. Some use solvents or other additives, but most penetrating oils do not dissolve rust. Apply the product as directed and allow time for it to soak in. Tapping or gently working the hub can help the penetrant reach the joint. Rust removers are different: many react chemically with corrosion, but they may also attack the base metal, coatings, or nearby finishes. Check product compatibility before use.
paras.zh: 化学品：渗透剂经过精心配制，可流入紧密的间隙并减少轮毂到转向节界面处的摩擦。有些使用溶剂或其他添加剂，但大多数渗透油不会溶解铁锈。按照指示涂抹产品，并留出时间让其渗透。轻敲或轻轻操作轮毂可以帮助渗透剂到达接头。除锈剂则不同：许多除锈剂会与腐蚀发生化学反应，但它们也可能会腐蚀基底金属、涂层或附近的饰面。使用前检查产品兼容性。

paras.en: This article is sponsored by BCA Bearings by NTN.
paras.zh: 本文由 NTN 的 BCA 轴承赞助。

articles.title: Bringing ADAS Calibration In-House
articles.author: Autel

paras.en: See how Vann York Collision Center in High Point, North Carolina, is using Autel technology to bring ADAS calibration in-house, streamline collision repair workflows, and reduce reliance on outsourced services.
paras.zh: 了解位于北卡罗来纳州海波因特的 Vann York 碰撞中心如何使用 Autel 技术将 ADAS 校准引入内部、简化碰撞修复工作流程并减少对外包服务的依赖。

paras.en: ASE-Certified Master Automobile Technician Eric visits Vann York to talk with the team about their transition to Autel diagnostic, ADAS calibration and wheel alignment equipment. After working with other scan and calibration tools, the team shares how Autel has helped simplify setup, improve usability and bring alignment and ADAS calibration together in a more efficient workflow.
paras.zh: ASE 认证汽车技术大师 Eric 拜访 Vann York，与团队讨论他们向 Autel 诊断、ADAS 校准和车轮定位设备的过渡。在与其他扫描和校准工具合作后，该团队分享了 Autel 如何帮助简化设置、提高可用性以及在更高效的工作流程中将对准和 ADAS 校准结合在一起。

paras.en: With guided software, integrated alignment and calibration capabilities, training and technical support, Vann York is building more control into the repair process—and planning to expand its use of Autel equipment as the business grows.
paras.zh: 凭借引导软件、集成对准和校准功能、培训和技术支持，Vann York 正在对维修过程进行更多控制，并计划随着业务的增长扩大 Autel 设备的使用。

paras.en: - Why Vann York brought ADAS calibration in-house;
paras.zh: - 为什么 Vann York 将 ADAS 校准引入内部；

articles.title: Bill Hanvey and Emily Poladian Discuss Aftermarket Growth Outlook
articles.author: aftermarketNews Staff

paras.en: The U.S. light-duty aftermarket is projected to grow 5.2% in 2026 and exceed $500 billion, but serving that demand requires companies to keep pace with changing vehicles, customer expectations and the technology reshaping their own operations.
paras.zh: 美国轻型汽车售后市场预计到 2026 年将增长 5.2%，超过 5000 亿美元，但满足这一需求需要公司跟上不断变化的车辆、客户期望和重塑自身运营的技术。

paras.en: That was a central message from Auto Care Association President and CEO Bill Hanvey and MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers President Emily Poladian at AAPEX, where they connected the industry’s growth outlook with the work required to develop replacement parts, move them through distribution and support the technicians who install them.
paras.zh: 这是汽车护理协会主席兼首席执行官 Bill Hanvey 和 MEMA 售后市场供应商总裁 Emily Poladian 在 AAPEX 上传达的核心信息，他们将行业的增长前景与开发替换零件、通过分销运输零件以及为安装零件的技术人员提供支持所需的工作联系起来。

paras.en: Hanvey cited the 2026 joint channel forecast as evidence of an industry that remains fundamentally strong. Both speakers pointed to speed, choice, innovation and adaptability as reasons consumers continue to choose independent aftermarket businesses.
paras.zh: Hanvey 引用 2026 年联合渠道预测作为行业基本面依然强劲的证据。两位发言者都指出速度、选择、创新和适应性是消费者继续选择独立售后市场企业的原因。

paras.en: “We learn fast, we build fast, we respond fast,” Hanvey said.
paras.zh: “我们学习快，构建快，响应快，”汉维说。

paras.en: That response starts well before a vehicle enters a service bay. Vehicle manufacturers begin with engineering information, service procedures, tools and years of development. Independent aftermarket companies must understand the technology, engineer replacement products, build catalog data and develop diagnostic tools. Technician training and distribution must follow.
paras.zh: 这种响应早在车辆进入维修站之前就开始了。汽车制造商从工程信息、服务程序、工具和多年的发展开始。独立的售后公司必须了解技术、设计替代产品、构建目录数据并开发诊断工具。技术人员的培训和分配必须遵循。

paras.en: For manufacturers, distributors and repair businesses, the speakers described opportunities to use technology throughout that process. Artificial intelligence can support forecasting, decision-making and predictive analytics. Additive manufacturing can accelerate parts development and production. E-commerce, automation and supply chain technology can help products and information move faster.
paras.zh: 对于制造商、分销商和维修企业来说，演讲者描述了在整个过程中使用技术的机会。人工智能可以支持预测、决策和预测分析。增材制造可以加速零件的开发和生产。电子商务、自动化和供应链技术可以帮助产品和信息更快地流动。

paras.en: The operational goal is to better understand demand, manage complexity and get the right parts and information to customers. That places business technology alongside the vehicle technologies already changing what the aftermarket makes, sells and services, including electrification, software and connectivity.
paras.zh: 运营目标是更好地了解需求、管理复杂性并向客户提供正确的零件和信息。这使得商业技术与汽车技术一起改变了售后市场的制造、销售和服务，包括电气化、软件和连接。

paras.en: “When the vehicle changes, we change with it,” Poladian said.
paras.zh: “当车辆发生变化时，我们也会随之改变，”波拉迪安说。

paras.en: Access to repair information remains part of that challenge. Hanvey said the industry’s right-to-repair objectives continue to center on consumer choice, fair competition and the independent aftermarket’s ability to service increasingly sophisticated vehicles.
paras.zh: 获取维修信息仍然是这一挑战的一部分。汉维表示，该行业的维修权目标仍然以消费者选择、公平竞争以及独立售后市场为日益复杂的车辆提供服务的能力为中心。

paras.en: The program recognized Rep. Dunn’s work on the REPAIR Act, including his efforts to bring stakeholders together around the issue. Hanvey and Poladian emphasized that the industry must remain willing to adjust its approach while pursuing those objectives.
paras.zh: 该计划认可了众议员邓恩在《修复法案》方面的工作，包括他为将利益相关者聚集在一起解决该问题所做的努力。汉维和波拉迪安强调，该行业在追求这些目标的同时必须保持调整方法的意愿。

paras.en: Workforce development was another priority. The speakers highlighted scholarships, industry networks and programs that help people find technical, operational, analytical and entrepreneurial careers. They also discussed changes to the University of the Aftermarket’s Leadership 2.0 program informed by industry focus groups.
paras.zh: 劳动力发展是另一个优先事项。演讲者强调了帮助人们找到技术、运营、分析和创业职业的奖学金、行业网络和项目。他们还讨论了行业焦点小组通报的售后大学领导力 2.0 计划的变化。

articles.title: Valvoline Global Showcases Motor Oil Testing at AAPEX
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Valvoline Global Operations presents new motor oil testing data at the Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo (AAPEX). The research examines differences in motor oil performance, including deposit removal and piston ring movement.
paras.zh: 胜牌全球运营部在汽车售后市场产品博览会 (AAPEX) 上展示了新的机油测试数据。该研究考察了机油性能的差异，包括沉积物去除和活塞环运动。

paras.en: At Booth V4418, Valvoline Global shares test results demonstrating how Restore & Protect removes deposits and frees stuck piston rings. The company compares its findings with results from competing motor oils.
paras.zh: 在 V4418 展位上，Valvoline Global 分享了测试结果，展示了 Restore & Protect 如何去除沉积物并释放卡住的活塞环。该公司将其研究结果与竞争机油的结果进行了比较。

paras.en: Valvoline Global Examines Motor Oil Performance
paras.zh: 胜牌全球检查机油性能

paras.en: Since its introduction in 2024, Restore & Protect has challenged traditional expectations of motor oil performance. Building on previously demonstrated deposit-removal capabilities, the latest research examines piston deposit formation in three competing motor oils.
paras.zh: 自 2024 年推出以来，Restore & Protect 挑战了对机油性能的传统预期。基于先前展示的沉积物去除能力，最新研究检查了三种竞争机油中活塞沉积物的形成。

paras.en: The testing includes a leading full synthetic motor oil and two other competing products. Researchers use Sequence IIIH engine tests and evaluate each oil at its recommended drain interval.
paras.zh: 测试包括领先的全合成机油和其他两种竞争产品。研究人员使用 Sequence IIIH 发动机测试并按照建议的换油周期评估每种机油。

paras.en: Valvoline Global conducts the controlled testing at its certified engine laboratory in Ashland, Kentucky. Each of the three competing oils produces engine deposits that contribute to one or more stuck piston rings.
paras.zh: 胜牌全球在其位于肯塔基州阿什兰的经过认证的发动机实验室进行受控测试。三种相互竞争的机油中的每一种都会产生发动机沉积物，从而导致一个或多个活塞环卡住。

paras.en: Researchers then run Restore & Protect through the same pistons twice at the vehicle manufacturer’s recommended oil-drain interval. The oil removes deposits and restores piston ring movement closer to its original equipment manufacturer (OEM)-intended operating condition.*
paras.zh: 然后，研究人员按照车辆制造商建议的换油间隔，通过相同的活塞运行恢复和保护两次。该油可去除沉积物并恢复活塞环的运动，使其更接近其原始设备制造商 (OEM) 预期的操作条件。*

paras.en: Stuck piston rings can cause significant engine problems, including blow-by and increased oil consumption.
paras.zh: 卡住的活塞环可能会导致严重的发动机问题，包括窜气和油耗增加。

paras.en: Restore & Protect Testing Highlights Deposit Removal
paras.zh: 恢复和保护测试亮点存款去除

paras.en: Valvoline states that Restore & Protect is the first and only motor oil to remove up to 100% of engine deposits with continuous use.**
paras.zh: 胜牌表示，Restore & Protect 是第一种也是唯一一种能够在持续使用的情况下去除高达 100% 的发动机沉积物的机油。**

paras.en: The company’s latest research also indicates that Restore & Protect helps restore movement to piston rings previously stuck by deposits.
paras.zh: 该公司的最新研究还表明，Restore & Protect 有助于恢复之前被沉积物卡住的活塞环的运动能力。

paras.en: Valvoline highlights Restore & Protect’s deposit-removal technology through a new television commercial for North American audiences.
paras.zh: Valvoline 通过面向北美观众的新电视广告突出了 Restore & Protect 的沉积物清除技术。

paras.en: At AAPEX, attendees can view the test results featured in the advertising campaign. The booth also features visual representations of the findings and a presentation by Dr. Michael Warholic.
paras.zh: 在 AAPEX 上，与会者可以查看广告活动中的测试结果。展位上还展示了研究结果的视觉展示以及迈克尔·沃霍利克 (Michael Warholic) 博士的演讲。

paras.en: Warholic serves as senior director of technology at Valvoline Global Operations.
paras.zh: Warholic 担任胜牌全球运营部的高级技术总监。

articles.title: Astemo to Invest Over $11 Million in Muncie Operations
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Astemo plans to invest more than $11 million in its Muncie, Indiana, manufacturing operations. The program includes additional injection molding capacity and a new assembly line for intake manifolds. The line will support internal combustion engine (ICE) and hybrid electric vehicle (HEV) applications.
paras.zh: Astemo 计划对其位于印第安纳州曼西的制造业务投资超过 1100 万美元。该计划包括额外的注塑能力和一条新的进气歧管装配线。该生产线将支持内燃机（ICE）和混合动力电动汽车（HEV）应用。

paras.en: The company expects the new assembly line to begin production in March 2027. The expansion will add up to nine jobs within the next three years.
paras.zh: 该公司预计新装配线将于 2027 年 3 月开始生产。此次扩建将在未来三年内增加多达 9 个就业岗位。

paras.en: Astemo Receives Tax Abatement for Expansion
paras.zh: Astemo 获得扩张减税

paras.en: Astemo Americas vice president of operations Alejandro Navarro Lopez noted that the Muncie City Council recently approved a five-year tax abatement.
paras.zh: Astemo Americas 运营副总裁 Alejandro Navarro Lopez 指出，曼西市议会最近批准了一项五年减税计划。

paras.en: “We appreciate the support of the Economic Development Alliance and the Muncie community,” Lopez said. “This partnership reinforces Astemo’s commitment to investing in Muncie, supporting our employees and driving long-term growth.”
paras.zh: “我们感谢经济发展联盟和曼西社区的支持，”洛佩兹说。 “这种合作伙伴关系强化了 Astemo 对投资曼西、支持我们的员工和推动长期增长的承诺。”

paras.en: Lopez added that interested applicants can visit Astemo’s careers website to apply for jobs and view current employment opportunities.
paras.zh: 洛佩兹补充说，感兴趣的申请人可以访问 Astemo 的职业网站申请工作并查看当前的就业机会。

paras.en: Astemo develops technologies and products focused on safe, sustainable and comfortable mobility. The company develops software-defined vehicle (SDV), autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems (AD/ADAS), advanced chassis and powertrain solutions. It serves automotive and motorcycle original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) worldwide.
paras.zh: Astemo 开发专注于安全、可持续和舒适移动的技术和产品。该公司开发软件定义车辆（SDV）、自动驾驶和高级驾驶员辅助系统（AD/ADAS）、先进底盘和动力总成解决方案。它为全球汽车和摩托车原始设备制造商 (OEM) 提供服务。

paras.en: “Astemo’s decision to expand its Muncie operation speaks to the strength of this facility, its workforce and our community,” said Traci Lutton, vice president of economic development for the Economic Development Alliance of Muncie-Delaware County. “Manufacturing companies with national and global footprints continually evaluate where to place future production and investment. We’re grateful Astemo continues to choose Muncie and Delaware County, and we’re proud to support a company that has demonstrated such a long-term commitment to our community.”
paras.zh: 曼西-特拉华县经济发展联盟经济发展副总裁 Traci Lutton 表示：“Astemo 扩大曼西业务的决定证明了该设施、员工队伍和我们社区的实力。” “足迹遍布全国和全球的制造公司不断评估未来的生产和投资地点。我们很感激 Astemo 继续选择曼西和特拉华县，我们很自豪能够支持一家对我们的社区做出如此长期承诺的公司。”

paras.en: Astemo established its Muncie facility in 1999. The facility employs approximately 188 people, nearly 70% of whom live in Muncie.
paras.zh: Astemo 于 1999 年建立了曼西工厂。该工厂拥有约 188 名员工，其中近 70% 居住在曼西。

articles.title: Choosing Between Wax and Ceramic Coatings
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Traditional car wax, particularly carnauba-based products, creates a protective barrier on a vehicle’s paint. However, UV exposure and water gradually degrade that protection, requiring regular reapplication. Ceramic coatings offer longer-lasting protection by bonding with the surface.
paras.zh: 传统车蜡，特别是巴西棕榈蜡产品，可以在车辆油漆上形成保护屏障。然而，紫外线照射和水会逐渐降低这种保护作用，需要定期重新涂抹。陶瓷涂层通过与表面粘合提供更持久的保护。

paras.en: It’s important to emphasize proper surface preparation, including removing dirt and contaminants with clay bars or specialized cleaning mitts before application.
paras.zh: 重要的是要强调适当的表面准备，包括在施工前用粘土棒或专门的清洁手​​套去除污垢和污染物。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: PRT to Showcase Expanded Product Lines at AAPEX
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: PRT, a brand of ADD USA Group, will showcase its product lines and latest applications at AAPEX 2026. The company will exhibit at the Venetian Expo in booth F14600. PRT manufactures shocks, struts and complete strut assemblies. A key highlight will be its new light commercial vehicle (LCV) line, which expands coverage in the segment.
paras.zh: ADD USA集团旗下品牌PRT将在AAPEX 2026上展示其产品线和最新应用。该公司将在威尼斯博览会F14600展位展出。 PRT 生产减震器、前减震器和完整的前减震器组件。一个主要亮点将是其新的轻型商用车（LCV）产品线，该产品线扩大了该细分市场的覆盖范围。

paras.en: PRT Expands Light Commercial Vehicle Coverage
paras.zh: PRT 扩大轻型商用车覆盖范围

paras.en: The company also will present its air shocks, top mounts and motor mounts product lines. Its heavy-duty portfolio includes applications for trucks, trailers, buses, commercial vehicles, cement mixers and motorhomes. Attendees can visit the booth to learn about promotional offers available to eligible customers during the show.
paras.zh: 该公司还将展示其空气减震器、顶部安装件和电机安装件产品线。其重型产品组合包括卡车、拖车、公共汽车、商用车、水泥搅拌机和房车的应用。与会者可以参观展位，了解展会期间向符合资格的客户提供的促销优惠。

paras.en: “We’re more than happy to introduce our new LCV line and showcase our multiple product lines at AAPEX 2026,” said Bruno Bello of PRT. “Our ongoing investments in manufacturing technology and OE-quality engineering support the continued development of solutions for the North American Aftermarket.”
paras.zh: PRT 的 Bruno Bello 表示：“我们非常高兴在 AAPEX 2026 上推出我们新的轻型商用车系列并展示我们的多个产品线。” “我们对制造技术和原厂质量工程的持续投资支持北美售后市场解决方案的持续开发。”

paras.en: Customers can obtain additional product information by calling PRT at 770-238-1611 or visiting www.prtautoparts.com. The company also provides updates through its social media channels at @prtautoparts.
paras.zh: 客户可以拨打 770-238-1611 联系 PRT 或访问 www.prtautoparts.com，获取更多产品信息。该公司还通过其社交媒体渠道@prtautoparts 提供更新信息。

articles.title: One-third of babies diagnosed with peanut allergy don't actually have one, study hints
articles.author: Anirban Mukhopadhyay

paras.en: A peanut allergy diagnosis in infancy can mean years of avoiding the food or undergoing treatments to build tolerance. But a recent study suggests that more than one-third of babies thought to have the allergy may stop reacting badly to peanuts within months of that diagnosis.
paras.zh: 在婴儿期诊断出花生过敏可能意味着要多年避免食用该食物或接受治疗以建立耐受性。但最近的一项研究表明，超过三分之一被认为患有过敏的婴儿可能会在诊断后几个月内停止对花生的不良反应。

paras.en: In an analysis published in The Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology: In Practice, researchers conducted supervised "food challenges" with infants diagnosed with a peanut allergy. These challenges involved giving the babies increasing amounts of peanut protein, with the intention of confirming whether they indeed had an allergy.
paras.zh: 在《过敏与临床免疫学杂志：实践》上发表的一项分析中，研究人员对被诊断患有花生过敏的婴儿进行了监督“食物挑战”。这些挑战包括给婴儿增加花生蛋白的摄入量，目的是确认他们是否确实过敏。

paras.en: The team found that more than 1 in 3 infants who underwent the food challenge tolerated the peanut protein, meaning they didn't experience symptoms of an allergic reaction.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，超过三分之一接受食物挑战的婴儿能够耐受花生蛋白，这意味着他们没有出现过敏反应症状。

paras.en: "This rate is much higher than we thought," study co-author Dr. Timothy Brettig, a pediatric allergist at the National Allergy Centre of Excellence in Australia, told Live Science.
paras.zh: “这个比率比我们想象的要高得多，”研究合著者、澳大利亚国家过敏卓越中心的儿科过敏专家蒂莫西·布雷蒂格博士告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: Between April 2024 and October 2025, Brettig and colleagues retroactively reviewed the medical records of 1,275 infants who had been referred to Australian public hospitals after having a reaction to peanuts before their first birthday. These babies had first been assessed by allergy specialists at a median of 10 months of age.
paras.zh: 2024 年 4 月至 2025 年 10 月期间，Brettig 及其同事回顾性审查了 1,275 名婴儿的医疗记录，这些婴儿在一岁生日前因花生过敏而被转诊至澳大利亚公立医院。这些婴儿在平均 10 个月大时首先接受了过敏专家的评估。

paras.en: For their initial diagnosis, the babies had to have a history of an allergic reaction to peanuts and show evidence of peanut sensitization on an allergy test. These tests included a skin-prick test, in which peanut extract is placed on the skin before it's lightly pricked, to check for a local reaction; and blood tests that detect antibodies against peanut proteins.
paras.zh: 对于初步诊断，婴儿必须有花生过敏反应史，并在过敏测试中显示出花生过敏的证据。这些测试包括皮肤点刺测试，在轻轻刺破皮肤之前将花生提取物放在皮肤上，以检查局部反应；以及检测花生蛋白抗体的血液测试。

paras.en: "Children under 1 year of age are an interesting group, as their immune system is still in rapid development and existing allergy tests may not reflect their allergic status well," said Dr. Alexandra Santos, a professor of pediatric allergy at King's College London who was not involved in the study. While these tests can hint that a child is sensitized to certain foods, they don't necessarily confirm that a baby will have an allergic reaction upon eating said food; the tests can also give false positives.
paras.zh: “1岁以下的儿童是一个有趣的群体，因为他们的免疫系统仍处于快速发育阶段，现有的过敏测试可能无法很好地反映他们的过敏状况，”未参与这项研究的伦敦国王学院儿科过敏学教授亚历山德拉·桑托斯博士说。虽然这些测试可以暗示孩子对某些食物敏感，但它们并不一定能证实婴儿在食用所述食物后会产生过敏反应；测试也可能给出误报。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Of the 1,275 infants, 778 later underwent a food challenge roughly six months after their first recorded allergic reaction; at that point, their median age was 13 months old. They were given up to seven gradually increasing doses of peanut protein, ranging from 15 to 1,300 milligrams. These doses were given at 15-minute intervals while medical staff monitored the children for signs of an allergic reaction.
paras.zh: 在这 1,275 名婴儿中，有 778 名婴儿在第一次记录到过敏反应后大约六个月接受了食物挑战；那时，他们的中位年龄是 13 个月大。他们被给予七次逐渐增加剂量的花生蛋白，范围从 15 到 1,300 毫克。这些剂量每隔 15 分钟注射一次，同时医务人员监测孩子们是否有过敏反应迹象。

paras.en: Nearly 35% of the participants — 271 kids — completed the challenge without reacting.
paras.zh: 近 35% 的参与者（271 名孩子）毫无反应地完成了挑战。

paras.en: "This is an excellent article," said Dr. Drew Bird, a pediatric allergist at the University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center who was not involved in the study. "The take-home message is to strongly consider a supervised oral food challenge when an infant's peanut allergy diagnosis is uncertain."
paras.zh: “这是一篇很棒的文章，”德克萨斯大学西南医学中心的儿科过敏症专家德鲁·伯德博士说，他没有参与这项研究。 “重要的信息是，当婴儿的花生过敏诊断不确定时，要强烈考虑在监督下进行口服食物挑战。”

paras.en: Bird emphasized that these challenges should ideally be done before a child starts oral immunotherapy, a treatment in which patients regularly consume carefully measured amounts of the food they are allergic to. The dose is gradually increased under medical supervision, with the goal of helping the patient tolerate greater amounts of the allergen and reducing the risk of reactions from accidental exposure.
paras.zh: 伯德强调，这些挑战最好在孩子开始口服免疫疗法之前完成，在这种疗法中，患者定期食用经过仔细测量的量的他们过敏的食物。在医疗监督下逐渐增加剂量，目的是帮助患者耐受更大量的过敏原并降低意外接触引起反应的风险。

paras.en: The starting dose is often determined through a similar oral food challenge to the one used in this study, though. So in theory, that challenge would help reveal whether the child needs treatment in the first place.
paras.zh: 不过，起始剂量通常是通过与本研究中使用的类似的口服食物挑战来确定的。因此从理论上讲，这一挑战将有助于揭示孩子是否首先需要治疗。

paras.en: Bird cautioned that food challenges should be performed by a board-certified allergist-immunologist and an experienced allergy team in a setting equipped to treat anaphylaxis — a severe, potentially life-threatening allergic reaction.
paras.zh: 伯德警告说，食物挑战应该由经过委员会认证的过敏症免疫学家和经验丰富的过敏团队在配备治疗过敏反应的环境中进行，过敏反应是一种严重的、可能危及生命的过敏反应。

paras.en: In this study, 507 infants reacted during the food challenge, and of those, 61 developed anaphylaxis and were treated with epinephrine (the hormone in EpiPens).
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，507 名婴儿在食物挑战期间出现反应，其中 61 名出现过敏反应并接受肾上腺素（EpiPens 中的激素）治疗。

paras.en: "In an ideal world, with infinite resources," Santos said, "all patients except for those with a history of severe reactions would have a food challenge for diagnosis."
paras.zh: 桑托斯说：“在一个拥有无限资源的理想世界中，除了那些有严重反应史的患者之外，所有患者都将面临诊断时的食物挑战。”

paras.en: Because that is not the case, the families of infants whose allergy diagnosis is uncertain may be advised to avoid peanut products while they await a formal food challenge, she noted. But in the interim, they may miss an opportunity to help the child develop tolerance and, in turn, increase the risk that their allergy will persist.
paras.zh: 她指出，由于情况并非如此，过敏诊断不确定的婴儿的家人可能会被建议在等待正式食物挑战期间避免食用花生产品。但在此期间，他们可能会错过帮助孩子培养耐受性的机会，进而增加过敏持续存在的风险。

paras.en: Food challenges should be prioritized for infants whose allergy diagnoses are uncertain, she said. This would include babies who have low levels of peanut-specific antibodies in their blood or who show only small welts on skin-prick tests.
paras.zh: 她说，对于过敏诊断不确定的婴儿，应优先考虑食物挑战。这包括血液中花生特异性抗体水平较低或在皮肤点刺测试中仅显示小伤痕的婴儿。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Brettig, T. W., McDonald, E., West, D., et al. (2026). An oral food challenge is required for accurate diagnosis of peanut allergy in infants prior to oral immunotherapy: Evaluation of the Allergy Development to an Accelerated Pathway to Tolerance Peanut Oral Immunotherapy Program. The Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology: In Practice. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jaip.2026.08.044
paras.zh: 布雷蒂格，T.W.，麦克唐纳，E.，韦斯特，D.，等人。 （2026）。在口服免疫治疗之前，需要进行口服食物挑战，以准确诊断婴儿花生过敏：评估过敏发展到加速耐受花生口服免疫治疗计划的途径。过敏与临床免疫学杂志：实践。 https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jaip.2026.08.044

paras.en: Anirban Mukhopadhyay is an independent science journalist. He holds a PhD in genetics and a master’s in computational biology and drug design. He regularly writes for The Hindu and has contributed to The Wire Science, where he conveys complex biomedical research to the public in accessible language. Beyond science writing, he enjoys creating and reading fiction that blends myth, memory, and melancholy into surreal tales exploring grief, identity, and the quiet magic of self-discovery. In his free time, he loves long walks with his dog and motorcycling across The Himalayas.
paras.zh: Anirban Mukhopadhyay 是一位独立科学记者。他拥有遗传学博士学位以及计算生物学和药物设计硕士学位。他定期为《印度教徒报》撰稿，并为《The Wire Science》撰稿，以通俗易懂的语言向公众传达复杂的生物医学研究成果。除了科学写作之外，他还喜欢创作和阅读小说，将神话、记忆和忧郁融入超现实故事中，探索悲伤、身份和自我发现的安静魔力。在空闲时间，他喜欢带着他的狗长途散步和骑摩托车穿越喜马拉雅山。

articles.title: 7 stunning Weather Photographer of the Year photos that capture the beauty and power of our planet
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Every year, the Royal Meteorological Society's Weather Photographer of the Year competition offers a reminder that some of the world's most compelling images emerge from the unpredictable forces of nature. The 2026 short list includes 30 photographs selected from more than 5,500 entries submitted by photographers around the world. Each offers a different perspective into the relationship among weather, landscapes and the people who experience these natural phenomena.
paras.zh: 每年，英国皇家气象学会的年度天气摄影师竞赛都会提醒人们，世界上一些最引人注目的图像来自不可预测的自然力量。 2026 年入围名单包括从世界各地摄影师提交的 5,500 多张参赛作品中选出的 30 张照片。每一个都对天气、风景和经历这些自然现象的人们之间的关系提供了不同的视角。

paras.en: The short-listed images span a range of settings and subjects, from lightning strikes, to cloud swirls, to rainbows. You can explore the full short list and vote for your favorite photo before the competition ends on Thursday (Nov. 5).
paras.zh: 入围的图像涵盖了一系列场景和主题，从雷击、云漩涡到彩虹。您可以在周四（11 月 5 日）比赛结束之前浏览完整的入围名单并为您最喜欢的照片投票。

paras.en: Live Science rounded up seven images that stood out for their composition, atmosphere and ability to tell a story. Which one is your favorite? Let us know in the comments!
paras.zh: 《Live Science》收集了七幅图像，这些图像的构图、氛围和讲述故事的能力都很突出。你最喜欢哪一个？请在评论中告诉我们！

paras.en: Photographer Lisa K. Kuhn captured a lenticular cloud above Mount Shasta in California.
paras.zh: 摄影师 Lisa K. Kuhn 在加利福尼亚州沙斯塔山上空拍摄到了荚状云。

paras.en: Watching from Bayonne, New Jersey, photographer Dan Martland captured this triple lightning strike above New York City.
paras.zh: 摄影师丹·马特兰 (Dan Martland) 在新泽西州巴约讷 (Bayonne) 拍摄到了纽约市上空的三重闪电。

paras.en: "A Supercell in the Sandhills of Nebraska"
paras.zh: “内布拉斯加州沙丘上的超级细胞”

paras.en: "Mother Nature was kind enough to give us a supercell and lightning at night," said photographer Laura Hedien about seeing this storm in Nebraska.
paras.zh: 摄影师劳拉·赫迪恩 (Laura Hedien) 谈到内布拉斯加州的这场风暴时说道：“大自然很仁慈，给了我们超级电池和夜间闪电。”

paras.en: During a walk in England's Lake District, photographer Mat Robinson waited in the pouring rain and eventually took this image of a beautiful rainbow.
paras.zh: 在英格兰湖区散步时，摄影师马特·罗宾逊在倾盆大雨中等待，最终拍下了这张美丽的彩虹照片。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: While walking through a wintery landscape in Bachledova dolina, Slovakia, photographer Dominika Koszowska noticed ice forming on wire mesh, creating unique heart shapes.
paras.zh: 摄影师多米尼卡·科佐夫斯卡 (Dominika Koszowska) 在斯洛伐克巴赫莱多瓦多利纳 (Bachledova dolina) 的冬日风景中漫步时，注意到金属丝网上结冰，形成独特的心形。

paras.en: Photographer Erfan Samanfar snapped a haunting image of a farmer trying to protect his farmland from a raging fire in Marvdasht, Iran.
paras.zh: 摄影师埃尔凡·萨曼法尔 (Erfan Samanfar) 在伊朗马尔夫达什特拍摄了一张令人难忘的照片，照片中一名农民试图保护自己的农田免受熊熊大火的侵害。

paras.en: Photographer Andres Miraglia captured the moment a floating iceberg was seen in the sunset off of Antarctica's Paradise Harbour.
paras.zh: 摄影师安德烈斯·米拉利亚 (Andres Miraglia) 捕捉到了南极洲天堂港日落时看到一座漂浮冰山的瞬间。

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: 'We’re looking at how a bear sees the world': From forest trails to 'Sims for Bears,' researchers are learning how grizzlies navigate a fragmented wilderness
articles.author: Jane Palmer

paras.en: Across 53 challenging days between fall 2020 and spring 2021, a 360-pound (160 kilograms) young male grizzly bear nicknamed "Lingenpolter" tried to cross Interstate 90 in western Montana 46 times. High-resolution GPS tracking showed him moving parallel to four lanes of roaring traffic, bouncing off the highway like a furry pinball as he searched for a gap.
paras.zh: 在 2020 年秋季至 2021 年春季的 53 天充满挑战的日子里，一只体重 360 磅（160 公斤）、绰号“Lingenpolter”的年轻雄性灰熊 46 次试图穿越蒙大拿州西部的 90 号州际公路。高分辨率 GPS 跟踪显示，他沿着四车道平行行驶，在寻找间隙时像毛茸茸的弹球一样在高速公路上弹跳。

paras.en: Eventually, Lingenpolter beat the odds, probably by slipping under a river bridge. But his hero's journey shows what a formidable barrier a busy highway can be for wildlife, Cecily Costello, a research wildlife biologist at Montana's Department of Fish, Wildlife and Parks, told Live Science. "It is easy to imagine the difficulty this grizzly bear experienced trying to reach the other side," Costello said.
paras.zh: 最终，林根波尔特克服了困难，可能是从河桥下滑倒了。但蒙大拿州鱼类、野生动物和公园部门的野生动物生物学家塞西莉·科斯特洛告诉《生活科学》杂志，他的英雄之旅表明，繁忙的高速公路对野生动物来说是一个多么可怕的障碍。 “很容易想象这只灰熊试图到达另一边所经历的困难，”科斯特洛说。

paras.en: This past May, another grizzly wasn't so lucky. Braving a crossing near one of Lingenpolter's attempts, the 27-year-old male bear was struck and killed by a truck, triggering a multicar rollover.
paras.zh: 今年五月，另一只灰熊就没那么幸运了。这只 27 岁的雄性熊在林根波尔特 (Lingenpolter) 的一次尝试附近闯过人行横道时，被一辆卡车撞死，引发了多车翻车。

paras.en: It's crucial for grizzly bears (Ursus arctos), also known as brown bears, to have room to roam. When they can't move between populations to mate, small groups get genetically isolated. And what's true for bears can also be true for other wildlife. "It's really challenging to be a small, fragmented population," said Michael Proctor, a wildlife biologist at Birchdale Ecological Ltd., a Canada-based environmental consulting firm. Such fragmentation is "one of the mechanisms by which we lose entire communities, and sometimes whole species," he told Live Science.
paras.zh: 对于灰熊（Ursus arctos）（也称为棕熊）来说，拥有漫步的空间至关重要。当它们无法在种群之间移动进行交配时，小群体就会在基因上被隔离。适用于熊的情况也适用于其他野生动物。加拿大环境咨询公司伯奇代尔生态有限公司的野生动物生物学家迈克尔·普罗克特说：“对于一个小而分散的种群来说，这确实具有挑战性。”他告诉《生活科学》杂志，这种分裂是“我们失去整个群落，有时甚至是整个物种的机制之一”。

paras.en: Nowhere is this challenge more urgent than in the 2,100 mile long (3,400 kilometers) region stretching along the spine of the Rocky Mountains between Yellowstone in Wyoming and the Yukon in northern Canada. The area, which spans five U.S. states, two Canadian provinces, and more than 75 Indigenous territories "represents the most intact, connected, wild, large mountain region in the world," Jordan Reeves, program director of landscape connectivity at the Yellowstone to Yukon Conservation Initiative (Y2Y), which aims to secure connectivity throughout the region told Live Science.
paras.zh: 这一挑战比在怀俄明州黄石公园和加拿大北部育空地区之间沿着落基山脉脊柱延伸的 2,100 英里（3,400 公里）地区更为紧迫。该地区横跨美国五个州、加拿大两个省和超过 75 个原住民领地，“代表了世界上最完整、联系最紧密、野生的大型山区”，黄石到育空保护计划 (Y2Y) 景观连通性项目主任乔丹·里夫斯 (Jordan Reeves) 告诉《生活科学》，该计划旨在确保整个地区的连通性。

paras.en: But as highways, rail lines, and human development fragment its valleys, maintaining connected pathways for grizzly bears across this landscape has become a challenge.
paras.zh: 但随着高速公路、铁路线和人类发展使山谷支离破碎，为灰熊穿越这片土地维持连通路径已成为一项挑战。

paras.en: Grizzlies range across vast, diverse terrain, spanning high-elevation alpine habitats, mid-mountain slopes, and low valley bottoms, which means safeguarding their movement can also protect passageways for coexisting species, including wolverines, mountain goats, elk and bighorn sheep, Proctor said. That's why researchers are trying to understand why, where and when grizzlies move. And what stops them in their tracks.
paras.zh: 普罗克特说，灰熊分布在广阔、多样化的地形上，跨越高海拔高山栖息地、中山斜坡和低谷底部，这意味着保护它们的活动也可以保护共存物种的通道，包括狼獾、山羊、麋鹿和大角羊。这就是为什么研究人员试图了解灰熊移动的原因、地点和时间。是什么阻止了他们的脚步。

paras.en: "We're looking at how a bear sees the world," Andrew Derocher, a bear biologist at the University of Alberta who has used GPS collars on grizzly bears to trace their movements, told Live Science.
paras.zh: “我们正在研究熊如何看待世界，”阿尔伯塔大学的熊生物学家安德鲁·德罗彻（Andrew Derocher）告诉《生活科学》杂志，他曾在灰熊身上使用 GPS 项圈来追踪它们的活动。

paras.en: When Sarah Sells started her graduate studies in animal behavior, her supervisor told her to "try to crawl into their fur brains and understand how they think," Sells told Live Science. Although we can't recreate exactly what's going on between a grizzly's ears, GPS collars that track animal movement hourly can tell scientists a lot about how animals behave, said Sells, who is currently the assistant unit leader of the U.S. Geological Survey's Montana Cooperative Wildlife Research Unit.
paras.zh: 当莎拉·塞尔斯开始动物行为研究生学习时，她的导师告诉她“尝试爬进它们的毛皮大脑并了解它们的思维方式”，塞尔斯告诉《生活科学》。目前担任美国地质调查局蒙大拿合作野生动物研究小组助理组长的塞尔斯说，虽然我们无法准确重现灰熊耳朵之间发生的情况，但每小时跟踪动物运动的 GPS 项圈可以告诉科学家很多有关动物行为的信息。

paras.en: That tracking data is starting to produce an incredibly detailed picture not just of where bears go but also how and why they're making those choices.
paras.zh: 跟踪数据开始产生令人难以置信的详细图片，不仅显示熊的去向，还显示它们如何以及为何做出这些选择。

paras.en: "Bears are food finding machines," Chris Servheen, a bear biologist with the International Union for Conservation of Nature's Bear Specialist Group, told Live Science. "So remembering where they found food is critical to their success in life."
paras.zh: “熊是寻找食物的机器，”国际自然保护联盟熊专家组的熊生物学家克里斯·瑟芬 (Chris Servheen) 告诉《生活科学》。 “因此，记住他们在哪里找到食物对于他们生活的成功至关重要。”

paras.en: Using a combination of telemetry data (information collected by tracking devices) and movement modeling, Derocher and colleagues have investigated how well grizzlies remember where food is and when it is best to visit a foraging patch. Derocher's research showed that about two-thirds of the bears have a great memory for where and in what season they previously found food. His tracking data also revealed that wild bears generally avoid humans. But bears have only a few months to fatten up for winter. If food is scarce, many bears go into human environments and sometimes get killed, Proctor said.
paras.zh: 德罗彻和同事结合使用遥测数据（通过跟踪设备收集的信息）和运动模型，研究了灰熊对食物位置以及何时最好前往觅食地的记忆程度。德罗彻的研究表明，大约三分之二的熊对之前在哪里、什么季节找到食物有很好的记忆力。他的追踪数据还显示，野熊通常会避开人类。但熊只有几个月的时间养肥过冬。普罗克特说，如果食物匮乏，许多熊就会进入人类环境，有时甚至被杀死。

paras.en: The data is also offering insight into different bear "personalities." Bears are ultimately individuals, with their own traits and quirks, Servheen said.
paras.zh: 这些数据还提供了对不同熊“性格”的洞察。塞尔芬说，熊最终也是个体，有自己的特征和怪癖。

paras.en: Tracking data suggests that a lot of bear behavior is transmitted culturally via a mother's influence. Sometimes, the wrong behavior can get passed down to the next generation, Servheen said. For example, an infamous female grizzly known as 399 jaywalked potentially hundreds of times in the Jackson Hole valley in Wyoming while managing to keep her distance from humans. Her 20-odd cubs learned to follow her example, but they lacked her strategic caution. Several were killed by vehicles or management euthanizations.
paras.zh: 跟踪数据表明，许多熊的行为是通过母亲的影响在文化上传播的。瑟芬说，有时，错误的行为可能会遗传给下一代。例如，一只臭名昭著的雌性灰熊（399）在怀俄明州杰克逊霍尔山谷中可能数百次乱穿马路，同时设法与人类保持距离。她的 20 多个幼崽学会了以她为榜样，但他们缺乏她的战略谨慎。有几人被车辆或管理人员安乐死杀死。

paras.en: "It's a risky thing to teach your kids to do stuff like that," Servheen said. "And her offspring weren't as smart as she was."
paras.zh: “教你的孩子做这样的事情是一件冒险的事情，”瑟芬说。 “而她的后代却没有她那么聪明。”

paras.en: Further north along the region between Yellowstone and the Yukon, Proctor's first DNA survey across 1,500 square miles (4,000 square kilometers) of southern British Columbia in the late 1990s shattered his illusion that the bears, along with bighorn sheep (Ovis canadensis) and other species in this province, were free to roam. Instead, he found a "cracked windshield" landscape, where roads and human sprawl had fractured the wilderness into isolated genetic islands. In the 2000s, the genetic diversity of the South Selkirk grizzly bears — a detatched subpopulation inhabiting southeastern British Columbia, northern Idaho, and northeastern Washington — was so low, for example, that biologists feared the bears wouldn't survive.
paras.zh: 沿着黄石公园和育空地区之间的地区再往北，普罗克特在 1990 年代末对不列颠哥伦比亚省南部 1,500 平方英里（4,000 平方公里）的地区进行了首次 DNA 调查，这打破了他的幻想，即熊、大角羊（Ovis canadensis）和该省的其他物种可以自由漫步。相反，他发现了一个“挡风玻璃破裂”的景观，道路和人类的蔓延将荒野分裂成孤立的基因岛。例如，在 2000 年代，南塞尔扣克灰熊（居住在不列颠哥伦比亚省东南部、爱达荷州北部和华盛顿州东北部的独立亚群）的遗传多样性非常低，以至于生物学家担心这些灰熊无法生存。

paras.en: But Proctor and his colleagues went on to use bear movement data to model pathways through human-settled valleys. Proctor was so convinced about the viability of one potential corridor that he paid 10,000 Canadian dollars ($7,000) of his own money to buy a key piece of land right in the middle of it. "That was the first canoe over the waterfall of purchasing connectivity land," Proctor said
paras.zh: 但普罗克特和他的同事继续利用熊的活动数据来模拟穿过人类居住山谷的路径。普罗克特对一条潜在走廊的可行性深信不疑，因此他自掏腰包 10,000 加元（7,000 美元）购买了该走廊中间的一块关键土地。 “这是购买连接土地瀑布上的第一艘独木舟，”普罗克特说

paras.en: Proctor’s land secured a segment of a crucial connectivity corridor and, in the following years, he and other scientists partnered with trusts to purchase other land parcels, build fences, and establish safe corridors for grizzlies in the Creston Valley in southeastern British Columbia. These actions helped bears move north and south (sometimes across the border) and between the South Selkirk Mountains and Purcell Mountains. The researchers then watched bears like "Captain Hook," who'd been shot in the leg, hobble into the South Selkirks and breed with eight females. By 2021, nine immigrant bears had produced 27 new offspring within the population.
paras.zh: 普罗克特的土地确保了重要连通走廊的一部分，在接下来的几年里，他和其他科学家与信托公司合作购买了其他地块，建造了围栏，并在不列颠哥伦比亚省东南部的克雷斯顿山谷为灰熊建立了安全走廊。这些行动帮助熊向北和向南（有时跨越边境）以及南塞尔柯克山脉和珀塞尔山脉之间移动。研究人员随后观察了腿部中枪的“胡克船长”熊一瘸一拐地进入南塞尔扣克群岛并与八只雌性熊交配。到 2021 年，9 只移民熊在种群中产下了 27 个新后代。

paras.en: "This is gene flow; this is connectivity," Proctor said. "We took a completely isolated population and pretty much recovered it."
paras.zh: “这就是基因流；这就是连通性，”普罗克特说。 “我们采取了完全孤立的群体，并且几乎恢复了它。”

paras.en: Despite efforts to safeguard corridors through human occupied landscape, roads continue to stop bears in their tracks. When Servheen tracked bears near Highway 2 in northwest Montana, he found that many of the grizzlies avoided the highway altogether and those that crossed did so at night. But he also found that the bears' crossings clustered in specific sections of the road. Finding the crossing zones has helped researchers identify good locations for constructing overpasses and underpasses on many busy highways, but a crossing structure on its own is not enough, Servheen cautioned.
paras.zh: 尽管人们努力保护人类居住区的走廊，但道路仍然阻止熊前进。当塞尔芬在蒙大拿州西北部 2 号高速公路附近追踪熊时，他发现许多灰熊完全避开了高速公路，而那些穿越高速公路的灰熊则在夜间这样做。但他还发现，熊的十字路口集中在道路的特定路段。 Servheen 警告说，寻找交叉区域有助于研究人员确定在许多繁忙的高速公路上建造立交桥和地下通道的好位置，但交叉结构本身还不够。

paras.en: A bear's memory for where to find food is exemplary, but there's no special reward in a bear's brain for crossing a road safely — only a fatal penalty when they don't, Servheen said. So conservationists can't rely on bears to remember where crossings are. Instead, they must build fencing along the highway to funnel wildlife into the underpasses or overpasses. Then, the immediate land on each side needs to allow animals safe passage. "Otherwise, you have a bridge to nowhere," Servheen said.
paras.zh: Servheen 说，熊对在哪里寻找食物的记忆力堪称典范，但安全过马路时，熊的大脑中并没有特别的奖励，只有安全过马路时才会受到致命的惩罚。因此，自然资源保护者不能依靠熊来记住十字路口在哪里。相反，他们必须沿高速公路修建围栏，将野生动物引入地下通道或立交桥。然后，两侧的直接土地需要允许动物安全通过。 “否则，你就会有一座通向任何地方的桥梁，”瑟芬说。

paras.en: Now researchers such as Sells are trying to use data about bears' likeliest routes to determine potential corridors in locations where they have little tracking data or where few bears live yet.
paras.zh: 现在，塞尔斯等研究人员正在尝试利用有关熊最可能路线的数据来确定那些几乎没有追踪数据或很少有熊居住的地方的潜在走廊。

paras.en: To do this, Sells is developing a virtual "Sims for Bears" that recreates the Continental Divide Ecosystem in Montana. In the life-simulation video game "The Sims," players give virtual humans personality traits, preferences and needs, and then drop them into a virtual environment to see how they behave.
paras.zh: 为此，塞尔斯正在开发虚拟的“熊模拟人生”，重现蒙大拿州的大陆分水岭生态系统。在生活模拟视频游戏《模拟人生》中，玩家赋予虚拟人类个性特征、偏好和需求，然后将他们放入虚拟环境中，观察他们的行为方式。

paras.en: Sells built the model using the GPS collaring data from 65 grizzly bears navigating individual paths through greenery, riparian areas and around forests and roads. Then, she "parachutes" an individual digital bear into a detailed computer simulation of real-world terrain and has them take thousands of virtual steps. By running these multiple simulated bears through thousands of iterations across the digital terrain, the researchers can watch where the virtual bears repeatedly choose to walk, effectively creating a map of predicted movement corridors.
paras.zh: Sells 使用 65 只灰熊的 GPS 项圈数据构建了该模型，这些灰熊在绿地、河岸地区以及森林和道路周围的单独路径中导航。然后，她将一只单独的数字熊“降落”到现实世界地形的详细计算机模拟中，并让它们采取数千个虚拟步骤。通过在数字地形上对这些多只模拟熊进行数千次迭代，研究人员可以观察虚拟熊反复选择行走的位置，从而有效地创建预测运动走廊的地图。

paras.en: Sells has used the model to predict how grizzly bears might recolonize the Bitterroot ecosystem of Idaho and Montana, which Lingenpolter was heading toward when attempting to cross Interstate 90.
paras.zh: 塞尔斯使用该模型来预测灰熊可能如何重新定居爱达荷州和蒙大拿州的比特鲁特生态系统，林根波尔特在试图穿越 90 号州际公路时正前往那里。

paras.en: To get to the Bitterroot Mountains, bears must pass through a valley filled with people, roads, garbage and fruit trees. "So knowing where they are more likely to end up is helpful to address things that could be difficult for humans or bears," Sells told Live Science.
paras.zh: 为了到达比特鲁特山脉，熊必须穿过一个充满了人、道路、垃圾和果树的山谷。塞尔斯告诉《生活科学》杂志：“因此，了解它们更有可能最终去往哪里，有助于解决对人类或熊来说可能困难的问题。”

paras.en: The data is also confirming that the greatest barrier bears face comes from human contact or transportation infrastructure across the entire Yellowstone-to-Yukon region. Studies from across west-central North America report that humans directly or indirectly caused between 77% and 90% of grizzly bear deaths from 1989 to 2015. Hunting, managed kills in urban areas and road and rail collisions all take a toll.
paras.zh: 数据还证实，熊面临的最大障碍来自整个黄石到育空地区的人类接触或交通基础设施。来自北美中西部地区的研究报告称，从 1989 年到 2015 年，人类直接或间接导致了 77% 至 90% 的灰熊死亡。狩猎、城市地区的有组织猎杀以及公路和铁路碰撞都造成了损失。

paras.en: Bears in the wild usually avoid people, but some bears seek out human-dominated areas because they know these places are a source of food. People move to the Elk Valley in southeastern British Columbia because they love nature, but then they plant apple trees in their backyard, which attract bears, said Clayton Lamb, a wildlife scientist at the nonprofit Biodiversity Pathways.
paras.zh: 野外的熊通常会避开人类，但有些熊会寻找人类主导的地区，因为它们知道这些地方是食物来源。非营利组织生物多样性路径的野生动物科学家克莱顿·兰姆说，人们搬到不列颠哥伦比亚省东南部的麋鹿谷是因为他们热爱大自然，但他们在后院种植苹果树，这吸引了熊。

paras.en: Quickly, a bear eating backyard apples gets labeled a "problem bear," "when really it is a 'people problem,'" Lamb told Live Science.
paras.zh: 很快，一只吃后院苹果的熊就被贴上了“问题熊”的标签，“而实际上这是一个‘人类问题’，”兰姆告诉《生活科学》杂志。

paras.en: Even human recreation takes a toll on bears' health and ability to move freely. Lamb's research has shown that grizzly bears try to avoid areas next to busy cycling and hiking trails.
paras.zh: 即使人类的娱乐活动也会损害熊的健康和自由活动的能力。兰姆的研究表明，灰熊会尽量避开繁忙的自行车道和远足小径附近的区域。

paras.en: Working with information from McLellan, the club has cut back overgrown vegetation along sight lines to prevent mountain bikers from startling bears at close range. They've also constructed wooden platforms on sections of trails that clatter and rumble as bikes pass over them, giving bears early notice of approaching riders. "The key is to not surprise them by making a lot of noise." McLellan told Live Science, noting that grizzlies are more likely to attack if they are surprised.
paras.zh: 根据麦克莱伦提供的信息，该俱乐部砍掉了视线沿线过度生长的植被，以防止山地自行车手近距离惊吓熊。他们还在部分小道上建造了木制平台，当自行车经过时，这些平台会发出叮当声和隆隆声，让熊尽早注意到接近的骑手。 “关键是不要发出太大的噪音，让他们感到惊讶。”麦克莱伦告诉《生活科学》杂志，他指出，灰熊如果感到惊讶，就更有可能发起攻击。

paras.en: One advantage of having human mountain biking and hiking trails concentrated close to towns is that it focuses recreation into specific areas, Lamb said. Keeping trails condensed supplies multiple accessible paths and reduces humans encroaching on true wilderness — prime bear habitat. "The goal would be to ensure that there's sufficient recreation opportunities for people to stay healthy and connected to their local landscape while ensuring that wildlife can still move around and access their habitats," Lamb said
paras.zh: 兰姆说，将人类山地自行车和徒步旅行路线集中在城镇附近的优点之一是，它将休闲活动集中在特定区域。保持步道紧凑，可以提供多条可通达的路径，并减少人类对真正的荒野（熊的主要栖息地）的侵占。兰姆说：“我们的目标是确保人们有足够的娱乐机会保持健康并与当地景观保持联系，同时确保野生动物仍然可以四处走动并进入其栖息地。”

paras.en: As humans increasingly live, work and play in bear territory, it's important to recognize the impact on the animals, Servheen said. "The bears never get a day off," he said. "Every day, they're trying to stay away from people and make a living in a place with multiple people on the landscape."
paras.zh: 瑟芬说，随着人类越来越多地在熊的领地生活、工作和玩耍，认识到熊的领地对动物的影响非常重要。 “熊从来没有休息过一天，”他说。 “每天，他们都试图远离人群，在一个有多人的地方谋生。”

paras.en: Bears expend a lot of much-needed energy trying to avoid people, and they won't be able to do that forever, Servheen said. As humans increase the development of private lands and recreation in bear territory, the squeeze is on. "There's going to be more conflicts with bears, and more dead bears," Servheen said.
paras.zh: 塞尔芬说，熊会消耗大量急需的能量来躲避人类，但它们不可能永远这样做。随着人类加大对熊领地的私人土地和娱乐活动的开发，压力越来越大。 “将会有更多与熊的冲突，也会有更多的熊死亡，”塞尔芬说。

paras.en: The bears have done their part, Lamb said. His research has shown that bears living near humans are adapting by becoming mostly nocturnal, which reduces their odds of clashing with humans. "So, we need to meet them where they are at and see what we can do to share the space," Lamb said.
paras.zh: 兰姆说，熊已经尽了自己的职责。他的研究表明，生活在人类附近的熊正在适应，变得大多在夜间活动，这减少了它们与人类发生冲突的可能性。 “因此，我们需要在他们所在的地方与他们会面，看看我们能做些什么来共享这个空间，”兰姆说。

paras.en: On the human side, people need to make it less tempting for bears to be in human dominated areas, McLellan said. That means keeping garbage stowed and making sure there is no ripe fruit available. "If you live rurally, you want them to be able to pass through your property but not linger near your home or in your front yard," McLellan said.
paras.zh: 麦克莱伦说，在人类方面，人们需要减少熊进入人类主导地区的诱惑。这意味着要存放垃圾并确保没有成熟的水果。麦克莱伦说：“如果你住在农村，你希望他们能够穿过你的房子，但不要在你家附近或前院逗留。”

paras.en: Bears have proved to be adaptable and persistent; Lingenpolter tried to cross the highway dozens of times before finding a way under. However, Servheen warned that we are putting them in a tough spot. To keep bear populations stable, scientists need data on bear behavior to help inform land management policies that create safe pathways for grizzlies to move through human dominated areas and regulate recreation with bears in mind, Servheen said.
paras.zh: 事实证明，熊具有很强的适应能力和毅力。林根波尔特数十次试图穿过高速公路，最后才找到一条路。然而，Servheen 警告说，我们正在让他们陷入困境。 Servheen 说，为了保持熊数量的稳定，科学家需要有关熊行为的数据来帮助制定土地管理政策，为灰熊穿越人类控制的地区创造安全通道，并在考虑到熊的情况下规范娱乐活动。

paras.en: "If we want to have bears in the future, we need to think about the needs bears have for some level of space on the landscape," Servheen said.
paras.zh: “如果我们想在未来拥有熊，我们需要考虑熊对景观中某种程度的空间的需求，”瑟芬说。

paras.en: Securing that space across the vast Yellowstone to Yukon landscape requires more than just land acquisitions and highway overpasses — it requires increasing public awareness and counteracting the perception that bears are inherently aggressive and irrational, Proctor said. If people understand bear behavior, they can learn to act in ways that neither attract bears nor threaten them. And understanding the totality of bears’ strong drive to survive, and protect each other, can elicit empathy and motivation to protect this iconic species.
paras.zh: 普罗克特说，确保从黄石公园到育空地区的广阔空间的安全需要的不仅仅是征地和高速公路立交桥，还需要提高公众意识并消除熊天生具有攻击性和非理性的看法。如果人们了解熊的行为，他们就可以学会以既不吸引熊也不威胁熊的方式行事。了解熊求生存和互相保护的强烈动力，可以激发人们的同理心和动力来保护这一标志性物种。

paras.en: - 'It's nature calling to humans, and humans deciding whether or not to reply': Why we need to start paying attention to our mutually beneficial relationships with other species
paras.zh: - “这是大自然对人类的呼唤，人类决定是否回应”：为什么我们需要开始关注我们与其他物种的互利关系

paras.en: - Bear hair and fish weirs: Meet the Indigenous people combining modern science with ancestral principles to protect the land
paras.zh: - 熊毛和鱼堰：了解土著人民将现代科学与祖先原则相结合以保护土地

paras.en: - Photojournalist Steve Winter on his iconic Hollywood puma image, the illegal tiger trade and having a black panther knock on his door
paras.zh: - 摄影记者史蒂夫·温特谈他标志性的好莱坞美洲狮形象、非法老虎贸易以及黑豹来敲门

paras.en: Early in his career, Proctor captured, immobilized and radio-collared a mother grizzly with her two yearlings, or newly adolescent bears. While the research team worked, the young bears circled quietly at a distance. When the scientists finally stepped back and the mother began to stir, the yearlings approached cautiously. As the mother's groggy head rested on a log, the yearlings' long-clawed front paws delicately explored the radio collar. Then, each one rested its head directly on hers, to form a quiet pile of three bear heads.
paras.zh: 在他职业生涯的早期，普罗克特捕获并固定了一只灰熊妈妈和她的两只一岁的小熊，或者刚进入青春期的熊，并给它戴上无线电项圈。研究小组工作时，小熊在远处静静地盘旋。当科学家们最终退后一步、母亲开始骚动时，一岁的孩子们小心翼翼地靠近。当母亲昏昏沉沉的头靠在一根圆木上时，一岁孩子的长爪前爪小心地探索着无线电项圈。然后，每个熊头都直接靠在她的头上，安静地堆成三个熊头。

paras.en: "They just wanted to touch mom after this ordeal," Proctor said. "Yes, grizzlies can be rough and dangerous but they can also be gentle at times," Proctor said.
paras.zh: “经历了这次磨难之后，他们只是想触摸妈妈，”普罗克特说。 “是的，灰熊可能很粗暴、很危险，但它们有时也很温和，”普罗克特说。

paras.en: Reporting and travel for this story was supported by the Sitka Foundation and the Science Media Centre of Canada.
paras.zh: 本故事的报道和旅行得到了锡特卡基金会和加拿大科学媒体中心的支持。

paras.en: Jane Palmer is a Colorado-based journalist who is contributing to Live Science with a focus on biodiversity conservation, neuroscience and mental health. She has written about science for many outlets including Nature, Science, Eos Magazine, Al Jazeera, BBC Earth, BBC Future, Mosaic Science and Proto Magazine. Before becoming a journalist, Palmer was a scientist, and she earned a bachelor's degree in cognitive science and a doctorate in computational molecular modeling from the University of Sheffield in England. She enjoys reading and being outside in nature whenever possible, preferably climbing rocks.
paras.zh: 简·帕尔默 (Jane Palmer) 是科罗拉多州的一名记者，为《生命科学》杂志撰稿，重点关注生物多样性保护、神经科学和心理健康。她为许多媒体撰写有关科学的文章，包括《自然》、《科学》、《Eos 杂志》、半岛电视台、BBC 地球、BBC 未来、Mosaic Sc​​ience 和 Proto 杂志。在成为一名记者之前，帕尔默是一名科学家，她在英国谢菲尔德大学获得了认知科学学士学位和计算分子模型博士学位。她喜欢阅读和尽可能到户外接触大自然，尤其是攀岩。

articles.title: Archaeologists Found a 3,300-Year-Old Sword at the Bottom of a Volcanic Lake in Italy—and It's Still Sharp

paras.en: Archaeologists have pulled a 3,300-year-old sword from a lake in Italy—and it’s still sharp.
paras.zh: 考古学家从意大利的一个湖中取出了一把有 3,300 年历史的剑，它仍然锋利。

paras.en: The bronze weapon was discovered at the bottom of Lake Mezzano, a small volcanic lake in central Italy, roughly 60 miles northwest of Rome.
paras.zh: 这件青铜武器是在梅扎诺湖 (Lake Mezzano) 的底部发现的，梅扎诺湖是意大利中部的一个小火山湖，距离罗马西北约 60 英里。

paras.en: It’s the third sword discovered in the lake since the 1970s, according to an announcement from Italy’s Superintendence of Archaeology, Fine Arts and Landscape for the Province of Viterbo and Southern Etruria.
paras.zh: 根据意大利维泰博省和南伊特鲁里亚考古、美术和景观管理局的公告，这是自 20 世纪 70 年代以来在湖中发现的第三把剑。

paras.en: Archaeologists think that between 1700 and 1150 B.C.E. the lake was home to a Bronze Age pile-dwelling village, a community lofted above the water on stilts.
paras.zh: 考古学家认为公元前 1700 年至 1150 年之间这个湖是一个青铜时代的木桩村的所在地，这是一个用高跷高高耸立在水面上的社区。

paras.en: The sword is thought to date to the 13th century B.C.E., which corresponds with the Late Bronze Age. At that time, the people living in central Italy maintained trade and connections with communities throughout the peninsula and across the Mediterranean. In that context, the researchers say, weapons were more than just combat tools—they were also symbols of prestige, identity and power.
paras.zh: 这把剑被认为可以追溯到公元前 13 世纪，相当于青铜时代晚期。当时，居住在意大利中部的人们与整个半岛和地中海各地的社区保持着贸易和联系。研究人员表示，在这种背景下，武器不仅仅是战斗工具，它们还是威望、身份和权力的象征。

paras.en: Archaeologists found the sword while excavating a largely unexplored area on the lake’s southern shore. During the same expedition, they found intact vases and numerous bronze artifacts, including axes, arrowheads, daggers, spearheads, pins and a razor. They found the sword and the razor lying near each other, which suggests they may have once belonged to the same person, possibly a high-status individual or an elite warrior.
paras.zh: 考古学家在湖南岸挖掘一片未开发的区域时发现了这把剑。在同一次探险中，他们发现了完整的花瓶和大量青铜器，包括斧头、箭头、匕首、矛头、别针和剃刀。他们发现剑和剃刀彼此靠近，这表明它们可能曾经属于同一个人，可能是一位地位很高的人，也可能是一位精英战士。

paras.en: Similar discoveries across Europe suggest that ancient people sometimes deliberately deposited weapons and other metal objects in lakes, possibly as part of religious rituals or offerings. According to Live Science’s Kristina Killgrove, the sword may have been tossed in the lake as an offering to a god.
paras.zh: 欧洲各地的类似发现表明，古代人们有时会故意将武器和其他金属物品放入湖泊中，这可能是宗教仪式或祭品的一部分。根据《Live Science》的克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫的说法，这把剑可能被扔进湖里作为献给神的祭品。

paras.en: Geologist Lamberto Ferri Ricchi first discovered the now-submerged village in 1971, when he found the remains of three prehistoric pile-dwellings submerged between nine and 30 feet deep. He returned several years later at the request of regional archaeology officials and uncovered roughly 50 vases, three bronze axes, skeletal remains, wooden planks, millstones and other artifacts.
paras.zh: 地质学家 Lamberto Ferri Ricchi 于 1971 年首次发现了这个现已被淹没的村庄，当时他在 9 至 30 英尺深的水下发现了三座史前木桩住宅的遗迹。几年后，他应地区考古官员的要求返回，发现了大约 50 个花瓶、三把青铜斧、骨骼遗骸、木板、磨石和其他文物。

paras.en: Excavations continued into the mid-1990s, then came to a halt for nearly three decades until funding became available again. Last year, archaeologists returned to the site and mapped more than 600 wooden posts they believe once held up the Bronze Age settlement. The posts were embedded into the clay lakebed at various depths, ranging from eight feet to more than 32 feet deep. Researchers suspect the newly discovered posts represent roughly a third of the entire settlement.
paras.zh: 挖掘工作一直持续到 20 世纪 90 年代中期，然后暂停了近三十年，直到资金再次到位。去年，考古学家返回该地点，绘制了 600 多根木柱的地图，他们认为这些木柱曾经支撑着青铜时代的定居点。这些柱子嵌入粘土湖床的不同深度，从八英尺到超过 32 英尺深。研究人员怀疑新发现的柱子大约占整个定居点的三分之一。

paras.en: Across Europe, similar discoveries have been made in bodies of water, including a 1,000-year-old Viking sword in an English river, an Iron Age sword in a Swedish lake and rust-covered medieval sword in Poland’s Vistula River.
paras.zh: 在整个欧洲，人们也在水体中发现了类似的发现，包括英国河流中的一把具有 1000 年历史的维京剑、瑞典湖中的铁器时代剑以及波兰维斯瓦河中锈迹斑斑的中世纪剑。

paras.en: During the 2025 expedition, they also recovered numerous artifacts, including axes, spearheads, brooches, rings, a pin and a sickle. They also found bronze ingots that may have been used in casting, suggesting that residents were producing metal objects within the village.
paras.zh: 在 2025 年的探险中，他们还发现了许多文物，包括斧头、矛头、胸针、戒指、别针和镰刀。他们还发现了可能用于铸造的青铜锭，这表明居民正在村内生产金属物品。

paras.en: Researchers are still trying to interpret the findings of their latest expedition. In the meantime, they say they plan to display the newly discovered artifacts during an upcoming exhibition, per the statement. They also hope to continue their research in Lake Mezzano to gain an even deeper understanding of the people who once lived there.
paras.zh: 研究人员仍在试图解释他们最新探险的发现。与此同时，根据声明，他们表示计划在即将举行的展览中展示新发现的文物。他们还希望继续对梅扎诺湖的研究，以更深入地了解曾经居住在那里的人们。

articles.title: Was the British King Who Urged the Romans to Invade Actually a Queen? One Archaeologist Thinks So

paras.en: In 43 C.E., the Roman Emperor Claudius invaded Britain, leading to its transformation it into an imperial province for nearly 400 years. This invasion was launched at the behest of an ousted British king named Verica, who fled across the English Channel to seek Roman aid. Now, a British archaeologist suggests that Verica was no king at all, but rather a queen.
paras.zh: 公元 43 年，罗马皇帝克劳狄斯入侵不列颠，导致其成为帝国行省近 400 年。这次入侵是应被驱逐的英国国王维里卡（Verica）的要求发起的，他越过英吉利海峡逃亡寻求罗马的援助。现在，一位英国考古学家认为维丽卡根本不是国王，而是一位女王。

paras.en: The reassessment by Miles Russell, an archaeologist at Bournemouth University, reinterprets one of the most consequential figures of the late British Iron Age. Writing in Current Archaeology, Russell argues that “the assumption that this powerful ruler must have been male reflects a degree of unconscious bias, and perhaps a hangover from the patriarchal mindset of early Classicists.”
paras.zh: 伯恩茅斯大学考古学家迈尔斯·拉塞尔的重新评估，重新诠释了英国铁器时代晚期最重要的人物之一。罗素在《当代考古学》中写道，“认为这位强大的统治者一定是男性的假设反映了一定程度的无意识偏见，也许是早期古典主义者父权思想的残余。”

paras.en: Verica was a Roman ally who led the Atrebates, a tribe whose territory spanned modern-day Berkshire, Hampshire and West Sussex. Around 40 C.E., during territorial upheavals following the death of powerful tribal leader Cunobelinus and the ascent of his son Caratacus, Verica was deposed and fled to Rome.
paras.zh: 维丽卡是罗马盟友，领导着阿特雷巴特斯部落，该部落的领土横跨现代伯克郡、汉普郡和西萨塞克斯郡。公元 40 年左右，在强大的部落首领库诺贝利努斯 (Cunobelinus) 去世和他的儿子卡拉塔库斯 (Caratacus) 上位后发生的领土动乱中，维里卡 (Verica) 被废黜并逃往罗马。

paras.en: Roman historian Cassius Dio, writing in the early third century C.E., recorded that a Briton called “Berikos,” or “Bericus,” appealed directly to Claudius, handing the emperor a pretext for invasion. Without this appeal, “it’s likely that Rome would never have invaded,” Russell tells Gizmodo’s Ed Cara.
paras.zh: 罗马历史学家卡西乌斯·迪奥 (Cassius Dio) 在公元三世纪初期写道，一位名叫“Berikos”或“Bericus”的英国人直接向克劳狄斯求助，为皇帝提供了入侵的借口。拉塞尔告诉 Gizmodo 的埃德·卡拉，如果没有这种吸引力，“罗马很可能永远不会入侵”。

paras.en: He adds: “Verica was a major player in the story of how Britain became a Roman province and has been discussed in many books, papers and articles, but has always been misgendered.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“维丽卡是英国如何成为罗马行省的故事中的一个主要角色，许多书籍、论文和文章都对她进行了讨论，但她的性别却一直被误解。”

paras.en: Numismatic evidence also presents a striking departure from standard Iron Age coinage. While contemporary male leaders like Cunobelinus decorated their currency with overtly masculine warriors, coins struck under Verica depict “slender, bare-breasted equestrian figures that appear irrefutably female,” Russell writes.
paras.zh: 钱币证据也显示出与标准铁器时代铸币的显着背离。拉塞尔写道，像库诺贝利努斯这样的当代男性领导人在货币上装饰了明显的男性武士，而维丽卡领导下铸造的硬币则描绘了“纤细、裸胸的马术人物，毫无疑问是女性形象”。

paras.en: Furthermore, some of Verica’s coins have the Latin abbreviation “COM F,” which is traditionally translated as Commios filius, or the “son of Commios,” a leader of the Atrebates tribe who allied with Julius Caesar during his invasion of Gaul. As Russell points out, that could just as easily denote Commios filia, or “daughter of Commios.” While the coins carry the Latin title “rex,” Russell argues that the designation is a “non-gender specific title” that shows Verica ruled with the “the full authorization of the emperor,” according to a statement.
paras.zh: 此外，维里卡的一些硬币上有拉丁文缩写“COM F”，传统上被翻译为 Commios filius，或“Commios 之子”，他是阿特雷巴特斯部落的首领，在凯撒入侵高卢期间与他结盟。正如拉塞尔指出的那样，这也可以很容易地表示 Commios filia，或“Commios 的女儿”。一份声明称，虽然这些硬币带有拉丁文标题“雷克斯”，但罗素认为该名称是“非性别特定标题”，表明维丽卡的统治得到了“皇帝的完全授权”。

paras.en: A female Verica could also explain the sharp anti-Claudius barbs in classical accounts by Roman chroniclers, who frequently portrayed the emperor as an easily swayed, “henpecked” figure, Russell writes.
paras.zh: 罗素写道，女性维丽卡也可以解释罗马编年史家的古典记述中尖锐的反克劳狄斯的倒刺，他们经常将皇帝描绘成一个容易动摇的“怕老婆”的人物。

paras.en: Presenting Claudius’ invasion as prompted by a woman fits this narrative pattern. “In effect, [Cassius] Dio was saying that the campaign was undertaken solely because of the whisperings of a barbarian femme fatale,” Russell explains in the statement.
paras.zh: 在女人的推动下呈现克劳狄斯的入侵符合这种叙事模式。 “实际上，[卡西乌斯]迪奥是在说这次活动的开展仅仅是因为一个野蛮蛇蝎美人的低语，”拉塞尔在声明中解释道。

paras.en: The idea also fits recent insights into the period. In 2025, Russell co-authored a study of ancient southern British cemeteries showing that Iron Age communities were matrilocal: Women remained settled in their ancestral communities while men moved, suggesting land and status were passed down the female line.
paras.zh: 这个想法也符合最近对该时期的见解。 2025 年，拉塞尔与人合着了一项对英国南部古代墓地的研究，表明铁器时代的社区是母居的：女性仍然定居在她们祖先的社区，而男性则搬迁，这表明土地和地位是通过女性血统传承的。

paras.en: Under Roman rule, Britain was a highly urbanized place with tiled-roofs, road networks and a coinage system. Centuries after the Romans left, however, Britons had gone back to living in homes with thatched roofs and reverted from market-based trades to subsistence farming.
paras.zh: 在罗马统治下，英国是一个高度城市化的地方，拥有瓦片屋顶、道路网络和铸币系统。然而，在罗马人离开几个世纪后，英国人又回到了茅草屋顶的房屋中，并从以市场为基础的贸易回归到自给农业。

paras.en: However, not all scholars are convinced. Katharina Rebay-Salisbury, an archaeologist at the University of Vienna, remains skeptical of the numismatic evidence. “I find it a bit difficult to differentiate a naked female body from a naked male body in these very stylized images,” she tells New Scientist.
paras.zh: 然而，并非所有学者都相信这一点。维也纳大学考古学家卡塔琳娜·雷贝-索尔兹伯里仍然对钱币证据持怀疑态度。 “我发现在这些非常程式化的图像中区分裸体女性身体和裸体男性身体有点困难，”她告诉新科学家。

paras.en: Roger Tomlin, a specialist in Roman epigraphy at University of Oxford, tells the Guardian’s Nicola Davis that while the feminine “-a” ending is plausible, Cassius Dio explicitly assumed the ruler was male, referring to him as “Bericus.” He also disputes Russell’s claim that “rex” had been used for both male and female rulers.
paras.zh: 牛津大学罗马铭文专家罗杰·汤姆林 (Roger Tomlin) 告诉《卫报》的尼古拉·戴维斯 (Nicola Davis)，虽然女性化的“-a”结尾是合理的，但卡西乌斯·迪奥 (Cassius Dio) 明确认为统治者是男性，并称他为“贝里库斯 (Bericus)”。他还对罗素关于“rex”曾被用于男性和女性统治者的说法提出异议。

paras.en: Russell welcomes the scholarly debate. “If it does create debate and argument, I think that's for the better,” he tells the Guardian. “The one-sided story’s been there for so long. We need that to change.”
paras.zh: 罗素欢迎学术辩论。 “如果它确实引发了争论和争议，我认为那就更好了，”他告诉卫报。 “片面的故事已经存在这么久了。我们需要改变这一点。”

articles.title: A Nazi Submarine Torpedoed a Merchant Ship Just Off the Coast of Maine in 1944. Divers Have Finally Located the Wreckage, 400 Feet Below the Surface

paras.en: In December 1944, a Nazi submarine torpedoed a Canadian merchant ship off the coast of Maine, killing 43 crew members on board. Now, more than eight decades later, divers say they’ve located the long-lost World War II wreck.
paras.zh: 1944 年 12 月，一艘纳粹潜艇在缅因州海岸用鱼雷击中了一艘加拿大商船，造成船上 43 名船员死亡。现在，八个多世纪过去了，潜水员说他们已经找到了失踪已久的二战沉船。

paras.en: The SS Cornwallis was discovered submerged nearly 400 feet deep in the northwest Atlantic Ocean near Mount Desert Rock, about 25 miles from the Maine mainland. Members of the Nomad Exploration Team, a self-funded civilian technical dive team based in Portsmouth, New Hampshire, found the nearly 5,500-ton vessel after years of searching.
paras.zh: SS Cornwallis 号被发现沉没在沙漠岩山附近西北大西洋近 400 英尺深的地方，距缅因州大陆约 25 英里。位于新罕布什尔州朴茨茅斯的游牧勘探队是一支自筹资金的民间技术潜水队，其成员经过多年的搜寻，发现了这艘近 5,500 吨的船只。

paras.en: The Cornwallis was traveling from Barbados to New Brunswick to deliver sugar and molasses when its forward cargo hold was struck by a torpedo from a German U-boat on December 3, 1944. Only five of the 48 crew members survived. They found life rafts, which were eventually spotted by aircraft. The survivors were picked up by fishing boats and transferred to a U.S. Navy rescue vessel, which delivered them to Rockland, Maine.
paras.zh: 1944 年 12 月 3 日，康沃利斯号正从巴巴多斯前往新不伦瑞克运送糖和糖蜜，其前部货舱被一艘德国潜艇的鱼雷击中。48 名船员中只有 5 人幸存。他们发现了救生筏，最终被飞机发现。幸存者被渔船救起并转移到美国海军救援船，然后将他们运送到缅因州罗克兰。

paras.en: Days earlier, the submarine had dropped off two Nazi spies near Hancock, Maine, as part of “Operation Magpie.” The spies—William C. Colepaugh, a 26-year-old American Nazi sympathizer, and Erich Gimpel, a 35-year-old German native—caught a taxi to Bangor, then took a train to Portland. They eventually reached New York City, where they stayed for several weeks before Colepaugh turned himself in to the FBI. Both men were originally sentenced to death, but President Harry Truman commuted their sentences down to 30 years.
paras.zh: 几天前，作为“喜鹊行动”的一部分，这艘潜艇在缅因州汉考克附近投放了两名纳粹间谍。这两名间谍——26 岁的美国纳粹同情者威廉·C·科尔波 (William C. Colepaugh) 和 35 岁的德国人埃里希·金佩尔 (Erich Gimpel)——乘出租车前往班戈，然后乘火车前往波特兰。他们最终到达纽约市，并在那里停留了几周，然后科尔波向联邦调查局自首。两人最初都被判处死刑，但哈里·杜鲁门总统将他们的刑期减至 30 年。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Cornwallis’ location remained unknown. The Nomad Exploration Team started looking for the Cornwallis in 2019, using historical records to narrow down the search to three potential locations. They made five total trips to search for the wreck, ultimately investigating more than 50 square miles of seafloor with side-scan sonar.
paras.zh: 与此同时，康沃利斯夫妇的下落仍然不明。 Nomad 勘探团队于 2019 年开始寻找康沃利斯群岛，利用历史记录将搜索范围缩小到三个潜在地点。他们一共进行了五次搜寻沉船的旅程，最终利用侧扫声纳对超过 50 平方英里的海底进行了调查。

paras.en: They found a wreck that seemed likely to be the Cornwallis on July 11, which was a moment of “exhilaration,” Danny Allan, a founding member of the group, tells the Portsmouth Herald’s Ian Lenahan. When they dove down to confirm its identity, however, they repeatedly encountered challenging conditions.
paras.zh: 该组织的创始成员丹尼·艾伦 (Danny Allan) 告诉《朴茨茅斯先驱报》的伊恩·莱纳汉 (Ian Lenahan)，7 月 11 日，他们发现了一艘似乎是康沃利斯号的残骸，那是一个“令人兴奋”的时刻。然而，当他们潜入海底确认其身份时，却一再遇到具有挑战性的情况。

paras.en: “It’s very deep, it’s very cold, a lot of current,” Jeff Goodreau, a member of the dive team, tells the Portland Press Herald’s Drew Johnson. “Pretty much the worst-case scenario as far as diving goes.”
paras.zh: “水很深，很冷，水流很大，”潜水队成员杰夫·古德罗 (Jeff Goodreau) 告诉波特兰新闻先驱报的德鲁·约翰逊 (Drew Johnson)。 “就潜水而言，这几乎是最坏的情况。”

paras.en: In the end, they used the Cornwallis’ blueprints to confirm the wreck as the missing ship, the Bangor Daily News’ Sabrina Martin reports.
paras.zh: 据《班戈每日新闻》的萨布丽娜·马丁报道，最终，他们利用康沃利斯号的蓝图确认了沉船就是失踪的船只。

paras.en: The Cornwallis isn’t the first shipwreck the Nomad Exploration Team has successfully located. In 2017, they found the SS William H. Machen, a cargo ship that sank in 1942 off the coast of Portsmouth. A year later, they located the USS Eagle 56, a warship sunk by a German torpedo in April 1945 off Cape Elizabeth, Maine.
