paras.zh: “虽然患者继续在英国接受治疗，但刚果民主共和国卫生当局仍保持充分警惕。正在采取接触者追踪、监测和其他公共卫生措施，以监测和遏制进一步传播的任何潜在风险。”

articles.title: Carlos Rivera Wins Big at 2026 Heat Latin Music Awards: Complete Winners List
articles.author: Jessica Roiz

paras.en: Carlos Rivera was the big winner at the 2026 Heat Latin Music Awards on Thursday (Nov. 5), nabbing the awards for best male artist, best music video for “Sin Despedida” in collaboration with Alejandro Fernández, and album of the year for ¡Vida México!
paras.zh: 卡洛斯·里维拉 (Carlos Rivera) 成为周四（11 月 5 日）2026 年热拉丁音乐奖的大赢家，获得最佳男艺人奖、与亚历杭德罗·费尔南德斯 (Alejandro Fernández) 合作的《Sin Despedida》最佳音乐录影带奖以及《Vida México!》年度专辑奖！

paras.en: Other winners of the night included Karol G as best female artist, Grupo Firme as regional Mexican artist, and Ovy on the Drums as producer of the year. Meanwhile, Gloria Trevi, Olga Tañon, La Arrolladora Banda El Limón de René Camacho, Los Angeles Azules and Piso 21 all received special awards at the popularly known Premios Heat.
paras.zh: 当晚的其他获奖者包括最佳女艺术家 Karol G、墨西哥地区艺术家 Grupo Firme 和年度制作人 Ovy on the Drums。与此同时，Gloria Trevi、Olga Tañon、La Arrolladora Banda El Limón de René Camacho、Los Angeles Azules 和 Piso 21 都在广为人知的 Premios Heat 中获得了特别奖。

paras.en: For the first time in the ceremony’s history two Cuban reparto acts took center stage. Pututi and Nesty performed a medley of “Efimero” and “Los Despechaos”—the latter peaked at No. 7 on the Latin Rhythm Airplay chart this year; and Rey Tony and Helabusador performed “Dichavate,” their collaboration with Ya Ice Dilan that won best viral song.
paras.zh: 在颁奖典礼的历史上，这是第一次有两场古巴表演表演占据了舞台的中心。 Pututi 和 Nesty 表演了一首《Efimero》和《Los Despecchaos》的混合曲——后者在今年的拉丁节奏音乐排行榜上最高排名第七； Rey Tony 和 Helabusador 表演了“Dichavate”，他们与 Ya Ice Dilan 合作赢得了最佳病毒歌曲奖。

paras.en: The gala’s 2026 edition was hosted for the first time in Mexico, in collaboration with the government of Jalisco and the municipality of Puerto Vallarta. Previously, Premios Heat took place in the Dominican Republic and Colombia.
paras.zh: 2026 年的盛典首次在墨西哥举办，由哈利斯科州政府和巴亚尔塔港市政府合作举办。此前，Premios Heat 曾在多米尼加共和国和哥伦比亚举行。

articles.title: JENNIE’s ‘Someone to Hold’ Is Here: Stream It Now
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: JENNIE strides on out with her latest solo cut “Someone to Hold,” which appears on the soundtrack for the forthcoming Netflix animated film, Steps.
paras.zh: JENNIE 带着她最新的独奏剪辑《Someone to Hold》大步向前迈进，这首歌曲出现在即将上映的 Netflix 动画电影《Steps》的配乐中。

paras.en: The BLACKPINK star shares in full her new song, written and produced by Justin Tranter. “Someone to Hold” is light on its feet, a melodic neo-disco production with strings, slapping bass, and layers of JENNIE vocals.
paras.zh: 这位 BLACKPINK 明星完整分享了她由贾斯汀·特兰特 (Justin Tranter) 创作和制作的新歌。 《Someone to Hold》节奏轻快，是一首旋律优美的新迪斯科作品，有弦乐、拍打的贝斯和 JENNIE 的歌声。

paras.en: On it, she sings: “After, after everything that we’ve been through / The ins and outs, the upside downs and good times too / You’re still the shooting star that’s in my skies / You’re still the only one I want in every life.”
paras.zh: 在歌曲中，她唱道：“在我们经历了一切之后/来龙去脉、颠倒和美好时光/你仍然是我天空中的流星/你仍然是我一生中唯一想要的人。”

paras.en: Tranter, who wrote and produced three more original songs for the film’s official soundtrack, has described “Someone to Hold” as “pure danceable joy inspired by vintage organic dance pop.”
paras.zh: 特兰特为电影的官方配乐创作并制作了另外三首原创歌曲，他将《Someone to Hold》描述为“受复古有机流行舞曲启发的纯粹的舞蹈乐趣”。

paras.en: Directed by Alyce Tzue and John Ripa, Steps sends the tale of Cinderella in a different direction. According to a statement, Cinderella’s “evil” stepsisters Lilith (Ali Wong) steals the magic wand belonging to the Fairy Godmother (Bette Midler) and hijacks the Royal Ball with Margot (Stephanie Hsu). Enter Priscilla (Nikki Glaser), a “villainous schemer who swoops in and snatches the throne.” With Priscilla in charge, consider the party over. And the happily-ever-after ending ruined.
paras.zh: 由 Alyce Tzue 和 John Ripa 执导的《Steps》将灰姑娘的故事推向了不同的方向。根据一份声明，灰姑娘“邪恶”的继姐妹莉莉丝（黄阿丽饰）偷走了仙女教母（贝蒂·米德勒饰）的魔杖，并与玛戈特（徐斯蒂芬妮饰）劫持了皇家舞会。普里西拉（尼基·格拉泽饰）登场，她是一个“突然袭击并夺取王位的邪恶阴谋家”。由普里西拉负责，聚会就结束了。而美好的结局也被毁了。

paras.en: Realizing her terrible move, Lilith must join forces with Cinderella (Amanda Seyfried) in an epic quest, with battles royale and friendships forged along the way.
paras.zh: 意识到自己的可怕举动后，莉莉丝必须与灰姑娘（阿曼达·塞弗里德饰）联手完成史诗般的任务，一路上进行皇家战斗并建立友谊。

paras.en: “We love how Jennie’s bright and spirited ‘Someone To Hold’ represents Lilith, Cinderella, and Margot’s sisterhood, giving audiences a shot of energy and positivity straight to the heart,” Tzue and Ripa comment in a statement.
paras.zh: Tzue 和 Ripa 在一份声明中评论道：“我们喜欢 Jennie 明亮而充满活力的《Someone To Hold》，它代表了莉莉丝、灰姑娘和玛戈特的姐妹情谊，让观众直击内心的能量和积极性。”

paras.en: Steps is produced by Amy Poehler, Jane Hartwell, Kim Lessing, with Poehler and Lessing producing for Paper Kite Productions.
paras.zh: Steps 由 Amy Poehler、Jane Hartwell、Kim Lessing 制作，Poehler 和 Lessing 为 Paper Kite Productions 制作。

paras.en: The companion soundtrack arrives Nov. 20, the same day as Steps rolls out on Netflix. JENNIE is coming off her biggest hit as a solo artist with her guest work on Tame Impala’s “Dracula” remix, which went to No. 5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 2 on the Official U.K. Singles Chart and enjoyed a scary Halloween streaming boost.
paras.zh: 配套原声带将于 11 月 20 日发布，与《Steps》在 Netflix 上推出的同一天。 JENNIE 凭借她在 Tame Impala 的《Dracula》混音版中的客串作品，结束了她作为独唱艺术家的最热门作品，该作品在 Billboard Hot 100 上排名第五，在英国官方单曲榜上排名第二，并在万圣节流媒体上获得了可怕的增长。

paras.en: Pre-save Steps here and stream “Someone to Hold” below.
paras.zh: 在此处预先保存步骤并在下面流式传输“有人要握住”。

articles.title: Lil Baby, JENNIE, Dove Cameron, XG, Boys Noize & More: New Music Friday Guide
articles.author: Lyndsey Havens

paras.en: Billboard’s Friday Music Guide serves as a handy guide to New Music Friday’s most essential releases each week — the key music that everyone will be talking about today, and that will be dominating playlists this weekend and beyond.
paras.zh: Billboard 的周五音乐指南是每周周五新音乐最重要版本的便捷指南 - 今天每个人都会谈论的关键音乐，并且将在本周末及以后的播放列表中占据主导地位。

paras.en: Last week, we featured Dominic Fike, Mariah Carey and Queens of the Stone Age.
paras.zh: 上周，我们特别报道了多米尼克·菲克、玛丽亚·凯莉和石器时代的女王。

paras.en: This week, Lil Baby is back with his anticipated fifth album; JENNIE drops a new single for the animated Netflix film STEPS; Dove Cameron releases her long-awaited debut album; and Boys Noize returns with his first solo studio album in five years.… plus much more.
paras.zh: 本周，Lil Baby 带着他备受期待的第五张专辑回归； JENNIE 为 Netflix 动画电影《STEPS》发布了一首新单曲；德芙·卡梅隆发行了她期待已久的首张专辑； Boys Noize 带着他五年来的第一张个人录音室专辑回归……还有更多。

paras.en: Check out all of this week’s picks below:
paras.zh: 查看以下本周所有精选内容：

paras.en: After scoring his third consecutive Billboard 200 No. 1 album with WHAM last year, Lil Baby is gunning for his fourth with Fresh. The new set arrives with a title inspired by his recent hit single “Dead Fresh,” an infectious, Pharrell-produced joint that soared to No. 18 on the Billboard Hot 100 and topped Rhythmic Airplay. Stacked with guest appearances by frequent collaborators Future, Young Thug and Rylo Rodriguez, Fresh finds Baby delivering 17 new songs that reassert his position as one of the most gifted mainstream MCs to blow up this decade. — KYLE DENIS
paras.zh: 去年，Lil Baby 凭借 WHAM 连续第三次登上 Billboard 200 专辑第一名，现在他正凭借 Fresh 力争第四张专辑。新专辑的标题灵感来自于他最近的热门单曲《Dead Fresh》，这是一首由 Pharrell 制作的富有感染力的单曲，在 Billboard Hot 100 中飙升至第 18 位，并在 Rhythmic Airplay 中名列榜首。 Fresh 发现 Baby 经常合作的人 Future、Young Thug 和 Rylo Rodriguez 都客串演出了 17 首新歌，重申了他作为近十年来最具天赋的主流 MC 之一的地位。 — 凯尔·丹尼斯

paras.en: The inviting disco-colored intro of “Someone To Hold” neither sounds like a typical song for JENNIE nor a Disney princess — and that’s what makes it magic. The colorful pop song shows a new side of JENNIE’s artistry that leans more playful and vibrant than anything on her solo debut full-length, while also matching the fresh take of the movie it’s from — as the upcoming musical comedy Steps reimagines Cinderella from the perspective of the stepsisters. — L.H.
paras.zh: 《Someone To Hold》引人入胜的迪斯科色彩前奏听起来既不像 JENNIE 的典型歌曲，也不像迪士尼公主的歌曲，而这正是它的魔力所在。这首色彩缤纷的流行歌曲展示了 JENNIE 艺术才华的新一面，比她的个人首张完整专辑中的任何歌曲都更加俏皮和充满活力，同时也与电影的新鲜感相匹配——即将上映的音乐喜剧《Steps》从继姐妹的角度重新想象了灰姑娘。 — L.H.

paras.en: Despite launching her career over a decade ago in Disney TV and film franchises — also lending her voice to both — Final Girl is Dove Cameron’s debut full-length. At long last. The dramatic and soaring album delivers a range of tempos and emotions, from softer songs like pop ballad “Silver Screen Baby” and the raw “Immortalized” to uptempo dance-pop single “When In Rome” and the haunting and heavy “Skin On Bone.” It’s an album that was well worth the wait, and offers so much possibility and intrigue as to what sounds and styles Cameron will want to explore next. — L.H.
paras.zh: 尽管十多年前就开始了她的职业生涯，在迪士尼电视和电影系列中也都有她的声音，但《最终女孩》是德芙·卡梅隆的处女作。终于。这张戏剧性的、飙升的专辑传达了一系列的节奏和情感，从流行民谣《Silver Screen Baby》和原始的《Immortalized》等柔和的歌曲，到快节奏舞曲流行单曲《When In Rome》和令人难以忘怀的沉重《Skin On Bone》。这是一张非常值得等待的专辑，它为卡梅隆接下来想要探索的声音和风格提供了如此多的可能性和吸引力。 — L.H.

paras.en: Veteran rock band Kings Of Leon has released its 10th album, O My Beloved — and the first the band has ever self-produced. That decision paid off, as the gorgeous album marries thoughtful and melodic production with deeply personal storytelling about the member’s families and upbringings. Described in a press release as a “love letter” to the road that brought the band to this point, it feels just as much a love letter to the fans who have walked that road with them for more than two decades. — L.H.
paras.zh: 老牌摇滚乐队 Kings Of Leon 发行了其第十张专辑《O My Beloved》，这也是该乐队自行制作的第一张专辑。这一决定得到了回报，这张华丽的专辑将深思熟虑、旋律优美的制作与关于成员家庭和成长的深刻个人故事结合在一起。在一份新闻稿中，这封信被描述为一封写给乐队走到今天的道路的“情书”，这也是一封写给与他们一起走过这条路二十多年的歌迷的情书。 — L.H.

paras.en: Since debuting in 2022, Japanese girl group XG have kept busy — especially this year. Since releasing its first full-length in January, titled THE CORE – 核, the group has embarked on its second world tour and has now, amidst that outing, released more new music with “Depends.” The electro-pop track showcases the members vocal strengths, from hard-hitting raps to syrupy, soaring high notes — all of which are united with groovy, metallic production and making for a high-energy addition to its set. — L.H.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年出道以来，日本女子组合 XG 一直很忙碌，尤其是今年。自从一月份发行第一张全长专辑《THE CORE – 核》以来，该乐队已经开始了第二次世界巡演，现在，在这次巡演中，又发行了更多新音乐《Depends》。这首电子流行歌曲展示了成员们的声音优势，从强劲的说唱到糖浆般高亢的高音，所有这些都与绝妙的金属制作相结合，为歌曲增添了高能量。 — L.H.

paras.en: Rex Orange County, “Elvis (featuring Brendan Yates)”
paras.zh: 雷克斯奥兰治县，“埃尔维斯（布伦丹·耶茨主演）”

paras.en: In just one month, on Dec. 4, Slayyyter will unveil the counterpart to this year’s acclaimed WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA album. Aptly titled wor$t man in america, the new album will contrast the perspectives she shared and ideas she explored on its predecessor. Frenetic new single “Hey Boyyy” delivers on Slayyyter’s signature sound thought is a bit softer in its lyrics, striking a balance only she can between a chaotic nature with good intentions. “I can’t stop blushing/ I’m too old to feel, more than nothing, she sings ahead of the chorus in which she admits, “Hey, boy, I got a funny little secret/ I get so nervous when you talk to me.” Not even ascendant superstars are immune. — L.H.
paras.zh: 仅仅一个月后，即 12 月 4 日，Slayyyter 将推出今年广受好评的 WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA 专辑的对应专辑。这张新专辑恰如其分地命名为“美国最糟糕的男人”，它将与她在前一张专辑中分享的观点和探索的想法进行对比。狂热的新单曲《Hey Boyyy》延续了 Slayyyter 的标志性声音，歌词中的声音更加柔和，只有她才能在混乱的本性与良好的意图之间取得平衡。 “我无法停止脸红/我太老了，感觉不到，比什么都没有，她在副歌之前唱到，她承认，“嘿，男孩，我有一个有趣的小秘密/当你和我说话时，我变得很紧张。”即使是冉冉升起的超级巨星也不能幸免。 — L.H.

paras.en: After nearly two decades as an underground hero, it feels like the world finally caught up to Boys Noize. Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross tapped him to remix their 2024 score for Challengers, then brought him on to co-produce much of their 2025 Tron: Ares soundtrack, finding clear connective tissue between their own industrial rock and the industrial electronic of the Boys Noize catalog. The Iraqi-German producer born Alex Ridha then lived out a rock ‘n’ roll fantasy, effectively becoming a member of Nine Inch Nails while opening for and playing with the band on its Peel It Back run before releasing the collaborative Nine Inch Noize album and playing a pair of Coachella shows that some called among the best in the festival’s history. On top of all that, he and Skrillex activated their longstanding side project Dog Blood last month with a headlining set at Portola, where they teased new music.
paras.zh: 作为地下英雄近二十年后，感觉世界终于追上了 Boys Noize。 Trent Reznor 和 Atticus Ross 聘请他为《挑战者》重新混音 2024 年的配乐，然后邀请他共同制作 2025 年《创：阿瑞斯》的配乐，在他们自己的工业摇滚乐和 Boys Noize 目录中的工业电子乐之间找到了清晰的结缔组织。伊拉克裔德国制作人亚历克斯·里达 (Alex Ridha) 实现了摇滚幻想，实际上成为了九寸钉 (Nine Inch Nails) 的成员，同时为乐队开场并在 Peel It Back 演出中与乐队一起演奏，随后发行了合作专辑《九寸噪音》(Nine Inch Noize)，并演奏了两场被一些人称为音乐节历史上最好的科切拉 (Coachella) 演出。最重要的是，他和 Skrillex 上个月启动了他们长期的副业项目《Dog Blood》，并在波托拉举办了一场头条新闻，在那里他们预告了新音乐。

paras.en: And now the producer returns to himself with 7LLVSION, his first solo studio album in five years. An all-killer-no-filler 12-song collection, the album is ferocious and unrelenting, drawing on EBM, punk, new wave and industrial to build music that’s hard as hell (“Illusion,” “Hyytup”) and often deliciously unhinged (“1+1+1”). Collaborators arrive from across the globe — Brazilian funkeiro Adame DJ, post-Soviet electro-punk collective Locked Club, Argentine rapper TAICHU, German duo Brutalismus 3000 — but Ridha never loses the thread. 7LLVSION is the work of a producer who spent years in other people’s worlds, then came home with something to say. — KATIE BAIN
paras.zh: 现在，这位制作人带着五年来的首张个人录音室专辑《7LLVSION》回归自我。这张专辑收录了 12 首歌曲，内容凶猛而无情，借鉴了 EBM、朋克、新浪潮和工业音乐，打造出极其艰难的音乐（“Illusion”、“Hyytup”），但又常常令人愉悦地精神错乱（“1+1+1”）。合作者来自世界各地——巴西 funkeiro Adame DJ、后苏联电子朋克团体 Locked Club、阿根廷说唱歌手 TAICHU、德国二人组 Brutalismus 3000——但 Ridha 从未失去线索。 《7LLVSION》是一位制作人的作品，他在别人的世界里度过了数年，然后带着一些话要说。 — 凯蒂·贝恩

paras.en: After taking a blue-eyed-soul detour earlier this year with his Monica album, Jack Harlow is going back to his roots with Sweet Action II, the official sequent to his breakthrough 2020 Sweet Action EP. While that older project housed the career-catapulting “Whats Poppin,” Sweet Action II leans on the ’90s for its exploration of romance, hence Babyface’s appearance on standout track “Too Soon.” — K.D.
paras.zh: 继今年早些时候推出《Monica》专辑后，杰克·哈洛 (Jack Harlow) 回归了自己的根源，推出了《Sweet Action II》，这是他突破性的 2020 年《Sweet Action EP》的正式续作。虽然那个较旧的项目包含了事业飞速发展的“Whats Poppin”，但《Sweet Action II》则依靠 90 年代的浪漫探索，因此 Babyface 出现在出色的单曲“Too Soon”中。 — K.D.

articles.title: Pam Abdy Laments Exits of Top Female Executives in Hollywood: “It Is Upsetting to See”
articles.author: Mia Galuppo

paras.en: At Thursday night‘s Women in Film Honors, Pamela Abdy was on hand to receive one of the evening’s big awards, one month after being ousted as the film chief at Warner Bros.
paras.zh: 在周四晚上的女性电影荣誉颁奖典礼上，帕梅拉·阿布迪 (Pamela Abdy) 现场领取了当晚的一项大奖，一个月前，她已经被华纳兄弟公司 (Warner Bros.) 的电影主管职位赶下台。

paras.en: “I have been relaxing and taking a breath and taking a minute and hanging out with my family,” Abdy told The Hollywood Reporter on the event‘s red carpet of what she has been up to in the past month, adding that her family was with her at the night‘s event, including her mother and daughter.
paras.zh: “我一直在放松、喘口气、花一分钟时间和家人一起出去玩，”阿卜迪在活动的红地毯上告诉《好莱坞报道》她过去一个月的所作所为，并补充说她的家人和她一起参加了当晚的活动，包括她的母亲和女儿。

paras.en: At this year‘s WIF Honors, Abdy is receiving the inaugural Vanguard Award, a recognition for a leader whose career embodies the qualities that move the industry forward, and is set to be presented the award by Nancy Meyers. Meyers worked with Abdy on her latest feature film, Paris Paramount, the beloved filmmaker‘s first time back in the director’s chair since 2015‘s The Intern.
paras.zh: 在今年的 WIF Honors 颁奖典礼上，Abdy 荣获首届先锋奖，这是对一位职业生涯体现了推动行业进步的品质的领导者的认可，该奖项将由 Nancy Meyers 颁发。迈耶斯与阿卜迪合作拍摄了她的最新故事片《巴黎派拉蒙》，这是这位深受喜爱的电影制片人自 2015 年的《实习生》以来首次重新担任导演。

paras.en: “It feels completely humbling,“ Abdy said of the recognition. “I am super proud to be a part of this organization and what it stands for and also be here to pass on whatever I can to the next generation. That is the most important thing to me.“
paras.zh: “这感觉完全是一种谦卑，”阿卜迪谈到这种认可时说道。 “我非常自豪能够成为这个组织的一员，了解它所代表的意义，并在这里将我能做的一切传递给下一代。这对我来说是最重要的。”

paras.en: The honor was announced before her exit from Warner Bros., which took place as Paramount Skydance completed its $111 billion merger with Warner Bros. last month. During her tenure at the studio, Abdy oversaw a slate that included movies from female directors like Emerald Fennell, Maggie Gyllenhaal and Meyers; 2025 saw films directed by women drop to a seven-year low.
paras.zh: 这一荣誉是在她退出华纳兄弟之前宣布的，当时派拉蒙 Skydance 上个月完成了与华纳兄弟 1,110 亿美元的合并。在工作室任职期间，阿卜迪监督了一系列影片，其中包括埃默拉尔德·芬内尔、玛吉·吉伦哈尔和迈耶斯等女导演的电影； 2025 年，女性导演的电影数量降至七年来的最低点。

paras.en: A subject that is being discussed with increasing alarm in industry circles, and was certainly a subject at Thursday night‘s WIF event, is the recent culling of top female executives during the ongoing layoffs and larger restructuring following the latest round of Hollywood mergers and acquisitions. In addition to Abdy, Cindy Holland exited her post as Paramount‘s streaming chief, while Bela Bajaria was ousted as Netflix’s chief content officer.
paras.zh: 业界正在日益警惕地讨论的一个话题，当然也是周四晚 WIF 活动的一个话题，是最近一轮好莱坞并购后持续裁员和更大规模重组期间女性高管被剔除的情况。除了阿卜迪之外，辛迪·霍兰 (Cindy Holland) 也辞去了派拉蒙流媒体主管的职务，而贝拉·巴贾里亚 (Bela Bajaria) 则被解除了 Netflix 首席内容官的职务。

paras.en: “Obviously, it is upsetting to see,“ Abdy offered of a raft of departures of female executives among Hollywood‘s top ranks. She went on to add: “But all of these women are incredible women and have incredible careers. These one moments don‘t define you. What defines you is the work you did and the work you left behind and the work you hope to do in the future. That‘s all we can keep doing, especially us executives, is try and support the next generation of storytellers and all of the artists.“
paras.zh: “显然，看到好莱坞高层女性高管大量离职，令人感到沮丧”，阿卜迪说道。她接着补充道：“但所有这些女性都是令人难以置信的女性，拥有令人难以置信的职业生涯。这些时刻并不能定义你。定义你的是你所做的工作、你留下的工作以及你希望在未来做的工作。这就是我们能继续做的，尤其是我们的高管，就是努力支持下一代讲故事的人和所有艺术家。”

paras.en: Where Abdy ends up next has been the subject of much speculation in Hollywood, with many wondering if she and her former Warner Bros. co-film head Mike De Luca would be taking over at Netflix’s film operation, after the firing of Dan Lin. When asked about her next move, Abdy said, “I have no idea what we are going to do next. Honestly, it is kind of a nice thing to not know.”
paras.zh: 阿迪接下来的去向一直是好莱坞众多猜测的话题，许多人想知道在丹·林被解雇后，她和她的前华纳兄弟联合电影主管迈克·德·卢卡是否会接管 Netflix 的电影业务。当被问及她的下一步行动时，阿卜迪说：“我不知道我们下一步要做什么。老实说，不知道也是件好事。”

articles.title: Parke’s Collab With Stoney Clover Lane Is Back by (Very) Popular Demand
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Parke’s latest inevitably viral launch comes in the form of a collaboration with beloved accessories brand Stoney Clover Lane.
paras.zh: Parke 与深受喜爱的配饰品牌 Stoney Clover Lane 合作，推出了一款势必走红的最新产品。

paras.en: The limited-edition drop, available on both Parke’s website and Stoney Clover Lane’s website starting Friday, Nov. 6 at 7 a.m. PT/10 a.m. ET, is chock-full of each brand’s customer favorites: denim, duffels, pouches, bag charms and, of course, a reimagined version of Parke’s signature Varsity Mockneck.
paras.zh: 该限量版产品将于太平洋时间 11 月 6 日星期五上午 7 点/东部时间上午 10 点在 Parke 网站和 Stoney Clover Lane 网站上发售，其中充满了每个品牌的顾客最爱：牛仔布、行李袋、手袋、包饰，当然还有 Parke 标志性 Varsity 无领毛衣的重新设计版本。

paras.en: “When my two worlds COLLIDE!,” writes one Instagram user. The sentiment is clearly widespread.
paras.zh: “当我的两个世界发生碰撞时！”一位 Instagram 用户写道。这种情绪显然很普遍。

paras.en: The latest release comes on the heels of Parke’s Halloween drop, which similarly revived sold-out favorites. Other recent campaigns include Parke’s Pink Aid partnership timed to Breast Cancer Awareness Month, its Fall ’26 Collection and Parke’s Collegiate Collection, the brand’s first licensed apparel launch, created in partnership with sports lifestyle brand ’47.
paras.zh: 最新版本是继 Parke 的万圣节系列之后推出的，这款系列也同样重新复活了售罄的热门产品。最近的其他活动包括 Parke’s Pink Aid 合作伙伴关系，配合乳腺癌意识月推出其秋季 ’26 系列，以及 Parke’s Collegiate Collection，这是该品牌与运动生活方式品牌 ’47 合作推出的首款授权服装。

paras.en: Since coming to market in 2022, Chelsea Parke’s direct-to-consumer clothing line has taken social media by storm. What started as reworked denim quickly turned into limited-release loungewear, most notably, Parke’s signature mockneck, known to sell out within minutes of online drops. By April 2026, the viral fashion brand made its way into Target stores nationwide. As for Stoney Clover Lane, the internet sensation launched in 2009 by two Palm Beach-based sisters. The brand has since collaborated with entertainment and retail giants like Disney, Sanrio, the NFL and American Girl, to name a few.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年上市以来，Chelsea Parke 的直接面向消费者的服装系列席卷了社交媒体。最初的改造牛仔布很快就变成了限量发售的家居服，其中最引人注目的是 Parke 的标志性小高领毛衣，众所周知，它在网上发售后几分钟内就被抢购一空。到 2026 年 4 月，这个病毒式时尚品牌已进入全国 Target 商店。至于 Stoney Clover Lane，它是由棕榈滩的两姐妹于 2009 年推出的，引起了网络轰动。此后，该品牌与迪士尼、三丽鸥、NFL 和 American Girl 等娱乐和零售巨头合作。

paras.en: Stoney Clover Lane x Parke will be available in limited quantities starting Friday, Nov. 6 at both Parke.com and StoneyCloverLane.com. As always, product is expected to move fast.
paras.zh: Stoney Clover Lane x Parke 将于 11 月 6 日星期五开始在 Parke.com 和 StoneyCloverLane.com 限量发售。一如既往，产品预计会快速发展。

articles.title: Pamela Abdy Gets Real About Her “Pure, Unadulterated Rage” in WIF Honors Speech: “What Business Are We Leaving?”
articles.author: Kirsten Chuba

paras.en: Pamela Abdy made her first public appearance since she and Mike De Luca were outed at Warner Bros., stepping out at Women in Film‘s annual WIF Honors event on Thursday — where she did not hold back.
paras.zh: 帕梅拉·阿布迪 (Pamela Abdy) 自从她和迈克·德·卢卡 (Mike De Luca) 在华纳兄弟出柜以来首次公开露面，周四她毫不犹豫地出席了女性电影人年度 WIF 荣誉活动。

paras.en: The exec received the inaugural Vanguard Award, a recognition for a leader whose career embodies the qualities that move the industry forward, presented by Nancy Meyers. The honor was announced before her exit from the legacy studio, which took place as Paramount Skydance completed its $111 billion merger with Warner Bros. last month.
paras.zh: 这位高管获得了由南希·迈耶斯 (Nancy Meyers) 颁发的首届先锋奖，这是对一位职业生涯体现了推动行业前进的品质的领导者的认可。这一荣誉是在她退出传统工作室之前宣布的，上个月派拉蒙 Skydance 完成了与华纳兄弟 1,110 亿美元的合并。

paras.en: Taking the stage, Abdy reflected on how she has worked with some of the greatest filmmakers of all time and tried to make films that spark “valuable conversations and debate.” However, she continued, “We also have to do this under the microscope of a media ecosystem that has largely abandoned analysis and fact for the trap of clickbait.” The exec then ran through a list, thanking every female director she has produced or worked with to date, followed by lists of the female execs and producers.
paras.zh: 阿迪在舞台上反思了她如何与一些有史以来最伟大的电影制片人合作，并试图制作能够引发“有价值的对话和辩论”的电影。然而，她继续说道，“我们还必须在媒体生态系统的显微镜下做到这一点，该生态系统基本上已经放弃了分析和事实，陷入点击诱饵的陷阱。”然后，这位高管列出了一份名单，感谢她迄今为止制作或合作过的每一位女性导演，然后列出了女性高管和制片人的名单。

paras.en: “My gratitude for these women has only grown over the years, but lately other feelings, and one in particular, have risen to the surface with undeniable ferocity — and that feeling is pure, unadulterated rage,” she told the crowd inside the Beverly Hilton. “Rage for these women, rage for me, and even more rage for the entire generation of women who deserve to have their potential recognized and elevated. Rage at how women are under attack everywhere. Rage at how our health and our well-being always seem to come second to how we show up in a room, and here’s the problem: as a leader who happens to be a woman, I am supposed to sublimate this rage. And you know what happens when they tell you to tamp down a fever? Sometimes it just burns hotter.”
paras.zh: “这些年来，我对这些女性的感激之情与日俱增，但最近，其他感情，尤其是一种感情，以不可否认的猛烈程度浮出水面——这种感觉是纯粹的、纯粹的愤怒，”她对贝弗利希尔顿酒店内的人群说道。 “为这些女性感到愤怒，为我感到愤怒，为值得让她们的潜力得到认可和提升的整整一代女性感到愤怒。为女性在任何地方都受到攻击而感到愤怒。为我们的健康和福祉似乎总是排在我们在房间里的表现之后而感到愤怒，问题是：作为一个碰巧是女性的领导者，我应该升华这种愤怒。你知道当他们告诉你要抑制发烧时会发生什么吗？有时它只是烧得更热。”

paras.en: Abdy continued, “I’ve been called difficult, emotional, combative. I’ve been told to put on my big-boy pants, to smile more. I’ve been told movies starring women and movies directed by women don’t make as much money, that the audience is limited. That everyone gets nervous when our sisters lead a movie because traditional tracking suggests men won’t show up,” going on to call out male directors for not supporting female directors in the same way they support each other.
paras.zh: 阿卜迪继续说道，“有人说我很难相处、情绪化、好斗。有人告诉我要穿上大男孩裤，多微笑。有人告诉我，女性主演的电影和女性导演的电影赚的钱没有那么多，而且观众也有限。当我们的姐妹们主演一部电影时，每个人都会感到紧张，因为传统的跟踪表明男性不会出现。”她接着指责男性导演不像支持女性导演那样支持女性导演。

paras.en: “It is getting harder, not easier, to be a woman in the business. We tell ourselves because a few of us made it into these chairperson seats, we broke through, that we paved the way for the next generation. But I don’t think it’s true,” she said, pointing out how there are most powerful women in Hollywood lists and no version for the men because “they are the list.”
paras.zh: “作为一名女性，在这个行业变得越来越难，而不是更容易。我们告诉自己，因为我们中的一些人进入了主席席位，我们取得了突破，我们为下一代铺平了道路。但我认为这不是真的，”她说，并指出好莱坞名单上有最有权势的女性，而没有男性的版本，因为“他们就是名单”。

paras.en: “What business are we leaving for future vanguards? Is it a healthy industry for the next generation of storytellers and executives to step into, one that allows women to enter with an open heart and mind without having to fight the fights we’re still fighting? These are the questions I think about when I focus on funneling my rage,” Abdy added, noting that this week’s election gave her some hope to see so many women appointed to top political positions. She went on to thank the people in her life (including De Luca) for being there through “the highs, the lows, the great successes, and yes, the very public failures.”
paras.zh: “我们要为未来的先锋留下什么生意？对于下一代讲故事的人和高管来说，这是一个健康的行业吗？这个行业是否允许女性以开放的心态和思想进入，而不必为我们仍在战斗的​​斗争而奋斗？这些是我在集中精力发泄愤怒时思考的问题，”阿卜迪补充道，并指出本周的选举让她看到了一些希望，看到如此多的女性被任命担任最高政治职位。她接着感谢生命中的人们（包括德卢卡），感谢他们陪伴她度过了“高潮、低谷、巨大的成功，是的，还有公开的失败”。

paras.en: “It has taken me 31 years in this business to speak in my own voice and to stop caring whether someone calls me difficult. Because now when I hear that, I say, ‘No, you’re wrong.’ If the definition of difficult is someone who is passionate about getting movies made, then I will just have to suffer the fools who don’t know the difference and keep fighting to do what I love,” Abdy said in closing out her 15-minute speech. “I am so grateful and so blessed for this life I have and this career so far — I’m not done. And to be a part of this incredible community.”
paras.zh: “我在这个行业花了 31 年的时间，才用自己的声音说话，不再关心是否有人说我很难相处。因为现在，当我听到这些话时，我会说，‘不，你错了。’如果困难的定义是热衷于拍电影的人，那么我就只能忍受那些不知道其中区别的傻瓜，并继续努力做我喜欢的事情，”阿布迪在结束她 15 分钟的演讲时说道。 “我对自己的生活和迄今为止的职业感到非常感激和祝福——我还没有完成。并成为这个令人难以置信的社区的一部分。”

paras.en: Earlier in the night, Abdy also spoke to The Hollywood Reporter about life after Warner Bros., saying she has “no idea what we are going to do next. Honestly, it is kind of a nice thing to not know.” She also reacted to the recent culling of top female executives during the ongoing layoffs and restructuring; in addition to Abdy, Cindy Holland exited her post as Paramount‘s streaming chief, while Bela Bajaria was ousted as Netflix’s chief content officer.
paras.zh: 当晚早些时候，阿卜迪还向《好莱坞报道》谈到了华纳兄弟之后的生活，称她“不知道我们下一步要做什么。老实说，不知道也是件好事。”她还对最近在持续的裁员和重组过程中剔除女性高管做出了反应；除了阿卜迪之外，辛迪·霍兰 (Cindy Holland) 也辞去了派拉蒙流媒体主管的职务，而贝拉·巴贾里亚 (Bela Bajaria) 则被解除了 Netflix 首席内容官的职务。

paras.en: “Obviously, it is upsetting to see,“ Abdy offered of a raft of departures of female executives among Hollywood‘s top ranks, adding, “But all of these women are incredible women and have incredible careers. These one moments don‘t define you. What defines you is the work you did and the work you left behind and the work you hope to do in the future. That‘s all we can keep doing, especially us executives, is try and support the next generation of storytellers and all of the artists.“
paras.zh: “显然，看到好莱坞高层女性高管的大量离职令人沮丧，”阿迪表示，“但所有这些女性都是令人难以置信的女性，拥有令人难以置信的职业生涯。这些时刻并不能定义你。定义你的是你所做的工作、你留下的工作以及你未来希望做的工作。我们能继续做的就是，尤其是我们高管，努力支持下一代讲故事的人和所有艺术家。”

paras.en: WIF Honors also celebrated Adria Arjona with the WIF Max Mara Face of the Future Award, Gemma Chan and Beth de Araújo with the Crystal Award for Advocacy in Film for their work on Josephine, Hannah Waddingham with the Crystal Award for Advocacy in TV for Ted Lasso, and Salma Hayek Pinault with the Jane Fonda Humanitarian Award, presented by Fonda herself.
paras.zh: WIF Honors 还向阿德里亚·阿霍纳 (Adria Arjona) 颁发了“WIF Max Mara 未来面孔奖”，嘉玛·陈 (Gemma Chan) 和贝丝·德·阿劳霍 (Beth de Araújo) 因其在《约瑟芬》中的出色表现而获得了电影宣传水晶奖，汉娜·沃丁汉姆 (Hannah Waddingham) 因泰德·拉索 (Ted Lasso) 获得了电视宣传水晶奖，萨尔玛·海耶克·皮诺 (Salma Hayek Pinault) 荣获由方达亲自颁发的简·方达人道主义奖。

articles.title: India as an AI hedge? The country's stocks could see robust inflows as markets globally tank

paras.en: The Indian stock market is emerging as an attractive hedge as investors seek refuge from a brutal sell-off in the artificial intelligence trade, making it a strong contender for global capital.
paras.zh: 随着投资者在人工智能行业的残酷抛售中寻求庇护，印度股市正在成为一种有吸引力的对冲工具，使其成为全球资本的有力竞争者。

paras.en: As sentiment around AI sours, foreign investors, who have been underweight on the Indian market for nearly two years due to high valuations, subdued earnings growth and lack of local AI tech champions, could start returning.
paras.zh: 随着围绕人工智能的情绪恶化，外国投资者可能会开始回归。近两年来，由于估值高、盈利增长低迷以及缺乏当地人工智能技术领军企业，外国投资者一直在印度市场减持。

paras.en: "If these foreign long only investor groups were to neutralize their underweight in Indian equities, this could translate into potential net inflows of around $115 billion," Rajiv Batra, head of Asia and co-head of global emerging markets equity strategy at JPMorgan, told CNBC.
paras.zh: 摩根大通亚洲主管兼全球新兴市场股票策略联席主管拉吉夫·巴特拉 (Rajiv Batra) 向 CNBC 表示：“如果这些只做多的外国投资者群体能够抵消其对印度股票的减持，这可能会转化为约 1150 亿美元的潜在净流入。”

paras.en: He said that multiple factors are currently stacked in favor of the country, such as falling global oil prices, a drop in U.S. Treasury yields, a recovery in earnings growth of Indian companies and unwinding of global AI trade.
paras.zh: 他表示，目前多种因素对印度有利，例如全球油价下跌、美国国债收益率下降、印度企业盈利增长复苏以及全球人工智能贸易放缓。

paras.en: "India has emerged as an 'AI hedge' for portfolios trimming or diversifying out of crowded AI trades," Batra said.
paras.zh: 巴特拉表示：“印度已成为‘人工智能对冲’，旨在削减投资组合或从拥挤的人工智能交易中实现多元化。”

paras.en: Over the last month, the country's benchmark Nifty 50 has gained nearly 9%, outperforming global markets with heavy AI exposure, including the U.S., Japan, South Korea and Taiwan that are deep in the red as investors ditch tech names.
paras.zh: 过去一个月，中国的基准 Nifty 50 指数上涨了近 9%，跑赢了人工智能投资较多的全球市场，其中包括美国、日本、韩国和台湾，这些市场因投资者抛弃科技公司而陷入严重亏损。

paras.en: On Friday, as major Asian markets tracked a sell-off on Wall Street overnight, India's benchmark indexes bucked the trend to trade higher. That divergence becomes stark as Japan's Nikkei 225 and Taiwan's Taiex entered bear territory, while South Korea's Kospi deepened its bear market and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite entered into correction territory overnight.
paras.zh: 周五，随着亚洲主要市场追随隔夜华尔街的抛售，印度基准指数逆势走高。随着日本日经 225 指数和台湾股市进入熊市，而韩国综合股价指数加深了熊市，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数隔夜进入调整区间，这种分歧变得更加明显。

paras.en: "India has been dubbed sort of the anti-AI trade, and our view there is that the underlying economic fundamentals have actually been better," Timothy Moe, chief Asia-Pacific equity strategist and co-head of Asia macro research at Goldman Sachs, told CNBC's "Squawk Box Asia" on Friday.
paras.zh: 高盛首席亚太股票​​策略师兼亚洲宏观研究联席主管蒂莫西·莫 (Timothy Moe) 周五对 CNBC 的“Squawk Box Asia”节目表示：“印度被称为某种反人工智能贸易，我们认为印度的经济基本面实际上更好。”

paras.en: He added that markets like India and Australia that were less exposed to the AI trade will see "some relative outperformance," adding that India's "domestic demand story" gives it an edge between the two.
paras.zh: 他补充说，印度和澳大利亚等受人工智能贸易影响较小的市场将出现“一些相对优异的表现”，并补充说印度的“国内需求故事”使其在两者之间具有优势。

paras.en: Unlike Korea and Taiwan, where indexes are heavily concentrated in AI hardware stocks, Indian benchmarks have little exposure to this segment and are instead focused on financial services, consumption, energy, industrials and other services companies.
paras.zh: 与韩国和台湾的指数主要集中在人工智能硬件股票不同，印度基准指数很少涉足这一领域，而是专注于金融服务、消费、能源、工业和其他服务公司。

paras.en: "India becomes an attractive alternative because of its size, liquidity and relatively lower dependence on the AI cycle," at a time when global investors want to cut exposure to AI-related stocks, Feroze Azeez, joint chief executive at Anand Rathi Wealth, told CNBC.
paras.zh: Anand Rathi Wealth 联合首席执行官费罗兹·阿齐兹 (Feroze Azeez) 向 CNBC 表示，“印度因其规模、流动性和对人工智能周期的依赖相对较低而成为一个有吸引力的选择”，而此时全球投资者希望减少对人工智能相关股票的投资。

paras.en: Foreign investors, which net sold more than $31 billion until October of this year, have turned net buyers over the past four days, investing over $2.3 billion, according to data from NSDL.
paras.zh: NSDL 的数据显示，截至今年 10 月，外国投资者净出售额超过 310 亿美元，在过去四天内已转变为净买家，投资额超过 23 亿美元。

paras.en: This wave of optimism around the Indian markets comes at a time when corporate earnings for the September quarter have shown material improvement.
paras.zh: 印度市场的这波乐观情绪出现之际，九月份季度的企业盈利已显示出实质性改善。

paras.en: As per data shared by JPMorgan, earnings growth of listed Indian companies is tracking at more than 20%, and consensus earnings per share estimates have been revised up 0.5% for 2026 and 0.6% for 2027 over the past month.
paras.zh: 根据摩根大通分享的数据，印度上市公司的盈利增长正在超过 20%，过去一个月，2026 年每股盈利预期上调了 0.5%，2027 年每股盈利预期上调了 0.6%。

paras.en: But despite a steep underperformance of Indian indexes over the last year — even for this year so far the key benchmarks are in the red — and the improvement in earnings growth, its valuations are still relatively higher than other emerging markets.
paras.zh: 但尽管去年印度指数表现严重不佳——即使今年到目前为止，主要基准指数仍处于亏损状态——而且盈利增长有所改善，但其估值仍相对高于其他新兴市场。

paras.en: Global brokerage Bernstein, however, disagrees that the South Asian country should be viewed as an AI hedge.
paras.zh: 然而，全球经纪公司伯恩斯坦不同意这个南亚国家应该被视为人工智能对冲。

paras.en: "India is increasingly being pitched as the hedge to the global AI trade. We disagree. India is neither an AI beneficiary nor an anti-AI trade," it said in a report on Monday, arguing that India's valuations remain expensive.
paras.zh: 它在周一的一份报告中表示：“印度越来越多地被宣传为全球人工智能贸易的对冲者。我们不同意。印度既不是人工智能的受益者，也不是反人工智能贸易的国家。”它认为印度的估值仍然昂贵。

paras.en: India is trading at a rolling 12-month forward price-to-earnings of 18.6 times, higher than China's 9.3x and Brazil's 7.9x, the report showed. It is also trading at a premium to AI-heavy markets like South Korea and Taiwan.
paras.zh: 报告显示，印度的 12 个月滚动远期市盈率为 18.6 倍，高于中国的 9.3 倍和巴西的 7.9 倍。它的交易价格也高于韩国和台湾等人工智能密集型市场。

paras.en: "There are easier and cheaper ways to hedge AI than investing in India," Saurabh Mukherjea, founder and chief investment officer of Marcellus Investment Managers, told CNBC. He added, though, that India's earnings growth has been "stellar" for the last two quarters and the valuation of some "quality large caps" is at a decade low.
paras.zh: Marcellus Investment Managers 创始人兼首席投资官 Saurabh Mukherjea 告诉 CNBC：“与投资印度相比，对冲人工智能有更简单、更便宜的方法。”不过他补充说，过去两个季度印度的盈利增长“非常出色”，一些“优质大盘股”的估值处于十年来的低位。

paras.en: India has always traded at a premium to the emerging markets of 1.4 times on average since 2007 due to its "durable earnings and a domestically driven growth engine," JPMorgan's Batra said.
paras.zh: 摩根大通的巴特拉表示，自2007年以来，由于其“稳定的盈利和国内驱动的增长引擎”，印度的交易价格始终高于新兴市场，平均溢价为1.4倍。

paras.en: The country's markets have struggled since late 2024 due to slowing earnings growth, but that has changed over the last two quarters.
paras.zh: 由于盈利增长放缓，该国市场自 2024 年底以来一直陷入困境，但这种情况在过去两个季度发生了变化。

paras.en: India's near-term appeal was diluted by "high crude, a weak rupee and the availability of high-growth opportunities elsewhere," Hari Shyamsunder, vice president and senior institutional portfolio manager of India equities at Templeton Global Investments, told CNBC.
paras.zh: Templeton Global Investments 印度股票副总裁兼高级机构投资组合经理 Hari Shyamsunder 向 CNBC 表示，印度的近期吸引力被“高原油价格、疲软的卢比以及其他地方的高增长机会”所削弱。

paras.en: He pointed out that Nifty now trades below its "10-year average forward P/E," while MSCI India, in October, was at its lowest forward multiple since 2020.
paras.zh: 他指出，Nifty 目前的交易价格低于其“10 年平均预期市盈率”，而 10 月份的 MSCI 印度指数则处于 2020 年以来的最低预期市盈率。

paras.en: "If crude softens sustainably and growth faces headwinds elsewhere, the picture could change quickly," he said, adding that foreign capital inflows would depend on sustained earnings growth over the next few quarters.
paras.zh: 他表示：“如果原油持续走软，而其他地区的增长面临阻力，情况可能会迅速改变。”他补充说，外国资本流入将取决于未来几个季度盈利的持续增长。

articles.title: Stock futures mixed after Nasdaq correction; Japan's Nikkei 225 enters bear market: Live updates

paras.en: Stock futures were mixed early Friday after a punishing sell-off in artificial intelligence stocks that sent the Nasdaq into correction territory. Traders also awaited a key payrolls report.
paras.zh: 周五早盘，人工智能股遭受惨重抛售，导致纳斯达克指数进入调整区间，股指期货涨跌互现。交易员还等待重要的就业报告。

paras.en: S&P 500 futures were little changed, while Nasdaq-100 futures added 1%. Futures tied to the Dow Jones Industrial Average shed 467 points, or 0.91%.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数期货几乎没有变化，而纳斯达克 100 指数期货则上涨 1%。道琼斯工业平均指数期货下跌 467 点，跌幅 0.91%。

paras.en: In Asia, South Korea led losses in the region, with the Kospi plunging more than 6%. Japan's Nikkei 225 dropped 5.9%, falling into bear market territory. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 slipped 0.9%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index fell 1%, and mainland China's CSI 300 declined 1.47%.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，韩国领跌该地区，Kospi 指数暴跌超过 6%。日本日经225指数下跌5.9%，跌入熊市区域。澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数下跌 0.9%。香港恒生指数下跌1%，中国大陆沪深300指数下跌1.47%。

paras.en: The moves follow a bout of heavy selling during Thursday's regular Wall Street session that saw the three major averages post their worst one-day performances since April 2025. The Nasdaq Composite tanked 5.5%, closing more than 10% below its most recent high and landing in correction territory. The broad-market S&P 500 lost 4.4%, while the Dow fell more than 1,800 points, or 3.4%.
paras.zh: 周四华尔街常规交易时段出现一轮大幅抛售，三大股指创下 2025 年 4 月以来最差单日表现。纳斯达克综合指数下跌 5.5%，收盘价较近期高点下跌逾 10%，并进入回调区域。标准普尔 500 指数大盘下跌 4.4%，道指下跌 1,800 多点，跌幅为 3.4%。

paras.en: While all 11 sectors of the S&P 500 closed with losses, shares of companies tied to the AI build-out suffered keenly. Democrats' big wins in the House and Senate, as well as key governorships in states like Texas, sparked traders' worries of a potential slowdown in data center construction.
paras.zh: 尽管标准普尔 500 指数的所有 11 个板块均收跌，但与人工智能发展相关的公司的股价却遭受了严重打击。民主党在众议院和参议院的重大胜利，以及德克萨斯州等关键州的州长职位，引发了交易员对数据中心建设可能放缓的担忧。

paras.en: Micron Technology and Advanced Micro Devices plummeted 17% each, while neocloud CoreWeave slid 10%. Even the Magnificent Seven weren't spared, as Nvidia dropped 9%, turning negative for 2026, and the cohort of tech juggernauts shed more than $1 trillion in aggregate market cap.
paras.zh: Micron Technology 和 Advanced Micro Devices 分别暴跌 17%，而 neocloud CoreWeave 则下跌 10%。就连七巨头也未能幸免，英伟达股价下跌 9%，2026 年转为负值，这群科技巨头的总市值缩水超过 1 万亿美元。

paras.en: The three major averages are poised for losses on the week, with the Nasdaq down 4.4% and the S&P 500 off almost 3% in the period. The 30-stock Dow is the relative outperformer of the three, off just 0.5% week to date.
paras.zh: 本周三大股指都将下跌，其中纳斯达克指数下跌 4.4%，标准普尔 500 指数下跌近 3%。道琼斯指数 30 只股票是三者中相对跑赢大盘的，本周迄今仅下跌 0.5%。

paras.en: The pullback creates a buying opportunity, Victoria Greene, CIO at G Squared Private Wealth told CNBC Thursday. "The AI trade, in my opinion, is not dead here," she said, adding, "it's a good discount." She's interested in memory stocks, citing how management teams throughout this earnings season have been talking about the capacity crunch. "Buying a volatile dip tends to be good as long as we're still in a non-recessionary period," she said.
paras.zh: G Squared Private Wealth 首席信息官维多利亚·格林 (Victoria Greene) 周四对 CNBC 表示，此次回调创造了买入机会。 “在我看来，人工智能行业并没有消亡，”她补充道，“这是一个很好的折扣。”她对内存股感兴趣，并引用了管理团队在整个财报季一直在谈论产能紧缩的情况。她表示：“只要我们仍处于非衰退期，逢低买入往往是件好事。”

paras.en: Another market catalyst awaits investors on Friday morning in the form of the October payrolls report. The Dow Jones consensus estimate is for 59,000 jobs added last month and for the unemployment rate to hold steady at 4.2%.
paras.zh: 周五上午，另一个市场催化剂正在等待投资者，那就是十月份的非农就业报告。道琼斯一致预测上个月新增就业岗位 59,000 个，失业率稳定在 4.2%。

paras.en: Correction: Victoria Greene is the CIO of G Squared Private Wealth. An earlier version misspelled her name.
paras.zh: 更正：维多利亚·格林 (Victoria Greene) 是 G Squared Private Wealth 的首席信息官。早期版本拼错了她的名字。

articles.title: The 'World's Best Airline' is updating its business and first-class experience

paras.en: Singapore Airlines is rolling out new onboard seating, dining and entertainment options as part of an over S$2 billion ($1.6 billion) investment to keep up with rivals from around the world.
paras.zh: 新加坡航空投资超过 20 亿新元（16 亿美元），推出新的机上座椅、餐饮和娱乐选项，以跟上世界各地的竞争对手的步伐。

paras.en: The cornerstone of this investment: new premium cabin seats for its long-haul flights, which will progressively debut on the Airbus A350 long-haul and ultra-long-range planes in mid-2027.
paras.zh: 这项投资的基石是：为长途航班提供新的高级客舱座椅，该座椅将于 2027 年中期逐步在空客 A350 长途和超远程飞机上首次亮相。

paras.en: First-class seats will come with 32-inch 4K high-definition screens, Bang and Olufsen noise-cancelling headphones and options for passengers to book double bed and face-to-face dining configurations.
paras.zh: 头等舱座椅将配备32英寸4K高清屏幕、Bang and Olufsen降噪耳机，并可供乘客预订双人床和面对面就餐配置。

paras.en: Seating in business class will come outfitted with 22-inch 4K screens, wireless charging and Bluetooth audio connectivity.
paras.zh: 商务舱座椅将配备 22 英寸 4K 屏幕、无线充电和蓝牙音频连接。

paras.en: These retrofits to the A350 aircraft also come as SIA grapples with a long-running delay to the delivery of new Boeing 777-9 planes, which were slated to come in 2021 and now faces an uncertain date as to when it will take delivery of the aircraft.
paras.zh: 对 A350 飞机进行这些改造之际，新航正在努力解决新波音 777-9 飞机交付长期延迟的问题，这些飞机原定于 2021 年交付，但目前接收飞机的日期尚不确定。

paras.en: These products will also debut with the 777-9 aircraft when they come into service with SIA.
paras.zh: 这些产品也将在新航投入运营的 777-9 飞机上首次亮相。

paras.en: Minor refreshes will be added to other classes, such as an extra inch of reclining space in premium economy cabins, and new upholstery in economy class. Both will also come with new 4K seatback entertainment monitors, but the new features for economy and premium economy seats will only be on the incoming 777-9 aircraft.
paras.zh: 其他舱位将进行小幅更新，例如高级经济舱增加一英寸的倾斜空间，以及经济舱的新内饰。两者都将配备新的 4K 座椅靠背娱乐显示器，但经济舱和高级经济舱座椅的新功能将仅出现在即将推出的 777-9 飞机上。

paras.en: Speaking at a media briefing on Nov 4, SIA Chief Commercial officer Lee Lik Hsin said that the decision to bring the products to the A350 was due to the delays with the 777-9.
paras.zh: 新航首席商务官 Lee Lik Hsin 在 11 月 4 日的媒体吹风会上表示，决定将这些产品引入 A350 是由于 777-9 的延误。

paras.en: Boeing had announced in its third quarter earnings results that it will not deliver the first 777-9 aircraft to customers until 2027. It is not known if SIA is a launch customer.
paras.zh: 波音公司在第三季度财报中宣布，要到 2027 年才会向客户交付第一架 777-9 飞机。目前尚不清楚新航是否是启动客户。

paras.en: When asked about the delivery timeline in its full year results briefing in May this year, SIA Chief Operating Officer Tan Kai Ping said that it was a "long-delayed program" and is not going to be in SIA's fleet in the current financial year ending March 2027.
paras.zh: 当在今年 5 月的全年业绩简报中被问及交付时间表时，新航首席运营官陈凯平表示，这是一个“长期拖延的计划”，在截至 2027 年 3 月的当前财政年度中不会出现在新航机队中。

paras.en: "Fingers crossed, it shows up in the next financial year," Tan said.
paras.zh: 谭说：“祈祷吧，它会在下一个财政年度显现出来。”

paras.en: The announcement comes as SIA was named the World's Best Airline for 2026 by Skytrax and took the World's Best Economy Class title. However, it lost out in the Business Class category to Middle Eastern carrier Qatar Airways and in the First Class category to Air France.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布之际，新航被 Skytrax 评为 2026 年全球最佳航空公司，并获得了全球最佳经济舱称号。然而，它在商务舱类别中输给了中东航空公司卡塔尔航空，在头等舱类别中输给了法国航空。

paras.en: Earlier this year, the airline had announced that it would introduce Starlink on almost all of its Airbus aircraft, except the A350 medium haul variant, starting from the first quarter of 2027. This would represent about half its current fleet.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，该航空公司宣布，从 2027 年第一季度开始，将在除 A350 中程机型之外的几乎所有空客飞机上引入 Starlink。这将占其现有机队的一半左右。

paras.en: In September, SIA also unveiled a new inflight dining experience, adding new menus and beverage offerings for all classes, as well as offering custom-designed Christofle serviceware for for its premium cabins.
paras.zh: 9 月，新航还推出了全新的机上餐饮体验，为所有舱位增加了新的菜单和饮料，并为其高级客舱提供定制设计的 Christofle 服务用品。

paras.en: New branded amenity kits were also announced for Business and First class travelers, Sisley in First and BYREDO in Business respectively. Sleepwear will also be available for Business Class passengers, a first for the airline.
paras.zh: 还推出了针对商务舱和头等舱旅客的新品牌洗漱用品套装，头等舱为希思黎 (Sisley)，商务舱为 BYREDO。商务舱乘客也可以穿睡衣，这对于该航空公司来说尚属首次。

paras.en: The changes also come alongside a separate S$130 million investment to renovate its Silverkris lounges and a "end to end" experience that begins at the curb at Singapore Changi Airport for Suites and First Class passengers, including concierge service priority immigration and security clearance, and a buggy transfer service.
paras.zh: 这些变化还包括单独投资 1.3 亿新元来翻新其 Silverkris 休息室，以及从新加坡樟宜机场路边开始为套房和头等舱乘客提供的“端到端”体验，包括礼宾服务、优先出入境和安全检查以及马车接送服务。

paras.en: — CNBC's Monica Pitrelli contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的莫妮卡·皮特雷利 (Monica Pitrelli) 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: NASA’s Swift telescope plunges back to Earth

paras.en: After more than two decades of observing some of the universe’s most powerful explosions, NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory has ended its mission with some fireworks of its own.
paras.zh: 经过二十多年对宇宙中一些最强大的爆炸的观察，美国宇航局的尼尔·格雷尔斯·斯威夫特天文台以自己的一些烟花结束了它的任务。

paras.en: The 3,200-pound (1.5-metric-ton) space telescope, which gathered data on gamma-ray bursts (GRBs), was projected to enter Earth’s atmosphere in the early-morning hours of November 4. Most of Swift should have burned up, although experts expected that a small fraction of its most durable components would survive the plunge and reach the planet’s surface. NASA officials estimated an approximately one-in-2,100 chance that Swift’s falling debris would harm anyone. The observatory’s fiery swan song leaves a hole in NASA’s space science fleet that is unlikely to be filled anytime soon.
paras.zh: 这台重 3,200 磅（1.5 公吨）的太空望远镜负责收集伽马射线暴 (GRB) 数据，预计将于 11 月 4 日凌晨进入地球大气层。雨燕号的大部分应该已经烧毁，尽管专家预计其最耐用部件的一小部分将在坠落中幸存下来并到达地球表面。 NASA 官员估计，Swift 坠落的碎片伤害任何人的可能性约为 2,100 分之一。天文台的绝唱给美国宇航局的太空科学舰队留下了一个缺口，而且不太可能很快被填补。

paras.en: Swift made its last observation on October 20, after which its orbit descended to just below 171 miles (275 kilometers) above Earth, making continued operations impossible.
paras.zh: 雨燕号于 10 月 20 日进行了最后一次观测，之后其轨道下降至距离地球略低于 171 英里（275 公里），无法继续运行。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Initially named for swifts, birds in the family Apodidae, because of its capability to swiftly slew in the heavens to focus on faraway GRBs, the observatory’s title was amended in 2018 to include the name of astrophysicist Neil Gehrels—who was the mission’s principal investigator—after he died in 2017.
paras.zh: 该天文台最初以雨燕（雨燕科的鸟类）命名，因为它能够在天空中迅速捕食，以聚焦遥远的伽马射线暴。天文台的名称于 2018 年进行了修改，加入了天体物理学家尼尔·格勒斯（Neil Gehrels）的名字，他是该任务的首席研究员，在他于 2017 年去世后。

paras.en: Swift was loaded with three instruments designed to pick up gamma rays, x-rays, and ultraviolet and optical wavelength light. Together, these tools offered astronomers extraordinary insights into GRBs—extremely luminous eruptions that occur in distant galaxies when massive stars explode or collide, sometimes leaving behind neutron stars or black holes.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特装载了三台仪器，旨在接收伽马射线、X射线、紫外线和可见光波长的光。这些工具共同为天文学家提供了对伽玛暴的非凡见解——当大质量恒星爆炸或碰撞时，遥远星系中会发生极其明亮的喷发，有时会留下中子星或黑洞。

paras.en: Since its launch in 2004, the observatory had been able to gather data on nearly 2,000 of these events. It also acted as an important sentinel for scientists, alerting astronomers within seconds of detecting incoming cosmic blasts so that terrestrial telescopes could follow-up with their own observations.
paras.zh: 自 2004 年启动以来，该观测站已经收集了近 2,000 起此类事件的数据。它还充当了科学家的重要哨兵，在检测到传入的宇宙爆炸后几秒钟内向天文学家发出警报，以便地面望远镜可以跟进自己的观测结果。

paras.en: While there are numerous other Earth and space-based observatories and telescopes, none currently in operation are able to compete with the Swift for capturing details of some of the most exciting events in distant space. That it was able to do so for over two decades, far longer than its initial mission length of two years, is a credit to both the technology aboard, and the hardworking astronomers and support staff who kept it running, says Jamie Kennea, the former lead of science operations for the observatory.
paras.zh: 尽管还有许多其他地球和太空天文台和望远镜，但目前正在运行的天文台和望远镜都无法与雨燕号竞争，捕捉遥远太空中一些最令人兴奋的事件的细节。该天文台前科学运营负责人杰米·肯尼表示，它能够坚持二十多年，远长于最初两年的任务期限，这要归功于船上的技术，以及辛勤工作的天文学家和支持人员，让其保持运行。

paras.en: “Throughout the mission the Swift team never rested on its laurels and reinvented the operations model yearly, keeping things fresh and, importantly, scientifically vital,” he says. “Swift was a one-of-a-kind mission that the community will hugely miss, and a huge testimony to the memory of Neil Gehrels, its original leader, who laid the foundations of this success by his sheer excitement about the new possibilities this little mission could explore.”
paras.zh: “在整个任务过程中，Swift 团队从未满足于现状，每年都会重新发明运营模式，保持新鲜感，更重要的是，具有科学意义，”他说。 “Swift 是一项独一无二的任务，社区将非常怀念，也是对其最初领导人 Neil Gehrels 记忆的巨大见证，他对这个小任务可以探索的新可能性感到非常兴奋，为这次成功奠定了基础。”

paras.en: Like all satellites in low-Earth orbit that aren’t actively maintaining altitude through engine firings or other measures, Swift was gradually falling to Earth, slowly losing speed as it dragged through our planet’s tenuous upper atmosphere. Starting some two years ago, high-energy particles from heavier-than-usual solar activity puffed up this part of Earth’s atmosphere, hastening Swift’s demise. NASA launched a last-ditch rescue mission to try and boost its orbit with another spacecraft, but that effort failed in July 2026 when the rescue craft suffered several malfunctions.
paras.zh: 与所有低地球轨道上的卫星一样，雨燕号也逐渐坠向地球，在穿过地球脆弱的高层大气时缓慢失去速度。从大约两年前开始，比平常更重的太阳活动产生的高能粒子使地球大气层的这一部分膨胀，加速了斯威夫特的消亡。 NASA 发起了最后一搏救援任务，试图用另一艘航天器提升其轨道，但这一努力于 2026 年 7 月失败，救援飞船遭遇多次故障。

paras.en: According to NASA’s projections, Swift’s reentry and resulting debris shower should’ve occurred in a broad swath stretching nearly 1,500 miles in latitude above and below the equator. That put much of South and Central America, as well as parts of Africa, Southeast Asia and Australia, in its potential path, but most of the spacecraft’s likely reentry profile was over remote stretches of open ocean.
paras.zh: 根据 NASA 的预测，雨燕的再入和由此产生的碎片簇射应该发生在赤道上下纬度近 1,500 英里的宽阔地带。这使得南美洲和中美洲的大部分地区，以及非洲、东南亚和澳大利亚的部分地区都处于其潜在路径中，但航天器可能的再入剖面大部分是在遥远的公海上空。

paras.en: The sparsity of suitable sensors in those regions likely contributed to the delayed confirmation of Swift’s demise, which was attributed to the U.S. Space Force on Wednesday afternoon. According to an X post by astrophysicist and space activity tracker Jonathan McDowell, Space Force tracking pinpointed the telescope’s reentry as occurring at 7:39 A.M. EST off the coast of northern Sumatra, an island in Indonesia.
paras.zh: 这些地区缺乏合适的传感器，这可能是导致斯威夫特沉没的延迟确认的原因，周三下午，美国太空军将其归咎于这一事件。根据天体物理学家和太空活动追踪者乔纳森·麦克道尔 (Jonathan McDowell) 的 X 帖子，太空部队追踪精确指出望远镜的再入发生在上午 7 点 39 分。 EST 位于印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛北部海岸附近。

paras.en: Editor’s Note (11/4/26): This story has been updated to include the reentry time and location of the Swift spacecraft.
paras.zh: 编者按（26 年 11 月 4 日）：本文已更新，包括雨燕号航天器的再入时间和位置。

articles.title: How George Clinton’s Mothership landed onstage in 1976

paras.en: Daniel Bedrosian was just a teenager when the world’s funkiest spaceship blew his mind.
paras.zh: 当丹尼尔·贝德罗西安（Daniel Bedrosian）还是个青少年时，世界上最时髦的太空飞船让他大吃一惊。

paras.en: It was the Boston-area stop of the 1997 Smokin’ Grooves tour, and the lineup had no shortage of stars: hip-hop group Cypress Hill, rapper Foxy Brown, singer Erykah Badu, and two young groups, Outkast and The Roots, that would soon become legends in their own right. But on this night, none of them could compete with George Clinton and the P-Funk All-Stars—or, more to the point, with Clinton’s ride.
paras.zh: 这是 1997 年 Smokin’ Grooves 巡回演唱会在波士顿地区的一站，阵容中不乏明星：嘻哈乐队 Cypress Hill、说唱歌手 Foxy Brown、歌手 Erykah Badu，以及​​两个年轻乐队 Outkast 和 The Roots，他们很快就成为了传奇。但在这个夜晚，他们中没有一个人可以与乔治·克林顿和 P-Funk 全明星队竞争，或者更重要的是，可以与克林顿的骑行竞争。

paras.en: In front of thousands of fans, a lit-up, smoke- and firework-spewing flying saucer known as the Mothership—a 1,500-pound aluminum-and-glass craft featuring a 241-pound landing ladder—descended onto the stage and out popped Clinton. The crowd went nuts.
paras.zh: 在数千名粉丝面前，一艘亮着灯、喷出烟雾和烟花的飞碟被称为“母舰”——这是一艘重 1,500 磅的铝和玻璃飞船，配有 241 磅的着陆梯——降落在舞台上，从克林顿身上跳了出来。人群疯狂了。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “It was surreal,” says Bedrosian, who years later would become P-Funk’s keyboard player and author of the book Make My Funk the P-Funk. “It was absolutely like nothing I had ever experienced before.”
paras.zh: “这太超现实了，”贝德罗西安说道，他多年后成为 P-Funk 的键盘手，也是《Make My Funk the P-Funk》一书的作者。 “这绝对是我以前从未经历过的。”

paras.en: October 27 marked the 50th anniversary of the Mothership’s first flight. Over that half century, the ship has risen from stage gimmick to cultural landmark, particularly in Black culture, and has earned a place in the Smithsonian’s National Museum of African American History and Culture (NMAAHC). It was also an audacious piece of engineering, arriving just as live music was beginning to look like the spectacle we now expect from arena headliners. Anyone who has gaped at the staging of a Taylor Swift, U2 or BTS concert has enjoyed the Mothership’s influence.
paras.zh: 10 月 27 日是母舰首飞 50 周年纪念日。半个世纪以来，这艘船已从舞台噱头上升为文化地标，特别是在黑人文化中，并在史密森国家非裔美国人历史和文化博物馆 (NMAAHC) 中赢得了一席之地。这也是一项大胆的工程，恰逢现场音乐开始看起来像我们现在期待的竞技场头条新闻那样。任何曾对泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift)、U2 或 BTS 演唱会的演出惊叹不已的人都感受到了 Mothership 的影响力。

paras.en: “My understanding of the business in those days was that they were just starting to experiment with bigger, better, more exciting effects across the board,” says William Gorlin, a regional practice leader in the entertainment division of the engineering firm McLaren, an Affiliate of KCI. “Bigger set pieces, larger audio, better lighting.”
paras.zh: “我当时对这个行业的理解是，他们才刚刚开始全面尝试更大、更好、更令人兴奋的效果，”KCI 旗下工程公司迈凯轮 (McLaren) 娱乐部门的区域实践负责人 William Gorlin 说道。 “更大的布景、更大的音频、更好的灯光。”

paras.en: Clinton had been performing since the late 1950s, but in the 1970s his career took off. By then he was leading two bands, Parliament and Funkadelic, known collectively as Parliament-Funkadelic, or P-Funk. Casablanca Records, Parliament’s label for much of the 1970s, was also home to the equally ostentatious KISS, and it gave Clinton the budget to put on the sci-fi shows playing in his head.
paras.zh: 克林顿从 20 世纪 50 年代末开始就开始表演，但在 20 世纪 70 年代他的事业开始腾飞。那时他领导着两个乐队：Parliament 和 Funkadelic，统称为Parliament-Funkadelic 或 P-Funk。卡萨布兰卡唱片公司（Casablanca Records）是 20 世纪 70 年代大部分时间的议会唱片公司，也是同样招摇的 KISS 的发源地，它为克林顿提供了播放他脑海中播放的科幻节目的预算。

paras.en: “The number one inspiration was Star Trek,” says P-Funk archivist and historian Tim Kinley. “You have African Americans being put in conceptual situations where white people wouldn’t normally see them. You have, for example, African Americans all through all facets of government on the [Parliament] album Chocolate City. You had African Americans in space because, at that time, you saw on Star Trek Lieutenant Uhura.”
paras.zh: “第一个灵感来自《星际迷航》，”P-Funk 档案管理员兼历史学家蒂姆·金利 (Tim Kinley) 说道。 “非裔美国人被置于白人通常看不到的概念情境中。例如，在[议会]专辑《巧克力城》中，非裔美国人经历了政府的各个方面。你在太空中有非裔美国人，因为当时你在《星际迷航》中看到了乌呼拉中尉。”

paras.en: The goal, says Kevin Strait, a curator at the NMAAHC, was to build a “vessel for the imagination” that could carry P-Funk’s “free your mind” ethos. The Mothership “offered audiences, particularly Black audiences, not only an epic visual spectacle but also a figurative means of transporting themselves beyond the hardships and constraints of everyday life,” he says.
paras.zh: NMAAHC 策展人凯文·斯特雷特 (Kevin Strait) 表示，我们的目标是建造一个“想象力的容器”，以承载 P-Funk“解放思想”的精神。他说，《母舰》“为观众，特别是黑人观众，不仅提供了史诗般的视觉奇观，而且提供了一种超越日常生活的艰辛和限制的象征性手段。”

paras.en: For the hardware, Clinton turned to two Tony Award–winning Broadway designers, Jules Fisher and Peter Larkin. With a production budget of around $275,000, equivalent to more than $1.5 million today, they created a roughly 20-foot-wide Mothership out of metal, plastic and glass. A much smaller model ship flew over the audience’s heads first, buying the crew time to ready the full-size Mothership for its landing.
paras.zh: 对于硬件，克林顿求助于两位托尼奖获奖百老汇设计师朱尔斯·费舍尔和彼得·拉金。他们的制作预算约为 275,000 美元（相当于今天的 150 万美元以上），用金属、塑料和玻璃打造了一艘约 20 英尺宽的母舰。一艘小得多的模型船首先飞过观众的头顶，为船员们争取了时间来准备全尺寸母舰的着陆。

paras.en: Keeping the ship flying night after night took around 100 roadies and stagehands, who had to disassemble it, load it up, haul it to the next city and reassemble it after every gig. “We’re talking about an army of tractor-trailers carrying various parts of the Mothership, as well as the other stage parts that went along with it,” Kinley says.
paras.zh: 为了让这艘船夜复一夜地飞行，大约需要 100 名乐队管理员和舞台工作人员，他们必须将其拆卸、装载、拖到下一个城市，并在每次演出结束后重新组装。 “我们谈论的是一支由牵引拖车组成的军队，运载着母舰的各个部件，以及与之配套的其他舞台部件，”金利说。

paras.en: The Mothership landed in dozens of venues, no two of them identical, and it had to work every time, whether it was descending from the roof of an arena in New York or one in Nebraska.
paras.zh: 母舰降落在数十个场馆，没有两个场馆是完全相同的，而且它每次都必须正常工作，无论是从纽约还是内布拉斯加州的一个竞技场的屋顶下降。

paras.en: The designers were also working with hardware that looks primitive by today’s standards.
paras.zh: 设计师们还使用了以今天的标准来看显得很原始的硬件。

paras.en: “Back in the day, most of the compact mechanical actuators”—the components that move stage machinery—“were hydraulic, and there was always fear of having hot oil over people,” Gorlin says. Today, he adds, electric linear actuators are opening up new possibilities for equipment that can hang over a crowd.
paras.zh: “过去，大多数紧凑型机械执行器”（移动舞台机械的组件）“都是液压的，人们总是担心热油会溅到人身上，”戈尔林说。他补充道，如今，电动直线推杆为可悬挂在人群上方的设备开辟了新的可能性。

paras.en: There was no rule book, either. Modern productions must follow standardized safety codes, but in the 1970s, Gorlin says, there was “minimal regulation, if any, for touring sets,” whether the people at risk were onstage or in the audience. The ship never suffered a major mishap, but it did pick up some precautions along the way. After its first outing, Clinton got a handrail to hold onto because the crowd’s reaction had nearly knocked him off the platform. And the designers made the “smoke” with dry ice, frozen carbon dioxide, to ensure the band could still breathe as the ship came down.
paras.zh: 也没有规则手册。现代制作必须遵循标准化的安全规范，但戈尔林表示，在 20 世纪 70 年代，无论处于危险之中的人是在舞台上还是在观众席中，“对于巡演现场的监管（如果有的话）也很少”。这艘船从未遭遇过重大事故，但一路上确实采取了一些预防措施。第一次亮相后，克林顿抓住了一个扶手，因为人群的反应几乎把他从讲台上撞了下来。设计师们用干冰、冷冻二氧化碳制造“烟雾”，以确保乐队在船沉没时仍然可以呼吸。

paras.en: The original Mothership stayed on the road until 1981, then went into retirement and, eventually, a junkyard. When P-Funk’s popularity surged again in the 1990s, a replica brought back the landing, including at the show that blew Bedrosian’s mind. That ship later sat in storage at Clinton’s recording studio in Florida before making its final landing at the Smithsonian, where it’s on display today.
paras.zh: 最初的“母舰”一直在路上行驶，直到 1981 年，然后退役，最终沦为垃圾场。当 P-Funk 的受欢迎程度在 20 世纪 90 年代再次飙升时，一款复制品让 P-Funk 重新流行起来，包括在令 Bedrosian 震惊的演出中。这艘船后来被存放在克林顿位于佛罗里达州的录音室，最后降落在史密森尼博物馆，今天它就在那里展出。

paras.en: The image of a white-suited Clinton popping out of the Mothership, outrageous in his appearance and his music, and in his vision of a future that was kinder to his people than the past had ever been, has outlived the original ship by more than four decades. It’s a legacy that “extends well beyond the world of funk,” Strait says. “It helped demonstrate that a live musical performance could be an immersive experience, bringing together sound, visual design and storytelling.”
paras.zh: 身着白色西装的克林顿从母舰中跳出来，他的外表和音乐令人震惊，他对未来对他的人民比过去更加友善的愿景已经比原来的母舰存在了四十多年。斯特雷特说，这是一项“远远超出放克世界”的遗产。 “它有助于证明现场音乐表演可以是一种身临其境的体验，将声音、视觉设计和故事讲述结合在一起。”

paras.en: P-Funk still tours, and this year it has a new ride: a third Mothership, which made its debut in July at the Essence Festival of Culture in New Orleans. To prepare, Bedrosian and several bandmates joined Clinton at the Nashville warehouse where the new ship was kept, to rehearse the landing.
paras.zh: P-Funk 仍在巡回演出，今年它有了一个新的设施：第三艘 Mothership，于 7 月在新奥尔良的 Essence 文化节上首次亮相。为了做好准备，贝德罗西安和几位乐队成员与克林顿一起来到停放新船的纳什维尔仓库，排练着陆。

paras.en: “It’s all still very much a practical mothership,” Bedrosian says, meaning a real, physical machine. “As far as I can tell, it requires most of the same type of rigor” to land the ship as it did in the old days. It’s still a trip watching it descend all these years later—and now he has one of the best seats in the house.
paras.zh: “这仍然是一艘非常实用的母舰，”贝德罗西安说，他指的是一台真正的物理机器。 “据我所知，这需要与过去一样严格的要求”才能使船舶着陆。这么多年过去了，看着它下降仍然是一次旅行——现在他拥有了房子里最好的座位之一。

articles.title: Ancient humans used cannabis in burial rituals 2,800 years ago

paras.en: Whether you’re eating, smoking or drinking it, cannabis is commonplace; in the U.S., more people use it on a daily or near-daily basis than any other intoxicating substance, including alcohol or cigarettes. But how far back does humanity’s relationship with cannabis stretch?
paras.zh: 无论你是吃、吸还是喝，大麻都很常见。在美国，每天或几乎每天使用它的人比任何其他致醉物质（包括酒精或香烟）都要多。但人类与大麻的关系可以追溯到多久之前呢？

paras.en: In new research, archaeologists have dated the earliest known human use of cannabis to 2,800 years ago. The drug was likely used in a burial ritual at a tomb discovered in what is now Siberia. The archaeologists found direct evidence of its use, gathered from a combination of seeds and human hair—together these provide new insights into ancient societies and their cultural legacies’ potential influence on our world today, experts say.
paras.zh: 在新的研究中，考古学家将已知人类最早使用大麻的日期追溯到 2800 年前。这种药物很可能用于在现在西伯利亚发现的一座坟墓的埋葬仪式中。专家表示，考古学家从种子和人类头发的组合中发现了其使用的直接证据，这些证据共同为了解古代社会及其文化遗产对当今世界的潜在影响提供了新的见解。

paras.en: “There is a lot of speculation about the use of psychoactive substances in the past,” says Gino Caspari, the paper’s lead author and an archaeologist at the Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology in Jena, Germany. “It is extremely rare to find real evidence for it. We bring a bit of realism into these debates, and we show that cannabis has a deep cultural history which might factor into ongoing societal discourse on legalization and medical use.”
paras.zh: “关于过去使用精神活性物质的情况有很多猜测，”该论文的主要作者、德国耶拿马克斯·普朗克地球人类学研究所的考古学家吉诺·卡斯帕里（Gino Caspari）说。 “找到真正的证据是极其罕见的。我们在这些辩论中引入了一些现实主义，我们表明大麻具有深厚的文化历史，这可能会影响正在进行的关于合法化和医疗用途的社会讨论。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Caspari’s team excavated Tunnug 1, a burial mound used by the Scythian people in southern Siberia that dates to between the eighth and ninth centuries B.C.E. While studying the tombs, the archaeologists found more than 1,000 cannabis seeds. Radiocarbon analysis dated them back to the early eighth century B.C.E.
paras.zh: 卡斯帕里 (Caspari) 的团队挖掘了图努格 1 号 (Tunnug 1)，这是西伯利亚南部斯基泰人使用的墓葬，其历史可以追溯到公元前八世纪到公元前九世纪之间。在研究坟墓时，考古学家发现了 1000 多颗大麻种子。放射性碳分析将它们追溯到公元前八世纪初。

paras.en: The real breakthrough, though, was in the human hair recovered from the burial sites, Caspari says. It contained cannabinol, a chemical produced from tetrahydrocannabinol, or THC—the compound that makes cannabis psychoactive.
paras.zh: 卡斯帕里说，真正的突破在于从墓地中发现的人类头发。它含有大麻酚，这是一种由四氢大麻酚或 THC（使大麻具有精神活性的化合物）产生的化学物质。

paras.en: “We had our suspicions when the little seeds first appeared in the tomb, but when we spotted the netlike pattern on the surface, this was a real moment when we knew we were holding something very special in our hands,” he says. “A little later we saw that there was also preserved human hair in the same burial—that was almost too good to be true.”
paras.zh: “当这些小种子第一次出现在坟墓中时，我们曾有过怀疑，但当我们发现表面上的网状图案时，这是一个真正的时刻，我们知道我们手中拿着的是非常特别的东西，”他说。 “不久之后，我们发现在同一个墓葬中还保存有人类的头发——这简直难以置信。”

paras.en: Researchers already knew that humans have a long history with cannabis. People have been cultivating the plant for agricultural reasons for at least 6,000 years. Until now, the earliest evidence of cannabis use dated to around 2,500 years ago: charred marijuana remains found in eastern China that contained high levels of THC. That evidence, however, was indirect because it only showed the plant remains—whereas the newly found combination of seeds and human hair offers a “smoking gun of evidence” for humans using the plant to get high, says Casper Meyer, an archaeologist at Bard College, who was not involved in the new study.
paras.zh: 研究人员已经知道人类使用大麻有着悠久的历史。人们出于农业原因种植这种植物已有至少 6,000 年的历史。到目前为止，大麻使用的最早证据可以追溯到大约 2,500 年前：在中国东部发现的烧焦的大麻中含有高含量的 THC。然而，这一证据是间接的，因为它只显示了植物的残留物，而新发现的种子和人类头发的组合为人类利用这种植物来获得兴奋提供了“确凿的证据”，巴德学院的考古学家卡斯珀·迈耶（Casper Meyer）说，他没有参与这项新研究。

paras.en: Meyer says that the finding challenges our modern assumptions of religion, drugs and the intersection of the two.
paras.zh: 迈耶说，这一发现挑战了我们对宗教、毒品以及两者交叉点的现代假设。

paras.en: “It’s an interesting way of looking at what ritual can be, what religion can be, and how it can bring people together,” he says. “There’s also a rethinking of what intoxication in a communal context is.”
paras.zh: “这是一种有趣的方式来看待什么是仪式，什么是宗教，以及它如何将人们聚集在一起，”他说。 “人们还重新思考什么是公共环境下的中毒。”

paras.en: Because the Scythian culture had no written language, researchers must rely on sites such as Tunnug 1 for clues to the people’s empire, which spanned from as early as the ninth century B.C.E. to as late as the third century C.E. and across the Asian continent.
paras.zh: 由于斯基泰文化没有书面语言，研究人员必须依靠像 Tunnug 1 这样的遗址来寻找有关这个人民帝国的线索，这个帝国的历史可以追溯到公元前九世纪。迟至公元三世纪并遍及亚洲大陆。

paras.en: As archaeologists continue to uncover the site, there will certainly be more plants that reveal secrets of these steppe societies, says William Taylor, an archaeologist at the University of Colorado Boulder, who was also not involved in the new work.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校的考古学家威廉·泰勒（William Taylor）也没有参与这项新工作，他说，随着考古学家继续发掘该地点，肯定会有更多植物揭示这些草原社会的秘密。

paras.en: “It’s easy to look at this stuff and say, ‘Oh, the Scythians toked the reefer,’” Taylor jokes. “But in fact, it is a tremendously powerful snapshot into an interconnected world in which the people and cultures of the steppe were starting to shape life on both ends of a massive continent.”
paras.zh: “看到这些东西很容易说，‘哦，斯基泰人拿走了冷藏箱，’”泰勒开玩笑说。 “但事实上，这是一个非常有力的快照，展示了一个相互联系的世界，在这个世界中，草原上的人民和文化开始塑造这片广阔大陆两端的生活。”

paras.en: Cannabis can often carry stigma or exist on the outskirts of research, Taylor says, but the new evidence, published today in Science, “fills this really important gap in our understanding of human history.”
paras.zh: 泰勒说，大麻常常带有耻辱，或者存在于研究的边缘，但今天发表在《科学》杂志上的新证据“填补了我们对人类历史理解的这一非常重要的空白。”

articles.title: This Halloween, amateur astronomers may be in for a dwarf planet treat
articles.author: Lisa Grossman

paras.en: The outer solar system is yielding its secrets to the Vera C. Rubin Observatory.
paras.zh: 外太阳系正在向维拉·C·鲁宾天文台透露其秘密。

paras.en: Less than five months into the observatory’s decade-long survey of the sky, a potential new dwarf planet has already popped up in its data, astronomers reported this week at a meeting of the American Astronomical Society’s Division of Planetary Sciences in Spokane, Wash.
paras.zh: 天文学家本周在华盛顿州斯波坎举行的美国天文学会行星科学部会议上报告说，天文台对天空进行了长达十年的调查不到五个月，一颗潜在的新矮行星已经出现在其数据中。

paras.en: Another team reported a handful of new Neptune Trojans, icy objects that share an orbit with Neptune, at the meeting and in the Astrophysical Journal Letters. The findings are filling in astronomers’ picture of the Kuiper Belt at the solar system’s frigid fringes.
paras.zh: 另一个团队在会议上和《天体物理学杂志快报》上报告了一些新的海王星特洛伊木马，它们是与海王星共享轨道的冰冷物体。这些发现填补了天文学家对太阳系寒冷边缘柯伊伯带的想象。

paras.en: “It feels a little bit like we’re replicating the 1800s and early 1900s, discovering what the solar system even looks like in general,” says Sam Deen, an amateur astronomer based in Simi Valley, Calif. “We’re finding out what there even is in the first place that makes up most of the Kuiper Belt.”
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州西米谷的业余天文学家萨姆·迪恩 (Sam Deen) 表示：“感觉有点像我们正在复制 1800 年代和 1900 年代初期，探索太阳系的总体面貌。我们正在寻找构成柯伊伯带大部分区域的物质。”

paras.en: A possible dwarf planet hid in historical data
paras.zh: 历史数据中隐藏着一颗可能的矮行星

paras.en: Perched on a mountaintop in Chile, the Vera Rubin Observatory is on a mission to map the entire southern sky every couple of nights, searching for faint and fast-moving cosmic objects. The observatory took its first images in June 2025 and officially began a decade-long survey in June 2026.
paras.zh: 维拉鲁宾天文台坐落在智利的山顶上，其任务是每隔几个晚上绘制整个南部天空的地图，寻找微弱且快速移动的宇宙物体。该天文台于 2025 年 6 月拍摄了第一张图像，并于 2026 年 6 月正式开始为期十年的调查。

paras.en: Even before the official survey started, Rubin had detected the motion of an object orbiting billions of kilometers beyond Pluto. Rubin observed the object 30 times on 20 nights from March 4 to July 11. But no one knew it was there until October 13, when astrophysicist Matt Holman of the Smithsonian Astronomical Observatory in Cambridge, Mass., ran a search for moving dots of light in the data.
paras.zh: 甚至在官方调查开始之前，鲁宾就探测到了一个绕冥王星数十亿公里运行的物体的运动。从3月4日到7月11日，鲁宾在20个晚上观察了这个物体30次。但直到10月13日，马萨诸塞州剑桥史密森天文台的天体物理学家马特·霍尔曼在数据中寻找移动的光点时，才有人知道它在那里。

paras.en: The object, called 2026 ED138, appeared to be about 47 times as far from Earth as Earth is from the sun. Its brightness suggests it’s between 600 and 1,500 kilometers wide, potentially as large as other dwarf planets like Ceres and Makemake. That’s probably big enough to be spherical, making it a dwarf planet.
paras.zh: 这个被称为 2026 ED138 的天体距离地球的距离似乎是地球距离太阳距离的 47 倍。它的亮度表明它的宽度在 600 到 1,500 公里之间，可能与谷神星和鸟神星等其他矮行星一样大。它可能足够大，成为球形，使其成为一颗矮行星。

paras.en: “It’s really big. It’s damn huge,” Deen says. “No matter what you call it, it’s still the biggest thing we’ve found in the entire solar system in 19 years.”
paras.zh: “它真的很大。真是太大了，”迪恩说。 “不管你怎么称呼它，它仍然是 19 年来我们在整个太阳系中发现的最大的东西。”

paras.en: When Holman realized what he had found, he was thrilled but doubtful. “It’s quite an exciting thing,” Holman said in a news briefing at the meeting on October 27. “But one of the things that you need to do when you discover something potentially of this size is to try to verify that it’s true.”
paras.zh: 当霍尔曼意识到他的发现时，他很兴奋，但也很怀疑。 “这是一件非常令人兴奋的事情，”霍尔曼在 10 月 27 日的会议新闻发布会上说。“但是，当你发现这种规模的潜在东西时，你需要做的事情之一就是尝试验证它的真实性。”

paras.en: Holman and colleagues were able to find observations of the same object in archived data from the Dark Energy Camera, located on an adjacent mountaintop in Chile, taken in 2016.
paras.zh: 霍尔曼和同事能够在 2016 年拍摄的位于智利邻近山顶的暗能量相机的存档数据中找到对同一物体的观察结果。

paras.en: Deen was able to trace it back even farther, to photographic plates taken as part of a sky survey at Palomar Observatory in California in 1954. Other amateur astronomers independently found the same sightings.
paras.zh: 迪恩能够追溯到更远的地方，追溯到 1954 年在加利福尼亚州帕洛玛天文台进行天空调查时拍摄的照片底片。其他业余天文学家独立发现了相同的目击事件。

paras.en: “They took an image from Palomar in 1954, and another about half an hour after the first one, that both by pure chance happen to point at where ED138 is,” Deen says. “And it’s really obvious. If you know it’s supposed to be there, it’s not particularly faint.”
paras.zh: “他们于 1954 年在帕洛玛拍摄了一张照片，在第一张照片拍摄后大约半小时又拍摄了一张照片，这两张照片都纯属偶然地指向了 ED138 所在的位置，”迪恩说。 “而且它真的很明显。如果你知道它应该在那里，它就不会特别微弱。”

paras.en: So why didn’t anybody notice it until now? It’s partly because ED138 practically crawls across the sky, orbiting the sun once every 280 years. It was also moving against a dense background of Milky Way stars, where it blended in.
paras.zh: 那么为什么直到现在还没有人注意到它呢？部分原因是 ED138 几乎在天空中爬行，每 280 年绕太阳一周。它也在密集的银河系恒星背景下移动，并融入其中。

paras.en: By combining observations spanning decades, astronomers can calculate the object’s orbit with more precision.
paras.zh: 通过结合数十年的观测结果，天文学家可以更精确地计算该物体的轨道。

paras.en: Deen is hoping to observe the potential new dwarf planet pass in front of a distant star on Halloween. That sort of observation, called an occultation, can help reveal more details of the putative dwarf planet’s size and shape, and even whether it has moons or rings. Usually, it takes years to understand an object’s orbit well enough to predict an occultation, Deen says. “Getting to do it immediately is like being a kid in a candy shop, really.”
paras.zh: 迪恩希望在万圣节观察到潜在的新矮行星从一颗遥远的恒星前面经过。这种被称为掩星的观察可以帮助揭示假定的矮行星的大小和形状的更多细节，甚至它是否有卫星或环。迪恩说，通常需要数年时间才能充分了解物体的轨道以预测掩星。 “立即开始做这件事就像是一个在糖果店里的孩子，真的。”

paras.en: Icy objects could offer clues to solar system beginnings
paras.zh: 冰冷的物体可以为太阳系的起源提供线索

paras.en: A crop of newly spotted Neptune Trojans were masked by the Milky Way, too. These asteroids gather in the same orbit as Neptune, but offset from the planet at 60 degrees. Astronomers think they were some of the original building blocks of the solar system and contain an ancient record of planetary formation and evolution.
paras.zh: 一批新发现的海王星特洛伊人也被银河系掩盖了。这些小行星聚集在与海王星相同的轨道上，但与海王星的偏移角度为 60 度。天文学家认为它们是太阳系的一些原始组成部分，并且包含行星形成和演化的古老记录。

paras.en: Other planets have Trojans, too. Jupiter has thousands. Astronomers think Neptune has many more, but so far they have seen only 30 in the cluster of space objects that orbit ahead of Neptune, and just two in the cluster behind it.
paras.zh: 其他行星也有特洛伊人。木星有数千个。天文学家认为海王星还有更多，但到目前为止，他们在海王星前面的空间物体星团中只看到了 30 个，而在海王星后面的星团中只看到了 2 个。

paras.en: “We would expect these [groups of Trojans] to be symmetric in numbers, so you have to get more than two,” planetary scientist Meg Schwamb said in a news conference at the meeting on October 28.
paras.zh: “我们预计这些[特洛伊木马群]在数量上是对称的，因此必须有两个以上，”行星科学家梅格·施万布 (Meg Schwamb) 在 10 月 28 日会议的新闻发布会上说道。

paras.en: The trailing cloud happened to have been moving in front of the Milky Way from the perspective of Earth for the last 15 years. Spotting individual Trojans against that crowded background was “like finding a needle in a sequined dress,” said Schwamb, of Queens University Belfast in Northern Ireland.
paras.zh: 在过去的 15 年里，从地球的角度来看，尾随云恰好一直在银河系前面移动。北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特女王大学的施万布说，在拥挤的背景下发现单个特洛伊木马“就像在亮片连衣裙中找到一根针”。

paras.en: Schwamb and colleagues examined Vera Rubin data taken from the commissioning phase — the period when engineers were testing the telescope. In this early data haul, the team found two more trailing Trojans, plus one candidate. They seem to be similar in composition to the leading ones, which matches theories of how the solar system formed.
paras.zh: 施万布和同事检查了维拉·鲁宾在调试阶段（工程师测试望远镜的时期）获取的数据。在早期的数据采集中，团队发现了另外两个跟踪特洛伊木马，以及一个候选木马。它们的组成似乎与主要的类似，这与太阳系形成的理论相匹配。

paras.en: “It just kind of got lucky,” Schwamb said. “These objects photobombed the commissioning survey.”
paras.zh: “这只是运气好，”施万布说。 “这些物体对委托调查进行了照片轰炸。”

paras.en: “This is really the appetizer for what Rubin Observatory is going to do in its mission for the next ten years,” she added. “There’s hundreds more of these objects likely to be found.”
paras.zh: “这确实是鲁宾天文台未来十年使命的开胃菜，”她补充道。 “可能还会发现数百个这样的物体。”

paras.en: Some of the excitement about these discoveries is dampened by fears of losing observations to bright satellites crisscrossing the telescope’s field of view, says astronomer Sam Lawler of the University of Regina in Canada.
paras.zh: 加拿大里贾纳大学的天文学家萨姆·劳勒说，这些发现的一些兴奋感因担心观测结果被穿过望远镜视场的明亮卫星而减弱。

paras.en: “I have to put in the constant downer of how the increasing numbers of satellites will make these discoveries harder,” Lawler says. “There are one hundred new satellites launching every week, and they keep getting bigger and brighter. These discoveries will be hindered by that.”
paras.zh: “我必须不断地沮丧，因为卫星数量的增加将使这些发现变得更加困难，”劳勒说。 “每周都有一百颗新卫星发射，而且它们变得越来越大、越来越亮。这些发现将因此受到阻碍。”

paras.en: But even with the satellites, Lawler anticipates many more cool discoveries from Rubin.
paras.zh: 但即使有了卫星，劳勒预计鲁宾还会有更多酷的发现。

paras.en: “Just finding a dwarf planet so quickly, maybe we’ll find something even bigger,” she says. “There could be something the size of Mars out there. And then we’d have the whole planet debate all over again. It would be fun.”
paras.zh: “这么快就找到了一颗矮行星，也许我们会发现更大的东西，”她说。 “那里可能有火星大小的东西。然后我们会再次进行整个星球的辩论。这会很有趣。”

articles.title: How hawkmoths turned their genitals into bat-busting weapons
articles.author: Elie Dolgin

paras.en: When a bat closes in, some hawkmoths fight back with their genitalia. By rasping specialized scales on their sex organs against structures on their abdomens, the moths unleash bursts of ultrasound that can scramble the sonar a hungry bat uses to lock onto prey.
paras.zh: 当蝙蝠逼近时，一些天蛾会用生殖器进行反击。通过用它们的性器官上的特殊鳞片摩擦腹部的结构，飞蛾释放出超声波脉冲，可以扰乱饥饿的蝙蝠用来锁定猎物的声纳。

paras.en: But this acoustic counterattack is no evolutionary one-off. Relentless pressure from predators has pushed these otherwise tasty insects to reinvent this defensive tactic up to seven times throughout their evolution, with separate lineages arriving at distinct anatomical solutions to the same threat, researchers report November 4 in the Proceedings of the Royal Society B.
paras.zh: 但这种声学反击并不是进化上的一次性事件。研究人员 11 月 4 日在《英国皇家学会学报 B》上报告称，来自捕食者的无情压力迫使这些原本美味的昆虫在其整个进化过程中重新发明了这种防御策略多达七次，不同的谱系针对同一威胁得出了不同的解剖学解决方案。

paras.en: The findings suggest that the high-frequency acoustic skirmishes playing out overhead each night, beyond the range of human hearing, may be far more varied than scientists realized.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，每天晚上在头顶上空发生的超出人类听觉范围的高频声学冲突可能比科学家们意识到的要多样化得多。

paras.en: “Clearly the hawkmoths as a whole have more tricks up their sleeve,” says Marc Holderied, a sensory biologist and bioacoustics researcher at the University of Bristol in England who was not involved in the study.
paras.zh: “显然，天蛾作为一个整体还有更多的伎俩，”英国布里斯托大学的感觉生物学家和生物声学研究员马克·霍尔德里德（Marc Holderied）说，他没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: The discovery builds on more than a decade of research by sensory ecologist Jesse Barber, now at the American Museum of Natural History in New York City, and entomologist Akito Kawahara of the Florida Museum of Natural History in Gainesville. Those scientists’ earlier work showed that moths across multiple families, from tiger moths and fruit-piercing moths to geometer moths and jewel caterpillar moths, produce ultrasound in response to bat attacks. Other insects, including some beetles and fireflies, do too.
paras.zh: 这一发现建立在纽约市美国自然历史博物馆的感官生态学家杰西·巴伯和盖恩斯维尔佛罗里达自然历史博物馆的昆虫学家川原明人十多年的研究基础上。这些科学家的早期工作表明，多个科的飞蛾，从虎蛾、穿果蛾到几何蛾和宝石毛虫蛾，都会产生超声波来应对蝙蝠的攻击。其他昆虫，包括一些甲虫和萤火虫，也会这样做。

paras.en: But among the most striking defenders are hawkmoths, a family of some 1,600 mostly nocturnal, torpedo-shaped speedsters, also known as sphinx moths, that hover at flowers like hummingbirds. Many fend off bats by scraping their genitalia like a fingernail dragged along a comb, producing ultrasonic clicks that can disrupt the predators’ sonar.
paras.zh: 但最引人注目的防御者是鹰蛾，这个家族约有 1,600 只，大多是夜间活动的鱼雷形飞蛾，也称为狮身人面像飞蛾，它们像蜂鸟一样盘旋在花朵上。许多蝙蝠通过刮擦蝙蝠的生殖器来抵御蝙蝠，就像用指甲沿着梳子拖动一样，产生超声波咔哒声，扰乱捕食者的声纳。

paras.en: The anatomical diversity of these sound-producing systems, however, and how they evolved remained poorly understood.
