articles.title: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers

paras.en: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers
paras.zh: 叙利亚无证儿童为战争和禁止母亲的法律“付出了代价”

paras.en: Many children born in Syria since the war began in 2011 have no legal identity because nationality passes only through fathers – many of whom are dead or missing – a member of the independent UN commission investigating rights violations in the country said on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 负责调查该国侵犯人权行为的联合国独立委员会的一名成员周三表示，自 2011 年战争爆发以来，许多在叙利亚出生的儿童没有合法身份，因为国籍只能通过父亲传递——其中许多人已经死亡或失踪。

paras.en: “A child born in the war did not choose the war, did not choose the enforced disappearance of their father, did not choose their mother’s unregistered marriage...Yet they alone pay the price – in education, in health, in nationality and in dignity,” said Monia Ammar, one of the commissioners on the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on Syria.
paras.zh: “在战争中出生的孩子没有选择战争，没有选择父亲的强迫失踪，没有选择母亲未登记的婚姻……然而，他们独自付出了代价——教育、健康、国籍和尊严，”叙利亚问题独立国际调查委员会委员之一莫妮娅·阿马尔说。

paras.en: Ms. Ammar was speaking at a high-level panel in Geneva, co-hosted with the Syrian Government, as the Commission released a new policy paper on the issue.
paras.zh: 阿马尔女士在日内瓦与叙利亚政府共同主办的高级别小组会议上发表讲话，委员会就此问题发布了一份新的政策文件。

paras.en: She called the lack of documents “among the most serious consequences of the legacy of the conflict”.
paras.zh: 她称缺乏文件是“冲突遗留下来的最严重后果之一”。

paras.en: Syria’s social affairs minister told the same meeting that a reform letting mothers pass on nationality is nearing approval.
paras.zh: 叙利亚社会事务部长在同一次会议上表示，允许母亲继承国籍的改革即将获得批准。

paras.en: The problem is especially acute because an estimated 12 out of every 13 people killed in the war were men.
paras.zh: 这个问题尤其严重，因为据估计，在战争中丧生的每 13 人中就有 12 人是男性。

paras.en: Under Syria’s 1969 nationality law, when the father is absent “the child finds themselves in a legal vacuum”, Ms. Ammar said.
paras.zh: 阿马尔女士说，根据叙利亚 1969 年的国籍法，当父亲缺席时，“孩子就会发现自己处于法律真空”。

paras.en: She described the law as gender-based discrimination that is “doubled for girls”. It is also at odds with Syria’s obligations under the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women.
paras.zh: 她将该法律描述为基于性别的歧视，“对女孩来说是双重歧视”。这也违背了叙利亚根据《消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》承担的义务。

paras.en: The Commission has no precise figures on how many children are affected, she said. But it has heard from widows and mothers “who carry their children in their arms and do not have a single piece of paper proving that these children legally exist”.
paras.zh: 她说，委员会没有关于有多少儿童受到影响的确切数字。但它从寡妇和母亲那里听说，“她们怀里抱着孩子，却没有一张纸证明这些孩子合法存在”。

paras.en: They face “a wall of procedures” and social stigma, and many end up giving up.
paras.zh: 他们面临着“程序之墙”和社会耻辱，许多人最终放弃了。

paras.en: Ms. Ammar welcomed the steps the authorities have taken since the fall of the former regime. But she warned that “legal reforms, however important, are not enough on their own” without changes in practice and culture.
paras.zh: 阿马尔女士对前政权倒台后当局采取的措施表示欢迎。但她警告说，如果不改变实践和文化，“法律改革无论多么重要，光靠法律改革是不够的”。

paras.en: The paper calls for every child to be registered whatever the circumstances of their birth, alternative documents to be accepted and nationality granted to children of Syrian mothers.
paras.zh: 该文件呼吁对每个孩子进行登记，无论其出生情况如何，接受替代文件并给予叙利亚母亲的孩子国籍。

paras.en: Syria’s Minister of Social Affairs and Labour, Hind Kabawat, told the story of Maryam, a mother from Dara’a.
paras.zh: 叙利亚社会事务和劳工部长欣德·卡巴瓦特讲述了来自德拉的母亲玛丽亚姆的故事。

paras.en: Maryam was left alone and displaced with two young children after losing her husband in the war. Her marriage had been conducted locally and his death was never officially recorded.
paras.zh: 在战争中失去丈夫后，玛丽亚姆独自一人，带着两个年幼的孩子流离失所。她的婚姻是在当地举行的，他的死亡从未被正式记录。

paras.en: “Under our outdated laws, she cannot pass her Syrian nationality to her children, so in the eyes of the State they became invisible,” the minister said.
paras.zh: “根据我们过时的法律，她无法将叙利亚国籍传给她的孩子，因此在国家眼中他们变得隐形，”部长说。

paras.en: Desperate families sometimes register children under relatives’ names, including maternal uncles, just to get them into school or medical care. Ms. Kabawat said these families deserve support rather than punishment.
paras.zh: 绝望的家庭有时会把孩子登记在亲戚的名下，包括叔叔的名字，只是为了让他们上学或接受医疗。卡巴瓦特女士说，这些家庭应该得到支持而不是惩罚。

paras.en: She called for a legal grace period so they can put the records right.
paras.zh: 她呼吁给予法律宽限期，以便他们能够纠正记录。

paras.en: The proposal now at the approval stage would allow mothers to pass on nationality under certain conditions, “so that no child is punished or left stateless simply because their father is missing, dead or foreign”.
paras.zh: 目前处于批准阶段的提案将允许母亲在一定条件下继承国籍，“这样，孩子就不会因为父亲失踪、死亡或外国人而受到惩罚或成为无国籍人”。

paras.en: Ms. Kabawat stressed that children of ISIL (or Da’esh) fighters should not be held responsible for their fathers’ choices. She repeated the call for countries of origin to take some responsibility for child welfare.
paras.zh: 卡巴瓦特女士强调，“伊斯兰国”（或“达伊沙”）武装分子的子女不应为其父亲的选择负责。她再次呼吁原籍国对儿童福利承担一些责任。

paras.en: Her Government’s aim, she said, is that “Maryam from Dara’a will never again have to wonder whether her children truly belong to the country they were born in.”
paras.zh: 她说，她的政府的目标是“来自德拉的玛丽亚姆再也不用怀疑她的孩子是否真正属于他们出生的国家。”

articles.title: Abyei: Deadly drone strikes mark ‘new and concerning’ threat, UN peacekeeping chief warns

paras.en: Abyei: Deadly drone strikes mark ‘new and concerning’ threat, UN peacekeeping chief warns
paras.zh: 阿卜耶伊：联合国维和部队负责人警告说，致命的无人机袭击标志着“新的、令人担忧的”威胁

paras.en: Drone strikes that killed at least 30 people in Abyei last month have added “a new and concerning dimension” to security in the disputed area, the UN’s peacekeeping chief told the Security Council on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国维和事务负责人周四向安理会表示，上个月在阿卜耶伊发动的无人机袭击造成至少 30 人死亡，这给该争议地区的安全带来了“新的、令人担忧的层面”。

paras.en: Jean-Pierre Lacroix said the 19 October attacks were the first of their kind in Abyei. They set off major fires, injured about 59 people and forced dozens of civilians from their homes. Peacekeepers are still checking whether the death toll is an underestimate.
paras.zh: 让-皮埃尔·拉克鲁瓦 (Jean-Pierre Lacroix) 表示，10 月 19 日发生的袭击是阿卜耶伊首次发生此类袭击。他们引发大火，造成约 59 人受伤，并迫使数十名平民离开家园。维和人员仍在检查死亡人数是否被低估。

paras.en: The strikes followed violence on 15 September in and around Amiet Common Market, where clashes involving members of the Ngok Dinka, Misseriya and Nuba communities left 124 people dead and 40 injured.
paras.zh: 此次罢工是在 9 月 15 日阿米特共同市场及其周边发生暴力事件之后发生的，恩哥克-丁卡族、米塞里亚族和努巴族社区成员之间发生冲突，造成 124 人死亡、40 人受伤。

paras.en: Taken together, Mr. Lacroix said, the incidents show that threats to stability in Abyei “are evolving, extending beyond traditional intercommunal dynamics and are increasingly influenced by wider political and economic regional conflicts”.
paras.zh: 拉克鲁瓦先生说，总的来说，这些事件表明，阿卜耶伊的稳定面临的威胁“正在演变，超出了传统的族群间动态，并越来越受到更广泛的政治和经济区域冲突的影响”。

paras.en: Amiet is now much more than a trading post. It is Abyei’s main economic hub and a transit point for more than 49,000 refugees and returnees who have fled the war in Sudan. Mr. Lacroix warned that this concentration of trade and people was opening the door to criminal networks and armed groups.
paras.zh: 阿米特现在不仅仅是一个贸易站。它是阿卜耶伊的主要经济中心，也是 49,000 多名逃离苏丹战争的难民和回返者的中转站。拉克鲁瓦警告说，贸易和人员的集中正在为犯罪网络和武装团体打开大门。

paras.en: He also pointed to real gains. Recorded security incidents fell by about 32 per cent compared with the same period last year, and this year’s seasonal cattle migration passed without a single related death.
paras.zh: 他还指出了实际收益。与去年同期相比，记录的安全事件减少了约32%，今年的季节性牛群迁徙没有发生一起相关死亡事件。

paras.en: Sudan and South Sudan resumed formal talks in August through their Joint Political and Security Mechanism, for the first time since January 2023. A second meeting is due in Khartoum from 8 to 10 November.
paras.zh: 苏丹和南苏丹于 8 月通过联合政治与安全机制恢复了正式会谈，这是自 2023 年 1 月以来的首次。第二次会议将于 11 月 8 日至 10 日在喀土穆举行。

paras.en: But the reported appointment by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) of its own representative to the Abyei Joint Oversight Committee risks setting up competing claims of authority and drawing the area further into Sudan’s conflict, he said.
paras.zh: 但他表示，据报道，准军事快速支援部队（RSF）在阿卜耶伊联合监督委员会任命了自己的代表，这可能会引发相互竞争的权力主张，并使该地区进一步陷入苏丹冲突。

paras.en: As the council weighs the future mandate of the UN Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA), Mr. Lacroix said the conditions for any major change to the mission’s set-up “do not yet exist”. He called for stronger protection for peacekeepers against aerial threats.
paras.zh: 在安理会权衡联合国阿卜耶伊临时安全部队（联阿安全部队）的未来任务时，拉克鲁瓦先生表示，对该特派团的设置进行任何重大改变的条件“尚不存在”。他呼吁加强保护维和人员免受空中威胁。

paras.en: “UNISFA needs the Council’s support now more than ever,” he said.
paras.zh: “联阿安全部队现在比以往任何时候都更需要安理会的支持，”他说。

paras.en: The Secretary-General’s Special Envoy for the Horn of Africa, Guang Cong, called the October drone strikes one of the deadliest incidents in Abyei’s history. He urged a prompt and independent investigation and called on both governments to uphold the area’s demilitarized status.
paras.zh: 秘书长非洲之角特使丛光称十月份的无人机袭击是阿卜耶伊历史上最致命的事件之一。他敦促立即进行独立调查，并呼吁两国政府维持该地区的非军事地位。

paras.en: In Sudan, Humanitarian Coordinator Denise Brown warned again that drone strikes are hitting power stations and fuel facilities. Where fuel is scarce, she said, lifesaving aid work is being badly affected.
paras.zh: 在苏丹，人道主义协调员丹尼斯·布朗再次警告说，无人机袭击正在袭击发电站和燃料设施。她说，在燃料短缺的地方，救生援助工作就会受到严重影响。

paras.en: According to local sources, drones struck an electricity transmission station and the Ar Rusayris Dam in Ed Damazine on Tuesday, causing widespread blackouts.
paras.zh: 据当地消息人士称，周二，无人机袭击了埃德达马辛的一个输电站和 Ar Rusayris 大坝，导致大范围停电。

paras.en: Another strike on a residential area killed two civilians. The same day, airstrikes in Um Bader killed two women, injured 10 people and badly damaged two water stations.
paras.zh: 另一次对住宅区的袭击造成两名平民死亡。同一天，乌姆巴德的空袭造成两名妇女死亡、十人受伤，两个水站严重受损。

paras.en: Aid is still getting through. The UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) has delivered malaria treatment to 765 health facilities across Darfur and West Kordofan, enough for 800,000 people. But with the year nearly over, the $2.9 billion humanitarian appeal for Sudan is less than half funded.
paras.zh: 援助仍在进行中。联合国儿童基金会 (UNICEF) 已向达尔富尔和西科尔多凡州的 765 个医疗机构提供疟疾治疗，足以满足 80 万人的需要。但随着这一年即将结束，为苏丹筹集的 29 亿美元人道主义援助资金还不到一半。

paras.en: On the Sudan–South Sudan border, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) warned that about 100,000 people could lose healthcare if the only clinic at the Wunthou crossing closes. It could shut by December without urgent funding.
paras.zh: 在苏丹和南苏丹边境，国际移民组织 (IOM) 警告称，如果文图过境点唯一的诊所关闭，大约 10 万人可能会失去医疗服务。如果没有紧急资金，它可能会在 12 月关闭。

paras.en: The clinic has carried out more than 400,000 consultations, given over 260,000 vaccinations and helped deliver more than 1,000 babies. It still sees more than 1,000 outpatients every week.
paras.zh: 该诊所已开展了超过40万次咨询，接种了超过26万次疫苗，并帮助接生了超过1000名婴儿。每周门诊量仍超过1000人次。

articles.title: World News in Brief: Korea tensions mount, UN demands answers over staff death in Yemen, Guterres in Spain, Nepal alert ahead of COP31

paras.en: World News in Brief: Korea tensions mount, UN demands answers over staff death in Yemen, Guterres in Spain, Nepal alert ahead of COP31
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：韩国紧张局势升级、联合国要求就也门工作人员死亡、西班牙古特雷斯、尼泊尔在 COP31 之前发出警报作出答复

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres remains concerned over the situation on the Korean Peninsula, including the potential escalation of tensions across the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), his Spokesperson said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯的发言人周四表示，他仍然对朝鲜半岛局势感到担忧，包括非军事区（DMZ）紧张局势可能升级。

paras.en: The Secretary-General encouraged the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) and neighbouring Republic of Korea – more commonly known as North and South Korea – to resume communication channels, including on the military-to-military level, to avoid unintended accidents or miscalculations, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric told journalists in New York.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克在纽约对记者表示，秘书长鼓励朝鲜民主主义人民共和国（朝鲜）和邻国大韩民国（通常称为朝鲜和韩国）恢复沟通渠道，包括军事层面的沟通渠道，以避免意外事故或误判。

paras.en: “Diplomatic engagement and renewed dialogue remain the only pathway to reduce tensions and to achieve sustainable peace on the Korean Peninsula,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“外交接触和重新对话仍然是缓解朝鲜半岛紧张局势和实现可持续和平的唯一途径。”

paras.en: Yemen: UN calls for investigation into staffer’s death
paras.zh: 也门：联合国呼吁对工作人员死亡事件进行调查

paras.en: The circumstances surrounding the death of UN staff member Mohammad el Shami, who was arbitrarily detained by the Houthi de facto authorities in Yemen, “raise serious concerns about possible ill-treatment”, the UN said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国周四表示，被也门胡塞事实上的当局任意拘留的联合国工作人员穆罕默德·沙米的死亡情况“引起了人们对可能遭受虐待的严重担忧”。

paras.en: Theses include the Houthis’ prolonged failure to disclose reliable information about his fate and well-being, Mr. Dujarric said.
paras.zh: 杜贾里克先生说，这些问题包括胡塞武装长期以来未能透露有关他的命运和福祉的可靠信息。

paras.en: He called for a prompt, independent, impartial and transparent investigation into the exact time, cause and circumstances of Mr. el Shami’s death.
paras.zh: 他呼吁对沙米先生死亡的确切时间、原因和情况进行迅速、独立、公正和透明的调查。

paras.en: It should cover the conditions of his detention, whether he received adequate and timely medical care, and why his family and the UN were not promptly informed, Mr. Dujarric continued.
paras.zh: 杜哈里克先生继续说，其中应涵盖他的拘留条件、他是否得到充分和及时的医疗护理，以及为什么他的家人和联合国没有得到及时通知。

paras.en: Those responsible must be identified and held to account, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，必须查明责任人并追究其责任。

paras.en: Mr. el Shami is the second UN colleague to die while arbitrarily detained by Houthi forces, raising grave concerns for all other UN and humanitarian personnel held in similar conditions – particularly those with serious medical conditions.
paras.zh: 沙米先生是第二位在胡塞武装任意拘留期间死亡的联合国同事，这引起了所有其他处于类似条件下的联合国和人道主义人员的严重关切，特别是那些患有严重疾病的人员。

paras.en: The UN called on Houthi leadership to provide verifiable information on all detainees’ whereabouts and health, and to release all arbitrarily detained UN personnel immediately and unconditionally.
paras.zh: 联合国呼吁胡塞领导人提供有关所有被拘留者下落和健康状况的可核实信息，并立即无条件释放所有被任意拘留的联合国人员。

paras.en: Meanwhile, nearly 135,000 people are now displaced within Taiz, more than 40 per cent of all those recently uprooted across Yemen.
paras.zh: 与此同时，塔伊兹境内目前有近 135,000 人流离失所，占也门最近背井离乡人数的 40% 以上。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) delivered four trucks of essential medical supplies, including surgical kits, to hospitals in the encircled city.
paras.zh: 周三，红十字国际委员会向被包围城市的医院运送了四卡车的基本医疗用品，其中包括手术包。

paras.en: The World Food Programme (WFP) and its partners launched an emergency meals initiative using locally sourced ingredients, initially aiming to reach 2,000 vulnerable families across three districts.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 及其合作伙伴发起了一项使用当地食材的紧急膳食计划，最初旨在为三个地区的 2,000 个弱势家庭提供帮助。

paras.en: Shelter partners have so far provided emergency shelter to about 5,600 displaced families, just over one in ten of the more than 51,000 families displaced since August.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，庇护所合作伙伴已为约 5,600 个流离失所家庭提供了紧急庇护所，仅占 8 月份以来超过 51,000 个流离失所家庭的十分之一。

paras.en: Guterres warns of AI shaped by ‘a handful of companies’
paras.zh: 古特雷斯警告人工智能由“少数公司”塑造

paras.en: Addressing the 30th Ibero-American Summit in Madrid on Thursday, Mr. Guterres called for artificial intelligence “that speaks with all our voices – without a handful of companies deciding what we see, read and believe.”
paras.zh: 古特雷斯周四在马德里举行的第 30 届伊比利亚美洲峰会上发表讲话，呼吁人工智能“代表我们所有人的声音——而不是由少数公司决定我们所看到的、读到的和相信的内容。”

paras.en: “The more capable machines become, the more we will need what makes us human,” he said, urging more arts and humanities in education to cultivate critical thinking.
paras.zh: 他说：“机器的能力越强，我们就越需要人类的本质。”他敦促教育中更多的艺术和人文学科来培养批判性思维。

paras.en: The summit brings together the Spanish and Portuguese-speaking countries of Latin America and Europe, and was first held in Guadalajara, Mexico, 35 years ago.
paras.zh: 该峰会汇集了拉丁美洲和欧洲的西班牙语和葡萄牙语国家，35年前首次在墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉举行。

paras.en: “Ibero-America is not a military or economic superpower, but it is a cultural superpower,” the Secretary-General said.
paras.zh: “伊比利亚美洲不是军事或经济超级大国，但它是文化超级大国，”秘书长说。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres hosted the summit in Porto 28 years ago, and used this year’s address to bid farewell, thanking leaders for their friendship and support during his 10-year term.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生28年前在波尔图主办峰会，并在今年的致辞中告别，感谢各国领导人在他10年任期内的友谊和支持。

paras.en: Nepal floods: UN urges global support ahead of COP31
paras.zh: 尼泊尔洪水：联合国在 COP31 之前敦促全球支持

paras.en: Nepal needs international solidarity to recover from catastrophic floods that struck 10 weeks ago, the top UN official in the country said on Thursday, ahead of the COP31 climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye.
paras.zh: 周四，在土耳其安塔利亚举行的 COP31 气候会议之前，尼泊尔驻尼泊尔高级官员表示，尼泊尔需要国际团结来从 10 周前发生的灾难性洪水中恢复过来。

paras.en: On 26 August, a glacier collapsed on the border with China’s Tibet Autonomous Region. UN Resident Coordinator Lila Pieters Yahia described the “awful wall of water, mud and heavy rock” which tore through 150 kilometres of Himalayan valleys.
paras.zh: 8月26日，中国西藏自治区边境的一座冰川崩塌。联合国驻地协调员莉拉·皮特斯·叶海亚 (Lila Pieters Yahia) 描述了“可怕的水、泥和重石墙”，它撕裂了 150 公里的喜马拉雅山谷。

paras.en: More than 1,450 people were killed, nearly 5,000 remain missing and over 84,000 were affected. Homes, schools, power grids and 115 bridges were damaged.
paras.zh: 超过 1,450 人死亡，近 5,000 人失踪，超过 84,000 人受到影响。房屋、学校、电网和 115 座桥梁遭到破坏。

paras.en: The World Bank puts the damage at $2.7 billion, and recovery will cost an estimated $4.7 billion. The authorities say the $21.5 million Nepal expects from the loss and damage fund falls far short.
paras.zh: 世界银行估计损失为 27 亿美元，恢复成本估计为 47 亿美元。当局表示，尼泊尔期望从损失和损害基金中获得的 2150 万美元远远低于预期。

paras.en: Ms. Pieters Yahia said many women who lost their husbands now support whole households, often while facing heavy debt.
paras.zh: 彼得斯·叶海亚女士表示，许多失去丈夫的女性现在要养活整个家庭，但往往还面临沉重的债务。

paras.en: Nepal and Bhutan want the needs of mountainous countries put on the COP31 agenda.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔和不丹希望将山区国家的需求列入 COP31 议程。

articles.title: Hearts bruised by Thun in self-inflicted Conference League defeat

paras.en: FC Thun vs Hearts; UEFA Conference League
paras.zh: 图恩FC vs 红心队；欧洲足联会议联赛

paras.en: FC Thun vs Hearts. UEFA Conference League.
paras.zh: 图恩队 vs 红心队。欧洲足联会议联赛。

paras.en: Thun 3-1 Hearts: Wouter Vrancken's side bruised by self-inflicted Conference League defeat
paras.zh: 图恩 3-1 哈茨：沃特·弗兰肯的球队因自己造成的分区联赛失利而受伤

paras.en: Report as Hearts lose 3-1 to Thun in the Conference League; Jamie McCart's own goal was the first of the errors; Stephen Kingsley gifted another; Stuart Findlay scored a late consolation; the Jambos have one point from their opening three games
paras.zh: 报道称哈茨队在分区联赛中以 3-1 输给图恩队；杰米·麦卡特的乌龙球是第一个失误；史蒂芬·金斯利（Stephen Kingsley）赠送了另一件礼物；斯图尔特·芬德利 (Stuart Findlay) 在最后时刻取得了安慰； Jambos 在前三场比赛中只得一分

paras.en: Depleted Hearts' Conference League bruising was almost totally self-inflicted in a 3-1 defeat by Thun in Switzerland.
paras.zh: 耗尽之心队在瑞士联赛中1-3输给图恩队的比赛中几乎完全是自己造成的。

paras.en: Belgian boss Wouter Vrancken was without 10 players through various ailments and the Scottish team were dealt another blow in the 22nd minute when defender Jamie McCart put through his own goal in calamitous fashion.
paras.zh: 比利时主帅沃特·弗兰肯因各种疾病缺席了10名球员，苏格兰队在第22分钟再次受到打击，后卫杰米·麦卡特以灾难性的方式射入乌龙球。

paras.en: Thun doubled their lead in the 33rd minute through striker Brighton Labeau after more poor defending, this time from skipper Stephen Kingsley - who went off later with an injury - and then Furkan Dursun grabbed a third in the 56th minute before Jambos defender Stuart Findlay reduced the deficit in the 82nd minute with a header.
paras.zh: 图恩在第 33 分钟通过前锋布莱顿·拉博 (Brighton Labeau) 在防守更加糟糕后将领先优势扩大了一倍，这次是队长斯蒂芬·金斯利 (Stephen Kingsley) - 后来他因伤下场 - 然后富尔坎·杜尔森 (Furkan Dursun) 在第 56 分钟获得第三个进球，随后詹博队后卫斯图尔特·芬德利 (Stuart Findlay) 在第 82 分钟用头球缩小了比分差距。

paras.en: - Conference League fixtures and results
paras.zh: - 会议联赛赛程和结果

paras.en: - Watch FREE Scottish Prem highlights | Latest Scottish Prem news | Latest scores
paras.zh: - 免费观看苏格兰Prem 精彩集锦|最新的苏格兰Prem新闻|最新成绩

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream the Scottish Prem with no contract
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新的天空体育交易或无合同的苏格兰Prem直播

paras.en: Hearts are left with one Conference League point out of nine following a 1-1 home draw against Nordsjaelland and a 2-0 defeat away to Trabzonspor.
paras.zh: 在主场 1-1 战平北西兰、客场 2-0 输给特拉布宗体育后，红心队在联赛联赛中仅积 1 分（满分 9 分）。

paras.en: Thick smoke from a pyro halted the game soon after kick-off but when play resumed after a lengthy delay - there were nine minutes added on at the end of the first half - Hearts winger Josh McPake drew a save from Niklas Steffen with an angled drive that lacked real power.
paras.zh: 开球后不久，烟火冒出的浓烟使比赛暂停，但当比赛在长时间的延误后重新开始时——上半场结束时还剩九分钟——红心队边锋乔什·麦克帕克(Josh McPake)以一记缺乏真正力量的角度射门被尼克拉斯·史蒂芬(Niklas Steffen)扑出。

paras.en: In the 20th minute McPake's effort from 25 yards after he had drifted in from the left had the power but was beaten away by the Thun 'keeper.
paras.zh: 第20分钟，麦克帕克从左侧飘入后25码处射门，但被图恩门将挡出。

paras.en: There appeared to be nothing untoward on the horizon but then came a Hearts horror show.
paras.zh: 地平线上似乎没有什么不愉快的事情，但随后出现了红心恐怖秀。

paras.en: There was no real pressure on the Jambos goal when a long ball came into the box but with Lucien Dahler at his shoulder, a simple pass back from McCart somehow evaded Hearts 'keeper Beau Reus and slipped into the corner of the net.
paras.zh: 当长传球进入禁区时，詹博斯的球门并没有受到真正的压力，但卢西恩·达勒在他的肩膀上，麦卡特的一个简单的回传不知何故避开了哈茨队的门将博·雷乌斯并滑入网角。

paras.en: Thun's second goal was also gift-wrapped.
paras.zh: 图恩的第二个进球也被视为礼物。

paras.en: The home side broke clear and with pace following a Heart set-piece and when Nils Reichmuth crossed into the box from the right, Kingsley stuck out a leg to clear but the ball went straight to Labeau who swept it into the net from 10 yards out.
paras.zh: 主队在红心定位球后迅速破门，当尼尔斯·赖希穆斯(Nils Reichmuth)从右侧传入禁区时，金斯利伸出一条腿解围，但皮球直接传给了拉博(Labeau)，拉博在10码外将球扫入网内。

paras.en: Dursun was shown a yellow card for a forearm challenge into the face of Findlay, and it perhaps deserved more punishment.
paras.zh: 杜尔松因前臂对抗芬德利而被出示黄牌，也许应该受到更多惩罚。

paras.en: The interval gave the Tynecastle side time to reset but, three minutes after the break, Reus made a diving save from Dursun and an even better one from Reichmuth moments later.
paras.zh: 中场休息给了泰恩卡斯尔队重新调整的时间，但中场休息后三分钟，罗伊斯扑出了杜尔松的一次鱼跃扑救，随后赖希穆特又做出了一次更好的扑救。

paras.en: However, the 'keeper was beaten once again when Dursun got his toe to a Reichmuth cross.
paras.zh: 然而，当杜尔松用脚尖碰到赖希穆特的传中时，守门员再次被击败。

paras.en: On the hour mark, Nico Maier raced clear of the Hearts defence but although his chip beat Reus, it sped wide of the target.
paras.zh: 比赛进行到一小时时，尼科·迈尔突破了红心队的防守，但尽管他的射门击败了罗伊斯，但还是偏离了目标。

paras.en: The night got worse for the rattled visitors as injured Kingsley was replaced by 19-year-old Matthew Gillies, called back from a loan spell at Stenhousemuir.
paras.zh: 对于惊慌失措的客队来说，这个夜晚变得更糟，受伤的金斯利被 19 岁的马修·吉利斯取代，他从斯滕豪斯缪尔租借回来。

paras.en: Malachi Fagan-Walcott's header from a Jordi Altena free-kick was brilliantly saved by Steffen.
paras.zh: 马拉奇·法根-沃尔科特接到约尔迪·阿尔特纳的任意球头球攻门，被斯特芬精彩扑出。

paras.en: In the 78th minute Jan Bamert had the ball in the net after Steffen tipped a free-kick from substitute Nassim Zoukit on to the bar but was ruled offside, before Findlay headed in a consolation from another Altena free-kick.
paras.zh: 第78分钟，斯特芬将替补纳西姆·祖基特的任意球踢到横梁上，扬·巴默特将球射入网内，但被判越位，随后芬德利从阿尔特纳的另一个任意球中头球安慰。

paras.en: Vrancken demands unity as Hearts seek to bounce back
paras.zh: 弗兰肯要求团结，红心队寻求反弹

paras.en: "We have to stick together now. We know which situation we're in with all the circumstances.
paras.zh: “我们现在必须团结在一起。我们知道在所有情况下我们所处的情况。

paras.en: "And there's only one thing that you have to do now and that is stick together and keep working hard.
paras.zh: “你现在要做的只有一件事，那就是团结一致，继续努力。

paras.en: "In general, it was not good enough in quality and can you blame them?
paras.zh: “总的来说，它的质量不够好，你能责怪他们吗？

paras.en: "Yeah, on one hand you can because you want to always expect the best and want the best.
paras.zh: “是的，一方面你可以，因为你总是希望得到最好的并且想要最好的。

paras.en: "On the other hand, I'm still proud of what they did already in the run-up games."
paras.zh: “另一方面，我仍然为他们在助跑比赛中所做的事情感到自豪。”

paras.en: Women's TGL golf explained - how does WTGL work? Format, teams, schedule, scoring and how to watch live on Sky Sports

paras.en: Five teams of LPGA Tour stars feature in the inaugural WTGL season, including Solheim Cup stars Charley Hull and Lottie Woad; all matches played at a custom-built indoor venue; watch every match exclusively live on Sky Sports Golf
paras.zh: 五支由 LPGA 巡回赛明星组成的球队将参加首届 WTGL 赛季，其中包括索尔海姆杯明星查理·赫尔 (Charley Hull) 和洛蒂·沃德 (Lottie Woad)；所有比赛均在定制的室内场地进行；独家观看天空体育高尔夫直播的每场比赛

paras.en: What is the WTGL, how does the format work and which players are involved? We take a closer look at what to expect ahead of the inaugural women's TGL season, live on Sky Sports…
paras.zh: 什么是 WTGL，其赛制如何运作以及涉及哪些选手？我们在天空体育直播中仔细研究了首届女子 TGL 赛季之前的预期……

paras.en: The WTGL follows on from the success of the Tomorrow's Golf League (TGL), founded by Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy's TMRW Sports, in partnership with the PGA Tour.
paras.zh: WTGL 是继泰格·伍兹 (Tiger Woods) 和罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 的 TMRW Sports 与 PGA 巡回赛合作创办的明天高尔夫联盟 (TGL) 的成功之后的又一赛事。

paras.en: The women's edition of the tech-infused golf league will see LPGA Tour stars feature in a unique team format, with five teams (representing five different cities) of five-player rosters confirmed for the inaugural season.
paras.zh: 在充满科技的女子高尔夫联赛中，LPGA 巡回赛明星将以独特的球队形式亮相，首个赛季将确定五支球队（代表五个不同城市）的五名球员名单。

paras.en: - Women's TGL: Line-ups confirmed for inaugural season
paras.zh: - 女子 TGL：首赛季阵容已确定

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract

paras.en: - What golf is live on Sky Sports and when? Full TV listings
paras.zh: - 天空体育直播哪些高尔夫比赛以及何时直播？完整电视节目表

paras.en: The season-long competition takes place across November and December at the SoFi Center in Florida, a purpose-built indoor venue, with every shot live and all the players mic'd up for the made-for-TV format.
paras.zh: 整个赛季的比赛于 11 月和 12 月在佛罗里达州的 SoFi 中心举行，这是一个专门建造的室内场地，每一个镜头都是现场直播，所有选手都配有麦克风以适应电视格式。

paras.en: Both the 2026 and 2027 editions of WTGL will be broadcast exclusively on Sky Sports as part of an expansion of its golf rights, which also includes a further two years of TGL presented by SoFi.
paras.zh: 作为扩大其高尔夫转播权的一部分，2026 年和 2027 年的 WTGL 都将在天空体育独家转播，其中还包括由 SoFi 提供的另外两年的 TGL。

paras.en: Every match will be exclusively live on Sky Sports Golf, Sky Sports+ or Sky Sports Mix, while repeats will be available the following day on Sky Sports Golf. You can also download the Sky Sports App for news, highlights, scores and reports.
paras.zh: 每场比赛都将在天空体育高尔夫、天空体育+或天空体育混合上独家直播，而次日将在天空体育高尔夫上重复播放。您还可以下载天空体育应用程序以获取新闻、亮点、比分和报告。

paras.en: Around 1,500 spectators will be able to fit around TGL's field of play - which is nearly 100 yards long and 50 yards wide, with matches a hybrid of virtual and real-time golf.
paras.zh: TGL 的球场长近 100 码，宽 50 码，可容纳约 1,500 名观众，比赛采用虚拟和实时高尔夫相结合的方式进行。

paras.en: Specially created holes start in the virtual world, with players hitting into a giant 64 x 53ft simulator that is powered by Full Swing, although shots are played from areas with real grass, fairway, rough and sand.
paras.zh: 专门创建的球洞从虚拟世界开始，玩家击球进入一个由 Full Swing 驱动的巨大 64 x 53 英尺模拟器，尽管击球是在有真实草地、球道、长草区和沙地的区域进行的。

paras.en: Shots from inside 50 yards are from a custom-built short game area inside the SoFi Center, with the 'GreenZone' having a 41-yard turntable that can rotate the green and change angles of the shots required.
paras.zh: 50 码内的击球是在 SoFi 中心内定制的短杆区进行的，“GreenZone”有一个 41 码的转盘，可以旋转果岭并改变所需的击球角度。

paras.en: Teams play 15 holes of golf each match, divided into two sessions, with nine holes of triples - three against three playing alternate shot - and six holes of head-to-head singles golf.
paras.zh: 各队每场比赛打 15 洞高尔夫球，分为两节，其中包括 9 洞三人赛（三对三交替击球）和 6 洞面对面的单打高尔夫球。

paras.en: In the singles format, each of the three players involved in a team play two matches each. Each hole in both sessions is worth one point and the team with the fewest shots on a hole wins the point.
paras.zh: 在单打赛制中，每队的三名球员每人打两场比赛。两场比赛的每个洞都得一分，每洞击球数最少的球队获胜。

paras.en: The use of 'The Hammer' increases the value of a hole by one, with each team having three a match to use. If the team throws the Hammer mid-hole and the opposition rejects it, the hole is automatically conceded. The maximum a hole can be worth is three points if both teams throw a Hammer on the same hole and each is accepted.
paras.zh: 使用“锤子”可以将一洞的价值增加一洞，每支球队在一场比赛中可以使用三个洞。如果球队在洞中投掷铁锤而对手拒绝投掷，则该洞自动认输。如果两队都在同一个洞上投掷锤子并且各自被接受，则该洞的最高得分为三分。

paras.en: A shot clock limits teams to 40 seconds to play a shot, while each team has a limited number of timeouts they can use in each match. If tied after 15 holes, overtime is a three-vs-three closest-to-the-pin competition to decide a winner.
paras.zh: 进攻时钟将球队的进攻时间限制为 40 秒，而每支球队在每场比赛中可以使用的暂停次数也有限。如果 15 洞后打成平手，加时赛将采用三对三最接近的比赛来决出胜负。

paras.en: All five of the WTGL teams also feature in TGL, which begins its third season on December 27 and is also live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: WTGL 的所有五支球队也在 TGL 中亮相，TGL 的第三个赛季将于 12 月 27 日开始，天空体育也进行直播。

paras.en: The WTGL standings, like the men's equivalent, use a points-based system that includes two points for a match win and one point for a loss in overtime.
paras.zh: WTGL 积分榜与男子积分榜一样，采用积分制，比赛获胜得两分，加时赛输掉一分。

articles.title: Fagnano's first NFL start ends in heavy Ravens defeat to Jaguars

paras.en: Jacksonville Jaguars 33-10 Baltimore Ravens: Joe Fagnano throws two interceptions as Ravens suffer heavy loss
paras.zh: 杰克逊维尔美洲虎队 33-10 巴尔的摩乌鸦队：乔·法格纳诺两次拦截，乌鸦队损失惨重

paras.en: Baltimore Ravens' third quarterback of the season, rookie Joe Fagnano, throws for just 60 yards and two interceptions in his first NFL start as the Baltimore Ravens (4-5) suffer a fourth straight loss at home to the Jacksonville Jaguars (6-2) on Thursday night
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩乌鸦队本赛季的第三个四分卫新秀乔·法格纳诺在他的第一次 NFL 首发中仅传出 60 码并被两次拦截，周四晚上巴尔的摩乌鸦队 (4-5) 在主场连续第四次输给杰克逊维尔美洲虎队 (6-2)

paras.en: Joe Fagnano had a forgettable first NFL start as the Baltimore Ravens quarterback - their third of the season - threw for just 60 yards and had two interceptions as the Jacksonville Jaguars earned a convincing 33-10 road win on Thursday night.
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩乌鸦队四分卫乔·法格纳诺 (Joe Fagnano) 的首次 NFL 首发令人难忘，他是巴尔的摩乌鸦队 (Baltimore Ravens) 本赛季的第三个四分卫，他的传球仅 60 码，并被两次拦截，杰克逊维尔美洲虎队 (Jacksonville Jaguars) 在周四晚上以 33-10 取得了令人信服的客场胜利。

paras.en: Fagnano came in due to Lamar Jackson and backup Tyler Huntley both being injured, with the 25-year-old rookie finding things a big struggle as Baltimore (4-5) lost a fourth straight on the season.
paras.zh: 法格纳诺因拉马尔·杰克逊和替补泰勒·亨特利双双受伤而上场，这位 25 岁的新秀在巴尔的摩 (4-5) 本赛季遭遇四连败的情况下陷入了困境。

paras.en: With their top two quarterbacks on injured reserve, the Ravens now await Jacoby Brissett's arrival in a trade from the Arizona Cardinals as they try to prevent their season from falling apart.
paras.zh: 由于两名顶级四分卫都处于伤病储备名单中，乌鸦队现在等待着来自亚利桑那红雀队的雅各比·布里塞特的到来，他们试图阻止他们的赛季崩溃。

paras.en: Jacksonville (6-2) did not need to do anything extraordinary to beat a badly weakened Baltimore team. Trevor Lawrence threw for 242 yards and a touchdown as the Jags won their fifth in their last six to take further command of the AFC South.
paras.zh: 杰克逊维尔（6-2）不需要做任何非凡的事情就可以击败实力严重削弱的巴尔的摩队。特雷弗·劳伦斯 (Trevor Lawrence) 传球 242 码并达阵，美洲虎队在过去六场比赛中取得第五场胜利，进一步掌控了亚足联南部赛场。

paras.en: Jacksonville drove 77 yards on the game's first possession, taking a 7-0 advantage on a one-yard touchdown run by Bhayshul Tuten.
paras.zh: 杰克逊维尔队在比赛的第一个回合中就推进了 77 码，在巴舒尔·图滕 (Bhayshul Tuten) 的一码达阵中取得了 7-0 的优势。

paras.en: The Ravens tried to be creative, repeatedly running Wildcat-style plays where running back Derrick Henry took direct snaps. They managed a field goal on their first drive but nothing more for much of the matchup.
paras.zh: 乌鸦队试图发挥创造力，反复进行野猫式的比赛，跑卫德里克·亨利直接抢断。他们在第一次进攻中就射门得分，但在比赛的大部分时间里仅此而已。

paras.en: It was still competitive up until the end of the first half, when Lawrence found Parker Washington for a 50-yard scoring strike with 58 seconds left in the second quarter to make the score 17-3.
paras.zh: 直到上半场结束时，双方的竞争依然激烈，第二节还剩 58 秒时，劳伦斯找到帕克·华盛顿 (Parker Washington) 50 码得分，将比分改写为 17-3。

paras.en: It was 20-3 when a fumble gave Baltimore the ball at midfield in the third quarter, but the Ravens immediately turned the ball over on downs and the boos came cascading down from the home crowd.
paras.zh: 第三节，巴尔的摩中场的一次掉球将球传给了巴尔的摩队，比分是20-3，但乌鸦队在进攻低位时立即将球翻了过来，主场球迷发出了如潮水般的嘘声。

paras.en: Fagnano went 10 of 18 with two second-half interceptions. Baltimore also lost a fumble on a kick return, which led to Chris Rodriguez Jr's two-yard touchdown run with just over seven minutes left in the game that made it 33-3.
paras.zh: 下半场法尼亚诺18投10中，有两次被拦截。巴尔的摩队还在回踢球中失手，导致小克里斯·罗德里格斯在比赛还剩七分多钟时完成两码达阵，将比分改写为 33-3。

paras.en: Justice Hill broke free for a 65-yard touchdown run 11 seconds later - Baltimore's first TD after half-time since Week 5. He finished with 85 yards and that score on nine carries.
paras.zh: 11 秒后，贾斯蒂斯·希尔 (Justice Hill) 冲球 65 码达阵，这是巴尔的摩自第五周以来半场结束后的首次达阵。他最终取得 85 码，并通过 9 次冲球取得这一成绩。

articles.title: Wave of bomb threats against European airliners triggers diversions and tarmac searches
articles.author: Matteo Moschella

paras.en: LONDON — A wave of bomb threats against passenger airliners caused chaos in the skies and airports of Europe on Thursday, the latest of such incidents this week that have prompted emergency landings and security sweeps on runways.
paras.zh: 伦敦——周四，针对客机的一波炸弹威胁在欧洲天空和机场造成混乱，这是本周发生的最新一起此类事件，引发了紧急着陆和跑道安全清扫。

paras.en: No explosives have so far been found, and it is not clear who or what is behind the security threats made against at least 14 airliners. But the threats have caused disruption to Europe’s airspace and some of its busiest airports.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，尚未发现爆炸物，也不清楚谁或什么是对至少 14 架客机造成安全威胁的幕后黑手。但这些威胁已经对欧洲领空和一些最繁忙的机场造成了干扰。

paras.en: The threats against two flights that landed in Rome came by email that cited opposition to “your feminist regime,” the airport confirmed to NBC News. Italy’s prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, is a woman who has conservative views.
paras.zh: 机场向 NBC 新闻证实，针对降落在罗马的两架航班的威胁是通过电子邮件发出的，其中提到反对“你们的女权主义政权”。意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼是一位持保守观点的女性。

paras.en: One of the first reports involved Aer Lingus Flight EI402 from Dublin to Rome, which changed course near Paris and diverted to a French air force base, the airline said. There, all 151 passengers and six crewmembers were evacuated while a bomb squad inspected the aircraft, French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu’s office said in a statement.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰航空公司表示，首批报告之一涉及从都柏林飞往罗马的 EI402 航班，该航班在巴黎附近改变航线并改道飞往法国空军基地。法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努 (Sébastien Lecornu) 办公室在一份声明中表示，在拆弹小组检查飞机时，所有 151 名乘客和 6 名机组人员均已撤离。

paras.en: - Aer Lingus EI402 from Dublin to Rome — received bomb threat over France, made emergency landing at air base and inspected by bomb squad, according to airline and French officials.
paras.zh: - 据航空公司和法国官员称，从都柏林飞往罗马的爱尔兰航空 EI402 在法国上空收到炸弹威胁，紧急降落在空军基地并接受拆弹小组检查。

paras.en: - Finnair AY1761 from Helsinki, Finland, to Rome Fiumicino — escorted into Rome by Italian air force jets, bomb squad search found no explosives, airline said.
paras.zh: - 芬兰航空 AY1761 从芬兰赫尔辛基飞往罗马菲乌米奇诺 — 航空公司表示，在意大利空军喷气机的护送下飞往罗马，拆弹小组搜查后没有发现爆炸物。

paras.en: - Finnair AY1471 from Helsinki to Vienna — also received bomb threat, likewise no explosives found, according to airline.
paras.zh: - 据航空公司称，从赫尔辛基飞往维也纳的芬兰航空 AY1471 航班也收到炸弹威胁，同样没有发现爆炸物。

paras.en: - LOT Polish Airlines LO235 from Warsaw, Poland, to Brussels — crew made midair checks after receiving threat, "additional screening" once in Brussels found no "suspicious items," airline said.
paras.zh: -从波兰华沙飞往布鲁塞尔的LOT波兰航空LO235——机组人员在收到威胁后进行了空中检查，航空公司表示，在布鲁塞尔进行的“额外检查”没有发现“可疑物品”。

paras.en: - LOT Polish Airlines LO331 from Warsaw to Paris — stopped while taxiing and directed to parking stand where searched, airline said. Passengers continued on trips after switching planes.
paras.zh: - 波兰航空公司表示，从华沙飞往巴黎的LO331航班在滑行时停下来，并被引导至接受搜查的停车位。乘客转机后继续旅行。

paras.en: - Ryanair FR3606 from Copenhagen, Denmark, to Sofia, Bulgaria, and Ryanair FR6410 from Madrid to Sofia — both landed normally following bomb threat, no explosives found, according to Bulgarian Transport Ministry.
paras.zh: - 保加利亚交通部表示，从丹麦哥本哈根飞往保加利亚索非亚的瑞安航空 FR3606 航班和从马德里飞往索非亚的瑞安航空 FR6410 航班均在炸弹威胁后正常着陆，未发现爆炸物。

paras.en: - Ryanair FR1730 from London Stansted to Sofia — also received a bomb threat and diverted to Plovdiv, Bulgaria, the Bulgarian Transport Ministry said.
paras.zh: 保加利亚交通部表示，从伦敦斯坦斯特德飞往索非亚的瑞安航空 FR1730 航班也收到炸弹威胁，并改道飞往保加利亚普罗夫迪夫。

paras.en: - Wizz Air WMT3064 from Milan to Bucharest — airport said it was notified of the bomb threat as flight was arriving, bomb squad found nothing.
paras.zh: - Wizz Air WMT3064 从米兰飞往布加勒斯特 — 机场表示，在航班抵达时接到炸弹威胁通知，拆弹小组什么也没发现。

paras.en: - Czech police say four unidentified flights headed for Prague also received threats.
paras.zh: - 捷克警方表示，四架飞往布拉格的不明航班也受到了威胁。

paras.en: From there, reports of threats in the skies over Europe arrived at a dizzying pace, triggering searches by cabin crews and then again by airport security crews on the ground.
paras.zh: 从那里开始，有关欧洲上空威胁的报告以令人眼花缭乱的速度传来，引发了机组人员的搜查，然后又引发了地面机场保安人员的搜查。

paras.en: Security operations were launched at airports in Prague; Copenhagen, Denmark; and Warsaw, Poland, where passengers saw the military and police sniffer dogs patrolling the tarmac.
paras.zh: 布拉格机场启动了安全行动；丹麦哥本哈根；波兰华沙，乘客看到军警嗅探犬在停机坪上巡逻。

paras.en: “It is too early to draw conclusions on whether the reported incidents are linked,” Apostolos Tzitzikostas, the European commissioner for sustainable transport and tourism, said at a news conference in Brussels.
paras.zh: 欧盟可持续交通和旅游业专员阿波斯托洛斯·齐齐科斯塔斯在布鲁塞尔举行的新闻发布会上表示：“现在就所报道的事件是否存在关联得出结论还为时过早。”

paras.en: British Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander appealed for calm, telling Sky News, “We have established processes for dealing with hoax and malicious threats, and that’s what these threats have been.”
paras.zh: 英国交通大臣海蒂·亚历山大呼吁保持冷静，她告诉天空新闻，“我们已经建立了处理恶作剧和恶意威胁的流程，而这些威胁就是这样的。”

paras.en: Italian air force jets escorted a Finnair flight from Helsinki to Rome’s Fiumicino Airport “following anonymous reports of a suspected bomb threat,” said a spokesperson for the city’s airport authority. Bomb disposal experts found nothing.
paras.zh: 罗马机场管理局发言人表示，“在收到疑似炸弹威胁的匿名报告后”，意大利空军喷气式飞机护送一架从赫尔辛基飞往罗马菲乌米奇诺机场的芬兰航空航班。拆弹专家什么也没发现。

paras.en: “Unfortunately, air traffic is sometimes subject to threats, as we have seen this week, when other airlines in Europe have also faced hoax bomb threats,” a Finnair spokesperson, Stiina Tuunanen, said in an email. “Threats are almost always unfounded.”
paras.zh: 芬兰航空发言人 Stiina Tuunanen 在一封电子邮件中表示：“不幸的是，空中交通有时会受到威胁，正如我们本周所看到的那样，欧洲其他航空公司也面临着恶作剧炸弹威胁。” “威胁几乎总是毫无根据的。”

paras.en: That was also the case for another Finnair flight from Helsinki to Vienna, whose threat was found to be baseless after it landed safely in the Austrian capital.
paras.zh: 芬兰航空另一架从赫尔辛基飞往维也纳的航班也是如此，该航班安全降落在奥地利首都后，人们发现该航班的威胁毫无根据。

paras.en: LOT Polish Airlines said two of its aircraft from Warsaw were targeted, one flying to Brussels and the other to Paris.
paras.zh: LOT波兰航空公司表示，其两架从华沙起飞的飞机成为目标，一架飞往布鲁塞尔，另一架飞往巴黎。

paras.en: Back on the ground in Warsaw, Polish resident Matthew Bojarsky, 28, was about to fly to Paris for a romantic trip with his American girlfriend, but he saw police, military and sniffer dogs on the tarmac, he told NBC News. Passengers were told that “safety protocols” meant their flight, LOT LO331, had to be aborted and moved to a later time.
paras.zh: 回到华沙后，28 岁的波兰居民马修·博贾斯基 (Matthew Bojarsky) 告诉 NBC 新闻，他正准备飞往巴黎与美国女友进行一次浪漫旅行，但他在停机坪上看到了警察、军队和嗅探犬。乘客被告知，“安全协议”意味着他们的 LOT LO331 航班必须中止并改期。

paras.en: Elsewhere, three Ryanair flights were interrupted as they headed to the Bulgarian capital, Sofia. Two flights, from Copenhagen and Milan, landed at their destination, while a third, from London, was diverted to the city of Plovdiv, the Bulgarian Transport Ministry said in an email.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，瑞安航空的三架航班在飞往保加利亚首都索非亚的途中被中断。保加利亚交通部在一封电子邮件中表示，来自哥本哈根和米兰的两架航班降落在目的地，而来自伦敦的第三架航班则改道飞往普罗夫迪夫市。

paras.en: Ryanair did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 瑞安航空没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Romania’s intelligence agency said a KLM flight to Tel Aviv with a layover in Bucharest had received a bomb threat.
paras.zh: 罗马尼亚情报机构表示，荷航飞往特拉维夫并在布加勒斯特中途停留的航班收到炸弹威胁。

paras.en: And Spanish police said three emailed threats came in within 20 minutes involving two Air Europa departures from Madrid to Paris and four inbound Iberia flights from Rome and Milan. Several aircraft were halted or returned to their stands in Madrid, and passengers disembarked as the aircraft were inspected.
paras.zh: 西班牙警方表示，20 分钟内收到了三封电子邮件威胁，涉及两架从马德里飞往巴黎的欧洲航空公司航班以及四架从罗马和米兰出发的伊比利亚航空公司航班。多架飞机被拦截或返回马德里的停机位，乘客在飞机接受检查时下机。

paras.en: In the Czech Republic, meanwhile, police said they had received threats about improvised explosive devices being placed on four planes heading to the country’s capital, Prague.
paras.zh: 与此同时，捷克共和国警方表示，他们收到了有关在飞往该国首都布拉格的四架飞机上放置简易爆炸装置的威胁。

paras.en: In this instance, it appeared that at least some of the threats were sent by email, so “clearly there must be a process whereby airlines distinguish more credible threats from obvious hoaxes,” said Peter Neumann, a professor of security studies at Kings College London.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院安全研究教授彼得·诺伊曼表示，在这种情况下，至少有一些威胁是通过电子邮件发送的，因此“显然，航空公司必须有一个流程来区分更可信的威胁和明显的恶作剧”。

paras.en: Thursday’s incidents follow days of airline bomb threats that have forced multiple flights to divert and an airport in Poland to close briefly. No explosive devices were found in the earlier incidents, according to authorities in various countries.
paras.zh: 周四的事件发生之前，几天来航空炸弹威胁迫使多个航班改道，波兰的一个机场短暂关闭。据各国当局称，在之前的事件中没有发现爆炸装置。

paras.en: On Tuesday, a security operation was also launched at the Greek island port of Syros after a bomb threat to an Israel-bound cruise ship. Authorities said an unknown person claimed an explosive device had been attached to the hull of the Panama-flagged Crown Iris, which was due to sail to Haifa.
paras.zh: 周二，一艘开往以色列的游轮受到炸弹威胁后，希腊锡罗斯岛港口也启动了安全行动。当局表示，一名身份不明的人声称，悬挂巴拿马国旗的“皇冠鸢尾”号船体上安装了爆炸装置，该船原定驶往海法。

paras.en: Authorities have not indicated who could have been behind the incidents, and there were no claims of responsibility.
paras.zh: 当局没有表明谁是这些事件的幕后黑手，也没有人声称对此负责。
