articles.title: Three ways Democrats could reshape U.S. foreign policy after the midterms
articles.author: Leila Fadel

paras.en: Three ways Democrats could reshape U.S. foreign policy after the midterms
paras.zh: 中期选举后民主党重塑美国外交政策的三种方式

paras.en: One thing is clear from this week's midterm elections: The Trump administration's foreign policy decisions were no longer just about what happened abroad. The war in Iran has driven up gas prices, while Trump's tariffs have raised costs for American businesses.
paras.zh: 从本周的中期选举中可以清楚地看出一件事：特朗普政府的外交政策决定不再仅仅与国外发生的事情有关。伊朗战争推高了天然气价格，而特朗普的关税则提高了美国企业的成本。

paras.en: According to the Voter Poll conducted by SSRS for several news outlets, including The Associated Press, 51% of voters said U.S. support for Israel had been too strong, while 63% said the war in Iran was the wrong decision. Nearly three-quarters (74%) considered the war a major or crucial factor in their vote. The economy weighed even more heavily, with 89% calling it a major or crucial factor.
paras.zh: 根据SSRS为美联社等多家新闻媒体进行的选民民意调查，51%的选民表示美国对以色列的支持过于强烈，而63%的选民表示对伊朗发动战争是错误的决定。近四分之三（74%）的人认为战争是他们投票的主要或关键因素。经济的权重甚至更大，89% 的人称其为主要或关键因素。

paras.en: And while Americans were making their views known at the ballot box, the rest of the world had plenty to say, too. Sometimes with a little more humor. The election results have inspired AI-generated videos, social media memes and newspaper headlines abroad.
paras.zh: 当美国人在投票箱中表达自己的观点时，世界其他国家也有很多话要说。有时多一点幽默。选举结果激发了人工智能生成的视频、社交媒体表情包和国外报纸头条的灵感。

paras.en: Anne Applebaum, a Pulitzer Prize-winning historian and staff writer at The Atlantic, has spent years studying authoritarianism and the erosion of democratic institutions. In a February interview with NPR, she warned about corruption in U.S. foreign policy, saying people around Trump and his family had accepted money from foreign governments and others.
paras.zh: 普利策奖获得者、《大西洋月刊》特约撰稿人安妮·阿普尔鲍姆多年来一直在研究威权主义和民主制度的侵蚀。在二月份接受美国国家公共广播电台采访时，她对美国外交政策中的腐败行为发出警告，称特朗普及其家人周围的人接受了外国政府和其他人的金钱。

paras.en: Now, with Democrats set to control Congress, Applebaum sees reason for U.S. allies to regain some confidence in American democracy. But whether that translates into changes in foreign policy is another question.
paras.zh: 现在，随着民主党即将控制国会，阿普鲍姆认为美国盟友有理由重新恢复对美国民主的信心。但这是否会转化为外交政策的变化则是另一个问题。

paras.en: On Morning Edition, Applebaum outlined three ways Congress could influence U.S. foreign policy, from the war in Iran to Ukraine, and where its power would stop. Read her takeaways below.
paras.zh: 在早间版中，阿普尔鲍姆概述了国会影响美国外交政策的三种方式，从伊朗战争到乌克兰，以及其权力将在哪里停止。请阅读下面她的要点。

paras.en: 1. How Congress could influence the war in Iran
paras.zh: 1. 国会如何影响伊朗战争

paras.en: The U.S. and Israel have carried out military campaigns against Iran since June 2025. The war has cost American taxpayers an estimated $47.1 billion as of mid-October, according to Pentagon figures obtained by The Associated Press. Iranian retaliatory strikes have also targeted U.S. military bases in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年 6 月以来，美国和以色列一直对伊朗发动军事行动。据美联社获得的五角大楼数据显示，截至 10 月中旬，这场战争已使美国纳税人损失了约 471 亿美元。伊朗的报复性袭击还针对美国在海湾的军事基地。

paras.en: "I don't expect Trump to change," Applebaum said. "He's not that interested in what Americans think of his policies."
paras.zh: “我不认为特朗普会改变，”阿普尔鲍姆说。 “他对美国人如何看待他的政策不太感兴趣。”

paras.en: There is also a question of timing. Iran remains wary of renewed attacks, and some supporters of the war may see the next two months, before the new Congress takes office, as their last chance to escalate the conflict, Trita Parsi, an Iran expert at the Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft, told NPR's Hadeel Al-Shalchi.
paras.zh: 还有一个时间问题。昆西负责任治国研究所的伊朗问题专家特丽塔·帕西 (Trita Parsi) 告诉美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的哈迪尔·沙尔奇 (Hadeel Al-Shalchi)，伊朗仍然对新一轮袭击保持警惕，一些战争支持者可能会将新国会就职前的未来两个月视为升级冲突的最后机会。

paras.en: Once Democrats take control of both chambers, they could use one of Congress's most important powers: deciding how federal money is spent. Lawmakers can seek restrictions in spending bills that would limit the use of federal funds for certain military operations.
paras.zh: 一旦民主党控制参众两院，他们就可以使用国会最重要的权力之一：决定如何使用联邦资金。立法者可以寻求对支出法案进行限制，以限制联邦资金用于某些军事行动。

paras.en: "You could see them trying to use the power of the purse, the appropriations committees, to end the war or to influence politics," Applebaum said.
paras.zh: 阿普尔鲍姆说：“你可以看到他们试图利用财政、拨款委员会的力量来结束战争或影响政治。”

paras.en: She expects that pressure to "change the trajectory of the war sooner or later."
paras.zh: 她预计这种压力“迟早会改变战争的轨迹”。

paras.en: 2. What congressional investigations could reveal
paras.zh: 2. 国会调查可以揭示什么

paras.en: Congress can also investigate how the administration makes foreign policy decisions, even when it cannot directly reverse them.
paras.zh: 国会还可以调查政府如何做出外交政策决定，即使它不能直接扭转这些决定。

paras.en: Applebaum expects lawmakers to examine potential corruption involving people close to Trump and decisions made by his foreign policy team. She raised questions about Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's competence and the advice Trump received during the Iran war.
paras.zh: 阿普尔鲍姆希望立法者能够审查涉及特朗普亲近人士的潜在腐败行为以及他的外交政策团队做出的决定。她对国防部长皮特·赫格斯的能力以及特朗普在伊朗战争期间收到的建议提出了质疑。

paras.en: Such investigations could bring more information into public view, but they would not necessarily produce a change in policy.
paras.zh: 此类调查可以让更多信息进入公众视野，但不一定会导致政策发生变化。

paras.en: "Congress can't force the president to make changes," Applebaum said, noting that Trump can veto legislation.
paras.zh: “国会不能强迫总统做出改变，”阿普尔鲍姆说，并指出特朗普可以否决立法。

paras.en: Congress could, however, offer "a different narrative, both about this war and more broadly about American foreign policy," she said.
paras.zh: 然而，国会可以“就这场战争以及更广泛的美国外交政策提供不同的叙述”，她说。

paras.en: For that to matter, Applebaum said, Democratic leaders would need to move quickly, decide what to investigate and establish their priorities.
paras.zh: 阿普鲍姆表示，为了解决这一问题，民主党领导人需要迅速采取行动，决定调查内容并确定优先事项。

paras.en: Support for Ukraine has crossed party lines in Congress, even as the Trump administration's approach to Russia has raised questions among lawmakers.
paras.zh: 尽管特朗普政府对俄罗斯的态度引起了立法者的质疑，但国会对乌克兰的支持已经跨越了党派界限。

paras.en: Applebaum expects that bipartisan coalition to become more active under Democratic control, including through legislation that would require the president to reimpose sanctions on Russia.
paras.zh: 阿普尔鲍姆预计，两党联盟在民主党的控制下将变得更加积极，包括通过立法要求总统重新对俄罗斯实施制裁。

paras.en: "I would expect legislation forcing the president to reimpose sanctions," she said.
paras.zh: “我预计立法会迫使总统重新实施制裁，”她说。

paras.en: The question is whether enough lawmakers would support such legislation to override a presidential veto. Applebaum said she could not predict that outcome, though she considered it possible given the level of congressional support for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 问题是是否有足够多的立法者支持此类立法以推翻总统否决。阿普尔鲍姆表示，她无法预测这一结果，但考虑到国会对乌克兰的支持程度，她认为这是可能的。

paras.en: Congress has already sought answers about disruptions to Ukraine's satellite communications. In October, the Pentagon's inspector general declined a bipartisan request to investigate slowdowns to Starlink and Starshield services, which Ukrainian officials said had hampered their ability to intercept Russian drones. The Trump administration and SpaceX have offered conflicting accounts of who was responsible.
paras.zh: 国会已经就乌克兰卫星通信中断问题寻求答案。十月份，五角大楼监察长拒绝了两党要求调查星链和星盾服务速度放缓的请求，乌克兰官员称这阻碍了他们拦截俄罗斯无人机的能力。特朗普政府和 SpaceX 对于责任人的说法相互矛盾。

paras.en: Applebaum expects lawmakers to examine those disruptions further, along with the administration's negotiations with Russia and Ukraine, including allegations of business dealings involving negotiators.
paras.zh: 阿普尔鲍姆预计立法者将进一步审查这些干扰，以及政府与俄罗斯和乌克兰的谈判，包括涉及谈判人员的商业交易的指控。

paras.en: She expects those issues to become "more open, more part of the conversation, more part of criticism."
paras.zh: 她希望这些问题变得“更加开放，更多地成为对话的一部分，更多地成为批评的一部分”。

articles.title: Federal judge temporarily blocks construction of Trump's Arlington triumphal arch hours after approval

paras.en: A federal judge early Friday temporarily blocked the Trump administration from breaking ground on President Donald Trump's proposed triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., just hours after a federal planning commission approved the project.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，联邦规划委员会批准了唐纳德·特朗普总统提议的华盛顿凯旋门项目几小时后，一名联邦法官暂时阻止特朗普政府破土动工。

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan issued a 14-day temporary restraining order halting construction of the proposed monument.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官 Tanya Chutkan 发布了为期 14 天的临时限制令，停止拟议纪念碑的建设。

paras.en: Chutkan granted a request from plaintiffs challenging the project in lawsuits filed by the District of Columbia and Virginia. The cases were consolidated with an earlier lawsuit brought by a group of Vietnam veterans and an architectural historian.
paras.zh: Chutkan 批准了原告在哥伦比亚特区和弗吉尼亚州提起的诉讼中质疑该项目的请求。这些案件与一群越南退伍军人和一名建筑历史学家早些时候提起的诉讼合并在一起。

paras.en: The National Capital Planning Commission approved the project hours earlier on Thursday with an 8-4 vote, clearing the way for construction before the court intervened.
paras.zh: 周四早些时候，国家首都规划委员会以 8 比 4 的投票结果批准了该项目，为法院介入之前的建设扫清了道路。

paras.en: The federal panel approved construction of the 250-foot-tall structure, which is inspired by Paris' Arc de Triomphe and intended to attract visitors crossing the Memorial Bridge from Arlington National Cemetery into the nation's capital.
paras.zh: 联邦委员会批准建造这座 250 英尺高的建筑，其灵感来自巴黎凯旋门，旨在吸引游客从阿灵顿国家公墓穿过纪念桥进入美国首都。

paras.en: Mark Paoletta, the commission's Trump-appointed chairman, expressed support for the new structure during the panel's meeting.
paras.zh: 特朗普任命的该委员会主席马克·保莱塔在小组会议上表达了对新结构的支持。

paras.en: "President Trump understands as president and a superb builder that it's important to our national identity to display who we are through grand monuments," Paoletta said.
paras.zh: 保莱塔说：“特朗普总统明白，作为总统和出色的建设者，通过宏伟的纪念碑展示我们的身份对我们的国家认同非常重要。”

paras.en: Paoletta, who also serves as general counsel for the White House Office of Management and Budget, pointed to Trump's admiration for similar monuments around the world.
paras.zh: 保莱塔还担任白宫管理和预算办公室总法律顾问，她指出特朗普对世界各地类似纪念碑的钦佩。

paras.en: "As Trump has often remarked, the great cities around the world have arches: Paris, Rome, London," Paoletta said.
paras.zh: “正如特朗普经常说的那样，世界各地的大城市都有拱门：巴黎、罗马、伦敦，”保莱塔说。

paras.en: The proposed structure would be clad in granite and topped with three golden statues.
paras.zh: 拟议的结构将覆盖花岗岩，顶部有三座金色雕像。

paras.en: Trump has previously said the triumphal arch would be converted into a military complex capable of rapidly deploying large numbers of drones, with snipers positioned on the roof and plaza areas. He also said the complex would store "large quantities of sniper ammunition."
paras.zh: 特朗普此前曾表示，凯旋门将被改造成军事综合体，能够快速部署大量无人机，并在屋顶和广场区域部署狙击手。他还表示，该建筑群将储存“大量狙击手弹药”。

paras.en: The project has drawn criticism from preservationists, lawmakers and veterans, who argue that it could disrupt views of the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery.
paras.zh: 该项目引起了保护主义者、立法者和退伍军人的批评，他们认为这可能会破坏林肯纪念堂和阿灵顿国家公墓的景观。

paras.en: Opponents have also questioned whether the project requires congressional approval under federal law.
paras.zh: 反对者还质疑该项目是否需要根据联邦法律获得国会批准。

paras.en: The National Capital Planning Commission previously approved the site and preliminary plans.
paras.zh: 国家首都计委此前已批准选址及初步规划。

paras.en: Fox News Digital's Amanda Macias and The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字版的阿曼达·马西亚斯和美联社对此报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: Colorado police officer killed, 3 more officers wounded after suspect opens fire near bus

paras.en: A Colorado police officer was killed and three more officers were wounded in a shooting Thursday evening near a bus outside Denver, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，周四晚上丹佛郊外一辆公共汽车附近发生枪击事件，一名科罗拉多州警察被杀，另外三名警察受伤。

paras.en: Lakewood police said officers responded to a report of a suspicious person near the intersection of Colfax Avenue and Wadsworth Boulevard around 6:30 p.m., where they encountered a suspect attempting to board a bus.
paras.zh: 莱克伍德警方表示，下午 6 点 30 分左右，警方接到了科尔法克斯大道 (Colfax Avenue) 和沃兹沃斯大道 (Wadsworth Boulevard) 交叉口附近可疑人员的报告，并在那里遇到了一名试图登上公交车的嫌疑人。

paras.en: The suspect opened fire on officers, striking four of them, Lakewood Police Public Information Officer John Romero said during a news conference.
paras.zh: 莱克伍德警方公共信息官员约翰·罗梅罗在新闻发布会上表示，嫌疑人向警察开枪，造成四人受伤。

paras.en: "We are very sorry to report that one of those agents has been pronounced dead of their injuries," Romero said.
paras.zh: 罗梅罗说：“我们非常遗憾地报告，其中一名特工已因伤势过重而被宣布死亡。”

paras.en: The suspect was shot by police and pronounced dead at the scene, Romero said.
paras.zh: 罗梅罗说，嫌疑人被警方开枪射杀，并在现场被宣布死亡。

paras.en: A civilian was also injured and transported to a local hospital.
paras.zh: 一名平民也受伤并被送往当地医院。

paras.en: Police did not immediately provide details about the extent of the injuries or the conditions of the three surviving officers.
paras.zh: 警方没有立即提供有关三名幸存警官受伤程度或状况的详细信息。

paras.en: Authorities said the suspect was attempting to board a Regional Transportation District (RTD) bus when officers approached.
paras.zh: 当局表示，当警察靠近时，嫌疑人正试图登上一辆地区交通区（RTD）巴士。

paras.en: "Within seconds of agents approaching the suspect, the suspect opened fire on our agents," Romero said.
paras.zh: 罗梅罗说：“特工接近嫌疑人后几秒钟内，嫌疑人就向我们的特工开枪。”

paras.en: Romero also delivered an emotional message to the fallen officer's family:
paras.zh: 罗梅罗还向阵亡军官的家人传达了一条感人的信息：

paras.en: "We just want the family to know that we love them, that we're here for them, and Lakewood Police Department is a family, and we will be here for each other."
paras.zh: “我们只是想让家人知道我们爱他们，我们在这里支持他们，莱克伍德警察局是一个家庭，我们会在这里支持彼此。”

paras.en: Colorado Gov. Jared Polis released a statement following the deadly shooting.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州州长贾里德·波利斯在致命枪击事件发生后发表声明。

paras.en: "Law enforcement put their lives on the line for our safety everyday and I am heartbroken to learn that a Lakewood Police Agent was killed in the line of duty this evening," Polis wrote.
paras.zh: 波利斯写道：“执法部门每天都为了我们的安全而冒着生命危险，当我得知今晚莱克伍德警察局特工在执行任务时被杀时，我感到心碎。”

paras.en: "My heart goes out to their family and friends," he continued. "My thoughts are also with the three agents who are still receiving care at area hospitals, as well as the civilian who was wounded, and I wish them a full and speedy recovery. Thank you to law enforcement who run into danger to keep us safe and to protect our communities."
paras.zh: “我的心与他们的家人和朋友同在，”他继续说道。 “我的心也与仍在地区医院接受治疗的三名特工以及受伤的平民同在，我祝愿他们早日全面康复。感谢执法人员冒着危险保护我们的安全并保护我们的社区。”

paras.en: Polis said the Colorado State Patrol was assisting at the scene and participating in a procession from the hospital honoring the fallen officer.
paras.zh: 波利斯说，科罗拉多州巡逻队正在现场协助，并参加了从医院出发的游行，以纪念倒下的警官。

paras.en: The Jefferson County Critical Incident Response Team is leading the investigation into the officer-involved shooting, with support from the Colorado Bureau of Investigation.
paras.zh: 在科罗拉多州调查局的支持下，杰斐逊县重大事件响应小组正在领导对涉警枪击事件的调查。

paras.en: RTD also released a statement saying it was "deeply concerned" by the shooting.
paras.zh: RTD 还发表声明称，对枪击事件“深感关切”。

paras.en: "Our thoughts are with those affected directly by this incident," the statement read. "The safety and well-being of our customers, employees, and partners remain our highest priority."
paras.zh: 声明中写道：“我们的想法与那些直接受此事件影响的人同在。” “我们的客户、员工和合作伙伴的安全和福祉仍然是我们的首要任务。”

articles.title: Wisconsin infant dies of measles as state sees first death from disease since 1990

paras.en: An infant in Wisconsin died of measles, marking the state’s first death linked to the disease in 36 years, the state's Department of Health Services announced on Thursday.
paras.zh: 威斯康星州卫生服务部周四宣布，该州一名婴儿死于麻疹，这是该州 36 年来首例因麻疹死亡的病例。

paras.en: The Department of Health Services said the child died in southwestern Wisconsin but did not provide a more precise location. The department said it would not release any additional details to protect the privacy of the family.
paras.zh: 卫生服务部表示，这名儿童在威斯康星州西南部死亡，但没有提供更准确的位置。该部门表示，为了保护该家庭的隐私，不会透露任何其他细节。

paras.en: The coroner listed the immediate cause of death as measles.
paras.zh: 验尸官将死亡的直接原因列为麻疹。

paras.en: "It is with a heavy heart we are reporting the first death of an infant connected with a measles outbreak in Wisconsin in many years. My heart is broken for the family," state Department of Health Services Secretary Kirsten Johnson said in a statement.
paras.zh: “我们怀着沉重的心情报告威斯康星州多年来首例与麻疹爆发有关的婴儿死亡事件。我为这个家庭感到心碎，”州卫生服务部部长克尔斯滕·约翰逊在一份声明中说。

paras.en: "Any death of a child is a tragedy and even more so when it is related to a vaccine-preventable disease. Measles can cause serious illness and death, and it is important for all Wisconsinites to evaluate their risk and take steps to protect themselves and their family," she continued.
paras.zh: “任何儿童的死亡都是一场悲剧，当它与疫苗可预防的疾病有关时更是如此。麻疹可导致严重疾病和死亡，对所有威斯康星州人来说，评估其风险并采取措施保护自己和家人非常重要，”她继续说道。

paras.en: Measles can cause life-threatening complications, including pneumonia and swelling of the brain. The department said that while anyone can become seriously ill, children younger than 5, pregnant people and people with weakened immune systems are at increased risk of complications.
paras.zh: 麻疹可引起危及生命的并发症，包括肺炎和脑肿胀。该部门表示，虽然任何人都可能患上重病，但 5 岁以下儿童、孕妇和免疫系统较弱的人出现并发症的风险更高。

paras.en: Wisconsin has reported 431 measles cases in 13 counties so far this year, reflecting the highest number of cases seen in the state in more than 35 years. Among these cases, nine people required hospitalization for severe symptoms.
paras.zh: 今年迄今为止，威斯康星州已在 13 个县报告了 431 例麻疹病例，这是该州 35 年来病例数最高的一次。其中，有九人因症状严重而需要住院治疗。

paras.en: State officials urged Wisconsinites to be proactive in preventing illness to protect themselves and their communities, saying the best way to prevent measles is with the measles, mumps, rubella (MMR) vaccine.
paras.zh: 州官员敦促威斯康星州人积极预防疾病，以保护自己和社区，并表示预防麻疹的最佳方法是接种麻疹、腮腺炎、风疹 (MMR) 疫苗。

paras.en: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services previously told FOX News Digital that "Secretary Kennedy and CDC Director Dr. Erica Schwartz continue to make clear that the MMR vaccine is the most effective way to prevent measles."
paras.zh: 美国卫生与公众服务部此前向福克斯新闻数字频道表示，“肯尼迪部长和疾病预防控制中心主任埃丽卡·施瓦茨博士继续明确表示，MMR 疫苗是预防麻疹的最有效方法。”

paras.en: Earlier this week, a child in New York state's Lewis County died in the first known measles-associated death in the state in more than 30 years.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，纽约州刘易斯县一名儿童死亡，这是该州 30 多年来首例已知的麻疹相关死亡事件。

paras.en: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul said she was "heartbroken" to learn of the child's death.
paras.zh: 纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔 (Kathy Hochul) 表示，得知孩子的死讯，她“心碎”。

paras.en: "As a mother and grandmother, I cannot imagine what this family is going through. My heart goes out to everyone who knew and loved this child," Hochul said in a statement.
paras.zh: 霍赫尔在一份声明中说：“作为一名母亲和祖母，我无法想象这个家庭正在经历什么。我的心与所有认识和爱这个孩子的人同在。”

paras.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has reported four measles-associated deaths across the country this year, although state health departments have reported higher figures.
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心报告称，今年全国有四例与麻疹相关的死亡，但各州卫生部门报告的数字更高。

paras.en: In Pennsylvania, state health officials have confirmed six measles-associated deaths in 2026 and are investigating another reported death that has not yet met the state's criteria to be classified as measles-associated.
paras.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州，州卫生官员已确认 2026 年有 6 例与麻疹相关的死亡，并正在调查另一起报告的死亡事件，该死亡尚未符合该州归类为与麻疹相关的标准。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon tells double murder trial shooting of Jesse Baird wasn’t intentional but ‘it was my fault’
articles.author: Ima Caldwell and Kat Wong

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon “stands by” his decision to shoot Jesse Baird but did not intend to kill him, the New South Wales supreme court has heard.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州最高法院获悉，博·拉马尔-康登“坚持”射杀杰西·贝尔德的决定，但无意杀死他。

paras.en: The former police officer is accused of fatally shooting Baird and his partner, Luke Davies, with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home in Sydney on 19 February 2024.
paras.zh: 这名前警官被指控于 2024 年 2 月 19 日在贝尔德位于悉尼帕丁顿的家中用警用武器射杀了贝尔德和他的搭档卢克·戴维斯。

paras.en: He has pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder and one charge of aggravated break and enter.
paras.zh: 他对两项谋杀罪和一项严重闯入罪指控不认罪。

paras.en: Lamarre-Condon continued giving evidence in the double murder trial on Friday, telling the court about the moment he allegedly shot Baird.
paras.zh: 周五，拉马尔-康登继续在双重谋杀案审判中提供证据，向法庭讲述了他据称枪杀贝尔德的那一刻。

paras.en: “That first shot into Jesse’s right shoulder was the right move. I stand by it,” he said.
paras.zh: “杰西右肩的第一枪是正确的举动。我坚持这一点，”他说。

paras.en: He claimed Baird had lunged at him with a knife and told the court he deliberately aimed his gun at the right shoulder, believing it would not kill Baird.
paras.zh: 他声称贝尔德用刀刺向他，并告诉法庭，他故意用枪瞄准右肩，认为这不会杀死贝尔德。

paras.en: “As police officers we are trained to shoot people at the centre of body mass … I had a split-second moment where I said, ‘Drop the knife’ … It was just police mode now,” he said from the witness box.
paras.zh: “作为警察，我们接受的训练是向人的身体中心开枪……我有那么一瞬间说，‘放下刀’……现在只是警察模式，”他在证人席上说道。

paras.en: “If I didn’t do that I was 110% going to have that knife driven into my throat.”
paras.zh: “如果我不这样做，我 110% 就会被那把刀插进我的喉咙。”

paras.en: However, Lamarre-Condon repeatedly told the court he “did not want to kill Jesse”.
paras.zh: 然而，拉马尔-康登多次告诉法庭，他“不想杀死杰西”。

paras.en: “Jesse did not deserve anything like that to happen to him,” he told the court.
paras.zh: “杰西不应该让这样的事情发生在他身上，”他告诉法庭。

paras.en: “He did nothing to me to deserve to be killed.”
paras.zh: “他对我没有做过任何值得被杀的事。”

paras.en: During his second day in the witness box, Lamarre-Condon told the jury he entered Baird’s home on 19 February 2024 because he wanted to retrieve his belongings from the house without being recognised.
paras.zh: 在出庭的第二天，拉马尔-康登告诉陪审团，他于 2024 年 2 月 19 日进入贝尔德的家，因为他想在不被认出的情况下从家里取回自己的物品。

paras.en: He claimed he did not want to come into contact with Baird due to a risk the other man could take out an apprehended violence order against him as Baird had previously asked him to “please refrain from contacting me”.
paras.zh: 他声称他不想与贝尔德接触，因为另一名男子可能会对他采取暴力逮捕令，因为贝尔德此前曾要求他“请不要与我联系”。

paras.en: Lamarre-Condon told the court he had seen what he assumed to be someone’s delivery motorcycle: “As soon as I saw that I had an idea … I saw a hi-vis hooded jacket, waterproof long pants and gloves.
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登告诉法庭，他看到了他认为是某人的送货摩托车：“当我看到我有一个想法时……我看到了一件反光连帽夹克、防水长裤和手套。

paras.en: “This moment here … I wish that I didn’t do this … But I had the thought process that if I was to put on this helmet and outfit I could knock on Jesse’s door I would look like an UberEats driver without any verbal interaction with Jesse.”
paras.zh: “此时此刻……我希望我没有这样做……但我的想法是，如果我戴上头盔和这套衣服，我就可以敲杰西的门，我会看起来像一个 UberEats 司机，而无需与杰西进行任何口头互动。”

paras.en: The accused thought Baird’s room was empty when he entered the home, he told the court.
paras.zh: 被告告诉法庭，当贝尔德进入家中时，他认为他的房间是空的。

paras.en: He looked through some storage boxes in Baird’s home in search of his belongings, including a Cartier ring and a $2,000 shirt, but could not find them, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，他翻遍了贝尔德家中的一些储物箱，寻找自己的物品，包括一枚卡地亚戒指和一件价值 2,000 美元的衬衫，但没有找到。

paras.en: When he looked up, he saw Baird with a knife and tape, sealing boxes, and said the other man began yelling, “We’re getting robbed,” the jury heard.
paras.zh: 当他抬起头时，他看到贝尔德拿着刀和胶带正在密封盒子，并说另一个人开始大喊：“我们被抢劫了，”陪审团听到。

paras.en: Lamarre-Condon said he was still wearing the motorcycle helmet and had his firearm in a holster under his shirt when Baird saw him.
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登说，当贝尔德看到他时，他仍然戴着摩托车头盔，枪支放在衬衫下的皮套里。

paras.en: “He started yelling, ‘We’re getting robbed, we’re getting robbed,’ … He couldn’t see it was me because the visor was down,” Lamarre-Condon said.
paras.zh: “他开始大喊，‘我们被抢劫了，我们被抢劫了’……他看不到是我，因为遮阳板放下了，”拉马尔-康登说。

paras.en: He told the court Baird pinned him against a wall with his left forearm while “swinging around the knife” in his other hand as the officer yelled: “It’s Beau, calm the fuck down.”
paras.zh: 他告诉法庭，贝尔德用左前臂将他按在墙上，另一只手“挥舞着刀”，警官大喊：“是博，他妈的冷静点。”

paras.en: He said he then had a “very, very clear thought”.
paras.zh: 他说他当时有一个“非常非常清晰的想法”。

paras.en: “[I thought] shoot him in the shoulder so you don’t kill him, so he drops the knife,” he told the court.
paras.zh: “[我想]朝他的肩膀开枪，这样你就不会杀死他，所以他放下了刀，”他告诉法庭。

paras.en: Lamarre-Condon claimed he then fired the gun, but the two continued to struggle and the officer’s finger remained on the trigger, the jury heard.
paras.zh: 陪审团获悉，拉马尔-康登声称他随后开枪，但两人继续挣扎，警官的手指仍然放在扳机上。

paras.en: They tripped over a storage box on the ground, which is when Lamarre-Condon “accidentally” discharged the gun.
paras.zh: 他们被地上的一个储物箱绊倒，拉马尔-康登“不小心”开枪了。

paras.en: He told the court: “It was my fault … I am guilty of manslaughter … But it wasn’t intentional.”
paras.zh: 他告诉法庭：“这是我的错……我犯有过失杀人罪……但这不是故意的。”

paras.en: Under cross-examination from crown prosecutor Brett Hatfield SC, Lamarre-Condon repeated that he “stands by” the decision to take the first shot.
paras.zh: 在皇家检察官布雷特·哈特菲尔德 SC 的盘问下，拉马尔·康登重申，他“支持”进行第一枪的决定。

paras.en: “If I didn’t, Mr Crown, you would be sitting here today interrogating Mr Baird,” he said.
paras.zh: “如果我不这样做，克朗先生，你今天就会坐在这里审问贝尔德先生，”他说。

paras.en: Asked by Hatfield if he shot Baird in the back, Lamarre-Condon said: “That’s not accurate, that’s not true.”
paras.zh: 当哈特菲尔德问他是否从背后开枪射击贝尔德时，拉马尔-康登说：“那不准确，那不是真的。”

paras.en: While Lamarre-Condon said Baird’s shooting was his fault, he maintained Davies shot himself.
paras.zh: 虽然拉马尔-康登表示贝尔德的投篮是他的错，但他坚称戴维斯是开枪自杀的。

paras.en: After the first two shots, the jury heard that Lamarre-Condon dialled the emergency hotline to try to get help for Baird.
paras.zh: 前两声枪响后，陪审团得知拉马尔-康登拨打了紧急热线，试图为贝尔德寻求帮助。

paras.en: But when he looked up, he saw Davies, who he didn’t recognise at the time.
paras.zh: 但当他抬起头时，他看到了戴维斯，但他当时并不认识戴维斯。

paras.en: The accused claimed the other man had picked up his gun.
paras.zh: 被告声称另一名男子拿起了他的枪。

paras.en: “It was pointed towards me at my chest and he said: ‘I’m going to fucking shoot you,’” he told the court.
paras.zh: “它指着我的胸口，他说：‘我他妈的要开枪打死你，’”他告诉法庭。

paras.en: “I started lowering my body towards the ground. I said, ‘Please don’t shoot me, I’m not here to shoot you. I’m not a threat I’m not here to hurt you.’
paras.zh: “我开始将身体降低到地面。我说，‘请不要开枪打我，我不是来开枪打你的。我不是威胁，我不是来伤害你的。’

paras.en: “That’s when he raised the gun towards my head and said, ‘Fuck off.’”
paras.zh: “就在那时，他举起枪指着我的头说，‘滚开。’”

paras.en: The former officer said police are trained to redirect gun muzzles when firearms are pointed at them.
paras.zh: 这名前警官表示，警察接受过训练，当有人用枪指着他们时，他们会改变枪口的方向。

paras.en: “I saw the gun, he was holding it with both hands, I thought, ‘fuck he’s going to fire the gun’ and that’s where my police training kicked in,” he told the court.
paras.zh: “我看到那把枪，他双手拿着枪，我想，‘操，他要开枪了’，这就是我的警察训练开始的地方，”他告诉法庭。

paras.en: “My left hand would have grabbed Luke’s left wrist and turned it away … my other hand pushed against the forearm and then I pushed the pivot point of the left wrist away from me.”
paras.zh: “我的左手会抓住卢克的左手腕并将其转开……我的另一只手推着前臂，然后我将左手腕的枢轴点推离我。”

paras.en: Asked by the defence lawyer whether the gun went off, Lamarre-Condon said: “Yes, during this motion. And it got Luke.”
paras.zh: 当辩护律师询问枪是否爆炸时，拉马尔-康登说：“是的，在这次动议期间。它击中了卢克。”

paras.en: Baird’s mother, Helen, left the courtroom partway through Lamarre-Condon’s evidence.
paras.zh: 贝尔德的母亲海伦在拉马尔-康登作证时中途离开了法庭。

paras.en: The trial before Justice Natalie Adams continues.
paras.zh: 娜塔莉·亚当斯法官的审判仍在继续。

articles.title: Bondi beach shooting: Eva Geller, 90, shot during massacre dies in hospital year after antisemitic attack
articles.author: Penry Buckley NSW state reporter

paras.en: A woman who was shot during the Bondi beach terror attack has died in hospital almost 12 months after the massacre.
paras.zh: 一名在邦迪海滩恐怖袭击中被枪杀的妇女在大屠杀发生近 12 个月后在医院死亡。

paras.en: Eva Geller, 90, had been in and out of hospital this year for treatment of injuries sustained during the attack on 14 December, a senior Jewish community source said on Friday.
paras.zh: 一位犹太社区资深消息人士周五表示，90 岁的伊娃·盖勒 (Eva Geller) 今年曾因 12 月 14 日袭击事件中受伤而进出医院。

paras.en: She had recently returned to hospital after developing an infection, where she died after having a stroke, the source said.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，她最近因感染而返回医院，并因中风死亡。

paras.en: Her funeral was scheduled to take place on Monday. A family spokesperson requested “privacy during this difficult time”.
paras.zh: 她的葬礼定于周一举行。一位家庭发言人要求“在这个困难时期保持隐私”。

paras.en: Rabbi Aron Moss from the Nefesh Synagogue in Sydney said Geller was “a mother, a grandmother, a great-grandmother, a positive person” who had escaped the Holocaust as a child with her family.
paras.zh: 悉尼尼菲什犹太教堂 (Nefesh Synagogue) 的拉比阿伦·莫斯 (Rabbi Aron Moss) 表示，盖勒是“一位母亲、一位祖母、一位曾祖母、一个积极的人”，她小时候与家人一起逃离了大屠杀。

paras.en: “She came to Australia, started a new life, a beautiful family and was strong and pretty healthy, right up until the Bondi attack, where she was shot.
paras.zh: “她来到澳大利亚，开始了新的生活，拥有了一个美好的家庭，身体很强壮，也很健康，直到邦迪袭击事件中她被枪杀。

paras.en: “Everyone in the community really loved her, loved being in her presence,” he said.
paras.zh: “社区里的每个人都非常爱她，喜欢和她在一起，”他说。

paras.en: “It’s just devastating to think that she’s gone. She’ll be sorely missed, very fondly remembered, and we just pray that her family have a lot of strength and comfort at this time.”
paras.zh: “一想到她已经离开了，真是令人心碎。我们会非常想念她，深情地怀念她，我们只是祈祷她的家人此时能得到很大的力量和安慰。”

paras.en: The prime minister, Anthony Albanese, said on Friday he was saddened to hear of Geller’s death, saying “her life was changed forever by an act of terror and antisemitism”.
paras.zh: 总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯周五表示，他对盖勒的去世感到悲痛，并表示“恐怖和反犹太主义行为永远改变了她的生活”。

paras.en: “We are wrapping our arms around Eva’s family, friends and the Jewish community at this very sad time.”
paras.zh: “在这个非常悲伤的时刻，我们拥抱伊娃的家人、朋友和犹太社区。”

paras.en: The New South Wales premier, Chris Minns, said the news of Geller’s death was “heartbreaking”.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州州长克里斯·明斯表示，盖勒去世的消息“令人心碎”。

paras.en: “My thoughts are with Eva’s family and the Jewish community as they face another painful loss,” he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“我的心与伊娃的家人和犹太社区同在，因为他们面临着又一次痛苦的损失。”

paras.en: The NSW opposition leader, Kellie Sloane, whose Vaucluse electorate takes in Bondi beach, said the death was “a heartbreaking reminder of the ongoing pain that remains for many people from last year’s terror attack”.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州反对党领袖凯莉·斯隆（Kellie Sloane）的沃克吕兹选区位于邦迪海滩，他表示，这起死亡事件“令人心碎地提醒人们，去年的恐怖袭击仍然给许多人带来持续的痛苦”。

paras.en: “We must continue to support the Jewish community, first responders and all victims.”
paras.zh: “我们必须继续支持犹太社区、急救人员和所有受害者。”

paras.en: In a statement on Friday afternoon, New South Wales police said they were aware of the death.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警方在周五下午的一份声明中表示，他们已经知道这起死亡事件。

paras.en: A spokesperson said police were “awaiting further advice and are working with the office of the coroner”.
paras.zh: 一位发言人表示，警方正在“等待进一步的建议，并正在与验尸官办公室合作”。

paras.en: Fifteen people died after Naveed Akram, 24, and his father, 50-year-old Sajid Akram, opened fire at the Hanukkah festival at Bondi beach on 14 December last year. Forty people were injured.
paras.zh: 去年 12 月 14 日，24 岁的纳维德·阿克拉姆 (Naveed Akram) 和他 50 岁的父亲萨吉德·阿克拉姆 (Sajid Akram) 在邦迪海滩光明节期间开枪，造成 15 人死亡。四十人受伤。

paras.en: Sajid was shot dead by police at the scene. Naveed has been charged with 78 offences, including 15 counts of murder and one count of committing a terrorist act that investigators allege may have been “inspired by Isis”. He remains before the courts.
paras.zh: 萨吉德当场被警察击毙。纳维德被指控犯有 78 项罪名，其中包括 15 项谋杀罪和一项调查人员声称可能“受伊斯兰国启发”的恐怖行为罪。他仍然出庭受审。

articles.title: Friday briefing: ​After a week of disruption, is living with threats our new normal?
articles.author: Libby Brooks

paras.en: Good morning. A multiplicity of hoax bomb threats divert passenger flights across Europe. A malign cyber-attack targets supermarket fridges in Belgium, Sweden, the UK and – in a sickening escalation – the cold storage facilities of France’s national blood service.
paras.zh: 早上好。多种恶作剧炸弹威胁导致整个欧洲的客运航班改道。一场恶意网络攻击的目标是比利时、瑞典、英国的超市冰箱，以及法国国家血液服务机构的冷藏设施（情况令人作呕）。

paras.en: The actors behind this week of chaos and disruption, be they hostile states or criminal gangs – or even enterprising teenagers – are yet to be identified. But what is certain is that they operate in a context of deepening global conflicts, building national threat and an accompanying, pervasive sense of vulnerability.
paras.zh: 本周混乱和破坏的幕后黑手，无论是敌对国家还是犯罪团伙，甚至是有进取心的青少年，目前尚不清楚。但可以肯定的是，它们是在全球冲突日益加深、国家威胁不断形成以及随之而来的普遍脆弱感的背景下运作的。

paras.en: Welcome to the grey zone – that ambiguous space between routine peace and conventional military conflict, where proxies duck state accountability and cyber-tactics are developing at an alarming rate.
paras.zh: 欢迎来到灰色地带——例行和平与常规军事冲突之间的模糊地带，代理人逃避国家责任，而网络战术正在以惊人的速度发展。

paras.en: - UK news | Russell Brand has been found guilty of raping a woman and sexually assaulting three others over the course of five years of his show business career.
paras.zh: - 英国新闻|拉塞尔·布兰德被判在五年的演艺生涯中强奸一名妇女并性侵犯另外三人。

paras.en: - US politics | Donald Trump signed a proclamation that he says will prevent future administrations from changing his design of the Oval Office and Cabinet Room, spaces he declared as national monuments that should be preserved.
paras.zh: - 美国政治|唐纳德·特朗普签署了一份公告，他表示这将阻止未来的政府改变他对椭圆形办公室和内阁室的设计，他宣称这些空间是应该保护的国家古迹。

paras.en: - UK politics | Andy Burnham has said he wants to “recast” the UK’s deal to cede control of the Chagos Islands after resistance from Washington.
paras.zh: - 英国政治|安迪·伯纳姆表示，在遭到华盛顿的抵制后，他希望“重新制定”英国放弃查戈斯群岛控制权的协议。

paras.en: - Health | Cancer diagnoses in England have hit record highs, with more than 1,000 people a day diagnosed, NHS figures show.
paras.zh: - 健康 | NHS 数据显示，英国的癌症诊断人数创下历史新高，每天有超过 1,000 人被诊断出癌症。

paras.en: - World news | The UN-recognised government of Yemen has shaken up its political and military leadership in an attempt to regain territory lost to the Houthis in September.
paras.zh: - 世界新闻|联合国承认的也门政府已经动摇了其政治和军事领导层，试图收复胡塞武装9月份失去的领土。

paras.en: In depth: ‘Terrorism doesn’t have to be violent. The purpose is to scare’
paras.zh: 深入：“恐怖主义不一定是暴力的。目的是吓唬人”

paras.en: Hoax bomb threats disrupted at least 25 different commercial flights across Europe yesterday, with some forced to make emergency landings, and after similar threats on Tuesday, when seven planes were searched or diverted after malicious alerts.
paras.zh: 昨天，骗局炸弹威胁扰乱了欧洲各地至少 25 架不同的商业航班，其中一些航班被迫紧急降落，周二也发生了类似的威胁，七架飞机在恶意警报后被搜查或改道。

paras.en: There is, at least so for, no suggestion of orchestration by a hostile terror group or state actor according to investigators, although investigations continue. It’s perfectly possible that this could be the work of some lone disruptors, says Dan, who reminds me that “airlines receive bomb threats on a daily basis, at a rate that we would find extraordinary if we knew”. Nonetheless, the fact that these airlines are treating these threats as credible suggests a potential level of coordination, aviation experts told the Guardian on Thursday.
paras.zh: 尽管调查仍在继续，但调查人员表示，至少没有迹象表明这是敌对恐怖组织或国家行为者精心策划的。丹说，这完全有可能是一些单独的破坏者所为。他提醒我，“航空公司每天都会收到炸弹威胁，如果我们知道的话，其速度会非常惊人”。尽管如此，航空专家周四告诉《卫报》，这些航空公司将这些威胁视为可信的事实表明了潜在的协调程度。

paras.en: These threats take place with aviation security under sharper scrutiny after the flydubai incident, when a pilot fought off his knife-wielding colleague in an apparent attempt to crash a full passenger flight heading for Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 在迪拜航空事件发生后，这些威胁发生，航空安全受到更严格的审查，当时一名飞行员击退了他持刀的同事，显然是试图撞毁一架飞往特拉维夫的满客航班。

paras.en: But beyond that “jittery background noise”, is a significant step-change in the manner of threat we face. Twenty-five years on from the inception of the War on Terror, when Islamist terrorism has receded relative to the hostile state threats, “we’re living in a different world with familiar uncertainties, but attributed to different players,” Dan tells me.
paras.zh: 但除了“紧张的背景噪音”之外，我们面临的威胁方式也发生了重大变化。反恐战争开始二十五年后，伊斯兰恐怖主义相对于敌对国家威胁已经消退，“我们生活在一个不同的世界，充满熟悉的不确定性，但归因于不同的参与者，”丹告诉我。

paras.en: Conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East are reverberating closer to home. Since 2022, we’ve witnessed intensifying acts of sabotage on European states that are believed to trace back to Russia but deliberately fall below the threshold for military response – a so-called hybrid or “shadow war” with the singular purpose of disrupting support for Ukraine. Only two months ago, an alleged attack plot on RAF Fairford was organised by a handler police believe was working on behalf of Iran.
paras.zh: 乌克兰和中东的冲突正在国内产生影响。自 2022 年以来，我们目睹了针对欧洲国家的破坏行为不断加剧，据信这些行为可以追溯到俄罗斯，但故意低于军事反应的门槛 — — 所谓的混合或“影子战争”，其唯一目的是破坏对乌克兰的支持。就在两个月前，据称针对英国皇家空军费尔福德空军基地的袭击阴谋是由一名警方负责人组织的，警方认为该人代表伊朗工作。

paras.en: Meanwhile, tech expert Azeem Azhar warned recently that the internet is experiencing it’s own Wuhan moment, as AI enables bad actors to hunt for system flaws and spread them, mirroring the early days of the Covid pandemic.
paras.zh: 与此同时，技术专家 Azeem Azhar 最近警告说，互联网正在经历自己的“武汉时刻”，因为人工智能使不良行为者能够寻找系统缺陷并传播它们，这与新冠病毒大流行初期的情况如出一辙。

paras.en: “Terrorism doesn’t have to be violent to terrorise,” says Dan. “The purpose of terrorism is to scare.”
paras.zh: “恐怖主义不一定要通过暴力来恐吓，”丹说。 “恐怖主义的目的是恐吓。”

paras.en: Ratcheting up disruption, and the accompanying psychological hit, is precisely what we’ve seen elsewhere this week. Supermarket fridges and freezers in seven European countries malfunctioned earlier this week, their thermostats remotely cranked up in some cases to 50C, in what some fear indicates a new front in hacking tactics.
paras.zh: 加剧的破坏以及随之而来的心理打击正是我们本周在其他地方看到的。本周早些时候，七个欧洲国家的超市冰箱和冰柜出现故障，恒温器在某些情况下远程调至 50 摄氏度，一些人担心这表明黑客策略出现了新的战线。

paras.en: Similar incidents have been reported in the UK, and I spoke to our global technology editor Dan Milmo on his way back from interviewing a fruit and veg wholesaler based near Heathrow, whose fridges went on the blink on Monday. The experience has prompted him to add some tinned goods to his weekend shopping list.
paras.zh: 英国也发生过类似事件，我在采访希思罗附近一家水果和蔬菜批发商回来的路上采访了我们的全球科技编辑 Dan Milmo，该公司的冰箱周一出现了故障。这次经历促使他在周末购物清单中添加了一些罐头食品。

paras.en: “There are only ever two likely candidates for a hack,” Dan tells me. “Criminal gangs or nation states.” He adds an emerging tertiary category of “troublesome teenagers”, such as the loose collective of English-speaking hackers Scattered Spider, two of whom were jailed in July for their attack on Transport for London.
paras.zh: “只有两个可能的黑客候选者，”丹告诉我。 “犯罪团伙或民族国家。”他补充道，新兴的第三类“麻烦青少年”，例如松散的英语黑客组织“分散的蜘蛛”，其中两人于 7 月因袭击伦敦交通局而入狱。

paras.en: One cybersecurity researcher told Dan that attacks on dummy Danfoss fridge controls – one of the software systems also targeted by the hackers in mainland Europe – had “all the hallmarks” of operations linked to Russia.
paras.zh: 一位网络安全研究人员告诉丹，对虚拟丹佛斯冰箱控制系统的攻击（也是欧洲大陆黑客攻击的软件系统之一）具有与俄罗斯有关的操作的“所有特征”。

paras.en: What are security services doing about these threats?
paras.zh: 安全部门正在采取哪些措施应对这些威胁？

paras.en: “There is a very real and intense cyberwar going on out there,” Dan Sabbagh tells me, and security agencies in the UK have viewed technological resilience as a key part of their responsibility for a number of years. The Turing Institute, for example, is looking at ways to utilise AI to make critical infrastructure systems more secure.
paras.zh: 丹·萨巴格 (Dan Sabbagh) 告诉我：“那里正在发生一场非常真实且激烈的网络战。”多年来，英国安全机构一直将技术弹性视为其责任的关键部分。例如，图灵研究所正在寻找利用人工智能使关键基础设施系统更加安全的方法。

paras.en: The police and security services are monitoring for threats all the time – MI5 has about 3,000 active subjects of interest currently – arranged in a hierarchy, with an understandable focus on the more serious ones, including threats to life. But lower level activity that is not obviously threatening, whether that’s online activity or buying paint with the intention of daubing racist graffiti, can be harder to pick up. As with other public services, this is a resourcing question as much as anything else.
paras.zh: 警察和安全部门一直在监控威胁——军情五处目前大约有 3,000 个感兴趣的活跃对象——按层次结构排列，重点关注更严重的威胁，包括生命威胁，这是可以理解的。但没有明显威胁的低水平活动，无论是在线活动还是购买油漆以涂抹种族主义涂鸦，可能更难发现。与其他公共服务一样，这也是一个资源问题。

paras.en: Is chaos easier to generate in our interconnected world?
paras.zh: 在我们这个相互关联的世界中，混乱是否更容易产生？

paras.en: I put this to our global technology reporter Aisha Down, who explains that many hacks happen though edge devices – networked items that are connected to the internet but don’t have processing power and so aren’t the main focus of security upgrades by a company or household.
paras.zh: 我把这个问题告诉了我们的全球科技记者 Aisha Down，她解释说，许多黑客攻击都是通过边缘设备发生的，边缘设备是连接到互联网但没有处理能力的联网设备，因此不是公司或家庭安全升级的主要焦点。

paras.en: Famously, in 2016, North Korea came within a few keystrokes of pulling off a billion-dollar heist by hacking the Bank of Bangladesh via an unsecured printer.
paras.zh: 众所周知，2016 年，朝鲜通过一台不安全的打印机入侵了孟加拉国银行，只需敲击几下键盘就可以实现价值十亿美元的抢劫。

paras.en: Aisha is keen to dial down the panic. The point about cyber-attacks is that every single one is opportunistic: a hacker has to find a vulnerability and then discover a way to exploit it. “Just like a burglary, you might get into the room where all the jewellery is stored,” she says, “but the damage you can do is not a given.”
paras.zh: 艾莎渴望平息恐慌。关于网络攻击的一点是，每一次攻击都是机会主义的：黑客必须找到漏洞，然后找到利用它的方法。 “就像入室盗窃一样，你可能会进入存放所有珠宝的房间，”她说，“但你可能造成的损失并不是一定的。”

paras.en: There is, however, a steady escalation in this type of threat. Aisha gives the example of Finland which, given its proximity to Russia, is watching cyber-tactics very closely. “What people report to their national cybersecurity centre is growing, from 18,000 reports last year for a population of 6 million people, to 21,000 this year.” This can be partly traced back to a developing criminal hacking ecosystem, some with loose links to the Russian state.
paras.zh: 然而，此类威胁正在稳步升级。艾莎举了芬兰的例子，由于靠近俄罗斯，芬兰正在密切关注网络战术。 “人们向国家网络安全中心报告的内容正在不断增加，从去年针对 600 万人的 18,000 份报告增加到今年的 21,000 份报告。”这在一定程度上可以追溯到不断发展的犯罪黑客生态系统，其中一些与俄罗斯政府有着松散的联系。

paras.en: While a key element of a cyber-attack is the psychological impact, that can be hard to square with the UK government’s own Be Ready initiative, which advises us to off-set threats of hybrid warfare and hostile state sabotage by stockpiling 72 hours’ worth of emergency supplies – including water, beans and Twiglets (if you’re Andy Burnham). Indeed, governments across Europe are advising citizens to build up non-perishable larders.
paras.zh: 虽然网络攻击的一个关键要素是心理影响，但这可能很难与英国政府自己的“做好准备”倡议相一致，该倡议建议我们通过储备 72 小时的应急物资来抵消混合战争和敌对国家破坏的威胁，包括水、豆类和小树枝（如果你是安迪·伯纳姆）。事实上，欧洲各国政府都建议公民建立不易腐烂的食品储藏室。

paras.en: It’s perhaps useful to balance the likelihood of a cyber-attack with the potential scope, suggests Aisha, who confesses she’s too busy sourcing furniture for her new flat to think about tinned goods.
paras.zh: 艾莎表示，平衡网络攻击的可能性和潜在范围可能很有用，她承认自己正忙着为新公寓采购家具，无暇考虑罐头食品。

paras.en: One European cybersecurity official told Aisha recently that there’s a vulnerability in every 1,500 lines of code, on average.
paras.zh: 一位欧洲网络安全官员最近告诉 Aisha，平均每 1,500 行代码就有一个漏洞。

paras.en: “Their view is: it’s going to happen. It’s going to be opportunistic. But, unlike bombing a power station in the dead of winter, you won’t be offline for months.”
paras.zh: “他们的观点是：这将会发生。这将是机会主义的。但是，与在隆冬轰炸发电站不同，你不会在几个月内离线。”

paras.en: With that perspective, keeping a bunch of tenners handy to see you through a few days of disruption makes sense.
paras.zh: 从这个角度来看，在手边准备一堆钱来帮助你度过几天的混乱是有意义的。

paras.en: As for stockpiling food and water, Dan is still debating with his partner just how necessary those extra tins of peas really are. “If you’re a government wanting to spend £10bn more on defence by the end of the decade, it’s useful to have that message about keeping a few bottles of water at home,” he says.
paras.zh: 至于储存食物和水，丹仍在与他的搭档争论这些额外的豌豆罐头到底有多大必要。他说：“如果你的政府希望在本世纪末在国防上增加 100 亿英镑的支出，那么传达关于在家里保留几瓶水的信息会很有用。”

paras.en: To be clear: it’s not Dan’s intention to dismiss stockpiling advice as a purely cynical exercise. The developing threats are all too real. But as he puts it: “If the purpose of terrorism is to generate fear, the first thing you should do is not panic and keep calm.”
paras.zh: 需要明确的是：丹并不是有意将库存建议视为纯粹的愤世嫉俗的行为而予以驳回。不断发展的威胁实在是太真实了。但正如他所说：“如果恐怖主义的目的是制造恐惧，那么你首先应该做的就是不要惊慌，保持冷静。”

paras.en: - Christmas decorations are adorable, but they definitely create a lot of waste. I enjoyed reading the best reusable Christmas things. Lysia
paras.zh: - 圣诞装饰品很可爱，但它们肯定会造成很多浪费。我喜欢阅读最好的可重复使用的圣诞物品。吕西亚

paras.en: - Parts of Erin Somers’ piece on lab-grown meat made me salivate, others made me nauseous. I was entirely immersed in her quest to find out why it never really took off. Micha
paras.zh: - 艾琳·萨默斯（Erin Somers）关于实验室培育的肉的文章的部分内容让我垂涎欲滴，另一些则让我感到恶心。我完全沉浸在她的探索中，想找出为什么它从未真正起飞。米夏

paras.en: - If I wrote a masterpiece during the Enlightenment I too would probably believe I was mythical. I hadn’t heard of Jan Potocki or his werewolf ways before reading Tobias Grey’s article. Lysia
paras.zh: - 如果我在启蒙运动期间写出一部杰作，我也可能会相信我是神话。在阅读托比亚斯·格雷的文章之前，我没有听说过简·波托茨基或他的狼人之道。吕西亚

paras.en: Football | Sunderland’s unbeaten run in the Europa League came to an end as they were beaten 2-0 by Dinamo Zagreb at the Stadium of Light, while Celtic got off the mark in a 3-2 victory over Besiktas.
paras.zh: 足球 |桑德兰在光明球场0-2不敌萨格勒布迪纳摩，结束了欧罗巴联赛的不败纪录，而凯尔特人则以3-2战胜贝西克塔斯。

paras.en: Rugby union | Tom Curry has emerged as a major doubt for England’s autumn opener against Australia on Sunday, handing Steve Borthwick a huge blow before a crucial November campaign.
paras.zh: 橄榄球联盟 |汤姆·库里（Tom Curry）成为英格兰队周日对阵澳大利亚队的秋季揭幕战的一大疑点，他在11月关键的比赛之前给史蒂夫·博斯威克（Steve Borthwick）带来了巨大的打击。

paras.en: Football | Cristiano Ronaldo has announced that he will not play for Portugal any more, ending an international career that spanned six World Cups and included a European title and the men’s all-time scoring record.
paras.zh: 足球 |克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多 (Cristiano Ronaldo) 宣布，他将不再为葡萄牙队效力，结束了他六届世界杯、欧洲冠军头衔和男子足球历史进球纪录的国家队生涯。

paras.en: Our critics’ roundup of the best things to watch, read, play and listen to right now
paras.zh: 我们的评论家对当前最值得观看、阅读、播放和聆听的内容进行了总结

paras.en: Constantinople to Istanbul (V&A, London) | ★★★★★
paras.zh: 君士坦丁堡飞往伊斯坦布尔（V&A，伦敦） | 航班★★★★★

paras.en: With tiled portraits and handmade robes, Victoria and Albert’s new exhibition showcases the colours of the Ottoman and Byzantine Empires. Read Jonathan Jones’s full review.
paras.zh: 维多利亚和阿尔伯特的新展览通过瓷砖肖像和手工长袍展示了奥斯曼帝国和拜占庭帝国的色彩。阅读乔纳森·琼斯的完整评论。

paras.en: Sylvester Stallone stars as himself in his latest film. A struggling American-Italian desperate to get his screenplay “Rocky” out there. Read Peter Bradshaw’s full review.
paras.zh: 西尔维斯特·史泰龙在他的最新电影中饰演他自己。一位苦苦挣扎的美裔意大利人迫切希望将自己的剧本《洛奇》问世。阅读 Peter Bradshaw 的完整评论。

paras.en: Keira Knightely returns to our screens as Helen Webb, an undercover spy and protagonist of Netflix drama Black Doves. Alongside her espionage work, she certainly keeps busy as a mother, wife to the prime minister and best friend to a hitman. Read Rachel Aroesti’s full review.
paras.zh: 凯拉·奈特利以海伦·韦伯的身份重返银幕，她是一名卧底间谍，也是 Netflix 电视剧《黑鸽子》的主角。除了从事间谍工作外，她还作为母亲、首相的妻子和杀手最好的朋友而忙碌。阅读 Rachel Aroesti 的完整评论。

paras.en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time | ★★★★★
paras.zh: 塞尔达传说：时之笛 | ★★★★★

paras.en: After changing a generation of gamers and their childhoods, The legend of Zelda lives on. Yesterday, Link came back to Nintendo screens, just in better definition and with fully voiced cutscenes. Read Keza MacDonald’s full review.
paras.zh: 《塞尔达传说》改变了一代游戏玩家和他们的童年，但它仍将继续存在。昨天，《林克》回到了任天堂的屏幕上，只是清晰度更好，并且有全配音的过场动画。阅读 Keza MacDonald 的完整评论。

paras.en: “Brand faces ‘significant’ prison term for rape and sexual assault”, is the Guardian’s front page today. The Times writes “Brand found guilty of rape”, the Telegraph says “BBC ‘enabled’ rapist Brand”, the Sun has “Rapist”, and the Mirror’s take is “Justice”. On the same story, the Mail splashes “Downfall of the swaggering sex predator fawned over by the Left”, and Metro has “Rapist Brand caged”.
paras.zh: “布兰德因强奸和性侵犯而面临‘严重’监禁”，这是《卫报》今天的头版。 《泰晤士报》写道“布兰德犯有强奸罪”，《电讯报》称“BBC‘启用’了强奸犯布兰德”，《太阳报》报道了“强奸犯”，而《镜报》则报道了“正义”。在同一个故事中，《邮报》大肆报道“被左派奉承的大摇大摆的性掠夺者的垮台”，而《地铁报》则将“强奸犯品牌关进笼子”。

paras.en: Elsewhere, the i Paper leads on “Godfather of AI warns humanity: it’s all hurtling out of control”, and the FT has “Tech stocks plunge as investors worry blue wave will sink AI spending boom”.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，《i Paper》以“人工智能教父警告人类：一切都在失控”为主题，英国《金融时报》则以“投资者担心蓝色浪潮将削弱人工智能支出热潮，科技股暴跌”为题。

paras.en: Will the UK finally pay slavery reparations?
paras.zh: 英国最终会支付奴隶制赔偿吗？

paras.en: Andy Burnham has asked countries affected by Britain’s role in slavery to help shape a formal apology through a ‘structured dialogue’. During the prime minister’s visit to the Commonwealth heads of government meeting in Antigua and Barbuda, Downing Street said affected countries would play an indispensable role in crafting an enduring message. Though the plans for talks were received positively, the British government is still ruling out the idea of paying reparations, which for decades campaigners have been calling for. Lucy Hough speaks to the Guardian’s Caribbean correspondent, Natricia Duncan.
paras.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 要求受英国奴隶制影响的国家通过“结构化对话”帮助形成正式道歉。在首相访问安提瓜和巴布达举行的英联邦政府首脑会议期间，唐宁街表示，受影响国家将在制定持久信息方面发挥不可或缺的作用。尽管谈判计划得到了积极回应，但英国政府仍然排除了支付赔偿的想法，而数十年来，活动人士一直在呼吁这一点。露西·霍夫接受了《卫报》加勒比地区记者娜翠西娅·邓肯的采访。

paras.en: A bit of good news to remind you that the world’s not all bad
paras.zh: 一个好消息提醒您世界并不全是坏事

paras.en: On 25 October, as Brazil held its presidential election, 101-year-old Celia de Oliveira Soares left home for the first time in months, to vote for the first time in nearly a decade. She was determined that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (known as Lula) – who had lost in the first round – should beat the far-right candidate Flávio Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 10 月 25 日，巴西举行总统选举，101 岁的西莉亚·德奥利维拉·苏亚雷斯 (Celia de Oliveira Soares) 几个月来首次离开家，参加近十年来的首次投票。她决心在第一轮中落败的路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva，简称卢拉）应该击败极右翼候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗。

paras.en: Since Brazil’s return to democracy in the 1980s, no first-round loser has ever bounced back. But 3 million extra voters took part in the second round, after skipping the first – and 1.4 million of them were over 70 years old. The victorious Lula, along with many others, is now hailing elderly voters as the election’s heroes.
paras.zh: 自 20 世纪 80 年代巴西回归民主以来，没有哪一个首轮失败者能够东山再起。但在跳过第一轮后，又有 300 万额外选民参加了第二轮，其中 140 万年龄在 70 岁以上。获胜的卢拉和其他许多人一起，现在将老年选民视为选举的英雄。

paras.en: “It is possible to resist fascism – all you need to do is mobilise society,” the former minister Simone Tebet said. “Young people hit the streets and golden-agers saved our democracy.”
paras.zh: “抵制法西斯主义是可能的——你所需要做的就是动员社会，”前部长西蒙娜·特贝特说。 “年轻人走上街头，黄金老人拯救了我们的民主。”

paras.en: And finally, the Guardian’s puzzles are here to keep you entertained throughout the day. Until tomorrow.
paras.zh: 最后，《卫报》的谜题可以让您全天享受乐趣。直到明天。

articles.title: Global tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to AI slowdown fears

paras.en: Trillions of dollars has been wiped off the stock value of major tech firms in the US, Europe and Asia in a market rout after the US midterm elections sparked concerns of a slowdown in artificial intelligence (AI) development.
paras.zh: 在美国中期选举引发人们对人工智能（AI）发展放缓的担忧后，美国、欧洲和亚洲主要科技公司的股票价值在市场暴跌中蒸发了数万亿美元。

paras.en: Shares in firms across the tech sector plummeted following Democratic wins after election campaigns run on slowing AI.
paras.zh: 民主党在人工智能放缓的竞选活动中获胜后，科技行业公司的股价暴跌。

paras.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite index closed down by more than 5.5% on Thursday, losing an estimated $2.5tn (Â£1.9tn) in market value, according to Dow Jones data, while other key US stock indexes also saw big losses in their worst days since 2025.
paras.zh: 根据道琼斯数据，以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数周四收盘下跌超过 5.5%，市值估计损失 2.5 万亿美元（1.9 万亿英镑），而美国其他主要股指也出现了 2025 年以来最糟糕的日子里的大幅下跌。

paras.en: The sell-off comes on top of broader concerns about whether the huge amounts being spent on AI will pay off.
paras.zh: 此次抛售引发了人们对在人工智能上投入的巨额资金能否获得回报的更广泛担忧。

paras.en: In Asia, tech-heavy indexes fell sharply on Friday morning as firms that make the computer chips and other equipment that power AI saw their shares slide.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，由于生产计算机芯片和其他人工智能设备的公司股价下跌，以科技股为主的指数周五上午大幅下跌。

paras.en: The Nikkei 225 in Japan was 6.3% lower in the afternoon as shares in memory chip maker Kioxia lost almost 11.5% and rival Tokyo Electron slipped by 5.8%.
paras.zh: 日本日经 225 指数下午下跌 6.3%，存储芯片制造商 Kioxia 股价下跌近 11.5%，竞争对手东京电子下跌 5.8%。

paras.en: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix fell by more than 8.8%, while Samsung was down by around 6%.
paras.zh: 韩国芯片制造商SK海力士跌幅超过8.8%，三星跌幅约为6%。

paras.en: The sell-off in Seoul sent the Kospi index plunging more than 8% in morning trading, triggering a so-called circuit breaker, a mechanism that temporarily halts trading to curb panic selling. The Kospi was around 5% lower in the afternoon.
paras.zh: 首尔的抛售导致 Kospi 指数在早盘交易中暴跌超过 8%，触发了所谓的熔断机制，这是一种暂时停止交易以抑制恐慌性抛售的机制。下午 Kospi 指数下跌约 5%。

paras.en: The Taiwan stock market suffered its biggest weekly decline since 2001, according to LSEG data, with the Taiex falling by 4.5% on Friday.
paras.zh: 伦敦证券交易所数据显示，台湾股市遭遇 2001 年以来最大单周跌幅，台交所周五下跌 4.5%。

paras.en: It marks a "continuation of worries" over the level of spending on AI infrastructure, said MarketWatch chips analyst Britney Nguyen.
paras.zh: MarketWatch 芯片分析师 Britney Nguyen 表示，这标志着人们对人工智能基础设施支出水平的“持续担忧”。

paras.en: Democrats in races across the US campaigned to slow the growth of data centres and AI, and there were dozens of measures on ballots around the country aimed at restricting the development of the hubs crucial for powering the technology.
paras.zh: 美国各地的民主党人都在努力减缓数据中心和人工智能的发展，全国各地的投票采取了数十项措施，旨在限制对技术驱动至关重要的中心的发展。

paras.en: They won both the US Senate and House of Representatives in Tuesday's midterms, taking control of Congress for the rest of President Donald Trump's presidency.
paras.zh: 他们在周二的中期选举中赢得了美国参议院和众议院的胜利，在唐纳德·特朗普总统的剩余任期内控制了国会。

paras.en: Texas' Democratic governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned heavily against data centres, pledging a moratorium on new construction in the sector.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州民主党当选州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨 (Gina Hinojosa) 大力反对数据中心，承诺暂停该行业的新建建设。

paras.en: In a social media post, Trump blamed the slide on his political opponents.
paras.zh: 特朗普在社交媒体帖子中将此次下滑归咎于他的政治对手。

paras.en: "The Stock Market suffered one of the Worst Days in History based on the results of the Election," he said.
paras.zh: “根据选举结果，股市经历了历史上最糟糕的日子之一，”他说。

paras.en: "Remember, it wasn't Republicans, it was Dumocrats. Do not fear, however, we will soon, one way or the other, be BIGGER AND STRONGER THAN EVER BEFORE. MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN!"
paras.zh: “记住，这不是共和党，而是杜民主。不过，不要害怕，我们很快就会以某种方式变得比以往任何时候都更大更强。让美国再次伟大！”

paras.en: Later on Thursday night he appeared to take aim at voters too.
paras.zh: 周四晚上晚些时候，他似乎也把矛头指向了选民。

paras.en: "The Stock Market crashed today because the Dumocrats had a big Tuesday â So sad to see, you only have yourselves to blame!" he wrote on Truth Social.
paras.zh: “今天股市崩盘，因为杜莫克拉特周二度过了一个重要的日子——看到如此令人难过，只能怪你们自己！”他在《真相社会》上撰文。

paras.en: Some Democrats have argued that AI has grown too big without any safeguards or oversight and have promised, with their new power in Congress, to change that.
paras.zh: 一些民主党人认为，人工智能在没有任何保障或监督的情况下已经发展得太大，并承诺利用他们在国会的新权力来改变这种状况。

paras.en: "Americans don't want Big Tech oligarchs wrecking the environment, gutting jobs and threatening humanity's future. NATIONAL DATA CENTER MORATORIUM NOW," Democrat Senator Bernie Sanders said in a post on X on Thursday.
paras.zh: “美国人不希望大型科技寡头破坏环境、破坏就业机会并威胁人类的未来。现在暂停国家数据中心，”民主党参议员伯尼·桑德斯周四在 X 上发帖表示。

paras.en: Shares in companies heavily exposed to AI data centres, including crucial chipmakers and semiconductor manufacturers, fell sharply on Thursday, highlighting investor concerns that had already been growing.
paras.zh: 周四，严重依赖人工智能数据中心的公司（包括重要的芯片制造商和半导体制造商）的股价大幅下跌，凸显了投资者已经日益加剧的担忧。

paras.en: In European trading on Thursday, shares in chipmaker Infineon fell by more than 8.5% while tech equipment manufacturer ASML dropped by 6.5%.
paras.zh: 周四欧洲交易中，芯片制造商英飞凌股价下跌超过 8.5%，科技设备制造商 ASML 股价下跌 6.5%。

paras.en: Nvidia shares slid more than 9%, knocking more than $400bn off the firm's market value in New York trading.
paras.zh: Nvidia 股价下跌超过 9%，导致该公司在纽约交易的市值缩水逾 4000 亿美元。

paras.en: Other chipmakers also suffered, with AMD and Micron both dropping by more than 17%. Intel shares also dropped, down 10.3%, while memory card maker SanDisk plunged more than 22%.
paras.zh: 其他芯片制造商也遭受损失，AMD 和美光均下跌超过 17%。英特尔股价也下跌了 10.3%，而存储卡制造商 SanDisk 则暴跌超过 22%。

paras.en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, which tracks the performance of 30 of the largest companies involved in semiconductor production, fell by more than 12%.
paras.zh: 追踪 30 家最大半导体生产公司业绩的费城半导体指数下跌超过 12%。

paras.en: Shares in Elon Musk's companies SpaceX and Tesla also plunged, falling 8% and nearly 11% respectively and shaving more than $300bn off the firms' market value on Thursday.
paras.zh: 周四，埃隆·马斯克旗下公司 SpaceX 和特斯拉的股价也暴跌，分别下跌 8% 和近 11%，公司市值缩水逾 3000 亿美元。

paras.en: Musk had spent nearly $450m backing Republican campaigns, including at least $45m in support of Ken Paxton for the Texas senate seat, but Texas was turned blue in the Democratic tsunami on Tuesday night.
paras.zh: 马斯克花费了近 4.5 亿美元支持共和党竞选活动，其中包括至少 4500 万美元支持肯帕克斯顿竞选德克萨斯州参议员席位，但德克萨斯州在周二晚上的民主党海啸中变成了蓝色。

paras.en: In total, the so-called magnificent seven tech companies, including Apple, Nvidia and Tesla, have shed a trillion dollars in value in a single trading day.
paras.zh: 包括苹果、英伟达和特斯拉在内的所谓的七大科技公司在一个交易日内的市值总计蒸发了万亿美元。

paras.en: The stock falls also hit other major US stock indexes. The S&P 500 index fell by 4.4% by the end of trading, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average erased gains made on Wednesday to close down more than 3.4%.
paras.zh: 股市下跌也影响了美国其他主要股指。截至交易结束，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 4.4%，道琼斯工业平均指数回吐周三涨幅，收盘跌幅超过 3.4%。

paras.en: The Nasdaq Composite fall was so large it is now in what market watchers call correction territory, which is where an index or company value falls at least 10% below its recent high.
paras.zh: 纳斯达克综合指数跌幅如此之大，目前已处于市场观察人士所说的调整区域，即指数或公司价值比近期高点至少下跌 10%。

paras.en: Susannah Streeter, chief investment strategist at Wealth Club, said the steep sell-off on the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 was sending shockwaves into other markets.
paras.zh: Wealth Club 首席投资策略师 Susannah Streeter 表示，纳斯达克指数和标准普尔 500 指数的大幅抛售正在给其他市场带来冲击波。

paras.en: "Fresh panic over the AI trade has hit Wall Street hard," she said.
paras.zh: “对人工智能交易的新恐慌对华尔街造成了沉重打击，”她说。

paras.en: "Fears that the vast sums poured into AI infrastructure may not deliver the returns investors have been banking on are now colliding with the prospect of a sharp slowdown in data centre construction.
paras.zh: “人们担心投入人工智能基础设施的巨额资金可能无法带来投资者一直指望的回报，现在与数据中心建设急剧放缓的前景相冲突。

paras.en: Some tech leaders have said they were caught off guard by the backlash against data centres in the midterms.
paras.zh: 一些科技领袖表示，他们对中期选举中针对数据中心的强烈反对感到措手不及。

paras.en: OpenAI president and co-founder Greg Brockman said he believed everyone had been surprised by the reaction to data centres, and more work needed to be done to ensure communities were on board.
paras.zh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman) 表示，他相信每个人都对数据中心的反应感到惊讶，并且需要做更多工作来确保社区参与其中。

paras.en: "A lot of our shift over the course of this year has really been to realise that from San Francisco trying to build infrastructure in Texas, Georgia, and other places, you can't just tweet and say: 'This is going to be good.' You need to be in those communities," Brockman said at the WSJ Tech conference in Napa, California on Wednesday evening.
paras.zh: “今年我们的很多转变实际上是为了认识到，从旧金山试图在德克萨斯州、佐治亚州和其他地方建设基础设施，你不能只是发推文说：‘这会很好。’你需要融入这些社区，”布罗克曼周三晚上在加利福尼亚州纳帕举行的《华尔街日报》科技会议上说道。

paras.en: Meta's president Dina Powell McCormick said that the industry needed to put more effort into selling AI as a good idea.
paras.zh: Meta 总裁迪娜·鲍威尔·麦考密克 (Dina Powell McCormick) 表示，业界需要付出更多努力，将人工智能作为一个好主意来推销。

paras.en: "I think we need to double and triple down on telling the story," she told the WSJ conference.
paras.zh: “我认为我们需要加倍努力讲述这个故事，”她在《华尔街日报》会议上说道。

paras.en: Alongside the immediate impacts of the US mid-term elections, some investors have become concerned that AI shares could be in a bubble that is due a correction.
paras.zh: 除了美国中期选举的直接影响之外，一些投资者开始担心人工智能股票可能会陷入泡沫，从而出现回调。

paras.en: With additional reporting from Lily Jamali
paras.zh: 莉莉·贾玛利 (Lily Jamali) 的补充报道

articles.title: Did a data centre revolt affect the US mid-term election results?

paras.en: A US midterms voter poll has suggested data centres were a highly motivating issue for many Americans, leading some to argue public backlash against the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure construction boom might have helped shape the election outcome.
paras.zh: 美国中期选民民意调查显示，数据中心对许多美国人来说是一个高度激励的问题，导致一些人认为公众对人工智能（AI）基础设施建设热潮的强烈反对可能有助于影响选举结果。

paras.en: BBC Verify has looked at its role in the campaign and examined the potential consequences for the AI industry.
paras.zh: BBC verify 审视了其在该活动中的作用，并研究了其对人工智能行业的潜在后果。

paras.en: The poll for AP and a consortium of news organisations found 56% of surveyed voters said data centres were a "crucial or major" factor in their vote, while 76% said they would oppose the construction of a new data centre in their community.
paras.zh: 美联社和新闻机构联盟的民意调查发现，56％的受访选民表示数据中心是他们投票的“关键或主要”因素，而76％的人表示他们反对在社区建设新的数据中心。

paras.en: The hostile sentiment was considerably stronger among those who said they voted Democrat at this election.
paras.zh: 那些自称在这次选举中投票给民主党的人中，敌对情绪要强烈得多。

paras.en: This follows other recent Pew Research polling, external which suggested about half of Americans think data centres are "mostly bad" for the environment, home energy costs and quality of life, a big deterioration in favourability since January.
paras.zh: 皮尤研究中心 (Pew Research) 最近进行的另一项外部民意调查显示，大约一半的美国人认为数据中心对环境、家庭能源成本和生活质量“大多有害”，自一月份以来，人们的好感度大幅下降。

paras.en: The congressional voter poll results certainly suggest a remarkable degree of salience for a subject which likely would not have been on most Americans' radar five years ago.
paras.zh: 国会选民民意调查结果无疑表明了这个主题的显着程度，而五年前，这个主题可能不会引起大多数美国人的关注。

paras.en: However, it is some way behind several key issues people considered "crucial or major factors" in their vote, including government corruption (90%) and the cost of living (89%).
paras.zh: 然而，它在某种程度上落后于人们在投票中认为“关键或主要因素”的几个关键问题，包括政府腐败（90%）和生活成本（89%）。

paras.en: Did the AI backlash affect Senate races?
paras.zh: 人工智能的强烈反对影响了参议院竞选吗？

paras.en: Three of the Senate seats flipped by the Democrats have significantly more data centres, external, Texas (595), Ohio (258) and Iowa (117), than the median of 55 across all 50 states.
paras.zh: 被民主党推翻的三个参议院席位（德克萨斯州（595 个）、俄亥俄州（258 个）和爱荷华州（117 个）拥有的外部数据中心数量明显多于所有 50 个州 55 个的中位数。

paras.en: And Texas alone has 31 ongoing data centre construction projects, the most of any state, external.
paras.zh: 仅德克萨斯州就有 31 个正在进行的数据中心建设项目，是所有州中最多的外部数据中心建设项目。

paras.en: But other factors would also have been motivating voters in these states, as elsewhere.
paras.zh: 但与其他地方一样，其他因素也会激励这些州的选民。

paras.en: BBC Verify analysis of state-level voter polling for Senate elections suggests states which swung to the Democrats either followed the national trend over data centre concerns, or seemed less concerned.
paras.zh: BBC verify 对参议院选举的州级选民民意调查的分析表明，转向民主党的州要么追随了数据中心担忧的全国趋势，要么似乎不太担心。

paras.en: So we can't say how many votes or Senate seats were directly delivered by data centre opposition.
paras.zh: 所以我们不能说有多少选票或参议院席位是由数据中心反对派直接交付的。

paras.en: But it's notable that three key states in the US AI build-out, Texas, Georgia and Ohio, all elected Democrats as senators and governors who called for tighter regulation on data centres in one form or another.
paras.zh: 但值得注意的是，美国人工智能建设的三个关键州——德克萨斯州、佐治亚州和俄亥俄州，都选举民主党人为参议员和州长，呼吁以某种形式对数据中心进行更严格的监管。

paras.en: - requirements to fully cover their own energy and water infrastructure costs
paras.zh: - 要求完全承担自己的能源和水基础设施成本

paras.en: - mandates to use unionised construction workers
paras.zh: - 强制使用加入工会的建筑工人

paras.en: - stricter environmental and transparency safeguards
paras.zh: - 更严格的环境和透明度保障措施

paras.en: What could the election results mean for the future of the AI boom?
paras.zh: 选举结果对人工智能繁荣的未来意味着什么？

paras.en: The US economy has been heavily supported in recent years by massive corporate investments in AI, external, including for data centre construction.
paras.zh: 近年来，美国经济得到了企业对人工智能、外部投资（包括数据中心建设）的大规模投资的大力支持。

paras.en: Official data, external shows inflation-adjusted monthly spending on building data centres, excluding the IT hardware to go into them, in August 2026 was $5bn (Â£4.2bn) - five times higher than in 2023.
paras.zh: 外部官方数据显示，2026 年 8 月，经通胀调整后的数据中心建设每月支出（不包括用于数据中心的 IT 硬件）为 50 亿美元（42 亿英镑），是 2023 年的五倍。

paras.en: Analysis by Columbia Business School, external suggests AI infrastructure investment in the US is currently larger as a share of the overall economy than spending on new railways was at the height of that boom in the 19th Century.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚商学院的外部分析表明，目前美国人工智能基础设施投资占整体经济的比重比 19 世纪繁荣时期新铁路的支出还要大。

paras.en: Cori Crider, executive director of the Future of Tech Institute, a European think tank, told BBC Verify the industry should anticipate that new state leaders will put conditions on or "even stop runaway data centre build".
paras.zh: 欧洲智库未来技术研究所执行董事科里·克里德 (Cori Crider) 告诉 BBC verify，业界应该预计新的国家领导人将提出条件，甚至“停止失控的数据中心建设”。

paras.en: Seema Shah, from global investment firm Principal Asset Management, said requirements for developers to pay for additional investment in the electricity grid, meet tougher standards over their usage of resources like water, or give up tax incentives could "raise development costs and slow new supply".
paras.zh: 全球投资公司信安资产管理公司的西玛·沙阿(Seema Shah)表示，要求开发商支付额外的电网投资、在水等资源使用方面满足更严格的标准，或者放弃税收优惠，可能会“增加开发成本并减缓新供应”。

paras.en: However, Heather West from the Eurasia Group consultancy said temporary bans on construction and new regulations might delay the data centre roll out, but would not stop it entirely.
paras.zh: 然而，欧亚集团咨询公司的希瑟·韦斯特表示，临时建设禁令和新法规可能会推迟数据中心的推出，但不会完全阻止它。

paras.en: She said "projects already permitted or under construction will largely proceed", but delays would affect the "next wave" of building through "local fights, slower permitting, and pressure to make data centres pay for their own power".
paras.zh: 她表示，“已经获得许可或正在建设的项目将大部分继续进行”，但延误将通过“当地斗争、较慢的许可以及迫使数据中心为自己的电力付费的压力”影响“下一波”建设。

paras.en: Analysts from the consultancy Oxford Economics have said there are also strong economic incentives for politicians to avoid policies that would severely disrupt data centre construction, pointing to tax revenue and construction jobs they bring.
paras.zh: 咨询公司牛津经济研究院的分析师表示，政客们也有强大的经济动机来避免采取会严重扰乱数据中心建设的政策，并指出这些政策带来的税收和建筑工作岗位。

paras.en: Deepak Surana of the Futurum Group, a technology research firm, said he expected there would ultimately be "a negotiation, not a moratorium" from Texas state leaders on data centres to ensure no negative impact on residents' energy and water bills.
paras.zh: 技术研究公司Futurum Group的迪帕克·苏拉纳(Deepak Surana)表示，他预计德克萨斯州领导人最终将就数据中心问题进行“谈判，而不是暂停”，以确保不会对居民的能源和水费产生负面影响。

paras.en: OpenAI, which has a data centre in Texas and under-construction projects in Ohio, pledged to ensure it fully paid for its own electricity on Thursday, external - one day after the midterm results.
paras.zh: OpenAI 在德克萨斯州设有数据中心，在俄亥俄州设有正在建设的项目，该公司承诺确保在周四（即中期业绩公布后一天）全额支付自己的电费。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Nicholas Barrett
paras.zh: 尼古拉斯·巴雷特的补充报道

articles.title: Macau jails pro-democracy campaigner in city's first national security case

paras.en: Macau has sentenced an ex-lawmaker and pro-democracy campaigner to 12 years and six months' jail in the city's first national security case.
paras.zh: 澳门判处一名前立法会议员、民主运动人士 12 年零 6 个月监禁，这是该市首例国家安全案件。

paras.en: Following a closed-door trial, Au Kam San, 69, was convicted on Friday of "subversion against the political power of the state", among other offences.
paras.zh: 经过闭门审判后，69 岁的区金山于周五被判犯有“颠覆国家政治权力”等罪名。

paras.en: His wife Virginia Cheang condemned the ruling, calling the case a "groundless persecution designed to humiliate Au".
paras.zh: 他的妻子Virginia Cheang谴责了这一裁决，称此案是“旨在羞辱区的毫无根据的迫害”。

paras.en: Macau was handed back to China in 1999, ending over 400 years of Portuguese administration. Its national security law came into effect in 2009, criminalising acts of treason, secession, and subversion against the Chinese Communist Party.
paras.zh: 1999年，澳门回归中国，结束了葡萄牙400多年的统治。其国家安全法于2009年生效，将叛国、分裂国家和颠覆中国共产党的行为定为刑事犯罪。

paras.en: The law was revised in 2023, broadening its scope to include non-violent acts of secession, and again this year, to allow for trials to be held behind closed doors.
paras.zh: 该法律于 2023 年进行了修订，扩大了其范围，将非暴力分裂国家行为纳入其中，并于今年再次修订，允许闭门进行审判。

paras.en: Prosecutors had accused Au of assisting and collaborating with "external hostile organisations" by collecting, preparing and disseminating information that was "manifestly filled with political claims of a subversive nature against the state".
paras.zh: 检察官指控欧通过收集、准备和传播“明显充满对国家具有颠覆性质的政治主张”的信息，协助并与“外部敌对组织”合作。

paras.en: These took place "over a long period of time", the prosecutors claim.
paras.zh: 检察官声称，这些事件发生在“很长一段时间内”。

paras.en: Au was arrested in July 2025 and later charged with three counts of subverting the state's power, three counts of endangering national security by establishing contact with foreign organisations, and one count of breach of confidentiality.
paras.zh: 欧于2025年7月被捕，后来被指控三项颠覆国家政权罪、三项通过与外国组织建立联系危害国家安全罪以及一项违反保密罪。

paras.en: He was found guilty of four of the seven charges following a three-day trial which ended in September. A judge had ordered that the trial be held behind closed doors "to ensure that no prejudice is caused to the interests of national security".
paras.zh: 经过为期三天的审判，九月结束后，他被判犯有七项指控中的四项。一名法官下令闭门进行审判，“以确保不会损害国家安全利益”。

paras.en: Macau's authorities never publicly disclosed the details of the case. Au's family had earlier told the media Au was not allowed to seek his own legal representation and had instead been assigned a lawyer by the court.
paras.zh: 澳门当局从未公开披露此案的细节。欧的家人早些时候告诉媒体，欧不被允许寻求自己的法律代理，而是由法院指派了一名律师。

paras.en: Au's wife Cheang said she hoped authorities would grant her and her family permission to regularly write to and visit Au in prison.
paras.zh: 欧的妻子郑表示，她希望当局允许她和她的家人定期给狱中的欧写信和探望。

paras.en: "I dare not hope for more as I believe that will only lead to greater disappointment," she said in an open letter on Friday.
paras.zh: 她在周五的一封公开信中表示：“我不敢抱有更多希望，因为我相信这只会导致更大的失望。”

paras.en: Au, who was formerly a primary school teacher, was elected to the Legislative Assembly in September 2001. For 20 years, he served as one of only a handful of pro-democracy lawmakers in the legislature, largely made up of pro-Beijing loyalists.
paras.zh: 区先生曾是一名小学教师，2001年9月当选为立法会议员。20年来，他是立法机关中少数几位亲民主议员之一，立法机关主要由亲北京的忠诚者组成。

paras.en: Au had co-organised annual vigils in Macau to commemorate the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown in Beijing.
paras.zh: 欧曾在澳门共同组织年度守夜活动，以纪念 1989 年北京天安门广场镇压事件。

paras.en: These vigils were previously tolerated in places like Macau and Hong Kong, but have effectively been banned in both cities since China imposed a sweeping national security law on Hong Kong in 2020.
paras.zh: 这些守夜活动此前在澳门和香港等地是被容忍的，但自从中国于2020年对香港实施全面的国家安全法以来，这些守夜活动在这两个城市实际上都被禁止了。

paras.en: Au's jailing comes a day after Hong Kong sentenced Joshua Wong, the face of its now-quashed democracy movement, to 10 years in jail. Wong, 30, whose activism started when he was just a teen, has been in custody for the last six years.
paras.zh: 欧区入狱的前一天，香港判处现已被镇压的民主运动代表人物黄之锋 10 年监禁。 30 岁的黄在十几岁的时候就开始了激进主义活动，在过去的六年里一直被监禁。
