articles.title: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 recap

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada, reaffirmed its position as the largest construction trade show in North America, drawing more than 140,000 construction professionals from 128 countries across the globe. For Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, the week was an incredible opportunity to showcase innovation, strengthen partnerships and gain valuable insights into the future of the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Throughout the busy week, attendees had the chance to speak with our experts and watch live demonstrations of our brake systems, along with our advanced brake and transmission friction solutions for the construction industry.
paras.zh: 在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 重申了其作为北美最大的建筑贸易展的地位，吸引了来自全球 128 个国家的超过 140,000 名建筑专业人士。对于 CentroMotion 品牌 Carlisle Brake & Friction 来说，本周是展示创新、加强合作伙伴关系以及获得对建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来的宝贵见解的绝佳机会。在忙碌的一周中，与会者有机会与我们的专家交谈并观看我们制动系统的现场演示，以及我们为建筑行业提供的先进制动和传动摩擦解决方案。

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG is more than a trade show, it’s a barometer for where the industry is headed. Top trends included integrating autonomous equipment, advanced digital tools and sustainable technologies. The exhibition footprint spanned more than 3 million square feet with greater than 2,000 exhibitors, and attendees covered miles of exhibits sprawled across indoor and outdoor spaces.
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 不仅仅是一个贸易展，它还是行业发展方向的晴雨表。主要趋势包括集成自主设备、先进的数字工具和可持续技术。展览面积超过 300 万平方英尺，参展商超过 2,000 家，与会者覆盖了遍布室内和室外空间的数英里展品。

paras.en: At the show, Carlisle Brake & Friction highlighted its advanced brake systems and friction technologies designed to withstand extreme duty cycles and demanding off‑highway applications. Attendees experienced firsthand the performance, quality, and engineering expertise that define the CarlisleCBF brand. The CentroMotion booth was a hub of activity, and the team welcomed OEM leaders and aftermarket specialists. These interactions went beyond showcasing our products, they enhanced relationships and increased our team’s understanding of the industry’s evolving needs. Check out this video https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8 for more detail about our booth and featured products serving the market.
paras.zh: 在展会上，卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司重点介绍了其先进的制动系统和摩擦技术，旨在承受极端的工作循环和苛刻的非公路应用。与会者亲身体验了 CarlisleCBF 品牌的性能、质量和工程专业知识。 CentroMotion 展位是活动中心，团队欢迎 OEM 领导者和售后市场专家。这些互动不仅仅是展示我们的产品，它们还增强了关系并增加了我们团队对行业不断变化的需求的了解。请观看此视频 https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8，了解有关我们的展位和服务于市场的特色产品的更多详细信息。

paras.en: The show floor was packed with the latest advancements across construction, aggregate, concrete and lifting. Attendees explored:
paras.zh: 展厅里充满了建筑、骨料、混凝土和起重方面的最新进展。与会者探讨：

paras.en: • New and upgraded equipment and machinery in action
paras.zh: • 新的和升级的设备和机械投入使用

paras.en: • Advances in automation, electrification and equipment intelligence
paras.zh: • 自动化、电气化和设备智能化的进步

paras.en: • Digital tools focused on productivity, fleet management and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 专注于生产力、车队管理和作业现场可视性的数字工具

paras.en: • Solutions designed to improve safety, efficiency and sustainability
paras.zh: • 旨在提高安全性、效率和可持续性的解决方案

paras.en: Hands on demos and a live equipment showcase gave attendees the opportunity to see innovations in action and understand how they can be applied on real jobsites.
paras.zh: 动手演示和现场设备展示让与会者有机会看到创新的实际应用，并了解如何将它们应用到实际工作现场。

paras.en: Technology continued to be a major focus at CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026. Exhibitors and education sessions highlighted these key updates as transformational in construction operations:
paras.zh: 技术仍然是 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 的主要焦点。参展商和教育会议强调了这些关键更新对建筑运营的变革：

paras.en: • Digital workflows and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 数字化工作流程和工地可视性

paras.en: • Sustainability and emissions reduction
paras.zh: • 可持续发展和减排

paras.en: • Workforce challenges and talent development
paras.zh: • 劳动力挑战和人才发展

paras.en: Together, these topics reflected an industry adapting to change while looking toward long term growth.
paras.zh: 这些主题共同反映了行业在适应变化的同时寻求长期增长。

paras.en: Looking ahead: The future of construction
paras.zh: 展望未来：建筑业的未来

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG shines a bold spotlight on the companies and innovations redefining what’s next in the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Our team’s conversations and key learnings will help shape our strategies for the coming year, and we’re committed to driving progress!
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 大胆聚焦于重新定义建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来发展的公司和创新。我们团队的对话和重要经验将有助于制定我们来年的战略，我们致力于推动进步！

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India
paras.zh: 新工厂将非公路湿摩擦生产带至印度

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司 (Carlisle Brake & Friction) 已破土动工，以扩大其位于印度钦奈的制造业务，该工厂位于世界上增长最快的工业地区之一。 Carlisle CBF 在该地区生产机电一体化产品已超过 15 年，将搬迁至更大的工厂，增加非公路用纸湿式摩擦片和钢制隔板的生产。新设施计划于 2027 年开业。

paras.en: The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.
paras.zh: 扩大空间的目的是为了满足印度和东南亚农业、建筑业、特别是采矿业不断增长的需求所需的制造能力。本地生产将提高供应链响应能力，同时支持成本敏感市场的原始设备和售后市场需求。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 正在钦奈新工厂建立最先进的湿式摩擦制造设施，与成熟的全球制造工艺相媲美，以打造更具弹性的区域平台。此次扩张增强了我们提供耐用湿式摩擦产品的能力，有助于保持关键非公路设备的生产力。

paras.en: Looking for a friction products partner for your next off-highway equipment build? Fill out the form below to connect with the Carlisle Brake & Friction India team and discuss your project needs.
paras.zh: 正在为您的下一个非公路设备制造寻找摩擦产品合作伙伴？填写下面的表格，与卡莱尔制动和摩擦印度团队联系并讨论您的项目需求。

articles.title: Seven Las Vegas Families Receive Recycled Rides During Industry Week
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Monday, Nov. 2, at a gathering of all the major companies in the collision repair industry, seven deserving Las Vegas area families in need, including two veterans, experienced a life-changing event – the presentation of a vehicle to provide them independence and the ability to work and take care of their families. This was made possible thanks to the National Auto Body Council Recycled Rides program along with its members — car donors GEICO, Allstate, Farmers, Travelers, USAA, Nationwide and Enterprise and repair partners Caliber, Crash Champions, Gerber Collision & Glass, Fix Auto USA, Cascade Collision, the Auto Group Collision Center and Universal Motor Cars.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日星期一，在碰撞修复行业所有主要公司的聚会上，拉斯维加斯地区七个有需要的家庭（其中包括两名退伍军人）经历了一场改变生活的事件 - 一辆汽车的出现为他们提供了独立性以及工作和照顾家人的能力。这要归功于国家汽车车身委员会回收乘车项目及其成员——汽车捐赠者 GEICO、Allstate、Farmers、Travelers、USAA、Nationwide 和 Enterprise 以及维修合作伙伴 Calibre、Crash Champions、Gerber Collision & Glass、Fix Auto USA、Cascade Collision、Auto Group Collision Center 和 Universal Motor Cars。

paras.en: The presentation took place in conjunction with the MSO Symposium at the Rio Hotel and Casino. At the event, seven vehicles were presented to two veterans, a Las Vegas Police Department cadet and other families in need. The seven deserving recipients were selected by local Las Vegas charities U.S. VETS, Family Promise of Las Vegas, YMCA of Las Vegas, My Scars Are Beautiful and Ayden’s Army of Angels
paras.zh: 该演示会与在里约酒店和赌场举行的 MSO 研讨会同时举行。在活动中，七辆车被赠送给两名退伍军人、一名拉斯维加斯警察局学员和其他有需要的家庭。七名获奖者是由拉斯维加斯当地慈善机构 U.S. VETS、Family Promise of Las Vegas、YMCA of Las Vegas、My Scars Are Beautiful 和 Ayden’s Army of Angels 选出的

paras.en: A 2019 Ford F150, donated by Allstate and repaired by Crash Champions was presented to Devon Rodgers, his wife and four children, who had experienced homelessness and now are working back towards a life of self-sufficiency with the help of Family Promise.
paras.zh: 一辆由 Allstate 捐赠并由 Crash Champions 维修的 2019 款福特 F150 赠送给 Devon Rodgers、他的妻子和四个孩子，他们曾经无家可归，现在正在 Family Promise 的帮助下重新过上自给自足的生活。

paras.en: Marquetta Kirkwood, a single mother of three who also with the help of Family Promise is working hard to create a stable and sustainable future for her family, received a A 2018 Subaru Forester donated by Nationwide and refurbished by the Auto Group.
paras.zh: Marquetta Kirkwood 是三个孩子的单亲母亲，她也在 Family Promise 的帮助下努力为家人创造稳定和可持续的未来，她收到了一辆由 Nationwide 捐赠并由 Auto Group 翻新的 2018 款斯巴鲁森林人 (Subaru Forester)。

paras.en: A 2024 Hyundai Sonata donated by GEICO and repaired by Caliber was gifted to Evelyn Perez-Lopez. Perez-Lopez is the survivor of a near fatal house fire explosion, suffering third-degree burns over her face and entire body. Despite enduring over 100 surgical procedures, she continues moving forward with the support of My Scars Are Beautiful charity and has become a cadet with the Las Vegas Police Department.
paras.zh: 一辆由 GEICO 捐赠并由 Calibre 维修的 2024 年现代索纳塔被赠送给伊芙琳·佩雷斯-洛佩兹。佩雷斯-洛佩兹是一场几乎致命的房屋火灾爆炸的幸存者，她的脸部和全身遭受三度烧伤。尽管经历了 100 多次外科手术，她在 My Scars Are Beautiful 慈善机构的支持下继续前进，并成为拉斯维加斯警察局的一名学员。

paras.en: A 2026 Toyota Corolla, donated by Farmers and refurbished by Fix Auto USA, was presented to Laton McCollins, a retired U.S. Army sergeant nominated by U.S. Vets, who had been using public transportation to get to his job each day.
paras.zh: 一辆由 Farmers 捐赠并由 Fix Auto USA 翻新的 2026 款丰田卡罗拉被赠送给拉顿·麦柯林斯 (Laton McCollins)，他是一位由美国退伍军人提名的退役美国陆军中士，他每天都使用公共交通工具上班。

paras.en: A 2022 Hyundai Tucson, donated by USAA and repaired by Cascade Collision, a member of Quality Collision Group and the CCG Network, was presented to Gabriel Kitchens, a retired U.S. Marine Corps Lance Corporal and proud father of two young children. Kitchens recently secured employmentas a motor coach operator.
paras.zh: 一辆由 USAA 捐赠并由 Quality Collision Group 和 CCG Network 成员 Cascade Collision 维修的 2022 款现代 Tucson 被赠送给 Gabriel Kitchens，他是一位退役的美国海军陆战队准下士，也是两个孩子的骄傲的父亲。厨房最近找到了一份大客车运营商的工作。

paras.en: Victoria Anderson, a mother of three who recently lost her husband, and whose daughter is battling a rare form of cancer, was nominated by Ayden’s Army of Angels. Anderson received a 2022 Honda Odyssey, donated by Travelers and refurbished Gerber Collision and Glass, to replace her 21-year-old unreliable vehicle.
paras.zh: 维多利亚·安德森 (Victoria Anderson) 是三个孩子的母亲，最近失去了丈夫，她的女儿正在与一种罕见的癌症作斗争，她获得了艾登天使军团的提名。安德森收到了旅行者捐赠的一辆 2022 款本田奥德赛，并翻新了格柏碰撞和玻璃，以取代她那辆已经使用了 21 年、不可靠的车辆。

paras.en: Rebecca Blair, also a mother of three who was nominated by the YMCA of Southern Nevada, received a 2023 Chrysler Pacifica, donated by Enterprise and refurbished by Universal Motor Cars, a member of the CSN Network. The roomy vehicle can accommodate her daughter’s wheelchair as she transports her to medical appointments and therapy sessions.
paras.zh: 丽贝卡·布莱尔 (Rebecca Blair) 也是三个孩子的母亲，获得南内华达州基督教青年会 (YMCA) 的提名，她收到了一辆 2023 款克莱斯勒 Pacifica，该车由 Enterprise 捐赠并由 CSN 网络成员环球汽车 (Universal Motor Cars) 翻新。这辆宽敞的车辆可以容纳她女儿的轮椅，以便她载她去就诊和治疗。

paras.en: For more information on Recycled Rides, click here.
paras.zh: 有关回收游乐设施的更多信息，请单击此处。

articles.title: House of Kolor Launches Eight New Kolors to Complete 70th Anniversary
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: House of Kolor, the custom paint brand known for bold kolors and groundbreaking finishes, has revealed eight new anniversary kolors to close out its yearlong 70th anniversary celebration.
paras.zh: House of Kolor 是一家以大胆的 kolor 和突破性饰面而闻名的定制涂料品牌，推出了八款新的周年纪念 kolor，以结束其为期一年的 70 周年庆典。

paras.en: House of Kolor named four of the new kolors, while the brand’s community of custom artists, builders and enthusiasts submitted ideas for the remaining four through Facebook and Instagram. The “kustom krew” engagement allowed the community to become part of the brand’s legacy.
paras.zh: House of Kolor 为其中四款新 kolor 命名，而该品牌的定制艺术家、建筑商和爱好者社区则通过 Facebook 和 Instagram 提交了其余四款的创意。 “kustom krew”参与让社区成为品牌遗产的一部分。

paras.en: “House of Kolor has always been fueled by the creativity of the custom community,” said Tom Smith, national warehouse distributor sales manager, House of Kolor. “Inviting that community to help name these anniversary kolors was a fitting way to celebrate our legacy and finish this milestone year together.”
paras.zh: “House of Kolor 一直受到定制社区创造力的推动，”House of Kolor 全国仓库分销商销售经理 Tom Smith 说道。 “邀请社区帮助命名这些周年纪念日是庆祝我们的遗产并共同完成这一具有里程碑意义的一年的合适方式。”

paras.en: - Kozality: A deep green with a hint of midnight
paras.zh: - Kozality：带有一丝午夜气息的深绿色

paras.en: - High Tide: A blue-purple hue with an electric brightness
paras.zh: - High Tide：具有电光亮度的蓝紫色色调

paras.en: - Traffik Light: A bright green that is always ready to go
paras.zh: - 交通灯：明亮的绿色，随时准备出发

paras.en: - Sunglo: A golden yellow shade perfect for its day in the sun
paras.zh: - Sunglo：金黄色调，非常适合阳光下的一天

paras.en: - Raven’s Wing: A deep, dramatic purple named by Blake Winters
paras.zh: - Raven’s Wing：一种深邃、戏剧性的紫色，由 Blake Winters 命名

paras.en: - Kosmic Forest: A bold green shade named by Richard Wilmot
paras.zh: - Kosmic Forest：理查德·威尔莫特命名的大胆绿色阴影

paras.en: - Celestial Switch: A vibrant pink-purple hue named by Steven Carrillo
paras.zh: - Celestial Switch：一种充满活力的粉紫色色调，由 Steven Carrillo 命名

paras.en: - Bordeaux Glow: A rich wine named by Shelley Molea
paras.zh: - Bordeaux Glow：一款由 Shelley Molea 命名的浓郁葡萄酒

paras.en: The eight new kolors cap a year with milestone moments told by founder Jon Kosmoski; storytelling videos from the House of Kolor team, customers and longtime enthusiasts; a one-of-a-kind custom giveaway; and exclusive merchandise drops that celebrated the artists, innovators and fans who helped define House of Kolor since 1956.
paras.zh: 创始人乔恩·科斯莫斯基 (Jon Kosmoski) 讲述了八个新的 kolors 每年的里程碑时刻； House of Kolor 团队、客户和长期爱好者的讲故事视频；独一无二的定制赠品；以及纪念自 1956 年以来帮助定义 House of Kolor 的艺术家、创新者和粉丝的独家商品。

paras.en: For more information on the anniversary kolors, visit houseofkolor.com and follow House of Kolor on Facebook and Instagram.
paras.zh: 有关 kolors 周年纪念日的更多信息，请访问 houseofkolor.com 并在 Facebook 和 Instagram 上关注 House of Kolor。

articles.title: Crash Champions Opens Ninth Michigan Repair Center
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Crash Champions has announced the opening of its ninth Michigan location.
paras.zh: Crash Champions 宣布在密歇根州开设第九家分店。

paras.en: The announcement comes as Crash Champions begins welcoming local customers at the new repair center located at 8105 Big Lake Road in Clarkston, Mich. The 28,000-square-foot facility offers comprehensive collision repair and calibration services to customers, backed by Crash Champions’ lifetime guarantee.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布之际，Crash Champions 开始在位于密歇根州克拉克斯顿 Big Lake Road 8105 号的新维修中心欢迎当地客户。这个占地 28,000 平方英尺的设施为客户提供全面的碰撞维修和校准服务，并得到 Crash Champions 的终身保修。

paras.en: The company also offers flexible payment options through its Fix Now Pay Later program.
paras.zh: 该公司还通过“立即修复，稍后付款”计划提供灵活的付款方式。

paras.en: “We’re thrilled to continue growing our Michigan presence and expand our service to the Clarkston community,” said Matt Ebert, founder and CEO of Crash Champions. “This is an important step forward in our strategic growth plan, and more importantly, we look forward to growing alongside our local Clarkston neighbors and business partners with the Crash Champions promise of trusted service.”
paras.zh: Crash Champions 创始人兼首席执行官马特·埃伯特 (Matt Ebert) 表示：“我们很高兴能够继续扩大我们在密歇根州的业务，并将我们的服务扩展到克拉克斯顿社区。” “这是我们战略增长计划中向前迈出的重要一步，更重要的是，我们期待着与当地克拉克斯顿邻居和业务合作伙伴一起成长，并践行 Crash Champions 值得信赖的服务承诺。”

paras.en: Today, Crash Champions operates more than 650 collision repair centers in 38 states and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 如今，Crash Champions 在 38 个州和华盛顿特区运营着 650 多个碰撞修复中心。

paras.en: Crash Champions is one of the largest automotive collision repair employers in the U.S. and proudly certified as a Great Place To Work. Automotive repair professionals seeking opportunities to join the team are encouraged to visit career.crashchampions.com to view the latest openings.
paras.zh: Crash Champions 是美国最大的汽车碰撞维修雇主之一，并自豪地被认证为“最佳工作场所”。我们鼓励寻求加入团队机会的汽车维修专业人士访问 Career.crashchampions.com 查看最新空缺职位。

paras.en: To learn more about the company and its nationwide network of repair centers, visit crashchampions.com.
paras.zh: 要了解有关该公司及其全国维修中心网络的更多信息，请访问 crashchampions.com。

articles.title: Georgia, Oklahoma, Kansas elect new insurance commissioners; California still counting votes
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: In Georgia, Democrat Keisha Sean Waites defeated incumbent Republican John King, winning 54% of the vote.
paras.zh: 在佐治亚州，民主党人凯莎·肖恩·韦特斯 (Keisha Sean Waites) 击败了现任共和党人约翰·金 (John King)，赢得了 54% 的选票。

paras.en: King has held the position since 2019, when he was appointed by the Governor. He was elected for a full term in 2022.
paras.zh: King 自 2019 年由总督任命以来一直担任该职位。他于 2022 年当选，任期满。

paras.en: Sean Waites is a former state representative and Atlanta city councilwoman.
paras.zh: 肖恩·韦茨 (Sean Waites) 是前州代表和亚特兰大市议员。

paras.en: She also previously worked as a disaster reservist/commercial loan specialist for the U.S. Small Business Administration Disaster Assistance Division and in several Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) roles, according to her LinkedIn.
paras.zh: 根据她的 LinkedIn 信息，她此前还曾担任美国小企业管理局灾难援助部门的灾难预备役人员/商业贷款专家，以及联邦紧急事务管理局 (FEMA) 的多个职位。

paras.en: Waites says that the rate freeze initiative is a top priority on her campaign page. This includes aggressively reviewing and challenging unjustified auto and home insurance rate hikes.
paras.zh: 韦茨表示，冻结利率举措是她竞选页面上的首要任务。这包括积极审查和挑战不合理的汽车和家庭保险费率上涨。

paras.en: She also wants to end ZIP code and credit score discrimination by investing in modern equipment and faster response times for Georgia’s rural and underserved communities.
paras.zh: 她还希望通过投资现代设备并为佐治亚州的农村和服务欠缺的社区提供更快的响应时间，结束邮政编码和信用评分歧视。

paras.en: Another of Waites’s priorities is a “Consumer Fraud Strike Force” to protect seniors and vulnerable families from predatory insurance scams.
paras.zh: 韦特斯的另一个优先事项是建立“消费者欺诈打击部队”，以保护老年人和弱势家庭免受掠夺性保险诈骗。

paras.en: Republican Bob Sullivan won the race for Insurance Commissioner in Oklahoma with 59% of the vote. He ran against Democrat Craig MacIntyre.
paras.zh: 共和党人鲍勃·沙利文 (Bob Sullivan) 以 59% 的选票赢得俄克拉荷马州保险专员竞选。他与民主党人克雷格·麦金泰尔竞选。

paras.en: Current commissioner, Glen Mulready, has reached the end of his second term. Insurance commissioners in the state hold the position for four years and are limited to eight-years in the position.
paras.zh: 现任专员格伦·马尔雷迪 (Glen Mulready) 的第二个任期即将结束。该州保险专员的任期为四年，最长为八年。

paras.en: Sullivan identifies himself as a “property and casualty insurance expert” on his campaign website.
paras.zh: 沙利文在他的竞选网站上将自己称为“财产和伤亡保险专家”。

paras.en: He states his expertise includes being a certified insurance counselor, certified risk manager, chartered property and casualty underwriter, associate in Fidelity & Surety Bonding and a certified environmental specialist.
paras.zh: 他表示，他的专业知识包括成为一名经过认证的保险顾问、经过认证的风险经理、特许财产和伤亡承保人、Fidelity & Surety Bonding 助理以及经过认证的环境专家。

paras.en: Sullivan currently works for the Alera Group and previously for Rich and Cartmill, the website states.
paras.zh: 该网站称，沙利文目前在 Alera Group 工作，此前曾在 Rich 和 Cartmill 工作。

paras.en: “Bob has seen carriers pull out of Oklahoma, leaving entire industries with one option and homeowners forced to pay more—or go without,” the website states. “He’s running to restore competition, cut costs, and deliver fast, fair claims for the people who actually pay the premiums.”
paras.zh: 该网站称：“鲍勃看到运营商撤出俄克拉荷马州，让整个行业只有一种选择，而房主被迫支付更多费用，或者放弃。” “他竞选的目的是恢复竞争、削减成本，并为实际支付保费的人提供快速、公平的索赔。”

paras.en: Kansas voters elected Republican Daniel Hawkins to the insurance commissioner position with 58% of the vote. He ran against Democrat Dinah Sykes.
paras.zh: 堪萨斯州选民以 58% 的选票选举共和党人丹尼尔·霍金斯 (Daniel Hawkins) 担任保险专员一职。他与民主党人黛娜赛克斯竞选。

paras.en: The four-year position has no term limits. Vicki Schmidt, a Republican, has served in the role since 2019. She did not run again so she could pursue the Republican nomination for governor.
paras.zh: 该职位为期四年，没有任期限制。共和党人维姬·施密特 (Vicki Schmidt) 自 2019 年起担任该职务。她没有再次竞选，以便争取共和党州长提名。

paras.en: Hawkins, Republican speaker of the Kansas House of Representatives, started a career in the insurance business in 1995. He specialized in employee benefits for small businesses, according to the website.
paras.zh: 霍金斯是堪萨斯州众议院共和党议长，1995 年开始从事保险业。据该网站称，他专门从事小型企业的员工福利工作。

paras.en: He was elected to the Kansas House in 2013.
paras.zh: 2013年，他当选为堪萨斯州众议院议员。

paras.en: “As Insurance Commissioner, I will wake up early every day and get to work, making sure we have an Insurance Department that stands strong for the hardworking people of Kansas,” Hawkins says on the website. “I’ll never stop fighting to lower costs, improve transparency, and hold fraudsters accountable.”
paras.zh: 霍金斯在网站上表示：“作为保险专员，我每天都会早起并开始工作，确保我们的保险部门能够为堪萨斯州勤劳的人民服务。” “我将永远不会停止努力降低成本、提高透明度并追究欺诈者的责任。”

paras.en: Hawkins’ website states he will focus on lower costs, holding the powerful and fraudsters accountable, and restoring competition and choice.
paras.zh: 霍金斯的网站称，他将专注于降低成本、追究有权势者和欺诈者的责任，以及恢复竞争和选择。

paras.en: As of Wednesday evening, the California race for two Democrats running for the Insurance Commissioner position was still too close to call.
paras.zh: 截至周三晚间，加州两名民主党人竞选保险专员职位的竞争仍然势均力敌。

paras.en: Jane Kim had 52.2% of the vote and Ben Allen 47.8%, as of Wednesday evening.
paras.zh: 截至周三晚上，简·金 (Jane Kim) 的得票率为 52.2%，本·艾伦 (Ben Allen) 的得票率为 47.8%。

paras.en: Political Action Committees (PACs) have contributed a record $6 million in campaign donations to the California Insurance Commission race, according to a CalMatters report.
paras.zh: 根据 CalMatters 的一份报告，政治行动委员会 (PAC) 为加州保险委员会竞选提供了创纪录的 600 万美元竞选捐款。

paras.en: The article says this includes $3.2 million to support Allen and $1.5 million to oppose Kim.
paras.zh: 文章称，这其中包括支持艾伦的 320 万美元和反对金正恩的 150 万美元。

paras.en: Kim previously served on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, as California political director for Bernie Sanders, and as California director for the Working Families Party, according to her campaign website.
paras.zh: 据她的竞选网站称，金此前曾在旧金山监事会任职，担任伯尼·桑德斯的加州政治主任，以及工作家庭党的加州主任。

paras.en: Her priorities focus on “affordable, available insurance for all,” the website states. She proposes a single-payer disaster insurance policy for state residents.
paras.zh: 该网站称，她的首要任务是“为所有人提供负担得起的、可用的保险”。她提议为州居民提供单一付款人灾难保险政策。

paras.en: The website also says she’ll ensure premiums cover claims, or lower them.
paras.zh: 该网站还表示，她将确保保费覆盖索赔，或降低保费。

paras.en: “Insurance companies should spend premium dollars on their intended purpose: protecting policyholders,” the website states. “If companies collect more than they need to cover claims and a reasonable profit, that money should go back to policyholders or be invested in statewide resilience, not huge payouts at our expense — like the $27 million salary one insurance company CEO was paid last year.”
paras.zh: 该网站指出：“保险公司应该将保费用于其预期目的：保护保单持有人。” “如果公司收取的金额超出了他们支付索赔和合理利润所需的金额，那么这笔钱应该返还给保单持有人或投资于全州的恢复力，而不是由我们承担巨额支出——就像去年向一位保险公司首席执行官支付的 2700 万美元的薪水一样。”

paras.en: Allen has served in the state’s legislature since 2014, according to his campaign website. He lists climate and environmental policies as a focus during his tenure.
paras.zh: 据艾伦的竞选网站称，他自 2014 年以来一直在该州立法机构任职。他将气候和环境政策列为任期内的重点。

paras.en: Allen’s plan focuses on strengthening the state’s insurance market as wildfires and climate disasters intensify.
paras.zh: 艾伦的计划重点是随着野火和气候灾害加剧，加强该州的保险市场。

paras.en: “My plan will restore a competitive insurance market, ensure Californians are treated fairly after disasters, and build resilient communities that can withstand the climate challenges ahead,” he states on his website.
paras.zh: 他在网站上表示：“我的计划将恢复有竞争力的保险市场，确保加州人在灾难后得到公平对待，并建立能够抵御未来气候挑战的有弹性的社区。”

paras.en: Fighting insurers that “deny and delay” and post-disaster insurer compliance are other planned action items, Allen’s site claims.
paras.zh: 艾伦的网站称，打击“拒绝和拖延”的保险公司以及灾后保险公司的合规是其他计划采取的行动项目。

paras.en: This would include higher upfront payments for coverage, requiring insurers to clearly explain claim denials and maintain post-disaster real-time reporting on delays and outstanding claims.
paras.zh: 这将包括更高的保险预付款，要求保险公司明确解释索赔被拒绝的情况，并维护有关延误和未决索赔的灾后实时报告。

paras.zh: 专题照片由 adamkaz/iStock 提供

paras.en: Embedded photos courtesy of campaign websites.
paras.zh: 嵌入的照片由活动网站提供。

articles.title: Celette AI Webtools wins SEMA Show’s best new collision repair and refinish product award
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Celette AI Webtools won first place for the 2026 SEMA Show’s New Product Awards for Best Collision Repair and Refinish Product Tuesday.
paras.zh: Celette AI Webtools 周二荣获 2026 年 SEMA 展会新产品奖最佳碰撞修复和修补产品第一名。

paras.en: Bossauto Innova’s Ionizer Pro and Innovative Tools & Technologies’ Innovative Truck Cab Protectors were runners-up for Best Collision Repair and Refinish Product.
paras.zh: Bossauto Innova 的 Ionizer Pro 和 Innovative Tools & Technologies 的创新卡车驾驶室保护器获得最佳碰撞修复和修补产品亚军。

paras.en: Celette describes its Webtools AI as a “unified software ecosystem for modern structural repair,” in a February news release. All of Celette’s structural software, databases and compatible measurement tools converge on the one platform, it adds.
paras.zh: Celette 在 2 月份的新闻稿中将其 Webtools AI 描述为“用于现代结构修复的统一软件生态系统”。它补充说，Celette 的所有结构软件、数据库和兼容的测量工具都集中在一个平台上。

paras.en: It functions as a cloud-based software hub, the release says. This includes compatibility layers for selected third-party benches and gauges. It also digitally documents and reports tools.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，它充当基于云的软件中心。这包括选定的第三方工作台和仪表的兼容性层。它还以数字方式记录和报告工具。

paras.en: Andrew Batenhorst, Barry Dorn and Kye Yeung, all Collision Industry Conference (CIC) committee chairs, served as judges for the awards and spoke about the products during the CIC meeting Tuesday.
paras.zh: 碰撞行业会议 (CIC) 委员会主席 Andrew Batenhorst、Barry Dorn 和 Kye Yeung 担任该奖项的评委，并在周二的 CIC 会议上谈到了这些产品。

paras.en: Batenhorst said he uses the new Celette Webtools AI in his shop.
paras.zh: Batenhorst 表示，他在自己的商店中使用了新的 Celette Webtools AI。

paras.en: “It is a generational leap in terms of ease of use and connectivity,” Batenhorst said. “It has fixed a lot of the bugs it had in the past, but what is cool is that it is compatible with other brands.”
paras.zh: “在易用性和连接性方面，这是一个代际的飞跃，”巴滕霍斯特说。 “它修复了过去存在的许多错误，但最酷的是它与其他品牌兼容。”

paras.en: He adds that it has made life easier for the technicians in his shop.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这让他店里的技术人员的生活变得更加轻松。

paras.en: Yeung said Bossauto Innova’s Ionizer Pro is different from other guns he’s used.
paras.zh: Yeung 表示 Bossauto Innova 的 Ionizer Pro 与他使用过的其他枪不同。

paras.en: “It basically can record and tell you firsthand what distance and what temperature is needed,” Yeung said.
paras.zh: “它基本上可以记录并直接告诉你需要多远的距离和多少温度，”杨说。

paras.en: Batenhorst said Innovative Tools & Technologies’ Innovative Truck Cab Protectors is simple but ingenious.
paras.zh: Batenhorst表示，创新工具和技术的创新卡车驾驶室保护器简单而巧妙。

paras.en: “As you’re lifting the bed up and away from the frame, it gives a really nice cushion to prevent you from accidentally chipping the paint on the back of the cab,” Batenhorst said.
paras.zh: “当你将床抬起并远离框架时，它会提供一个非常好的缓冲垫，以防止你意外地将驾驶室后面的油漆剥落，”巴滕霍斯特说。

paras.en: Dorn said that the protector was debated by the judges because the idea is simple.
paras.zh: 多恩表示，法官们对保护者进行了辩论，因为这个想法很简单。

paras.en: “But we’ve never seen anything like it,” he said.
paras.zh: “但我们从未见过这样的事情，”他说。

paras.en: A lot of thought went into each decision made by the judges, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，法官做出的每项决定都经过了深思熟虑。

paras.en: “We want to bring forth the best thing that’s going to revolutionize the collision industry,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们希望推出最好的产品，彻底改变碰撞行业，”他说。

paras.en: Yeung added that SEMA looks for industry experts to judge.
paras.zh: Yeung补充说，SEMA正在寻找行业专家来评判。

paras.en: “We take it seriously because this could be life-changing for these companies,” Yeung said. “We look at innovation; we look at price point. We look at how the industry can use this product.”
paras.zh: “我们认真对待它，因为这可能会改变这些公司的生活，”杨说。 “我们关注创新；我们关注价格点。我们关注行业如何使用该产品。”

paras.en: Justine Hubbard, SEMA new product showcase manager, told CIC that the showcase is the number one destination for all buyers that attend the SEMA show.
paras.zh: SEMA新产品展示经理Justine Hubbard告诉CIC，该展示是所有参加SEMA展会的买家的第一目的地。

paras.en: “We call it a trade show within a trade show,” Hubbard said. “So we are a one-stop shop of everything that is new this year.”
paras.zh: “我们称之为贸易展中的贸易展，”哈伯德说。 “所以我们是今年所有新品的一站式商店。”

paras.en: It is a way for an exhibitor to increase their brand exposure, she said. She said the average visitor spent 21 minutes in New Products and 78% of buyers/media reported visiting an exhibitor’s booth after seeing their product in the showcase.
paras.zh: 她说，这是参展商增加品牌曝光度的一种方式。她表示，参观者平均在新产品上花费 21 分钟，78% 的买家/媒体表示在展示中看到他们的产品后参观了参展商的展位。

paras.en: The showcase can be found in the Lower South Hall, Booth #41271.
paras.zh: 该展示位于下南厅，展位号：41271。

paras.en: More than 1,300 products competed for top honors across 15 New Products Showcases categories.
paras.zh: 超过 1,300 种产品在 15 个新产品展示类别中角逐最高荣誉。

paras.en: “The SEMA Show New Product Awards celebrate the ingenuity driving the automotive aftermarket forward,” SEMA CEO Mike Spagnola said in a release. “This year’s honorees demonstrate how our industry continues to anticipate customer needs and turn bold ideas into market-ready products.”
paras.zh: SEMA 首席执行官 Mike Spagnola 在一份新闻稿中表示：“SEMA 展会新产品奖旨在表彰推动汽车售后市场向前发展的独创性。” “今年的获奖者展示了我们的行业如何继续预测客户需求并将大胆的想法转化为市场就绪的产品。”

articles.title: Brake Job: 2019-Present Ram 2500
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The fifth-generation Ram 2500 places substantial demands on its brakes. Many of these trucks carry heavy payloads, tow trailers or operate in fleets, so a successful brake job requires a complete-system inspection and parts that match the platform’s thermal and mechanical demands.
paras.zh: 第五代 Ram 2500 对刹车提出了很高的要求。许多卡车都承载重物、牵引拖车或在车队中运行，因此成功的制动工作需要完整的系统检查和符合平台热和机械要求的零件。

paras.en: This Brake Job covers the 2019-present fifth-generation Ram 2500, not the Ram 1500. The 2500 uses heavy-duty components and platform-specific procedures. Confirm the model year, engine, axle and options before ordering parts or applying specifications.
paras.zh: 此制动作业涵盖 2019 年推出的第五代 Ram 2500，而不是 Ram 1500。2500 使用重型组件和特定于平台的程序。在订购零件或应用规格之前，请确认型号年份、发动机、车轴和选件。

paras.en: The Ram 2500 has four-wheel vented discs and dual-piston sliding calipers. Separate parking-brake shoes act against a drum surface inside each rear rotor hat.
paras.zh: Ram 2500 配备四轮通风盘和双活塞滑动卡钳。单独的驻车制动蹄作用于每个后转子帽内的鼓表面。

paras.en: Booster configuration depends on the engine. The 6.4L Hemi uses a dual-diaphragm vacuum booster and an electric vacuum pump near the left front of the engine to supplement engine vacuum. The PCM commands the pump based on operating inputs. The 6.7L diesel uses Hydro-Boost, supplied by the power-steering pump, with an accumulator providing limited reserve assist if pump pressure is lost.
paras.zh: 增压器配置取决于发动机。 6.4L Hemi采用双膜片真空助力器和靠近发动机左前部的电动真空泵来补充发动机真空。 PCM 根据操作输入命令泵。 6.7L 柴油机采用 Hydro-Boost，由动力转向泵提供动力，蓄能器在泵压力损失时提供有限的储备辅助。

paras.en: When it’s practical, begin the process with a road test and note pedal travel, assist, pull, vibration and noise under normal braking. Confirm the complaint before disassembly; a vibration blamed on the front brakes may originate at the rear, and an assist complaint may come from the vacuum or power-steering circuit rather than the foundation brakes.
paras.zh: 如果可行，请从道路测试开始，并记录正常制动下的踏板行程、助力、拉力、振动和噪音。拆机前确认投诉内容；前制动器的振动可能源自后制动器，辅助投诉可能来自真空或动力转向电路，而不是基础制动器。

paras.en: Clean around the master-cylinder cap and verify that the fluid is at the MAX mark. On a diesel vehicle, you should also inspect the power-steering fluid level, hoses and lines, because Hydro-Boost depends on that circuit. Low fluid, leaks, restrictions or weak pump output can create assist complaints. On gasoline models, inspect booster vacuum plumbing and electric-pump operation.
paras.zh: 清洁主缸盖周围并确认油液处于 MAX 标记处。对于柴油车，您还应该检查动力转向液液位、软管和管路，因为 Hydro-Boost 依赖于该回路。低液量、泄漏、限制或泵输出较弱都会引起辅助投诉。对于汽油型号，检查增压真空管道和电动泵的运行情况。

paras.en: Compare inner and outer pad wear and both sides of each axle. Uneven wear can reveal seized hardware, binding pads, piston trouble or slide problems. Replace pads as an axle set if usable lining at the thinnest point is 1 mm (0.04 inch) or less. Inspect boots, pistons, slides, hoses and bleeders for damage, leakage and corrosion.
paras.zh: 比较内、外垫磨损情况以及每个轴两侧的磨损情况。不均匀磨损可能会暴露出卡住的硬件、结合垫、活塞故障或滑动问题。如果最薄点处的可用衬里为 1 毫米（0.04 英寸）或更小，则将轴垫更换为轴组。检查防尘套、活塞、滑块、软管和泄放器是否有损坏、泄漏和腐蚀。

paras.en: Be sure to measure the rotors. Minimum thickness is 37.4 mm (1.47 inches) front and 32.4 mm (1.28 inches) rear. Maximum runout is 0.020 mm (0.0008 inch); maximum loose-rotor thickness variation is 0.008 mm (0.00031 inch). You should also inspect the internal parking-brake surface; maximum drum diameter is 207.2 mm (8.157 inches).
paras.zh: 请务必测量转子。正面最小厚度为 37.4 毫米（1.47 英寸），背面最小厚度为 32.4 毫米（1.28 英寸）。最大跳动为 0.020 毫米（0.0008 英寸）；最大松动转子厚度变化为 0.008 毫米（0.00031 英寸）。您还应该检查内部驻车制动器表面；最大滚筒直径为 207.2 毫米（8.157 英寸）。

paras.en: Support the caliper and adapter; never let the hose carry their weight. Clean the pad lands and hub face without removing base metal. Install new anti-rattle clips, verify free pad movement and make sure both pistons retract smoothly. Because the rotor fits over the hub studs, hub cleanliness and uniform wheel-fastener torque are critical to controlling installed runout.
paras.zh: 支持卡尺和适配器；切勿让软管承载其重量。清洁垫片焊盘和轮毂面，无需去除基底金属。安装新的防震夹，验证自由垫运动并确保两个活塞顺利缩回。由于转子安装在轮毂螺柱上，因此轮毂清洁度和均匀的车轮紧固件扭矩对于控制安装跳动至关重要。

paras.en: Rear service adds the parking-brake assembly. A rotor that will not release may be hanging on the shoes, so release the pedal and back off the star wheel if necessary. With the rotor off, inspect the shoes, springs, adjuster, cable action and drum surface. Clean the hub and bracket, verify piston and slide movement, and install new hardware and sealing washers as required.
paras.zh: 后部服务增加了驻车制动器组件。无法释放的转子可能挂在鞋子上，因此如有必要，请释放踏板并退出星轮。转子关闭后，检查蹄块、弹簧、调节器、拉索和滚筒表面。清洁轮毂和支架，验证活塞和滑块的运动，并根据需要安装新的硬件和密封垫圈。

paras.en: Always replace caliper hardware; old clips can restrict pad movement and cause uneven wear.
paras.zh: 务必更换卡尺硬件；旧夹子会限制刹车片的移动并导致磨损不均匀。

paras.en: Use fresh fluid meeting SAE J1703-F and DOT 3 standards. Bleed in this order: right rear, left rear, right front and left front, keeping the reservoir full. For pressure bleeding, use the correct adapter; 15-20 PSI is generally sufficient, depending on equipment limits.
paras.zh: 使用符合 SAE J1703-F 和 DOT 3 标准的新鲜液体。按此顺序放气：右后、左后、右前、左前，保持储液罐充满。对于压力排放，请使用正确的适配器； 15-20 PSI 通常就足够了，具体取决于设备限制。

paras.en: If air entered the HCU, perform a base bleed, use a capable scan tool’s ABS Miscellaneous menu to run the HCU bleed routine, then bleed the base system again. Set the fluid level and verify a firm pedal.
paras.zh: 如果空气进入 HCU，请执行基础排气，使用功能强大的扫描工具的 ABS 杂项菜单运行 HCU 排气程序，然后再次对基础系统进行排气。设置液位并检查踏板是否牢固。

paras.en: Hydro-Boost is generally self- bleeding. Fill the power-steering reservoir, disable the engine and crank it for several seconds, then recheck the level. Re-enable and start the engine, slowly turn lock to lock twice, shut it off and discharge the accumulator with five pedal applications. Restart, repeat two slow lock-to-lock cycles, shut down and correct the level. If the fluid foams, let it dissipate before repeating the final cycles.
paras.zh: Hydro-Boost 通常是自出血的。加注动力转向油箱，关闭发动机并转动几秒钟，然后重新检查油位。重新启用并启动发动机，缓慢地将锁旋转至锁止两次，将其关闭，并通过五次踏板应用对蓄能器进行放电。重新启动，重复两个缓慢的锁定到锁定循环，关闭并校正电平。如果液体起泡，请使其消散，然后再重复最后的循环。

paras.en: Adjust the shoes before cable tension. With the pedal fully released and the front cable slackened at the frame-rail adjuster, turn each star wheel through the backing-plate hole until slight drag is felt, then back it off until drag disappears. Adjust both sides equally.
paras.zh: 在缆线张紧之前调整鞋子。当踏板完全释放并且前拉线在车架纵梁调节器处松弛时，通过背板孔转动每个星轮，直到感觉到轻微的阻力，然后向后退，直到阻力消失。两边调整均匀。

paras.en: Cable-tensioner adjustment is normally required only after replacement or disconnection. After verifying cable movement and shoe adjustment, fully apply the pedal. Mark the non-threaded tensioner rod 1/4 inch from the tensioner edge and tighten the nut until the mark disappears. Release the pedal, confirm both wheels rotate freely, verify that the brake holds and road-test the truck.
paras.zh: 通常仅在更换或断开连接后才需要调整拉索张紧器。验证缆线移动和蹄调整后，完全踩下踏板。在距张紧器边缘 1/4 英寸处的无螺纹张紧器杆上做标记，然后拧紧螺母直至标记消失。松开踏板，确认两个车轮自由旋转，验证制动器是否固定并对卡车进行道路测试。

articles.title: Understanding the Audi Valve Lift System (AVS)
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The Audi valvelift system, or AVS, is a two-stage variable-valve-lift system. Instead of changing only a camshaft’s angular position, AVS changes the lobe that operates the intake, exhaust or both valves. A small or short-duration profile reduces pumping losses at partial load; while a larger profile improves cylinder filling or exhaust flow under load. Some versions add a zero-lift profile for cylinder deactivation.
paras.zh: 奥迪气门升程系统（AVS）是一种两级可变气门升程系统。 AVS 不是仅改变凸轮轴的角位置，而是改变操作进气门、排气门或两个气门的凸角。小或短持续时间的剖面可减少部分负载时的泵送损失；而较大的轮廓可改善负载下的气缸填充或排气流量。某些版本增加了用于气缸停用的零升程曲线。

paras.en: AVS first appeared globally on Audi’s 2.8-liter FSI V6 and reached North America on the 3.2-liter FSI V6 for 2008. Audi subsequently used it on some 2.0 TFSI EA888 four-cylinders; the 2.5 TFSI EA855 evo; 2.9- and turbocharged 3.0-liter EA839 V6 engines; 4.0 TFSI V8s; the second-generation 5.2 FSI V10; and the 6.3 FSI W12. European applications include the 1.4 TFSI cylinder-on-demand engine and 4.0 TDI V8. The supercharged EA837 3.0 TFSI is an important exception: Audi states that it does not use AVS.
paras.zh: AVS 首次出现在全球奥迪的 2.8 升 FSI V6 发动机上，并于 2008 年在 3.2 升 FSI V6 发动机上进入北美。奥迪随后将其用于一些 2.0 TFSI EA888 四缸发动机； 2.5 TFSI EA855 evo； 2.9 升和涡轮增压 3.0 升 EA839 V6 发动机； 4.0 TFSI V8；第二代 5.2 FSI V10；和 6.3 FSI W12。欧洲应用包括 1.4 TFSI 气缸按需发动机和 4.0 TDI V8 发动机。增压型 EA837 3.0 TFSI 是一个重要的例外：奥迪声明其不使用 AVS。

paras.en: Volkswagen-brand applications include the intake-side system on the EA888 Generation III B 2.0 TSI introduced in the 2018 Tiguan and related B-cycle applications. European 1.4- and 1.5-liter TSI engines use the sliding-cam principle for Active Cylinder Technology, or ACT. Equipment varies by output, market and engine code, so never identify AVS by displacement or badge alone.
paras.zh: 大众品牌应用包括 2018 Tiguan 中推出的 EA888 第三代 B 2.0 TSI 上的进气侧系统以及相关的 B 循环应用。欧洲 1.4 升和 1.5 升 TSI 发动机采用主动气缸技术 (ACT) 的滑动凸轮原理。设备因产量、市场和发动机代码而异，因此切勿仅通过排量或徽章来识别 AVS。

paras.en: AVS can be installed on either side. The longitudinal Audi EA888 2.0 TFSI originally used AVS on its single exhaust camshaft. Volkswagen’s EA888 Generation III B uses it on the intake camshaft. A V6 may have it on one intake camshaft per bank, or two camshafts. Cylinder-deactivation V8 and V10 versions switch both intake and exhaust valves on the affected cylinders, sealing them with all valves closed.
paras.zh: AVS 可以安装在任意一侧。纵向奥迪 EA888 2.0 TFSI 最初在其单排气凸轮轴上使用 AVS。大众的EA888 III B代将其用在进气凸轮轴上。 V6 发动机可能安装在每组一个进气凸轮轴上，或者安装在两个凸轮轴上。停缸 V8 和 V10 版本会同时切换受影响气缸上的进气门和排气门，在所有阀门关闭的情况下将其密封。

paras.en: The basic camshaft carries external splines. Cylindrical cam pieces, sometimes called cam sleeves, fit over those splines and carry two or more adjacent lobe profiles. Electromagnetic actuators are mounted in the cam cover or camshaft frame above the sleeves.
paras.zh: 基本凸轮轴带有外花键。圆柱形凸轮件（有时称为凸轮套筒）安装在这些花键上并带有两个或多个相邻的凸角轮廓。电磁执行器安装在套筒上方的凸轮盖或凸轮轴架内。

paras.en: When the ECM commands a change, it briefly energizes an actuator and extends a metal pin into a helical groove in the rotating cam piece. The groove converts rotation into axial movement, sliding the sleeve until the alternate lobe aligns with the follower. A spring-loaded detent holds the sleeve, and a return ramp pushes the actuator pin back, inducing a voltage pulse that confirms the shift. A second actuator and groove move the sleeve in the opposite direction.
paras.zh: 当 ECM 命令进行更改时，它会短暂地为执行器通电，并将金属销伸入旋转凸轮件的螺旋槽中。凹槽将旋转转换为轴向运动，滑动套筒，直到备用凸角与从动件对齐。弹簧加载的制动器固定套筒，返回斜坡将致动器销向后推，从而产生确认移位的电压脉冲。第二个致动器和凹槽使套筒沿相反方向移动。

paras.en: AVS and variable valve timing are separate systems. AVS changes lift and duration by selecting lobes. A hydraulic camshaft adjuster rotates the entire camshaft relative to the crankshaft, changing when the valves open and close. The ECM coordinates both with throttle angle, load, speed, boost and temperature.
paras.zh: AVS 和可变气门正时是独立的系统。 AVS 通过选择波瓣来改变升力和持续时间。液压凸轮轴调节器使整个凸轮轴相对于曲轴旋转，从而在阀门打开和关闭时发生变化。 ECM 与节气门角度、负载、速度、增压和温度进行协调。

paras.en: On an intake-side B-cycle engine, the small profile provides a shorter opening period and earlier closing point. Cam phasing positions that event. Under higher load, AVS selects the longer profile and the phaser moves toward an Otto-cycle strategy. Exhaust-side systems coordinate lift, duration and cam position to manage residual gas, turbine energy and cylinder filling.
paras.zh: 在进气侧 B 循环发动机上，较小的轮廓可提供更短的开启时间和更早的关闭点。凸轮定相位置该事件。在较高负载下，AVS 选择较长的轮廓，并且移相器转向奥托循环策略。排气侧系统协调升力、持续时间和凸轮位置，以管理残余气体、涡轮能量和气缸填充。

paras.en: On exhaust-side applications, it selects the valve event that preserves exhaust-pulse energy and gas velocity at lower speed, helping the turbine respond sooner. At higher airflow, the larger, longer-duration profile reduces restriction. The ECM coordinates AVS with cam phasing, ignition, throttle and wastegate control; the benefit comes from the complete charge-management strategy.
paras.zh: 在排气侧应用中，它选择在较低速度下保留排气脉冲能量和气体速度的阀门事件，帮助涡轮机更快地响应。在气流较高时，较大、持续时间较长的轮廓可减少限制。 ECM 协调 AVS 与凸轮定相、点火、节气门和废气旁通阀控制；好处来自于完整的充电管理策略。

paras.en: The sleeve is not shifted by engine oil. The actuator is electrical, and camshaft rotation supplies the force that moves the sleeve. However, oil is still essential for lubricating the cam pieces, splines, followers and bearings. More importantly, the conventional cam phasers paired with AVS are hydraulically operated. Incorrect viscosity, low oil pressure, sludge or aeration can therefore cause timing faults or poor operation that may be mistaken for an AVS failure.
paras.zh: 套筒不会因发动机油而移动。执行器是电动的，凸轮轴旋转提供移动套筒的力。然而，油对于润滑凸轮件、花键、从动件和轴承仍然是必不可少的。更重要的是，与 AVS 配对的传统凸轮相位器是液压操作的。因此，不正确的粘度、低油压、油泥或充气可能会导致正时故障或操作不良，从而可能被误认为是 AVS 故障。

paras.en: Common complaints include a MIL or EPC lamp, rough operation, reduced power and valve-lift actuator codes. Depending on the application, technicians may encounter P11A1 through P11B8 electrical or implausible-signal faults. Likely causes include an open or shorted actuator coil, connector or harness damage, incorrect actuator-to-cam clearance, a sticking actuator pin, or a cam piece that cannot slide because of wear, damage or contamination.
paras.zh: 常见的投诉包括 MIL 或 EPC 灯、操作粗暴、功率降低和阀门升程执行器代码。根据应用的不同，技术人员可能会遇到 P11A1 至 P11B8 电气或不可信信号故障。可能的原因包括执行器线圈开路或短路、连接器或线束损坏、执行器与凸轮间隙不正确、执行器销粘住或凸轮件因磨损、损坏或污染而无法滑动。

paras.en: Audi TSB 2031085/1 addresses implausible cam-actuator signals on 2009-2012 3.2 FSI applications. It calls for measuring actuator-pin clearance and specifies a revised actuator at 0.9 mm or greater; Audi also noted an optimized camshaft frame from July 2011.
paras.zh: Audi TSB 2031085/1 解决了 2009-2012 3.2 FSI 应用中不可信的凸轮执行器信号问题。它要求测量执行器销间隙，并指定修改后的执行器为 0.9 毫米或更大；奥迪还注意到自 2011 年 7 月起优化了凸轮轴框架。

paras.en: When working on this, start diagnosis with a full scan, freeze-frame data and the appropriate output test or basic setting. Confirm power, ground and coil integrity before condemning the camshaft, and separate AVS codes from cam-phaser or oil-pressure faults.
paras.zh: 进行此操作时，请通过完整扫描、冻结帧数据和适当的输出测试或基本设置开始诊断。在报废凸轮轴之前确认电源、接地和线圈的完整性，并将 AVS 代码与凸轮相位器或油压故障分开。

articles.title: Autel Integrates Alldata Repair With MaxiSYS Tablets
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Autel U.S. and Alldata have partnered to connect Autel’s MaxiSYS diagnostic software with Alldata Repair on select MaxiSYS tablets. Alldata provides original equipment manufacturer (OEM) repair information. The integration connects vehicle fault codes with corresponding OEM diagnostic information, bringing scan results and repair procedures together on one screen, the companies said.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 和 Alldata 合作，将 Autel 的 MaxiSYS 诊断软件与指定 MaxiSYS 平板电脑上的 Alldata Repair 连接起来。 Alldata 提供原始设备制造商 (OEM) 维修信息。两家公司表示，该集成将车辆故障代码与相应的 OEM 诊断信息连接起来，将扫描结果和维修程序集中在一个屏幕上。

paras.en: Supported models include the MaxiSYS Ultra S2, MS919 S2 and MS909 S2. The integration also supports the MaxiSYS Ultra, MS919, MS909, Ultra ADAS and Ultra EV.
paras.zh: 支持的型号包括 MaxiSYS Ultra S2、MS919 S2 和 MS909 S2。该集成还支持 MaxiSYS Ultra、MS919、MS909、Ultra ADAS 和 Ultra EV。

paras.en: From a fault code in MaxiSYS, users can open the associated Alldata information for the selected vehicle. They can review OEM code descriptions, detection criteria, possible causes and diagnostic procedures.
paras.zh: 用户可以通过 MaxiSYS 中的故障代码打开所选车辆的关联 Alldata 信息。他们可以查看 OEM 代码描述、检测标准、可能的原因和诊断程序。

paras.en: A split-screen view displays MaxiSYS diagnostic results alongside Alldata. This allows technicians to consult factory instructions while viewing the fault they are investigating.
paras.zh: 分屏视图与 Alldata 一起显示 MaxiSYS 诊断结果。这使得技术人员可以在查看他们正在调查的故障时查阅工厂说明。

paras.en: Technicians can follow links within Alldata to related testing, removal and installation procedures, illustrations and service precautions.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以通过 Alldata 中的链接查看相关测试、拆卸和安装程序、插图和服务预防措施。

paras.en: The integration carries vehicle and fault-code information into the repair-information workflow, reducing the need for separate searches. It also helps technicians move from diagnosis to repair.
paras.zh: 该集成将车辆和故障代码信息纳入维修信息工作流程，从而减少单独搜索的需要。它还可以帮助技术人员从诊断转向修复。

paras.en: The integration also provides access to Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence, Alldata’s newest solution. It combines OEM repair information, real-world repair intelligence and AI-assisted insights in one diagnostic workflow, according to the company.
paras.zh: 该集成还提供对 Alldata 最新解决方案 Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence 的访问。据该公司称，它将 OEM 维修信息、现实世界的维修智能和人工智能辅助的见解结合在一个诊断工作流程中。

articles.title: Advics Offers More Aftermarket Brake Pads, Rotors
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Advics announced the availability of 56 new brake pad kit SKUs and three new disc brake rotor SKUs.
paras.zh: Advics 宣布推出 56 款新刹车片套件 SKU 和 3 款新盘式制动器转子 SKU。

paras.en: The 56 new ultra-premium brake pad kit SKUs provide approximately 62.8 million vehicles in operation (VIO) axle coverage in the U.S. and Canada. The expansion covers import models including Acura, Honda, Infiniti, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Hyundai and Kia applications.
paras.zh: 这 56 个全新超高级刹车片套件 SKU 为美国和加拿大约 6280 万辆运营车辆 (VIO) 提供车轴覆盖。此次扩展涵盖了讴歌、本田、英菲尼迪、马自达、三菱、日产、现代和起亚等进口车型。

paras.en: Advics is also expanding its ultra-premium disc brake rotor line with three new SKUs for Toyota and Lexus applications, providing approximately 858,000 VIO axle coverage in the U.S. and Canada.
paras.zh: Advics 还通过适用于丰田和雷克萨斯应用的三个新 SKU 扩展其超优质盘式制动器转子产品线，在美国和加拿大提供约 858,000 个 VIO 车轴覆盖范围。

paras.en: All three rotor SKUs are manufactured in the U.S.
paras.zh: 所有三个转子 SKU 均在美国制造。

articles.title: Autel Awards Five Automotive Education Scholarships
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Autel announced five recipients of its second annual Awarding Excellence Scholarships. The scholarships are part of Autel Cares, the company’s philanthropic initiative supporting automotive education and community causes.
paras.zh: Autel 宣布了第二届年度卓越奖学金的五位获奖者。这些奖学金是 Autel Cares 的一部分，这是该公司支持汽车教育和社区事业的慈善计划。

paras.en: The 2026 program awards five $5,000 scholarships, totaling $25,000. The awards support students pursuing education and training in automotive repair and service.
paras.zh: 2026 年计划颁发五项 5,000 美元的奖学金，总计 25,000 美元。该奖项支持学生接受汽车维修和服务方面的教育和培训。

paras.en: Recipients can use the scholarships for tuition, tools, books, supplies and other education-related expenses. The students are preparing for careers in the automotive repair industry.
paras.zh: 获奖者可以使用奖学金支付学费、工具、书籍、用品和其他与教育相关的费用。学生们正在为汽车维修行业的职业生涯做准备。

paras.en: This year, Autel expanded eligibility beyond recent high school graduates. Adult learners returning to school or transitioning from another career also qualified.
paras.zh: 今年，Autel 将资格范围扩大到应届高中毕业生之外。返回学校或从其他职业转型的成人学习者也符合资格。

paras.en: The 2026 recipients represent students at different stages of life and training. Their interests include automotive technology, collision repair, manufacturer-level service and automotive cybersecurity.
paras.zh: 2026 名获奖者代表了处于人生和培训不同阶段的学生。他们的兴趣包括汽车技术、碰撞修复、制造商级服务和汽车网络安全。

paras.en: “Last year, selecting our first scholarship recipients was difficult. This year was even more challenging because we received so many outstanding applications from students with compelling stories, clear goals, and a genuine commitment to automotive education,” said Chloe Hung, CEO of Autel U.S.
paras.zh: Autel 美国首席执行官 Chloe Hung 表示：“去年，选择第一批奖学金获得者非常困难。今年更具挑战性，因为我们收到了许多来自学生的优秀申请，这些学生拥有引人入胜的故事、明确的目标以及对汽车教育的真诚承诺。”

paras.en: “The five recipients selected this year reflect the many different paths people take into the automotive repair industry, from students beginning their training to adults continuing or returning to school. Autel is proud to support their education and invest in the skilled professionals who will help shape the future of automotive repair.”
paras.zh: “今年选出的五位获奖者反映了人们进入汽车维修行业的多种不同途径，从学生开始接受培训到成人继续或返回学校。Autel 很自豪能够支持他们的教育并投资于有助于塑造汽车维修未来的熟练专业人员。”

paras.en: The 2026 Autel Awarding Excellence Scholarship recipients are:
paras.zh: 2026 年 Autel 卓越奖学金获得者是：

paras.en: - Shawn Clark, of Deer Lodge, Montana, attends Highlands College of Montana Tech. Clark is beginning a new chapter in automotive education at age 50. He is pursuing an associate degree in automotive technology. His application reflects this year’s expanded eligibility for adult learners returning to school. Clark plans to build a new career in automotive repair.
paras.zh: - 蒙大拿州 Deer Lodge 的 Shawn Clark 就读于蒙大拿州高地理工学院。 50 岁时，克拉克开始了汽车教育的新篇章。他正在攻读汽车技术副学士学位。他的申请反映了今年成人学习者重返校园的资格扩大了。克拉克计划在汽车维修领域开创新的职业生涯。

paras.en: - Jacob Heinrichs, of Austin, Texas, attends Universal Technical Institute of Texas Inc. Heinrichs already works in the field and has three years of experience as an automotive technician. His selection reflects Autel’s support for working technicians seeking additional training. Heinrichs aims to advance his skills and career opportunities.
paras.zh: - Jacob Heinrichs 来自德克萨斯州奥斯汀，就读于德克萨斯州通用技术学院。Heinrichs 已经在该领域工作，并拥有三年的汽车技术人员经验。他的选择反映了 Autel 对寻求额外培训的工作技术人员的支持。海因里希斯的目标是提高他的技能和职业机会。

paras.en: - Marisa Rueger, of Harleysville, Pennsylvania, attends Automotive Training Center-Warminster. Rueger is pursuing collision repair and holds a 4.0 GPA. In her application, she described collision repair as her art. She also emphasized her desire to continue learning, growing and succeeding in the field.
paras.zh: - 来自宾夕法尼亚州哈利斯维尔的 Marisa Rueger 就读于沃明斯特汽车培训中心。 Rueger 致力于碰撞修复并拥有 4.0 GPA。在她的申请中，她将碰撞修复描述为她的艺术。她还强调了她在该领域继续学习、成长和取得成功的愿望。

paras.en: - Logan Mercier, of Claremont, California, attends Universal Technical Institute of California Inc. Mercier aims to complete school with a 4.0 GPA. He also plans to build advanced diagnostic skills and work toward becoming a master technician. His application focuses on academic achievement, professional growth and building a career in automotive repair.
paras.zh: - Logan Mercier，来自加利福尼亚州克莱蒙特，就读于加州环球技术学院。Mercier 的目标是以 4.0 的 GPA 完成学业。他还计划培养先进的诊断技能，并努力成为一名技术大师。他的申请重点是学术成就、专业发展和在汽车维修领域建立职业生涯。

paras.en: - Kristof Adam, of Stillwater, Minnesota, attends Century College. Adam is pursuing a career in automotive cybersecurity. He has a strong interest in hands-on vehicle work and advanced automotive technology. His application highlights the growing importance of technical education as vehicles become more connected, complex and software-driven.
paras.zh: - 明尼苏达州斯蒂尔沃特的克里斯托夫·亚当 (Kristof Adam) 就读于世纪学院。 Adam 正在从事汽车网络安全领域的职业。他对车辆实践和先进汽车技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他的申请凸显了随着车辆变得更加互联、复杂和软件驱动，技术教育变得越来越重要。

paras.en: Applicants submitted either a 500- to 600-word essay or a two- to three-minute video. They described the path that led them to pursue automotive repair education.
paras.zh: 申请人提交了一篇 500 到 600 字的论文或一段两到三分钟的视频。他们描述了引导他们追求汽车维修教育的道路。

paras.en: Applicants also explained how the scholarship would support their training. They discussed their goals, obstacles and planned careers in the automotive repair industry.
paras.zh: 申请人还解释了奖学金将如何支持他们的培训。他们讨论了自己在汽车维修行业的目标、障碍和职业规划。

articles.title: Bosch Blue Disc Brake Rotors Line Announced
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Bosch Mobility Aftermarket announced the launch of its Bosch Blue disc brake rotors line.
paras.zh: 博世移动售后市场宣布推出博世蓝色盘式制动器转子系列。

paras.en: According to Bosch, the rotors feature the same composition, weight and vane design as OE parts. The company touts precise machining and high-quality casting to ensure reliable braking and a long lifespan, protective paint coatings on the hat and edge, and a non-directional finish for stopping performance.
paras.zh: 据博世称，转子的成分、重量和叶片设计与原厂部件相同。该公司吹捧精确的加工和高质量的铸造，以确保可靠的制动和较长的使用寿命，帽子和边缘上的保护性油漆涂层，以及用于停止性能的非定向表面处理。

paras.en: “Bosch Blue rotors were designed to give shop owners an everyday option that delivers quality, performance and value – helping end-customers get the most from their repair investment without sacrificing confident performance,” said Bobby Mathius, senior product marketing manager at Bosch Mobility Aftermarket. “With 830 total part numbers across the Bosch Blue disc brake rotors line, shop owners and technicians can confidently recommend and install Blue rotors for 95% of foreign and domestic vehicles currently on the road.”
paras.zh: 博世移动售后市场高级产品营销经理 Bobby Mathius 表示：“博世 Blue 转子旨在为店主提供质量、性能和价值的日常选择，帮助最终客户从维修投资中获得最大回报，同时又不牺牲自信的性能。” “博世 Blue 盘式制动器转子系列共有 830 个零件号，店主和技术人员可以自信地为目前在路上行驶的 95% 的外国和国内车辆推荐和安装 Blue 转子。”

articles.title: Autel Integrates Alldata Repair With MaxiSYS Tablets
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Autel U.S. and Alldata have partnered to connect Autel’s MaxiSYS diagnostic software with Alldata Repair on select MaxiSYS tablets. Alldata provides original equipment manufacturer (OEM) repair information. The integration connects vehicle fault codes with corresponding OEM diagnostic information, bringing scan results and repair procedures together on one screen, the companies said.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 和 Alldata 合作，将 Autel 的 MaxiSYS 诊断软件与指定 MaxiSYS 平板电脑上的 Alldata Repair 连接起来。 Alldata 提供原始设备制造商 (OEM) 维修信息。两家公司表示，该集成将车辆故障代码与相应的 OEM 诊断信息连接起来，将扫描结果和维修程序集中在一个屏幕上。

paras.en: Supported models include the MaxiSYS Ultra S2, MS919 S2 and MS909 S2. The integration also supports the MaxiSYS Ultra, MS919, MS909, Ultra ADAS and Ultra EV.
paras.zh: 支持的型号包括 MaxiSYS Ultra S2、MS919 S2 和 MS909 S2。该集成还支持 MaxiSYS Ultra、MS919、MS909、Ultra ADAS 和 Ultra EV。

paras.en: From a fault code in MaxiSYS, users can open the associated Alldata information for the selected vehicle. They can review OEM code descriptions, detection criteria, possible causes and diagnostic procedures.
paras.zh: 用户可以通过 MaxiSYS 中的故障代码打开所选车辆的关联 Alldata 信息。他们可以查看 OEM 代码描述、检测标准、可能的原因和诊断程序。

paras.en: A split-screen view displays MaxiSYS diagnostic results alongside Alldata. This allows technicians to consult factory instructions while viewing the fault they are investigating.
paras.zh: 分屏视图与 Alldata 一起显示 MaxiSYS 诊断结果。这使得技术人员可以在查看他们正在调查的故障时查阅工厂说明。

paras.en: Technicians can follow links within Alldata to related testing, removal and installation procedures, illustrations and service precautions.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以通过 Alldata 中的链接查看相关测试、拆卸和安装程序、插图和服务预防措施。

paras.en: The integration carries vehicle and fault-code information into the repair-information workflow, reducing the need for separate searches. It also helps technicians move from diagnosis to repair.
paras.zh: 该集成将车辆和故障代码信息纳入维修信息工作流程，从而减少单独搜索的需要。它还可以帮助技术人员从诊断转向修复。

paras.en: The integration also provides access to Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence, Alldata’s newest solution. It combines OEM repair information, real-world repair intelligence and AI-assisted insights in one diagnostic workflow, according to the company.
paras.zh: 该集成还提供对 Alldata 最新解决方案 Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence 的访问。据该公司称，它将 OEM 维修信息、现实世界的维修智能和人工智能辅助的见解结合在一个诊断工作流程中。

articles.title: NexaMotion Group on ‘Creating More Room for Greater Expertise’
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: More than 100 NexaMotion Group employees are actively using AI, NMG’s CEO Neil Sethi said. Much of that use begins with analytics. CRM information that once required employees to work through large amounts of data manually can now be summarized and analyzed quickly.
paras.zh: NMG 首席执行官 Neil Sethi 表示，超过 100 名 NexaMotion Group 员工正在积极使用人工智能。其中大部分用途都是从分析开始的。曾经需要员工手动处理大量数据的 CRM 信息现在可以快速汇总和分析。

paras.en: “We’re trying to allow our team members to really get the busy work out of their day-to-day lives and really put their intellectual horsepower to work more and more,” he said. “Which is really great for us because they’re really the asset that we have.”
paras.zh: “我们正在努力让我们的团队成员真正从日常生活中摆脱繁忙的工作，并真正将他们的智力更多地投入到工作中，”他说。 “这对我们来说真的很棒，因为它们确实是我们拥有的资产。”

paras.en: Naresh Kopparapu, NexaMotion Group’s chief information officer, grounds those projects in measurable business problems.
paras.zh: NexaMotion 集团首席信息官 Naresh Kopparapu 将这些项目建立在可衡量的业务问题之上。

paras.en: “We are looking at solving the customer’s problems. We have to put an AI where there’s a real cash flow or a real customer problem and see how we measure AI is able to help us with,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们正在考虑解决客户的问题。我们必须将人工智能放在有真正现金流或真正客户问题的地方，然后看看我们如何衡量人工智能能够帮助我们解决问题，”他说。

paras.en: Sales and service calls are one example. NexaMotion can summarize and score interactions, giving leaders visibility across a volume of calls they could never review individually.
paras.zh: 销售和服务电话就是一个例子。 NexaMotion 可以对交互进行总结和评分，让领导者能够了解他们无法单独查看的大量通话。

paras.en: “It gives the leadership information so that they can coach at scale because it used to be very difficult to go down that level,” Kopparapu said. “With all the tools that we have, we can summarize, we can create insights with the data that we generate. It’s not sitting in a database or a spreadsheet anymore.”
paras.zh: “它为领导层提供了信息，以便他们能够进行大规模指导，因为过去很难降到这个级别，”科帕拉普说。 “总结一下，利用我们拥有的所有工具，我们可以利用生成的数据创建见解。它不再存在于数据库或电子表格中。”

paras.en: That visibility supports a customer relationship that can operate across multiple forms of communication. Some shops prefer digital ordering and primarily want accurate availability and a dependable ETA for deliveries. Others want to call the person they have dealt with for years.
paras.zh: 这种可见性支持可以跨多种通信形式运作的客户关系。一些商店更喜欢数字订购，主要希望获得准确的供货情况和可靠的预计交货时间。其他人则想给已经打交道多年的人打电话。

paras.en: Billy Gwinn, executive vice president, NexaMotion Group operations and general repair sales, sees Transend eventually supporting that broader customer experience across both transmission and general repair with programs like the aforementioned Platinum Program.
paras.zh: NexaMotion 集团运营和一般维修销售执行副总裁 Billy Gwinn 认为 Transend 最终会通过上述白金计划等计划支持变速箱和一般维修方面更广泛的客户体验。

paras.en: “A customer may want to pay a dollar more to get the part in a timely manner versus having to wait two hours because then they have to deal with their customer who’s waiting for a part,” Gwinn said. “Ultimately Transend is the platform of the future.”
paras.zh: 格温说：“客户可能希望多付一美元才能及时获得零件，而不是等待两个小时，因为那样他们就必须与正在等待零件的客户打交道。” “最终 Transend 是未来的平台。”

paras.en: Kevin Rozsa, executive vice president of NMG mergers and acquisitions and Transtar sales, sees the same opportunity on the Transtar side. Customers who become more comfortable identifying and ordering straightforward parts through Transend give NexaMotion’s telephonic sales team additional room for consultative conversations.
paras.zh: NMG 并购和 Transtar 销售执行副总裁 Kevin Rozsa 在 Transtar 方面也看到了同样的机会。通过 Transend 更轻松地识别和订购简单零件的客户为 NexaMotion 的电话销售团队提供了更多的咨询对话空间。

paras.en: “Every time a customer places an order on Transend, our sales reps are automatically notified of that order and what it is,” Rozsa said. “Our reps can then review that and then reach out to the customer and say, ‘For this application have you considered these other items? Because these are important items to use in a complete rebuild.’”
paras.zh: “每次客户在 Transend 下订单时，我们的销售代表都会自动收到该订单及其内容的通知，”Rozsa 说。 “然后我们的代表可以对此进行审查，然后联系客户并询问，‘对于此应用程序，您考虑过这些其他项目吗？因为这些是在完整重建中使用的重要项目。’”

paras.en: Sethi sees that idea expanding much further as AI becomes better at connecting large datasets. Diagnostics, repair information, procurement, sourcing and planning all produce information. Connecting those systems could give participants throughout the supply chain a clearer view of what is happening and what actions to take.
paras.zh: Sethi 认为，随着人工智能在连接大型数据集方面变得更好，这一想法将得到进一步扩展。诊断、维修信息、采购、采购和规划都会产生信息。连接这些系统可以让整个供应链的参与者更清楚地了解正在发生的事情以及要采取的行动。

paras.en: “A lot of the data was already analyzed before the meeting,” Sethi said, describing a recent conversation with a key partner. “Now we’re talking about affecting the interworking relationship. So, they could take their datasets that have given them information and ours to, like, make change happen.”
paras.zh: “在会议之前已经分析了很多数据，”塞西在描述最近与一位重要合作伙伴的对话时说道。 “现在我们正在讨论影响互通关系。因此，他们可以利用为他们提供信息的数据集和我们的数据集来实现变革。”

paras.en: The people in the room still determine where to go next.
paras.zh: 房间里的人仍然决定下一步该去哪里。

paras.en: “We’re going to have to use our intelligence, our knowledge, our expertise and trust,” Sethi said. “Trust is not going to be AI driven.”
paras.zh: “我们必须利用我们的智慧、知识、专业知识和信任，”塞西说。 “信任不会由人工智能驱动。”

paras.en: For all of NexaMotion’s investment in systems capable of seeing across thousands of products and customer interactions, Sethi continues to look for information at its most immediate source: The shop.
paras.zh: 尽管 NexaMotion 对能够查看数千种产品和客户互动的系统进行了所有投资，但 Sethi 仍继续从最直接的来源寻找信息：商店。

paras.en: “I think any executive leadership team can get really entrapped in conference rooms. Literally, all day, every day, forever,” Sethi said. “At NMG we want to be in the field with the shops, understanding what they’re doing, understanding what they’re seeing.”
paras.zh: “我认为任何执行领导团队都可能真正陷入会议室。毫不夸张地说，整天、每一天、永远，”塞西说。 “在 NMG，我们希望与商店一起深入现场，了解他们在做什么，了解他们所看到的内容。”

paras.en: Technology gives NexaMotion more ways to see that future taking shape. The work comes in translating those signals and the intel they produce into something useful for the technician, the customer, the employee and, ultimately, the repair and parts requirements in front of them.
paras.zh: 技术为 NexaMotion 提供了更多方式来实现未来。我们的工作是将这些信号及其产生的情报转化为对技术人员、客户、员工以及最终对他们面前的维修和零件需求有用的东西。

paras.en: Pictured: The NMG team (left to right): Neil Sethi, Scott Weinstein, Kevin Rozsa, Billy Gwinn, Tim Cox, Naresh Kopparapu.
paras.zh: 图为：NMG 团队（从左到右）：Neil Sethi、Scott Weinstein、Kevin Rozsa、Billy Gwinn、Tim Cox、Naresh Kopparapu。

paras.en: Please note: This article concludes the 3-part NexaMotion Group article series.
paras.zh: 请注意：本文是由 3 部分组成的 NexaMotion Group 文章系列的总结。

paras.en: Part 1, NexaMotion Group on ‘Making Smarter Connections,’ can be found here.
paras.zh: 第 1 部分，NexaMotion Group 关于“打造更智能的连接”，可在此处找到。

paras.en: Part 2, NexaMotion Group on ‘Turning Information Into Better Decisions,’ can be viewed here.
paras.zh: 您可以在此处查看 NexaMotion Group 关于“将信息转化为更好的决策”的第 2 部分。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Newnan, Ga.
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Newnan, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 216 Bullsboro Dr. with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from West Georgia Technical College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在纽南开设了最新的商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司为庆祝位于 Bullsboro Dr. 216 号的商店开业，举行了剪彩仪式，当地官员和西乔治亚技术学院的代表在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training and career opportunities through the College’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学院的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to open our newest store in Newnan and continue serving customers across the area,” said Mike Fogarty, Rregional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “This location helps us better support local drivers and professional customers with convenient access to the parts, and products they rely on. We’re also proud to support students at West Georgia Technical College and strengthen our connection to the Newnan community.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Mike Fogarty 表示：“我们很高兴在纽南开设最新的商店，并继续为该地区的客户提供服务。” “这个地点帮助我们更好地支持当地司机和专业客户，方便地获取他们所依赖的零件和产品。我们也很自豪能够为西乔治亚技术学院的学生提供支持，并加强我们与纽南社区的联系。”

paras.en: “Community support plays an important role in career and technical education,” said Brittney Wells, executive director of institutional advancement at West Georgia Technical College. “We are grateful to Advance Auto Parts for this contribution, which helps support our students as they gain practical experience and explore opportunities in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: “社区支持在职业和技术教育中发挥着重要作用，”西乔治亚技术学院机构发展执行主任布里特尼·韦尔斯说。 “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 的这一贡献，这有助于支持我们的学生获得实践经验并探索汽车行业的机会。”

paras.en: The new store also serves as a market hub – a centralized facility designed to improve parts availability and same-day fulfillment across a network of stores, enhancing hard parts coverage for professional customers.
paras.zh: 新商店还充当市场中心——一个集中设施，旨在提高整个商店网络的零件可用性和当日履行能力，从而提高专业客户的硬件零件覆盖率。

articles.title: GSP Launches All-New, Core-Free Brake Caliper Line
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: GSP North America announced the GSP ADVANTEDGE Brake Caliper program, an all-new caliper range that frees distributors from the cost and hassle of managing cores. It’s on display at AAPEX, booth #F14611.
paras.zh: GSP North America 宣布了 GSP ADVANTEDGE 制动卡钳计划，这是一个全新的卡钳系列，可让经销商免于管理核心的成本和麻烦。它在 AAPEX 上展出，展位号：F14611。

paras.en: Every caliper is entirely new, distributors no longer need to handle, store, sort and ship cores back to the supplier, GSP said.
paras.zh: GSP 表示，每个卡钳都是全新的，经销商不再需要处理、存储、分类并将卡钳运回供应商。

paras.en: Every unit is built from the ground up with OE-matched components:
paras.zh: 每个单元均采用与原厂设备匹配的组件从头开始构建：

paras.en: - Precision-cast ductile iron or aluminum bodies and carrier brackets, with precision-machined surfaces and threads
paras.zh: - 精密铸造球墨铸铁或铝主体和托架，具有精密加工的表面和螺纹

paras.en: - OE-specified phenolic or steel pistons to match each braking system
paras.zh: - OE 指定的酚醛或钢活塞，以匹配每个制动系统

paras.en: - OE-grade EPDM seals and boots that hold piston pressure and keep contaminants out
paras.zh: - OE 级 EPDM 密封件和防尘套可保持活塞压力并防止污染物进入

paras.en: - Installation hardware included: copper washers, new banjo bolt and abutment clips
paras.zh: - 安装硬件包括：铜垫圈、新的班卓琴螺栓和基台夹

paras.en: - 100% end-of-line pressure and leak validated before leaving the factory
paras.zh: - 出厂前经过 100% 终端压力和泄漏验证

paras.en: The initial range covers more than 80% of category demand and is expected to reach 95% within 12 months of its formal launch at AAPEX.
paras.zh: 最初的产品系列覆盖了80%以上的品类需求，预计在AAPEX正式推出后12个月内将达到95%。

paras.en: The range is produced at GSP’s new manufacturing facility in Malaysia. GSP’s distribution partners can expect the same high-level quality and execution they have experienced in all GSP lines, the company said.
paras.zh: 该系列产品在 GSP 位于马来西亚的新制造工厂生产。该公司表示，GSP 的分销合作伙伴可以期待与所有 GSP 系列产品相同的高水平质量和执行力。

paras.en: “The GSP ADVANTEDGE Brake Caliper program is designed to improve distributors’ operational performance, increase bay throughput through enhanced quality and, ultimately, give customers restored and reliable braking performance,” said Tom Galla, director of new products for GSP North America.
paras.zh: GSP 北美新产品总监 Tom Galla 表示：“GSP ADVANTEDGE 制动卡钳计划旨在提高经销商的运营绩效，通过提高质量来增加海湾吞吐量，并最终为客户提供恢复且可靠的制动性能。”
